verses.textZh: 亚哈死后，摩押背叛以色列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈死后，摩押背叛以色列。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈死后，摩押背叛以色列。
verses.textEnNiv: After Ahab’s death, Moab rebelled against Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: After the death of Ahab, Moab rebelled against Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.
verses.textEnNlt: After King Ahab’s death, the land of Moab rebelled against Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Moab broke with Israel after the death of Ahab.
verses.textEn: After Ahab’s death, Moab rebelled against Israel.

verses.textZh: 有一天，亚哈谢在撒玛利亚，从楼上的窗户掉下来，他就病了；于是他差派使者，对他们说："你们去求问以革伦的神巴力．西卜，我这个病到底能否复原？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一天，亚哈谢在撒玛利亚，从楼上的窗户掉下来，他就病了；于是他差派使者，对他们说："你们去求问以革伦的神巴力．西卜，我这个病到底能否复原？"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈谢在撒马利亚，一日从楼上的栏杆里掉下来，就病了；于是差遣使者说：「你们去问以革伦的神巴力‧西卜，我这病能好不能好。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now Ahaziah had fallen through the lattice of his upper room in Samaria and injured himself. So he sent messengers, saying to them, "Go and consult Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron, to see if I will recover from this injury."
verses.textEnEsv: Now Ahaziah fell through the lattice in his upper chamber in Samaria, and lay sick; so he sent messengers, telling them, "Go, inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I shall recover from this sickness."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Ahaziah fell through the lattice of his upper room in Samaria, and was injured; so he sent messengers and said to them, "Go, inquire of Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I shall recover from this injury."
verses.textEnNlt: One day Israel’s new king, Ahaziah, fell through the latticework of an upper room at his palace in Samaria and was seriously injured. So he sent messengers to the temple of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, to ask whether he would recover.
verses.textEnNasb: And Ahaziah fell through the window lattice in his upper chamber which was in Samaria, and became ill. So he sent messengers and said to them, "Go, inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I will recover from this sickness."
verses.textEn: Now Ahaziah had fallen through the lattice of his upper room in Samaria and injured himself. So he sent messengers, saying to them, "Go and consult Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron, to see if I will recover from this injury."

verses.textZh: 但耶和华的使者对提斯比人以利亚说："你动身上去迎着撒玛利亚王的使者，对他们说：‘你们去求问以革伦的神巴力．西卜，是因为以色列中没有神吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶和华的使者对提斯比人以利亚说："你动身上去迎着撒玛利亚王的使者，对他们说：‘你们去求问以革伦的神巴力．西卜，是因为以色列中没有神吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 但耶和华的使者对提斯比人以利亚说：「你起来，去迎着撒马利亚王的使者，对他们说：『你们去问以革伦神巴力‧西卜，岂因以色列中没有神吗？』
verses.textEnNiv: But the angel of the Lord said to Elijah the Tishbite, "Go up and meet the messengers of the king of Samaria and ask them, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are going off to consult Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron?’
verses.textEnEsv: But the angel of the Lord said to Elijah the Tishbite, "Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and say to them, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are going to inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron?
verses.textEnNkjv: But the angel of the Lord said to Elijah the Tishbite, "Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and say to them, ‘Isit because thereis no God in Israel that you are going to inquire of Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron?’
verses.textEnNlt: But the angel of the Lord told Elijah, who was from Tishbe, "Go and confront the messengers of the king of Samaria and ask them, ‘Is there no God in Israel? Why are you going to Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, to ask whether the king will recover?
verses.textEnNasb: But the angel of the Lord said to Elijah the Tishbite, "Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria and say to them, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are going to inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron?’
verses.textEn: But the angel of the Lord said to Elijah the Tishbite, "Go up and meet the messengers of the king of Samaria and ask them, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are going off to consult Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron?’

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华这样说：你必不能从你躺上去的那张床上下来，因为你必定死。’"于是以利亚去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华这样说：你必不能从你躺上去的那张床上下来，因为你必定死。’"于是以利亚去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华如此说：『你必不下你所上的床，必定要死！』」以利亚就去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord says: ‘You will not leave the bed you are lying on. You will certainly die!’ " So Elijah went.
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore thus says the Lord , You shall not come down from the bed to which you have gone up, but you shall surely die.’" So Elijah went.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, thus says the Lord: ‘You shall not come down from the bed to which you have gone up, but you shall surely die.’ " So Elijah departed.
verses.textEnNlt: Now, therefore, this is what the Lord says: You will never leave the bed you are lying on; you will surely die.’" So Elijah went to deliver the message.
verses.textEnNasb: Now therefore, this is what the Lord says: ‘ You will not get down from the bed upon which you have lain, but you shall certainly die.’ " Then Elijah departed.
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord says: ‘You will not leave the bed you are lying on. You will certainly die!’ " So Elijah went.

verses.textZh: 众使者回到亚哈谢那里；他对他们说："你们为甚么回来呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众使者回到亚哈谢那里；他对他们说："你们为甚么回来呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 使者回来见王，王问他们说：「你们为什么回来呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: When the messengers returned to the king, he asked them, "Why have you come back?"
verses.textEnEsv: The messengers returned to the king, and he said to them, "Why have you returned?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the messengers returned to him, he said to them, "Why have you come back?"
verses.textEnNlt: When the messengers returned to the king, he asked them, "Why have you returned so soon?"
verses.textEnNasb: When the messengers returned to Ahaziah, he said to them, " Why have you returned?"
verses.textEn: When the messengers returned to the king, he asked them, "Why have you come back?"

verses.textZh: 他们对王说："有一个人上来迎着我们，又对我们说：‘去吧，回到那差派你们的王那里，对他说：耶和华这样说：你派人去求问以革伦的神巴力．西卜，是因为以色列中没有神吗？因此，你必不能从你躺上去的那张床上下来，因为你必定死。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对王说："有一个人上来迎着我们，又对我们说：‘去吧，回到那差派你们的王那里，对他说：耶和华这样说：你派人去求问以革伦的神巴力．西卜，是因为以色列中没有神吗？因此，你必不能从你躺上去的那张床上下来，因为你必定死。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 使者回答说：「有一个人迎着我们来，对我们说：『你们回去见差你们来的王，对他说：耶和华如此说，你差人去问以革伦神巴力‧西卜，岂因以色列中没有神吗？所以你必不下所上的床，必定要死。』」
verses.textEnNiv: "A man came to meet us," they replied. "And he said to us, ‘Go back to the king who sent you and tell him, "This is what the Lord says: Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are sending messengers to consult Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you will not leave the bed you are lying on. You will certainly die!" ’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And they said to him, "There came a man to meet us, and said to us, ‘Go back to the king who sent you, and say to him, Thus says the Lord , Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are sending to inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you shall not come down from the bed to which you have gone up, but you shall surely die.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: So they said to him, "A man came up to meet us, and said to us, ‘Go, return to the king who sent you, and say to him, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Isit because thereis no God in Israel that you are sending to inquire of Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you shall not come down from the bed to which you have gone up, but you shall surely die.’ " ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: They replied, "A man came up to us and told us to go back to the king and give him this message. ‘This is what the Lord says: Is there no God in Israel? Why are you sending men to Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, to ask whether you will recover? Therefore, because you have done this, you will never leave the bed you are lying on; you will surely die.’"
verses.textEnNasb: They said to him, "A man came up to meet us and said to us, ‘Go, return to the king who sent you and say to him, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are sending messengers to inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you will not get down from the bed upon which you have lain, but you shall certainly die.’ " ’ "
verses.textEn: "A man came to meet us," they replied. "And he said to us, ‘Go back to the king who sent you and tell him, "This is what the Lord says: Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are sending messengers to consult Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you will not leave the bed you are lying on. You will certainly die!" ’ "

verses.textZh: 王对他们说："那上来迎着你们，又对你们说这番话的是个怎样的人？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王对他们说："那上来迎着你们，又对你们说这番话的是个怎样的人？"
verses.textZhCuv: 王问他们说：「迎着你们来告诉你们这话的，是怎样的人？」
verses.textEnNiv: The king asked them, "What kind of man was it who came to meet you and told you this?"
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "What kind of man was he who came to meet you and told you these things?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to them, "What kind of man wasit who came up to meet you and told you these words?"
verses.textEnNlt: "What sort of man was he?" the king demanded. "What did he look like?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to them, "What did the man look like, who came up to meet you and spoke these words to you?"
verses.textEn: The king asked them, "What kind of man was it who came to meet you and told you this?"

verses.textZh: 他们对王说："那人穿著毛皮衣，腰间束上皮带。"王说："这人必是提斯比人以利亚。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对王说："那人穿著毛皮衣，腰间束上皮带。"王说："这人必是提斯比人以利亚。"
verses.textZhCuv: 回答说：「他身穿毛衣，腰束皮带。」王说：「这必是提斯比人以利亚。」
verses.textEnNiv: They replied, "He had a garment of hair and had a leather belt around his waist." The king said, "That was Elijah the Tishbite."
verses.textEnEsv: They answered him, "He wore a garment of hair, with a belt of leather about his waist." And he said, "It is Elijah the Tishbite."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they answered him, "A hairy man wearing a leather belt around his waist." And he said, "It is Elijah the Tishbite."
verses.textEnNlt: They replied, "He was a hairy man, and he wore a leather belt around his waist." "Elijah from Tishbe!" the king exclaimed.
verses.textEnNasb: And they said to him, "He was a hairy man with a leather belt worn around his waist." And he said, "It is Elijah the Tishbite."
verses.textEn: They replied, "He had a garment of hair and had a leather belt around his waist." The king said, "That was Elijah the Tishbite."

verses.textZh: 于是王差派一个五十夫长和他的五十名手下到以利亚那里；那位五十夫长就上到以利亚那里去。他看见以利亚正坐在山顶上，就对以利亚说："神人哪！王吩咐你下来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是王差派一个五十夫长和他的五十名手下到以利亚那里；那位五十夫长就上到以利亚那里去。他看见以利亚正坐在山顶上，就对以利亚说："神人哪！王吩咐你下来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，王差遣五十夫长，带领五十人去见以利亚，他就上到以利亚那里；以利亚正坐在山顶上。五十夫长对他说：「神人哪，王吩咐你下来！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he sent to Elijah a captain with his company of fifty men. The captain went up to Elijah, who was sitting on the top of a hill, and said to him, "Man of God, the king says, ‘Come down!’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king sent to him a captain of fifty men with his fifty. He went up to Elijah, who was sitting on the top of a hill, and said to him, "O man of God, the king says, ‘Come down.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king sent to him a captain of fifty with his fifty men. So he went up to him; and there he was, sitting on the top of a hill. And he spoke to him: "Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down!’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then he sent an army captain with fifty soldiers to arrest him. They found him sitting on top of a hill. The captain said to him, "Man of God, the king has commanded you to come down with us."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king sent to him a captain of fifty with his fifty men. And he went up to him, and behold, he was sitting on the top of the hill. And he said to him, "You man of God, the king says, ‘Come down.’ "
verses.textEn: Then he sent to Elijah a captain with his company of fifty men. The captain went up to Elijah, who was sitting on the top of a hill, and said to him, "Man of God, the king says, ‘Come down!’ "

verses.textZh: 以利亚回答五十夫长说："如果我是神人，愿火从天降下，把你和你的五十名手下吞灭。"于是有火从天降下，吞灭了五十夫长和他的五十名手下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚回答五十夫长说："如果我是神人，愿火从天降下，把你和你的五十名手下吞灭。"于是有火从天降下，吞灭了五十夫长和他的五十名手下。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚回答说：「我若是神人，愿火从天上降下来，烧灭你和你那五十人！」于是有火从天上降下来，烧灭五十夫长和他那五十人。
verses.textEnNiv: Elijah answered the captain, "If I am a man of God, may fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men!" Then fire fell from heaven and consumed the captain and his men.
verses.textEnEsv: But Elijah answered the captain of fifty, "If I am a man of God, let fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty." Then fire came down from heaven and consumed him and his fifty.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, "If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men." And fire came down from heaven and consumed him and his fifty.
verses.textEnNlt: But Elijah replied to the captain, "If I am a man of God, let fire come down from heaven and destroy you and your fifty men!" Then fire fell from heaven and killed them all.
verses.textEnNasb: But Elijah replied to the captain of fifty, "If I am a man of God, may fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty." Then fire came down from heaven and consumed him and his fifty men.
verses.textEn: Elijah answered the captain, "If I am a man of God, may fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men!" Then fire fell from heaven and consumed the captain and his men.

verses.textZh: 王再次派一个五十夫长和他的五十名手下到以利亚那里去。那五十夫长对以利亚说："神人哪！王这样吩咐：‘你赶快下来。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王再次派一个五十夫长和他的五十名手下到以利亚那里去。那五十夫长对以利亚说："神人哪！王这样吩咐：‘你赶快下来。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 王第二次差遣一个五十夫长，带领五十人去见以利亚。五十夫长对以利亚说：「神人哪，王吩咐你快快下来！」
verses.textEnNiv: At this the king sent to Elijah another captain with his fifty men. The captain said to him, "Man of God, this is what the king says, ‘Come down at once!’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Again the king sent to him another captain of fifty men with his fifty. And he answered and said to him, "O man of God, this is the king’s order, ‘Come down quickly!’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he sent to him another captain of fifty with his fifty men. And he answered and said to him: "Man of God, thus has the king said, ‘Come down quickly!’ "
verses.textEnNlt: So the king sent another captain with fifty men. The captain said to him, "Man of God, the king demands that you come down at once."
verses.textEnNasb: So the king again sent to him another captain of fifty with his fifty men. And he said to him, "You man of God, this is what the king says: ‘Come down quickly!’ "
verses.textEn: At this the king sent to Elijah another captain with his fifty men. The captain said to him, "Man of God, this is what the king says, ‘Come down at once!’ "

verses.textZh: 以利亚回答他们说："如果我是神人，愿火从天降下，把你和你的五十名手下吞灭。"于是神的火从天降下，吞灭了五十夫长和他的五十名手下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚回答他们说："如果我是神人，愿火从天降下，把你和你的五十名手下吞灭。"于是神的火从天降下，吞灭了五十夫长和他的五十名手下。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚回答说：「我若是神人，愿火从天上降下来，烧灭你和你那五十人！」于是神的火从天上降下来，烧灭五十夫长和他那五十人。
verses.textEnNiv: "If I am a man of God," Elijah replied, "may fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men!" Then the fire of God fell from heaven and consumed him and his fifty men.
verses.textEnEsv: But Elijah answered them, "If I am a man of God, let fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty." Then the fire of God came down from heaven and consumed him and his fifty.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Elijah answered and said to them, "If I am a man of God, let fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men." And the fire of God came down from heaven and consumed him and his fifty.
verses.textEnNlt: Elijah replied, "If I am a man of God, let fire come down from heaven and destroy you and your fifty men!" And again the fire of God fell from heaven and killed them all.
verses.textEnNasb: But Elijah replied to them, "If I am a man of God, may fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty." Then the fire of God came down from heaven and consumed him and his fifty men.
verses.textEn: "If I am a man of God," Elijah replied, "may fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men!" Then the fire of God fell from heaven and consumed him and his fifty men.

verses.textZh: 王又派出第三名五十夫长和他的五十名手下；那五十夫长来到，就双膝跪在以利亚面前，恳求他，对他说："神人哪！愿我的性命和这五十个仆人的性命在你眼中看为宝贵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王又派出第三名五十夫长和他的五十名手下；那五十夫长来到，就双膝跪在以利亚面前，恳求他，对他说："神人哪！愿我的性命和这五十个仆人的性命在你眼中看为宝贵。
verses.textZhCuv: 王第三次差遣一个五十夫长，带领五十人去。这五十夫长上去，双膝跪在以利亚面前，哀求他说：「神人哪，愿我的性命和你这五十个仆人的性命在你眼前看为宝贵！
verses.textEnNiv: So the king sent a third captain with his fifty men. This third captain went up and fell on his knees before Elijah. "Man of God," he begged, "please have respect for my life and the lives of these fifty men, your servants!
verses.textEnEsv: Again the king sent the captain of a third fifty with his fifty. And the third captain of fifty went up and came and fell on his knees before Elijah and entreated him, "O man of God, please let my life, and the life of these fifty servants of yours, be precious in your sight.
verses.textEnNkjv: Again, he sent a third captain of fifty with his fifty men. And the third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and pleaded with him, and said to him: "Man of God, please let my life and the life of these fifty servants of yours be precious in your sight.
verses.textEnNlt: Once more the king sent a third captain with fifty men. But this time the captain went up the hill and fell to his knees before Elijah. He pleaded with him, "O man of God, please spare my life and the lives of these, your fifty servants.
verses.textEnNasb: So the king again sent the captain of a third fifty with his fifty men. When the third captain of fifty went up, he came and bowed down on his knees before Elijah, and begged him and said to him, "You man of God, please let my life and the lives of these fifty servants of yours be precious in your sight.
verses.textEn: So the king sent a third captain with his fifty men. This third captain went up and fell on his knees before Elijah. "Man of God," he begged, "please have respect for my life and the lives of these fifty men, your servants!

verses.textZh: 看哪！曾经有火从天降下，吞灭了先前两个五十夫长和他们各五十名手下；现在，愿我的性命在你眼中看为宝贵。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！曾经有火从天降下，吞灭了先前两个五十夫长和他们各五十名手下；现在，愿我的性命在你眼中看为宝贵。"
verses.textZhCuv: 已经有火从天上降下来，烧灭前两次来的五十夫长和他们各自带的五十人；现在愿我的性命在你眼前看为宝贵！」
verses.textEnNiv: See, fire has fallen from heaven and consumed the first two captains and all their men. But now have respect for my life!"
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, fire came down from heaven and consumed the two former captains of fifty men with their fifties, but now let my life be precious in your sight."
verses.textEnNkjv: Look, fire has come down from heaven and burned up the first two captains of fifties with their fifties. But let my life now be precious in your sight."
verses.textEnNlt: See how the fire from heaven came down and destroyed the first two groups. But now please spare my life!"
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, fire came down from heaven and consumed the first two captains of fifty with their fifties; but now let my life be precious in your sight."
verses.textEn: See, fire has fallen from heaven and consumed the first two captains and all their men. But now have respect for my life!"

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者对以利亚说："你和他下去吧，不要怕他。"于是以利亚起来，和他下山到王那里去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者对以利亚说："你和他下去吧，不要怕他。"于是以利亚起来，和他下山到王那里去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者对以利亚说：「你同着他下去，不要怕他！」以利亚就起来，同着他下去见王，
verses.textEnNiv: The angel of the Lord said to Elijah, "Go down with him; do not be afraid of him." So Elijah got up and went down with him to the king.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the angel of the Lord said to Elijah, "Go down with him; do not be afraid of him." So he arose and went down with him to the king
verses.textEnNkjv: And the angel of the Lord said to Elijah, "Go down with him; do not be afraid of him." So he arose and went down with him to the king.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the angel of the Lord said to Elijah, "Go down with him, and don’t be afraid of him." So Elijah got up and went with him to the king.
verses.textEnNasb: And the angel of the Lord said to Elijah, "Go down with him; do not be afraid of him." So he got up and went down with him to the king.
verses.textEn: The angel of the Lord said to Elijah, "Go down with him; do not be afraid of him." So Elijah got up and went down with him to the king.

verses.textZh: 以利亚对亚哈谢说："耶和华这样说：‘你差派使者去求问以革伦的神巴力．西卜，是因为以色列中没有神可以求问吗？因此，你必不能从你躺上去的那张床上下来，因为你必定死。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚对亚哈谢说："耶和华这样说：‘你差派使者去求问以革伦的神巴力．西卜，是因为以色列中没有神可以求问吗？因此，你必不能从你躺上去的那张床上下来，因为你必定死。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 对王说：「耶和华如此说：『你差人去问以革伦神巴力‧西卜，岂因以色列中没有神可以求问吗？所以你必不下所上的床，必定要死！』」
verses.textEnNiv: He told the king, "This is what the Lord says: Is it because there is no God in Israel for you to consult that you have sent messengers to consult Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron? Because you have done this, you will never leave the bed you are lying on. You will certainly die!"
verses.textEnEsv: and said to him, "Thus says the Lord , ‘Because you have sent messengers to inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron—is it because there is no God in Israel to inquire of his word?—therefore you shall not come down from the bed to which you have gone up, but you shall surely die.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to him, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Because you have sent messengers to inquire of Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron, isit because thereis no God in Israel to inquire of His word? Therefore you shall not come down from the bed to which you have gone up, but you shall surely die.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And Elijah said to the king, "This is what the Lord says: Why did you send messengers to Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, to ask whether you will recover? Is there no God in Israel to answer your question? Therefore, because you have done this, you will never leave the bed you are lying on; you will surely die."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to him, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Since you have sent messengers to inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron—is it because there is no God in Israel to inquire of His word? Therefore you will not get down from the bed upon which you have lain, but you shall certainly die.’ "
verses.textEn: He told the king, "This is what the Lord says: Is it because there is no God in Israel for you to consult that you have sent messengers to consult Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron? Because you have done this, you will never leave the bed you are lying on. You will certainly die!"

verses.textZh: 亚哈谢果然死了，正如耶和华藉以利亚所宣告的话。因为他没有儿子，他的弟弟约兰就接续他作王，那时是犹大王约沙法的儿子约兰第二年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈谢果然死了，正如耶和华藉以利亚所宣告的话。因为他没有儿子，他的弟弟约兰就接续他作王，那时是犹大王约沙法的儿子约兰第二年。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈谢果然死了，正如耶和华藉以利亚所说的话。因他没有儿子，他兄弟约兰接续他作王，正在犹大王约沙法的儿子约兰第二年。
verses.textEnNiv: So he died, according to the word of the Lord that Elijah had spoken. Because Ahaziah had no son, Joram succeeded him as king in the second year of Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: So he died according to the word of the Lord that Elijah had spoken. Jehoram became king in his place in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, because Ahaziah had no son.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ahaziah died according to the word of the Lord which Elijah had spoken. Because he had no son, Jehoram became king in his place, in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: So Ahaziah died, just as the Lord had promised through Elijah. Since Ahaziah did not have a son to succeed him, his brother Joram became the next king. This took place in the second year of the reign of Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: So Ahaziah died in accordance with the word of the Lord which Elijah had spoken. And since he had no son, Jehoram became king in his place in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah.
verses.textEn: So he died, according to the word of the Lord that Elijah had spoken. Because Ahaziah had no son, Joram succeeded him as king in the second year of Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah.

verses.textZh: 亚哈谢其余所行的事迹，不是都写在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈谢其余所行的事迹，不是都写在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈谢其余所行的事都写在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for all the other events of Ahaziah’s reign, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Ahaziah’s reign and everything he did are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEn: As for all the other events of Ahaziah’s reign, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

verses.textZh: 耶和华将要用旋风接以利亚往天上去的时候，以利亚和以利沙一起离开吉甲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华将要用旋风接以利亚往天上去的时候，以利亚和以利沙一起离开吉甲。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华要用旋风接以利亚升天的时候，以利亚与以利沙从吉甲前往。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord was about to take Elijah up to heaven in a whirlwind, Elijah and Elisha were on their way from Gilgal.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when the Lord was about to take Elijah up to heaven by a whirlwind, Elijah and Elisha were on their way from Gilgal.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when the Lord was about to take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lord was about to take Elijah up to heaven in a whirlwind, Elijah and Elisha were traveling from Gilgal.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about, when the Lord was about to bring Elijah up by a whirlwind to heaven, that Elijah left Gilgal with Elisha.
verses.textEn: When the Lord was about to take Elijah up to heaven in a whirlwind, Elijah and Elisha were on their way from Gilgal.

verses.textZh: 以利亚对以利沙说："你留在这里吧，因为耶和华差派我到伯特利去。"以利沙说："我指着永活的耶和华和你的性命起誓：我必不离开你。"于是他们下到伯特利去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚对以利沙说："你留在这里吧，因为耶和华差派我到伯特利去。"以利沙说："我指着永活的耶和华和你的性命起誓：我必不离开你。"于是他们下到伯特利去。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚对以利沙说：「耶和华差我往伯特利去，你可以在这里等候。」以利沙说：「我指着永生的耶和华，又敢在你面前起誓，我必不离开你。」于是二人下到伯特利。
verses.textEnNiv: Elijah said to Elisha, "Stay here; the Lord has sent me to Bethel." But Elisha said, "As surely as the Lord lives and as you live, I will not leave you." So they went down to Bethel.
verses.textEnEsv: And Elijah said to Elisha, "Please stay here, for the Lord has sent me as far as Bethel." But Elisha said, "As the Lord lives, and as you yourself live, I will not leave you." So they went down to Bethel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Elijah said to Elisha, "Stay here, please, for the Lord has sent me on to Bethel." But Elisha said, "As the Lord lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you!" So they went down to Bethel.
verses.textEnNlt: And Elijah said to Elisha, "Stay here, for the Lord has told me to go to Bethel." But Elisha replied, "As surely as the Lord lives and you yourself live, I will never leave you!" So they went down together to Bethel.
verses.textEnNasb: And Elijah said to Elisha, "Stay here please, for the Lord has sent me as far as Bethel." But Elisha said, "As surely as the Lord lives and as you yourself live, I will not leave you." So they went down to Bethel.
verses.textEn: Elijah said to Elisha, "Stay here; the Lord has sent me to Bethel." But Elisha said, "As surely as the Lord lives and as you live, I will not leave you." So they went down to Bethel.

verses.textZh: 在伯特利的先知门徒出来见以利沙，对他说："你知道今天耶和华要接你的老师离开你吗？"他说："我已经知道了，你们别再多说。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在伯特利的先知门徒出来见以利沙，对他说："你知道今天耶和华要接你的老师离开你吗？"他说："我已经知道了，你们别再多说。"
verses.textZhCuv: 住伯特利的先知门徒出来见以利沙，对他说：「耶和华今日要接你的师傅离开你，你知道不知道？」他说：「我知道，你们不要作声。」
verses.textEnNiv: The company of the prophets at Bethel came out to Elisha and asked, "Do you know that the Lord is going to take your master from you today?" "Yes, I know," Elisha replied, "so be quiet."
verses.textEnEsv: And the sons of the prophets who were in Bethel came out to Elisha and said to him, "Do you know that today the Lord will take away your master from over you?" And he said, "Yes, I know it; keep quiet."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the sons of the prophets who were at Bethel came out to Elisha, and said to him, "Do you know that the Lord will take away your master from over you today?" And he said, "Yes, I know; keep silent!"
verses.textEnNlt: The group of prophets from Bethel came to Elisha and asked him, "Did you know that the Lord is going to take your master away from you today?" "Of course I know," Elisha answered. "But be quiet about it."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of the prophets who were at Bethel went out to Elisha and said to him, "Are you aware that the Lord will take away your master from over you today?" And he said, "Yes, I am aware; say nothing about it."
verses.textEn: The company of the prophets at Bethel came out to Elisha and asked, "Do you know that the Lord is going to take your master from you today?" "Yes, I know," Elisha replied, "so be quiet."

verses.textZh: 以利亚对以利沙说："你留在这里吧，因为耶和华差派我往耶利哥。"他说："我指着永活的耶和华和你的性命起誓：我必不离开你。"于是他们来到耶利哥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚对以利沙说："你留在这里吧，因为耶和华差派我往耶利哥。"他说："我指着永活的耶和华和你的性命起誓：我必不离开你。"于是他们来到耶利哥。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚对以利沙说：「耶和华差遣我往耶利哥去，你可以在这里等候。」以利沙说：「我指着永生的耶和华，又敢在你面前起誓，我必不离开你。」于是二人到了耶利哥。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Elijah said to him, "Stay here, Elisha; the Lord has sent me to Jericho." And he replied, "As surely as the Lord lives and as you live, I will not leave you." So they went to Jericho.
verses.textEnEsv: Elijah said to him, "Elisha, please stay here, for the Lord has sent me to Jericho." But he said, "As the Lord lives, and as you yourself live, I will not leave you." So they came to Jericho.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Elijah said to him, "Elisha, stay here, please, for the Lord has sent me on to Jericho." But he said, "As the Lord lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you!" So they came to Jericho.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elijah said to Elisha, "Stay here, for the Lord has told me to go to Jericho." But Elisha replied again, "As surely as the Lord lives and you yourself live, I will never leave you." So they went on together to Jericho.
verses.textEnNasb: And Elijah said to him, "Elisha, please stay here, for the Lord has sent me to Jericho." But he said, "As surely as the Lord lives, and as you yourself live, I will not leave you." So they came to Jericho.
verses.textEn: Then Elijah said to him, "Stay here, Elisha; the Lord has sent me to Jericho." And he replied, "As surely as the Lord lives and as you live, I will not leave you." So they went to Jericho.

verses.textZh: 在耶利哥的先知门徒前来见以利沙，对他说："你知道今天耶和华要接你的老师离开你吗？"他说："我已经知道了，你们别再多说。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶利哥的先知门徒前来见以利沙，对他说："你知道今天耶和华要接你的老师离开你吗？"他说："我已经知道了，你们别再多说。"
verses.textZhCuv: 住耶利哥的先知门徒就近以利沙，对他说：「耶和华今日要接你的师傅离开你，你知道不知道？」他说：「我知道，你们不要作声。」
verses.textEnNiv: The company of the prophets at Jericho went up to Elisha and asked him, "Do you know that the Lord is going to take your master from you today?" "Yes, I know," he replied, "so be quiet."
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of the prophets who were at Jericho drew near to Elisha and said to him, "Do you know that today the Lord will take away your master from over you?" And he answered, "Yes, I know it; keep quiet."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the sons of the prophets who were at Jericho came to Elisha and said to him, "Do you know that the Lord will take away your master from over you today?" So he answered, "Yes, I know; keep silent!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then the group of prophets from Jericho came to Elisha and asked him, "Did you know that the Lord is going to take your master away from you today?" "Of course I know," Elisha answered. "But be quiet about it."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of the prophets who were at Jericho approached Elisha and said to him, "Do you know that the Lord will take away your master from over you today?" And he answered, "Yes, I know; say nothing about it."
verses.textEn: The company of the prophets at Jericho went up to Elisha and asked him, "Do you know that the Lord is going to take your master from you today?" "Yes, I know," he replied, "so be quiet."

verses.textZh: 以利亚对他说："你留在这里吧，因为耶和华差派我往约旦河去。"以利沙说："我指着永活的耶和华和你的性命起誓：我必不离开你。"于是他们二人继续前行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚对他说："你留在这里吧，因为耶和华差派我往约旦河去。"以利沙说："我指着永活的耶和华和你的性命起誓：我必不离开你。"于是他们二人继续前行。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚对以利沙说：「耶和华差遣我往约旦河去，你可以在这里等候。」以利沙说：「我指着永生的耶和华，又敢在你面前起誓，我必不离开你。」于是二人一同前往。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Elijah said to him, "Stay here; the Lord has sent me to the Jordan." And he replied, "As surely as the Lord lives and as you live, I will not leave you." So the two of them walked on.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Elijah said to him, "Please stay here, for the Lord has sent me to the Jordan." But he said, "As the Lord lives, and as you yourself live, I will not leave you." So the two of them went on.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Elijah said to him, "Stay here, please, for the Lord has sent me on to the Jordan." But he said, "As the Lord lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you!" So the two of them went on.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elijah said to Elisha, "Stay here, for the Lord has told me to go to the Jordan River." But again Elisha replied, "As surely as the Lord lives and you yourself live, I will never leave you." So they went on together.
verses.textEnNasb: And Elijah said to him, "Please stay here, for the Lord has sent me to the Jordan." But he said, "As surely as the Lord lives, and as you yourself live, I will not leave you." So the two of them went on.
verses.textEn: Then Elijah said to him, "Stay here; the Lord has sent me to the Jordan." And he replied, "As surely as the Lord lives and as you live, I will not leave you." So the two of them walked on.

verses.textZh: 先知门徒中有五十人跟着他们，远远地站在他们对面；他们二人在约旦河河边站着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 先知门徒中有五十人跟着他们，远远地站在他们对面；他们二人在约旦河河边站着。
verses.textZhCuv: 有先知门徒去了五十人，远远地站在他们对面；二人在约旦河边站住。
verses.textEnNiv: Fifty men from the company of the prophets went and stood at a distance, facing the place where Elijah and Elisha had stopped at the Jordan.
verses.textEnEsv: Fifty men of the sons of the prophets also went and stood at some distance from them, as they both were standing by the Jordan.
verses.textEnNkjv: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went and stood facing them at a distance, while the two of them stood by the Jordan.
verses.textEnNlt: Fifty men from the group of prophets also went and watched from a distance as Elijah and Elisha stopped beside the Jordan River.
verses.textEnNasb: Now fifty men of the sons of the prophets went and stood opposite them at a distance, while the two of them stood by the Jordan.
verses.textEn: Fifty men from the company of the prophets went and stood at a distance, facing the place where Elijah and Elisha had stopped at the Jordan.

verses.textZh: 以利亚拿着自己的外衣，把它卷起，击打河水，河水就左右分开，他们二人就在干地上走过去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚拿着自己的外衣，把它卷起，击打河水，河水就左右分开，他们二人就在干地上走过去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚将自己的外衣卷起来，用以打水，水就左右分开，二人走干地而过。
verses.textEnNiv: Elijah took his cloak, rolled it up and struck the water with it. The water divided to the right and to the left, and the two of them crossed over on dry ground.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Elijah took his cloak and rolled it up and struck the water, and the water was parted to the one side and to the other, till the two of them could go over on dry ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Elijah took his mantle, rolled it up, and struck the water; and it was divided this way and that, so that the two of them crossed over on dry ground.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elijah folded his cloak together and struck the water with it. The river divided, and the two of them went across on dry ground!
verses.textEnNasb: And Elijah took his coat, folded it, and struck the waters, and they were divided here and there, so that the two of them crossed over on dry ground.
verses.textEn: Elijah took his cloak, rolled it up and struck the water with it. The water divided to the right and to the left, and the two of them crossed over on dry ground.

verses.textZh: 他们过去之后，以利亚对以利沙说："在我没有被接离开你以先，我可以为你作些甚么，你尽管求吧！"以利沙说："求你使你的灵双倍地临到我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们过去之后，以利亚对以利沙说："在我没有被接离开你以先，我可以为你作些甚么，你尽管求吧！"以利沙说："求你使你的灵双倍地临到我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 过去之后，以利亚对以利沙说：「我未曾被接去离开你，你要我为你做什么，只管求我。」以利沙说：「愿感动你的灵加倍地感动我。」
verses.textEnNiv: When they had crossed, Elijah said to Elisha, "Tell me, what can I do for you before I am taken from you?" "Let me inherit a double portion of your spirit," Elisha replied.
verses.textEnEsv: When they had crossed, Elijah said to Elisha, "Ask what I shall do for you, before I am taken from you." And Elisha said, "Please let there be a double portion of your spirit on me."
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, when they had crossed over, that Elijah said to Elisha, "Ask! What may I do for you, before I am taken away from you?" Elisha said, "Please let a double portion of your spirit be upon me."
verses.textEnNlt: When they came to the other side, Elijah said to Elisha, "Tell me what I can do for you before I am taken away." And Elisha replied, "Please let me inherit a double share of your spirit and become your successor."
verses.textEnNasb: When they had crossed over, Elijah said to Elisha, "Ask me what I should do for you before I am taken from you." And Elisha said, "Please let a double portion of your spirit be upon me."
verses.textEn: When they had crossed, Elijah said to Elisha, "Tell me, what can I do for you before I am taken from you?" "Let me inherit a double portion of your spirit," Elisha replied.

verses.textZh: 以利亚说："你所求的是一件难事，不过我被接离开你的时候，如果你看见我，就必得着，否则就得不着了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚说："你所求的是一件难事，不过我被接离开你的时候，如果你看见我，就必得着，否则就得不着了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚说：「你所求的难得。虽然如此，我被接去离开你的时候，你若看见我，就必得着；不然，必得不着了。」
verses.textEnNiv: "You have asked a difficult thing," Elijah said, "yet if you see me when I am taken from you, it will be yours—otherwise, it will not."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "You have asked a hard thing; yet, if you see me as I am being taken from you, it shall be so for you, but if you do not see me, it shall not be so."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said, "You have asked a hard thing. Nevertheless, if you see me whenIam taken from you, it shall be so for you; but if not, it shall not be so."
verses.textEnNlt: "You have asked a difficult thing," Elijah replied. "If you see me when I am taken from you, then you will get your request. But if not, then you won’t."
verses.textEnNasb: He said, "You have asked a hard thing. Nevertheless, if you see me when I am taken from you, it shall be so for you; but if not, it shall not be so."
verses.textEn: "You have asked a difficult thing," Elijah said, "yet if you see me when I am taken from you, it will be yours—otherwise, it will not."

verses.textZh: 他们边走边谈的时候，忽然，有火车火马把他们二人分开，以利亚就在旋风中被接往天上去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们边走边谈的时候，忽然，有火车火马把他们二人分开，以利亚就在旋风中被接往天上去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们正走着说话，忽有火车火马将二人隔开，以利亚就乘旋风升天去了。
verses.textEnNiv: As they were walking along and talking together, suddenly a chariot of fire and horses of fire appeared and separated the two of them, and Elijah went up to heaven in a whirlwind.
verses.textEnEsv: And as they still went on and talked, behold, chariots of fire and horses of fire separated the two of them. And Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it happened, as they continued on and talked, that suddenly a chariot of fire appeared with horses of fire, and separated the two of them; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: As they were walking along and talking, suddenly a chariot of fire appeared, drawn by horses of fire. It drove between the two men, separating them, and Elijah was carried by a whirlwind into heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: And as they were walking along and talking, behold, a chariot of fire appeared with horses of fire, and they separated the two of them. Then Elijah went up by a whirlwind to heaven.
verses.textEn: As they were walking along and talking together, suddenly a chariot of fire and horses of fire appeared and separated the two of them, and Elijah went up to heaven in a whirlwind.

verses.textZh: 以利沙看见，就喊叫："我父！我父！以色列的战车马兵啊！"跟着就不再看见他了。以利沙抓住自己的衣服，把它撕成两片。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙看见，就喊叫："我父！我父！以色列的战车马兵啊！"跟着就不再看见他了。以利沙抓住自己的衣服，把它撕成两片。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙看见，就呼叫说：「我父啊！我父啊！以色列的战车马兵啊！」以后不再见他了。于是以利沙把自己的衣服撕为两片。
verses.textEnNiv: Elisha saw this and cried out, "My father! My father! The chariots and horsemen of Israel!" And Elisha saw him no more. Then he took hold of his garment and tore it in two.
verses.textEnEsv: And Elisha saw it and he cried, "My father, my father! The chariots of Israel and its horsemen!" And he saw him no more. Then he took hold of his own clothes and tore them in two pieces.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Elisha saw it, and he cried out, "My father, my father, the chariot of Israel and its horsemen!" So he saw him no more. And he took hold of his own clothes and tore them into two pieces.
verses.textEnNlt: Elisha saw it and cried out, "My father! My father! I see the chariots and charioteers of Israel!" And as they disappeared from sight, Elisha tore his clothes in distress.
verses.textEnNasb: And Elisha was watching it and he was crying out, "My father, my father, the chariot of Israel and its horsemen!" And he did not see Elijah again. Then he took hold of his own clothes and tore them in two pieces.
verses.textEn: Elisha saw this and cried out, "My father! My father! The chariots and horsemen of Israel!" And Elisha saw him no more. Then he took hold of his garment and tore it in two.

verses.textZh: 他拾起以利亚身上掉下来的外衣，就回去，站在约旦河河边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他拾起以利亚身上掉下来的外衣，就回去，站在约旦河河边。
verses.textZhCuv: 他拾起以利亚身上掉下来的外衣，回去站在约旦河边。
verses.textEnNiv: Elisha then picked up Elijah’s cloak that had fallen from him and went back and stood on the bank of the Jordan.
verses.textEnEsv: And he took up the cloak of Elijah that had fallen from him and went back and stood on the bank of the Jordan.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also took up the mantle of Elijah that had fallen from him, and went back and stood by the bank of the Jordan.
verses.textEnNlt: Elisha picked up Elijah’s cloak, which had fallen when he was taken up. Then Elisha returned to the bank of the Jordan River.
verses.textEnNasb: He also took up the coat of Elijah that had fallen from him, and he went back and stood by the bank of the Jordan.
verses.textEn: Elisha then picked up Elijah’s cloak that had fallen from him and went back and stood on the bank of the Jordan.

verses.textZh: 他拿着从以利亚身上掉下来的外衣，击打河水，说："耶和华以利亚的神在哪里呢？"他一击打河水，河水就左右分开，以利沙就走过去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他拿着从以利亚身上掉下来的外衣，击打河水，说："耶和华以利亚的神在哪里呢？"他一击打河水，河水就左右分开，以利沙就走过去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用以利亚身上掉下来的外衣打水，说：「耶和华－以利亚的神在哪里呢？」打水之后，水也左右分开，以利沙就过来了。
verses.textEnNiv: He took the cloak that had fallen from Elijah and struck the water with it. "Where now is the Lord , the God of Elijah?" he asked. When he struck the water, it divided to the right and to the left, and he crossed over.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he took the cloak of Elijah that had fallen from him and struck the water, saying, "Where is the Lord , the God of Elijah?" And when he had struck the water, the water was parted to the one side and to the other, and Elisha went over.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he took the mantle of Elijah that had fallen from him, and struck the water, and said, "Where is the Lord God of Elijah?" And when he also had struck the water, it was divided this way and that; and Elisha crossed over.
verses.textEnNlt: He struck the water with Elijah’s cloak and cried out, "Where is the Lord , the God of Elijah?" Then the river divided, and Elisha went across.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he took the coat of Elijah that had fallen from him and struck the waters, and said, "Where is the Lord, the God of Elijah?" And when he also had struck the waters, they were divided here and there; and Elisha crossed over.
verses.textEn: He took the cloak that had fallen from Elijah and struck the water with it. "Where now is the Lord , the God of Elijah?" he asked. When he struck the water, it divided to the right and to the left, and he crossed over.

verses.textZh: 那些耶利哥的先知门徒在远处看见，就说："以利亚的灵在以利沙身上了。"他们就来迎接他，俯伏在地拜他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些耶利哥的先知门徒在远处看见，就说："以利亚的灵在以利沙身上了。"他们就来迎接他，俯伏在地拜他。
verses.textZhCuv: 住耶利哥的先知门徒从对面看见他，就说：「感动以利亚的灵感动以利沙了。」他们就来迎接他，在他面前俯伏于地，
verses.textEnNiv: The company of the prophets from Jericho, who were watching, said, "The spirit of Elijah is resting on Elisha." And they went to meet him and bowed to the ground before him.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when the sons of the prophets who were at Jericho saw him opposite them, they said, "The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha." And they came to meet him and bowed to the ground before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the sons of the prophets who were from Jericho saw him, they said, "The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha." And they came to meet him, and bowed to the ground before him.
verses.textEnNlt: When the group of prophets from Jericho saw from a distance what happened, they exclaimed, "Elijah’s spirit rests upon Elisha!" And they went to meet him and bowed to the ground before him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the sons of the prophets who were at Jericho opposite him saw him, they said, "The spirit of Elijah has settled on Elisha." And they came to meet him and bowed down to the ground before him.
verses.textEn: The company of the prophets from Jericho, who were watching, said, "The spirit of Elijah is resting on Elisha." And they went to meet him and bowed to the ground before him.

verses.textZh: 他们对他说："请看，你的仆人这里有五十个壮士；请让他们去寻找你的老师，或者耶和华的灵把他提去，丢在某一座山上，或某一处山谷里。"以利沙说："你们不必派人去了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对他说："请看，你的仆人这里有五十个壮士；请让他们去寻找你的老师，或者耶和华的灵把他提去，丢在某一座山上，或某一处山谷里。"以利沙说："你们不必派人去了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 对他说：「仆人们这里有五十个壮士，求你容他们去寻找你师傅，或者耶和华的灵将他提起来，投在某山某谷。」以利沙说：「你们不必打发人去。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Look," they said, "we your servants have fifty able men. Let them go and look for your master. Perhaps the Spirit of the Lord has picked him up and set him down on some mountain or in some valley." "No," Elisha replied, "do not send them."
verses.textEnEsv: And they said to him, "Behold now, there are with your servants fifty strong men. Please let them go and seek your master. It may be that the Spirit of the Lord has caught him up and cast him upon some mountain or into some valley." And he said, "You shall not send."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to him, "Look now, there are fifty strong men with your servants. Please let them go and search for your master, lest perhaps the Spirit of the Lord has taken him up and cast him upon some mountain or into some valley." And he said, "You shall not send anyone."
verses.textEnNlt: "Sir," they said, "just say the word and fifty of our strongest men will search the wilderness for your master. Perhaps the Spirit of the Lord has left him on some mountain or in some valley." "No," Elisha said, "don’t send them."
verses.textEnNasb: Then they said to him, "Behold now, there are with your servants fifty strong men; please let them go and search for your master, in case the Spirit of the Lord has taken him up and cast him on some mountain or into some valley." But he said, "You shall not send anyone."
verses.textEn: "Look," they said, "we your servants have fifty able men. Let them go and look for your master. Perhaps the Spirit of the Lord has picked him up and set him down on some mountain or in some valley." "No," Elisha replied, "do not send them."

verses.textZh: 他们恳求他，使他不好意思推辞，于是他说："你们派人去吧。"他们就派出五十个人，寻觅了三天，仍然找不着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们恳求他，使他不好意思推辞，于是他说："你们派人去吧。"他们就派出五十个人，寻觅了三天，仍然找不着。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们再三催促他，他难以推辞，就说：「你们打发人去吧！」他们便打发五十人去，寻找了三天，也没有找着。
verses.textEnNiv: But they persisted until he was too embarrassed to refuse. So he said, "Send them." And they sent fifty men, who searched for three days but did not find him.
verses.textEnEsv: But when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, "Send." They sent therefore fifty men. And for three days they sought him but did not find him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, "Send them!" Therefore they sent fifty men, and they searched for three days but did not find him.
verses.textEnNlt: But they kept urging him until they shamed him into agreeing, and he finally said, "All right, send them." So fifty men searched for three days but did not find Elijah.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet when they urged him until he was ashamed to refuse, he said, "Send them." So they sent fifty men; and they searched for three days, but did not find him.
verses.textEn: But they persisted until he was too embarrassed to refuse. So he said, "Send them." And they sent fifty men, who searched for three days but did not find him.

verses.textZh: 于是他们回到以利沙那里；那时，他还停留在耶利哥，他对他们说："我不是告诉了你们不必去的吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们回到以利沙那里；那时，他还停留在耶利哥，他对他们说："我不是告诉了你们不必去的吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙仍然在耶利哥等候他们回到他那里；他对他们说：「我岂没有告诉你们不必去吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: When they returned to Elisha, who was staying in Jericho, he said to them, "Didn’t I tell you not to go?"
verses.textEnEsv: And they came back to him while he was staying at Jericho, and he said to them, "Did I not say to you, ‘Do not go’?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they came back to him, for he had stayed in Jericho, he said to them, "Did I not say to you, ‘Do not go’?"
verses.textEnNlt: Elisha was still at Jericho when they returned. "Didn’t I tell you not to go?" he asked.
verses.textEnNasb: They returned to him while he was staying in Jericho; and he said to them, "Did I not say to you, ‘Do not go’?"
verses.textEn: When they returned to Elisha, who was staying in Jericho, he said to them, "Didn’t I tell you not to go?"

verses.textZh: 那城的人对以利沙说："请看这城的地势很好，老师你也看见，可惜水恶劣，以致此地没有出产。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那城的人对以利沙说："请看这城的地势很好，老师你也看见，可惜水恶劣，以致此地没有出产。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利哥城的人对以利沙说：「这城的地势美好，我主看见了；只是水恶劣，土产不熟而落。」
verses.textEnNiv: The people of the city said to Elisha, "Look, our lord, this town is well situated, as you can see, but the water is bad and the land is unproductive."
verses.textEnEsv: Now the men of the city said to Elisha, "Behold, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord sees, but the water is bad, and the land is unfruitful."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the men of the city said to Elisha, "Please notice, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord sees; but the water is bad, and the ground barren."
verses.textEnNlt: One day the leaders of the town of Jericho visited Elisha. "We have a problem, my lord," they told him. "This town is located in pleasant surroundings, as you can see. But the water is bad, and the land is unproductive."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the men of the city said to Elisha, "Behold now, the site of the city is pleasant, as my lord sees; but the water is bad and the land is unfruitful."
verses.textEn: The people of the city said to Elisha, "Look, our lord, this town is well situated, as you can see, but the water is bad and the land is unproductive."

verses.textZh: 以利沙说："给我拿一个新碗来，里面要盛点盐。"他们就把碗拿给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙说："给我拿一个新碗来，里面要盛点盐。"他们就把碗拿给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙说：「你们拿一个新瓶来，装盐给我」；他们就拿来给他。
verses.textEnNiv: "Bring me a new bowl," he said, "and put salt in it." So they brought it to him.
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "Bring me a new bowl, and put salt in it." So they brought it to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "Bring me a new bowl, and put salt in it." So they brought it to him.
verses.textEnNlt: Elisha said, "Bring me a new bowl with salt in it." So they brought it to him.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "Bring me a new jar, and put salt in it." So they brought it to him.
verses.textEn: "Bring me a new bowl," he said, "and put salt in it." So they brought it to him.

verses.textZh: 他就出去到水源那里，把盐倒在那里，然后说："耶和华这样说：‘我已经医好了这水，从此不再有人死亡，地也不再没有出产了。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就出去到水源那里，把盐倒在那里，然后说："耶和华这样说：‘我已经医好了这水，从此不再有人死亡，地也不再没有出产了。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他出到水源，将盐倒在水中，说：「耶和华如此说：『我治好了这水，从此必不再使人死，也不再使地土不生产。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he went out to the spring and threw the salt into it, saying, "This is what the Lord says: ‘I have healed this water. Never again will it cause death or make the land unproductive.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Then he went to the spring of water and threw salt in it and said, "Thus says the Lord , I have healed this water; from now on neither death nor miscarriage shall come from it."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he went out to the source of the water, and cast in the salt there, and said, "Thus says the Lord: ‘I have healed this water; from it there shall be no more death or barrenness.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then he went out to the spring that supplied the town with water and threw the salt into it. And he said, "This is what the Lord says: I have purified this water. It will no longer cause death or infertility. "
verses.textEnNasb: Then he went out to the spring of water and threw salt in it and said, "This is what the Lord says: ‘I have purified these waters; there shall not come from there death or unfruitfulness any longer.’ "
verses.textEn: Then he went out to the spring and threw the salt into it, saying, "This is what the Lord says: ‘I have healed this water. Never again will it cause death or make the land unproductive.’ "

verses.textZh: 那水果然治好了，直到今日，正如以利沙所说的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那水果然治好了，直到今日，正如以利沙所说的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是那水治好了，直到今日，正如以利沙所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: And the water has remained pure to this day, according to the word Elisha had spoken.
verses.textEnEsv: So the water has been healed to this day, according to the word that Elisha spoke.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the water remains healed to this day, according to the word of Elisha which he spoke.
verses.textEnNlt: And the water has remained pure ever since, just as Elisha said.
verses.textEnNasb: So the waters have been purified to this day, in accordance with the word of Elisha which he spoke.
verses.textEn: And the water has remained pure to this day, according to the word Elisha had spoken.

verses.textZh: 以利沙从那里上伯特利去，正沿路上去的时候，从城里有一班年轻人走出来，讥笑他，说："秃头的上去吧！秃头的上去吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙从那里上伯特利去，正沿路上去的时候，从城里有一班年轻人走出来，讥笑他，说："秃头的上去吧！秃头的上去吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙从那里上伯特利去，正上去的时候，有些童子从城里出来，戏笑他说：「秃头的上去吧！秃头的上去吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: From there Elisha went up to Bethel. As he was walking along the road, some boys came out of the town and jeered at him. "Get out of here, baldy!" they said. "Get out of here, baldy!"
verses.textEnEsv: He went up from there to Bethel, and while he was going up on the way, some small boys came out of the city and jeered at him, saying, "Go up, you baldhead! Go up, you baldhead!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he went up from there to Bethel; and as he was going up the road, some youths came from the city and mocked him, and said to him, "Go up, you baldhead! Go up, you baldhead!"
verses.textEnNlt: Elisha left Jericho and went up to Bethel. As he was walking along the road, a group of boys from the town began mocking and making fun of him. "Go away, baldy!" they chanted. "Go away, baldy!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now he went up from there to Bethel; and as he was going up by the road, some young boys came out from the city and ridiculed him and said to him, "Go up, you baldhead; go up, you baldhead!"
verses.textEn: From there Elisha went up to Bethel. As he was walking along the road, some boys came out of the town and jeered at him. "Get out of here, baldy!" they said. "Get out of here, baldy!"

verses.textZh: 以利沙回头看着他们，奉耶和华的名咒诅他们。于是有两只母熊从树林里走出来，撕裂了他们中间四十二个年轻人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙回头看着他们，奉耶和华的名咒诅他们。于是有两只母熊从树林里走出来，撕裂了他们中间四十二个年轻人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他回头看见，就奉耶和华的名咒诅他们。于是有两只母熊从林中出来，撕裂他们中间四十二个童子。
verses.textEnNiv: He turned around, looked at them and called down a curse on them in the name of the Lord . Then two bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of the boys.
verses.textEnEsv: And he turned around, and when he saw them, he cursed them in the name of the Lord . And two she-bears came out of the woods and tore forty-two of the boys.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he turned around and looked at them, and pronounced a curse on them in the name of the Lord. And two female bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of the youths.
verses.textEnNlt: Elisha turned around and looked at them, and he cursed them in the name of the Lord . Then two bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of them.
verses.textEnNasb: When he looked behind him and saw them, he cursed them in the name of the Lord. Then two female bears came out of the woods and tore up forty-two of the boys.
verses.textEn: He turned around, looked at them and called down a curse on them in the name of the Lord . Then two bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of the boys.

verses.textZh: 以利沙从那里上迦密山，又从迦密山回到撒玛利亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙从那里上迦密山，又从迦密山回到撒玛利亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙从伯特利上迦密山，又从迦密山回到撒马利亚。
verses.textEnNiv: And he went on to Mount Carmel and from there returned to Samaria.
verses.textEnEsv: From there he went on to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he went from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria.
verses.textEnNlt: From there Elisha went to Mount Carmel and finally returned to Samaria.
verses.textEnNasb: He then went on from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria.
verses.textEn: And he went on to Mount Carmel and from there returned to Samaria.

verses.textZh: 犹大王约沙法第十八年，亚哈的儿子约兰在撒玛利亚作王，统治以色列；他作王共有十二年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王约沙法第十八年，亚哈的儿子约兰在撒玛利亚作王，统治以色列；他作王共有十二年。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王约沙法十八年，亚哈的儿子约兰在撒马利亚登基作了以色列王十二年。
verses.textEnNiv: Joram son of Ahab became king of Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned twelve years.
verses.textEnEsv: In the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Jehoram the son of Ahab became king over Israel in Samaria, and he reigned twelve years.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab became king over Israel at Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.
verses.textEnNlt: Ahab’s son Joram began to rule over Israel in the eighteenth year of King Jehoshaphat’s reign in Judah. He reigned in Samaria twelve years.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab became king over Israel at Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned for twelve years.
verses.textEn: Joram son of Ahab became king of Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned twelve years.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，只是还不至于像他的父亲和母亲一样，因为他除去了他父亲所做的巴力神柱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，只是还不至于像他的父亲和母亲一样，因为他除去了他父亲所做的巴力神柱。
verses.textZhCuv: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，但不至像他父母所行的，因为除掉他父所造巴力的柱像。
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , but not as his father and mother had done. He got rid of the sacred stone of Baal that his father had made.
verses.textEnEsv: He did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , though not like his father and mother, for he put away the pillar of Baal that his father had made.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, but not like his father and mother; for he put away the sacred pillar of Baal that his father had made.
verses.textEnNlt: He did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight, but not to the same extent as his father and mother. He at least tore down the sacred pillar of Baal that his father had set up.
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord, though not like his father and his mother; for he removed the memorial stone of Baal which his father had made.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , but not as his father and mother had done. He got rid of the sacred stone of Baal that his father had made.

verses.textZh: 只是尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪中的那些罪，他却坚持不舍，不肯脱离。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪中的那些罪，他却坚持不舍，不肯脱离。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，他贴近尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，总不离开。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless he clung to the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit; he did not turn away from them.
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, he clung to the sin of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which he made Israel to sin; he did not depart from it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless he persisted in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who had made Israel sin; he did not depart from them.
verses.textEnNlt: Nevertheless, he continued in the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had committed and led the people of Israel to commit.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless, he clung to the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, into which he misled Israel; he did not abandon them.
verses.textEn: Nevertheless he clung to the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit; he did not turn away from them.

verses.textZh: 摩押王米沙是个以牧羊为生的人。他每年进贡十万头绵羊羔和十万头公羊羔给以色列王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押王米沙是个以牧羊为生的人。他每年进贡十万头绵羊羔和十万头公羊羔给以色列王。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押王米沙牧养许多羊，每年将十万羊羔的毛和十万公绵羊的毛给以色列王进贡。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Mesha king of Moab raised sheep, and he had to pay the king of Israel a tribute of a hundred thousand lambs and the wool of a hundred thousand rams.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder, and he had to deliver to the king of Israel 100,000 lambs and the wool of 100,000 rams.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheepbreeder, and he regularly paid the king of Israel one hundred thousand lambs and the wool of one hundred thousand rams.
verses.textEnNlt: King Mesha of Moab was a sheep breeder. He used to pay the king of Israel an annual tribute of 100,000 lambs and the wool of 100,000 rams.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Mesha the king of Moab was a sheep breeder, and he used to make tribute payments to the king of Israel of a hundred thousand lambs, and the wool of a hundred thousand rams.
verses.textEn: Now Mesha king of Moab raised sheep, and he had to pay the king of Israel a tribute of a hundred thousand lambs and the wool of a hundred thousand rams.

verses.textZh: 亚哈死后，摩押王背叛以色列王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈死后，摩押王背叛以色列王。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈死后，摩押王背叛以色列王。
verses.textEnNiv: But after Ahab died, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: But when Ahab died, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: But it happened, when Ahab died, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: But after Ahab’s death, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: However, when King Ahab died, the king of Moab broke with the king of Israel.
verses.textEn: But after Ahab died, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

verses.textZh: 那时约兰王从撒玛利亚出来点阅以色列众人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时约兰王从撒玛利亚出来点阅以色列众人。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时约兰王出撒马利亚，数点以色列众人。
verses.textEnNiv: So at that time King Joram set out from Samaria and mobilized all Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: So King Jehoram marched out of Samaria at that time and mustered all Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So King Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time and mustered all Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: So King Joram promptly mustered the army of Israel and marched from Samaria.
verses.textEnNasb: So King Jehoram left Samaria for battle at that time and mustered all Israel.
verses.textEn: So at that time King Joram set out from Samaria and mobilized all Israel.

verses.textZh: 他一面起行，一面派人到犹大王约沙法那里，说："摩押王背叛了我，你肯不肯和我同去攻打摩押呢？"约沙法说："我愿意去；我和你不分彼此，我的人民就像是你的人民，我的马就像是你的马。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他一面起行，一面派人到犹大王约沙法那里，说："摩押王背叛了我，你肯不肯和我同去攻打摩押呢？"约沙法说："我愿意去；我和你不分彼此，我的人民就像是你的人民，我的马就像是你的马。"
verses.textZhCuv: 前行的时候，差人去见犹大王约沙法，说：「摩押王背叛我，你肯同我去攻打摩押吗？」他说：「我肯上去，你我不分彼此，我的民与你的民一样，我的马与你的马一样。」
verses.textEnNiv: He also sent this message to Jehoshaphat king of Judah: "The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me to fight against Moab?" "I will go with you," he replied. "I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses."
verses.textEnEsv: And he went and sent word to Jehoshaphat king of Judah: "The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me to battle against Moab?" And he said, "I will go. I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he went and sent to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, saying, "The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me to fight against Moab?" And he said, "I will go up; I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses."
verses.textEnNlt: On the way, he sent this message to King Jehoshaphat of Judah: "The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you join me in battle against him?" And Jehoshaphat replied, "Why, of course! You and I are as one. My troops are your troops, and my horses are your horses."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he went and sent word to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, "The king of Moab has broken away from me. Will you go with me to fight against Moab?" And he said, "I will go up. Consider me yours, my people as your people, my horses as your horses."
verses.textEn: He also sent this message to Jehoshaphat king of Judah: "The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me to fight against Moab?" "I will go with you," he replied. "I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses."

verses.textZh: 约沙法问："我们从哪条路上去呢？"约兰回答："从以东旷野的路上去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法问："我们从哪条路上去呢？"约兰回答："从以东旷野的路上去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约兰说：「我们从哪条路上去呢？」回答说：「从以东旷野的路上去。」
verses.textEnNiv: "By what route shall we attack?" he asked. "Through the Desert of Edom," he answered.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said, "By which way shall we march?" Jehoram answered, "By the way of the wilderness of Edom."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "Which way shall we go up?" And he answered, "By way of the Wilderness of Edom."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehoshaphat asked, "What route will we take?" "We will attack from the wilderness of Edom," Joram replied.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "Which way shall we go up?" And he answered, "The way of the wilderness of Edom."
verses.textEn: "By what route shall we attack?" he asked. "Through the Desert of Edom," he answered.

verses.textZh: 于是以色列王、犹大王和以东王，绕道行了七日的路程。军队和随行的牲畜都没有水喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以色列王、犹大王和以东王，绕道行了七日的路程。军队和随行的牲畜都没有水喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，以色列王和犹大王，并以东王，都一同去绕行七日的路程；军队和所带的牲畜没有水喝。
verses.textEnNiv: So the king of Israel set out with the king of Judah and the king of Edom. After a roundabout march of seven days, the army had no more water for themselves or for the animals with them.
verses.textEnEsv: So the king of Israel went with the king of Judah and the king of Edom. And when they had made a circuitous march of seven days, there was no water for the army or for the animals that followed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king of Israel went with the king of Judah and the king of Edom, and they marched on that roundabout route seven days; and there was no water for the army, nor for the animals that followed them.
verses.textEnNlt: The king of Edom and his troops joined them, and all three armies traveled along a roundabout route through the wilderness for seven days. But there was no water for the men or their animals.
verses.textEnNasb: So the king of Israel went with the king of Judah and the king of Edom, and they made a circuit of seven days’ journey. But there was no water for the army or for the cattle that followed them.
verses.textEn: So the king of Israel set out with the king of Judah and the king of Edom. After a roundabout march of seven days, the army had no more water for themselves or for the animals with them.

verses.textZh: 以色列王说："哎哟，耶和华招聚这三位君王，是要把他们交在摩押人的手中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王说："哎哟，耶和华招聚这三位君王，是要把他们交在摩押人的手中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王说：「哀哉！耶和华招聚我们这三王，乃要交在摩押人的手里。」
verses.textEnNiv: "What!" exclaimed the king of Israel. "Has the Lord called us three kings together only to deliver us into the hands of Moab?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king of Israel said, "Alas! The Lord has called these three kings to give them into the hand of Moab."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king of Israel said, "Alas! For the Lord has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab."
verses.textEnNlt: "What should we do?" the king of Israel cried out. "The Lord has brought the three of us here to let the king of Moab defeat us."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Israel said, "It is hopeless! For the Lord has called these three kings to hand them over to Moab!"
verses.textEn: "What!" exclaimed the king of Israel. "Has the Lord called us three kings together only to deliver us into the hands of Moab?"

verses.textZh: 约沙法说："这里不是有一位耶和华的先知吗？我们可以托他求问耶和华。"以色列王的一位臣仆说："这里有沙法的儿子以利沙，他从前是服事以利亚的 。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法说："这里不是有一位耶和华的先知吗？我们可以托他求问耶和华。"以色列王的一位臣仆说："这里有沙法的儿子以利沙，他从前是服事以利亚的 。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法说：「这里不是有耶和华的先知吗？我们可以托他求问耶和华。」以色列王的一个臣子回答说：「这里有沙法的儿子以利沙，就是从前服事以利亚的 。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Jehoshaphat asked, "Is there no prophet of the Lord here, through whom we may inquire of the Lord ?" An officer of the king of Israel answered, "Elisha son of Shaphat is here. He used to pour water on the hands of Elijah. "
verses.textEnEsv: And Jehoshaphat said, "Is there no prophet of the Lord here, through whom we may inquire of the Lord ?" Then one of the king of Israel’s servants answered, "Elisha the son of Shaphat is here, who poured water on the hands of Elijah."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jehoshaphat said, "Isthere no prophet of the Lord here, that we may inquire of the Lord by him?" So one of the servants of the king of Israel answered and said, "Elisha the son of Shaphat is here, who poured water on the hands of Elijah."
verses.textEnNlt: But King Jehoshaphat of Judah asked, "Is there no prophet of the Lord with us? If there is, we can ask the Lord what to do through him." One of King Joram’s officers replied, "Elisha son of Shaphat is here. He used to be Elijah’s personal assistant. "
verses.textEnNasb: But Jehoshaphat said, "Is there no prophet of the Lord here, that we may inquire of the Lord by him?" And one of the king of Israel’s servants answered and said, "Elisha the son of Shaphat is here, who used to pour water on the hands of Elijah."
verses.textEn: But Jehoshaphat asked, "Is there no prophet of the Lord here, through whom we may inquire of the Lord ?" An officer of the king of Israel answered, "Elisha son of Shaphat is here. He used to pour water on the hands of Elijah. "

verses.textZh: 约沙法说："他必有耶和华的话。"于是以色列王、约沙法和以东王都下到他那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法说："他必有耶和华的话。"于是以色列王、约沙法和以东王都下到他那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法说：「他必有耶和华的话。」于是以色列王和约沙法，并以东王都下去见他。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoshaphat said, "The word of the Lord is with him." So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jehoshaphat said, "The word of the Lord is with him." So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jehoshaphat said, "The word of the Lord is with him." So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoshaphat said, "Yes, the Lord speaks through him." So the king of Israel, King Jehoshaphat of Judah, and the king of Edom went to consult with Elisha.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jehoshaphat said, "The word of the Lord is with him." So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
verses.textEn: Jehoshaphat said, "The word of the Lord is with him." So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

verses.textZh: 以利沙对以色列王说："我和你有甚么关系呢？去问你父亲和你母亲的先知吧！"以色列王对他说："不要这样说，耶和华招聚这三位君王，是要把他们交在摩押人手中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙对以色列王说："我和你有甚么关系呢？去问你父亲和你母亲的先知吧！"以色列王对他说："不要这样说，耶和华招聚这三位君王，是要把他们交在摩押人手中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙对以色列王说：「我与你何干？去问你父亲的先知和你母亲的先知吧！」以色列王对他说：「不要这样说，耶和华招聚我们这三王，乃要交在摩押人的手里。」
verses.textEnNiv: Elisha said to the king of Israel, "Why do you want to involve me? Go to the prophets of your father and the prophets of your mother." "No," the king of Israel answered, "because it was the Lord who called us three kings together to deliver us into the hands of Moab."
verses.textEnEsv: And Elisha said to the king of Israel, "What have I to do with you? Go to the prophets of your father and to the prophets of your mother." But the king of Israel said to him, "No; it is the Lord who has called these three kings to give them into the hand of Moab."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Elisha said to the king of Israel, "What have I to do with you? Go to the prophets of your father and the prophets of your mother." But the king of Israel said to him, "No, for the Lord has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab."
verses.textEnNlt: "Why are you coming to me?" Elisha asked the king of Israel. "Go to the pagan prophets of your father and mother!" But King Joram of Israel said, "No! For it was the Lord who called us three kings here—only to be defeated by the king of Moab!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now Elisha said to the king of Israel, " What business do you have with me? Go to your father’s prophets and your mother’s prophets." But the king of Israel said to him, "No, for the Lord has called these three kings together to hand them over to Moab."
verses.textEn: Elisha said to the king of Israel, "Why do you want to involve me? Go to the prophets of your father and the prophets of your mother." "No," the king of Israel answered, "because it was the Lord who called us three kings together to deliver us into the hands of Moab."

verses.textZh: 以利沙说："我指着我所事奉永活的万军耶和华起誓，若不是看犹大王约沙法的情面，我根本不会理你，看也不看你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙说："我指着我所事奉永活的万军耶和华起誓，若不是看犹大王约沙法的情面，我根本不会理你，看也不看你。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙说：「我指着所事奉永生的万军耶和华起誓，我若不看犹大王约沙法的情面，必不理你，不顾你。
verses.textEnNiv: Elisha said, "As surely as the Lord Almighty lives, whom I serve, if I did not have respect for the presence of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, I would not pay any attention to you.
verses.textEnEsv: And Elisha said, "As the Lord of hosts lives, before whom I stand, were it not that I have regard for Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would neither look at you nor see you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Elisha said, "As the Lord of hosts lives, before whom I stand, surely were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, I would not look at you, nor see you.
verses.textEnNlt: Elisha replied, "As surely as the Lord Almighty lives, whom I serve, I wouldn’t even bother with you except for my respect for King Jehoshaphat of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Elisha said, "As surely as the Lord of armies lives, before whom I stand, if I did not respect Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look at you nor see you.
verses.textEn: Elisha said, "As surely as the Lord Almighty lives, whom I serve, if I did not have respect for the presence of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, I would not pay any attention to you.

verses.textZh: 现在，给我找一个琴师来。"当琴师弹琴的时候，耶和华的能力就临到他身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，给我找一个琴师来。"当琴师弹琴的时候，耶和华的能力就临到他身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们给我找一个弹琴的来。」弹琴的时候，耶和华的灵 就降在以利沙身上。
verses.textEnNiv: But now bring me a harpist." While the harpist was playing, the hand of the Lord came on Elisha
verses.textEnEsv: But now bring me a musician." And when the musician played, the hand of the Lord came upon him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now bring me a musician." Then it happened, when the musician played, that the hand of the Lord came upon him.
verses.textEnNlt: Now bring me someone who can play the harp." While the harp was being played, the power of the Lord came upon Elisha,
verses.textEnNasb: But now bring me a musician." And it came about, when the musician played, that the hand of the Lord came upon him.
verses.textEn: But now bring me a harpist." While the harpist was playing, the hand of the Lord came on Elisha

verses.textZh: 以利沙说："耶和华这样说：‘要在这山谷到处挖濠沟。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙说："耶和华这样说：‘要在这山谷到处挖濠沟。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他便说：「耶和华如此说：『你们要在这谷中满处挖沟；
verses.textEnNiv: and he said, "This is what the Lord says: I will fill this valley with pools of water.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Thus says the Lord , ‘I will make this dry streambed full of pools.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Make this valley full of ditches.’
verses.textEnNlt: and he said, "This is what the Lord says: This dry valley will be filled with pools of water!
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Make this valley full of trenches.’
verses.textEn: and he said, "This is what the Lord says: I will fill this valley with pools of water.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华这样说：‘你们虽然没有看见风，也没有看见雨，但这山谷必充满了水，你们和你们的牲畜都可以有水喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华这样说：‘你们虽然没有看见风，也没有看见雨，但这山谷必充满了水，你们和你们的牲畜都可以有水喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华如此说：你们虽不见风，不见雨，这谷必满了水，使你们和牲畜有水喝。』
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what the Lord says: You will see neither wind nor rain, yet this valley will be filled with water, and you, your cattle and your other animals will drink.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord , ‘You shall not see wind or rain, but that streambed shall be filled with water, so that you shall drink, you, your livestock, and your animals.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord: ‘You shall not see wind, nor shall you see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, so that you, your cattle, and your animals may drink.’
verses.textEnNlt: You will see neither wind nor rain, says the Lord , but this valley will be filled with water. You will have plenty for yourselves and your cattle and other animals.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord says this: ‘You will not see wind, nor will you see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, so that you will drink, you, your livestock, and your other animals.
verses.textEn: For this is what the Lord says: You will see neither wind nor rain, yet this valley will be filled with water, and you, your cattle and your other animals will drink.

verses.textZh: 这事在耶和华眼中算是小事，他还要把摩押交在你们手中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事在耶和华眼中算是小事，他还要把摩押交在你们手中。
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶和华眼中这还算为小事，他也必将摩押人交在你们手中。
verses.textEnNiv: This is an easy thing in the eyes of the Lord ; he will also deliver Moab into your hands.
verses.textEnEsv: This is a light thing in the sight of the Lord . He will also give the Moabites into your hand,
verses.textEnNkjv: And this is a simple matter in the sight of the Lord; He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.
verses.textEnNlt: But this is only a simple thing for the Lord , for he will make you victorious over the army of Moab!
verses.textEnNasb: And this is an insignificant thing in the sight of the Lord; He will also give the Moabites into your hand.
verses.textEn: This is an easy thing in the eyes of the Lord ; he will also deliver Moab into your hands.

verses.textZh: 你们要攻破所有坚固的城和一切繁华的都市；砍下各种佳美的树木，堵塞所有水泉，用石头堆满一切肥沃的田地。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要攻破所有坚固的城和一切繁华的都市；砍下各种佳美的树木，堵塞所有水泉，用石头堆满一切肥沃的田地。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们必攻破一切坚城美邑，砍伐各种佳树，塞住一切水泉，用石头糟踏一切美田。」
verses.textEnNiv: You will overthrow every fortified city and every major town. You will cut down every good tree, stop up all the springs, and ruin every good field with stones."
verses.textEnEsv: and you shall attack every fortified city and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree and stop up all springs of water and ruin every good piece of land with stones."
verses.textEnNkjv: Also you shall attack every fortified city and every choice city, and shall cut down every good tree, and stop up every spring of water, and ruin every good piece of land with stones."
verses.textEnNlt: You will conquer the best of their towns, even the fortified ones. You will cut down all their good trees, stop up all their springs, and ruin all their good land with stones."
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall strike every fortified city and every choice city, and cut down every good tree and stop up all the springs of water, and spoil every good plot of land with stones.’ "
verses.textEn: You will overthrow every fortified city and every major town. You will cut down every good tree, stop up all the springs, and ruin every good field with stones."

verses.textZh: 到了早上，约在献祭的时候，忽然有水从以东来，遍地就满了水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了早上，约在献祭的时候，忽然有水从以东来，遍地就满了水。
verses.textZhCuv: 次日早晨，约在献祭的时候，有水从以东而来，遍地就满了水。
