verses.textEnNiv: The next morning, about the time for offering the sacrifice, there it was—water flowing from the direction of Edom! And the land was filled with water.
verses.textEnEsv: The next morning, about the time of offering the sacrifice, behold, water came from the direction of Edom, till the country was filled with water.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened in the morning, when the grain offering was offered, that suddenly water came by way of Edom, and the land was filled with water.
verses.textEnNlt: The next day at about the time when the morning sacrifice was offered, water suddenly appeared! It was flowing from the direction of Edom, and soon there was water everywhere.
verses.textEnNasb: And it happened in the morning about the time of offering the sacrifice, that behold, water came from the direction of Edom, and the country was filled with water.
verses.textEn: The next morning, about the time for offering the sacrifice, there it was—water flowing from the direction of Edom! And the land was filled with water.

verses.textZh: 摩押全国听见这几位君王上来要攻打他们，就召集所有能够穿上武装的，不论老幼，到边界上防守。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押全国听见这几位君王上来要攻打他们，就召集所有能够穿上武装的，不论老幼，到边界上防守。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押众人听见这三王上来要与他们争战，凡能顶盔贯甲的，无论老少，尽都聚集站在边界上。
verses.textEnNiv: Now all the Moabites had heard that the kings had come to fight against them; so every man, young and old, who could bear arms was called up and stationed on the border.
verses.textEnEsv: When all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them, all who were able to put on armor, from the youngest to the oldest, were called out and were drawn up at the border.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them, all who were able to bear arms and older were gathered; and they stood at the border.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, when the people of Moab heard about the three armies marching against them, they mobilized every man who was old enough to strap on a sword, and they stationed themselves along their border.
verses.textEnNasb: Now all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them. And all who were able to put on armor and older were summoned and they took their positions on the border.
verses.textEn: Now all the Moabites had heard that the kings had come to fight against them; so every man, young and old, who could bear arms was called up and stationed on the border.

verses.textZh: 第二天早上，他们起来的时候，太阳照在水上，摩押人从那边看见水红得像血一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天早上，他们起来的时候，太阳照在水上，摩押人从那边看见水红得像血一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 次日早晨，日光照在水上，摩押人起来，看见对面水红如血，
verses.textEnNiv: When they got up early in the morning, the sun was shining on the water. To the Moabites across the way, the water looked red—like blood.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they rose early in the morning and the sun shone on the water, the Moabites saw the water opposite them as red as blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they rose up early in the morning, and the sun was shining on the water; and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood.
verses.textEnNlt: But when they got up the next morning, the sun was shining across the water, making it appear red to the Moabites—like blood.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they got up early in the morning, and the sun shone on the water, and the Moabites saw the water opposite them as red as blood.
verses.textEn: When they got up early in the morning, the sun was shining on the water. To the Moabites across the way, the water looked red—like blood.

verses.textZh: 他们说："这是血啊！一定是那些王互相攻击，自相残杀；现在，摩押人哪，去抢掠吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："这是血啊！一定是那些王互相攻击，自相残杀；现在，摩押人哪，去抢掠吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 就说：「这是血啊！必是三王互相击杀，俱都灭亡。摩押人哪，我们现在去抢夺财物吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: "That’s blood!" they said. "Those kings must have fought and slaughtered each other. Now to the plunder, Moab!"
verses.textEnEsv: And they said, "This is blood; the kings have surely fought together and struck one another down. Now then, Moab, to the spoil!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said, "This is blood; the kings have surely struck swords and have killed one another; now therefore, Moab, to the spoil!"
verses.textEnNlt: "It’s blood!" the Moabites exclaimed. "The three armies must have attacked and killed each other! Let’s go, men of Moab, and collect the plunder!"
verses.textEnNasb: So they said, "This is blood; the kings must have fought each other, and they have killed one another. Now then, Moab, to the spoils!"
verses.textEn: "That’s blood!" they said. "Those kings must have fought and slaughtered each other. Now to the plunder, Moab!"

verses.textZh: 他们来到以色列营，以色列人起来，击杀摩押人，摩押人就在以色列人面前逃跑；以色列人就攻进摩押，击杀他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们来到以色列营，以色列人起来，击杀摩押人，摩押人就在以色列人面前逃跑；以色列人就攻进摩押，击杀他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押人到了以色列营，以色列人就起来攻打他们，以致他们在以色列人面前逃跑。以色列人往前追杀摩押人，直杀入摩押的境内，
verses.textEnNiv: But when the Moabites came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and fought them until they fled. And the Israelites invaded the land and slaughtered the Moabites.
verses.textEnEsv: But when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose and struck the Moabites, till they fled before them. And they went forward, striking the Moabites as they went.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when they came to the camp of Israel, Israel rose up and attacked the Moabites, so that they fled before them; and they entered their land, killing the Moabites.
verses.textEnNlt: But when the Moabites arrived at the Israelite camp, the army of Israel rushed out and attacked them until they turned and ran. The army of Israel chased them into the land of Moab, destroying everything as they went.
verses.textEnNasb: But when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites, so that they fled from them; and the Israelites invaded the land, killing the Moabites.
verses.textEn: But when the Moabites came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and fought them until they fled. And the Israelites invaded the land and slaughtered the Moabites.

verses.textZh: 他们毁坏城市，各人向一切肥沃的田地拋掷石头，把田地填满了，又堵塞一切水泉，砍下各种佳美的树木，直到吉珥．哈列设只剩下石头，甩石的兵把它包围，攻击它。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们毁坏城市，各人向一切肥沃的田地拋掷石头，把田地填满了，又堵塞一切水泉，砍下各种佳美的树木，直到吉珥．哈列设只剩下石头，甩石的兵把它包围，攻击它。
verses.textZhCuv: 拆毁摩押的城邑，各人抛石填满一切美田，塞住一切水泉，砍伐各种佳树，只剩下吉珥‧哈列设的石墙；甩石的兵在四围攻打那城。
verses.textEnNiv: They destroyed the towns, and each man threw a stone on every good field until it was covered. They stopped up all the springs and cut down every good tree. Only Kir Hareseth was left with its stones in place, but men armed with slings surrounded it and attacked it.
verses.textEnEsv: And they overthrew the cities, and on every good piece of land every man threw a stone until it was covered. They stopped every spring of water and felled all the good trees, till only its stones were left in Kir-hareseth, and the slingers surrounded and attacked it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they destroyed the cities, and each man threw a stone on every good piece of land and filled it; and they stopped up all the springs of water and cut down all the good trees. But they left the stones of Kir Haraseth intact. However the slingers surrounded and attacked it.
verses.textEnNlt: They destroyed the towns, covered their good land with stones, stopped up all the springs, and cut down all the good trees. Finally, only Kir-hareseth and its stone walls were left, but men with slings surrounded and attacked it.
verses.textEnNasb: So they destroyed the cities; and each one threw a stone on every plot of good land and filled it. So they stopped up every spring of water and cut down every good tree, until in Kir-hareseth only they left its stones; however, the rock slingers surrounded it and struck it.
verses.textEn: They destroyed the towns, and each man threw a stone on every good field until it was covered. They stopped up all the springs and cut down every good tree. Only Kir Hareseth was left with its stones in place, but men armed with slings surrounded it and attacked it.

verses.textZh: 摩押王见战事激烈，无法抵抗，于是带领七百持刀的兵，想要突围到以东王那里，可是不成功，
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押王见战事激烈，无法抵抗，于是带领七百持刀的兵，想要突围到以东王那里，可是不成功，
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押王见阵势甚大，难以对敌，就率领七百拿刀的兵，要冲过阵去到以东王那里，却是不能；
verses.textEnNiv: When the king of Moab saw that the battle had gone against him, he took with him seven hundred swordsmen to break through to the king of Edom, but they failed.
verses.textEnEsv: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was going against him, he took with him 700 swordsmen to break through, opposite the king of Edom, but they could not.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too fierce for him, he took with him seven hundred men who drew swords, to break through to the king of Edom, but they could not.
verses.textEnNlt: When the king of Moab saw that he was losing the battle, he led 700 of his swordsmen in a desperate attempt to break through the enemy lines near the king of Edom, but they failed.
verses.textEnNasb: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was too fierce for him, he took with him seven hundred men who drew swords, to break through to the king of Edom; but they could not.
verses.textEn: When the king of Moab saw that the battle had gone against him, he took with him seven hundred swordsmen to break through to the king of Edom, but they failed.

verses.textZh: 于是他把那要接续他作王的长子，在城墙上献为燔祭。以色列人就遭遇极大的忿怒，于是离开他，回到自己的地方去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他把那要接续他作王的长子，在城墙上献为燔祭。以色列人就遭遇极大的忿怒，于是离开他，回到自己的地方去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 便将那应当接续他作王的长子，在城上献为燔祭。以色列人遭遇耶和华的大怒 ，于是三王离开摩押王，各回本国去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he took his firstborn son, who was to succeed him as king, and offered him as a sacrifice on the city wall. The fury against Israel was great; they withdrew and returned to their own land.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he took his oldest son who was to reign in his place and offered him for a burnt offering on the wall. And there came great wrath against Israel. And they withdrew from him and returned to their own land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he took his eldest son who would have reigned in his place, and offered him as a burnt offering upon the wall; and there was great indignation against Israel. So they departed from him and returned to theirown land.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king of Moab took his oldest son, who would have been the next king, and sacrificed him as a burnt offering on the wall. So there was great anger against Israel, and the Israelites withdrew and returned to their own land.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Moab took his oldest son who was to reign in his place, and offered him as a burnt offering on the wall. And great anger came upon Israel, and they departed from him and returned to their own land.
verses.textEn: Then he took his firstborn son, who was to succeed him as king, and offered him as a sacrifice on the city wall. The fury against Israel was great; they withdrew and returned to their own land.

verses.textZh: 一位先知门徒的妻子哀求以利沙说："你仆人我的丈夫死了，你知道你的仆人是敬畏耶和华的。现在债主来要抓我的两个孩子作他的奴仆。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 一位先知门徒的妻子哀求以利沙说："你仆人我的丈夫死了，你知道你的仆人是敬畏耶和华的。现在债主来要抓我的两个孩子作他的奴仆。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个先知门徒的妻哀求以利沙说：「你仆人－我丈夫死了，他敬畏耶和华是你所知道的。现在有债主来，要取我两个儿子作奴仆。」
verses.textEnNiv: The wife of a man from the company of the prophets cried out to Elisha, "Your servant my husband is dead, and you know that he revered the Lord . But now his creditor is coming to take my two boys as his slaves."
verses.textEnEsv: Now the wife of one of the sons of the prophets cried to Elisha, "Your servant my husband is dead, and you know that your servant feared the Lord , but the creditor has come to take my two children to be his slaves."
verses.textEnNkjv: A certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha, saying, "Your servant my husband is dead, and you know that your servant feared the Lord. And the creditor is coming to take my two sons to be his slaves."
verses.textEnNlt: One day the widow of a member of the group of prophets came to Elisha and cried out, "My husband who served you is dead, and you know how he feared the Lord . But now a creditor has come, threatening to take my two sons as slaves."
verses.textEnNasb: Now a woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha, saying, "Your servant my husband is dead, and you know that your servant feared the Lord; and the creditor has come to take my two children to be his slaves."
verses.textEn: The wife of a man from the company of the prophets cried out to Elisha, "Your servant my husband is dead, and you know that he revered the Lord . But now his creditor is coming to take my two boys as his slaves."

verses.textZh: 以利沙对他说："我可以为你作甚么呢？告诉我，你家里有甚么呢？"她说："婢女家中除了一瓶油以外，甚么也没有。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙对他说："我可以为你作甚么呢？告诉我，你家里有甚么呢？"她说："婢女家中除了一瓶油以外，甚么也没有。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙问她说：「我可以为你做什么呢？你告诉我，你家里有什么？」她说：「婢女家中除了一瓶油之外，没有什么。」
verses.textEnNiv: Elisha replied to her, "How can I help you? Tell me, what do you have in your house?" "Your servant has nothing there at all," she said, "except a small jar of olive oil."
verses.textEnEsv: And Elisha said to her, "What shall I do for you? Tell me; what have you in the house?" And she said, "Your servant has nothing in the house except a jar of oil."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Elisha said to her, "What shall I do for you? Tell me, what do you have in the house?" And she said, "Your maidservant has nothing in the house but a jar of oil."
verses.textEnNlt: "What can I do to help you?" Elisha asked. "Tell me, what do you have in the house?" "Nothing at all, except a flask of olive oil," she replied.
verses.textEnNasb: So Elisha said to her, "What shall I do for you? Tell me, what do you have in the house?" And she said, "Your servant has nothing in the house except a jar of oil."
verses.textEn: Elisha replied to her, "How can I help you? Tell me, what do you have in your house?" "Your servant has nothing there at all," she said, "except a small jar of olive oil."

verses.textZh: 以利沙说："你到外面去向你所有的邻居借空器皿，要尽量多借。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙说："你到外面去向你所有的邻居借空器皿，要尽量多借。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙说：「你去，向你众邻舍借空器皿，不要少借；
verses.textEnNiv: Elisha said, "Go around and ask all your neighbors for empty jars. Don’t ask for just a few.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said, "Go outside, borrow vessels from all your neighbors, empty vessels and not too few.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "Go, borrow vessels from everywhere, from all your neighbors—empty vessels; do not gather just a few.
verses.textEnNlt: And Elisha said, "Borrow as many empty jars as you can from your friends and neighbors.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "Go, borrow containers elsewhere for yourself, empty containers from all your neighbors—do not get too few.
verses.textEn: Elisha said, "Go around and ask all your neighbors for empty jars. Don’t ask for just a few.

verses.textZh: 然后回去，把你和你儿子关在家里，你要把油倒在所有器皿里面，装满了的就放在一边。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后回去，把你和你儿子关在家里，你要把油倒在所有器皿里面，装满了的就放在一边。"
verses.textZhCuv: 回到家里，关上门，你和你儿子在里面将油倒在所有的器皿里，倒满了的放在一边。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then go inside and shut the door behind you and your sons. Pour oil into all the jars, and as each is filled, put it to one side."
verses.textEnEsv: Then go in and shut the door behind yourself and your sons and pour into all these vessels. And when one is full, set it aside."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when you have come in, you shall shut the door behind you and your sons; then pour it into all those vessels, and set aside the full ones."
verses.textEnNlt: Then go into your house with your sons and shut the door behind you. Pour olive oil from your flask into the jars, setting each one aside when it is filled."
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall come in and shut the door behind you and your sons, and pour into all these containers; and you shall set aside what is full."
verses.textEn: Then go inside and shut the door behind you and your sons. Pour oil into all the jars, and as each is filled, put it to one side."

verses.textZh: 于是妇人离开了他，把自己和儿子关在门内；她的儿子不住地把器皿拿到她面前，她就把油倒进去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是妇人离开了他，把自己和儿子关在门内；她的儿子不住地把器皿拿到她面前，她就把油倒进去。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，妇人离开以利沙去了，关上门，自己和儿子在里面；儿子把器皿拿来，她就倒油。
verses.textEnNiv: She left him and shut the door behind her and her sons. They brought the jars to her and she kept pouring.
verses.textEnEsv: So she went from him and shut the door behind herself and her sons. And as she poured they brought the vessels to her.
verses.textEnNkjv: So she went from him and shut the door behind her and her sons, who brought thevessels to her; and she poured it out.
verses.textEnNlt: So she did as she was told. Her sons kept bringing jars to her, and she filled one after another.
verses.textEnNasb: So she left him and shut the door behind her and her sons; they began bringing the containers to her, and she poured the oil.
verses.textEn: She left him and shut the door behind her and her sons. They brought the jars to her and she kept pouring.

verses.textZh: 器皿都倒满了的时候，她对儿子说："再拿一个器皿给我。"他对她说："再没有器皿了。"油就止住了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 器皿都倒满了的时候，她对儿子说："再拿一个器皿给我。"他对她说："再没有器皿了。"油就止住了。
verses.textZhCuv: 器皿都满了，她对儿子说：「再给我拿器皿来。」儿子说：「再没有器皿了。」油就止住了。
verses.textEnNiv: When all the jars were full, she said to her son, "Bring me another one." But he replied, "There is not a jar left." Then the oil stopped flowing.
verses.textEnEsv: When the vessels were full, she said to her son, "Bring me another vessel." And he said to her, "There is not another." Then the oil stopped flowing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said to her son, "Bring me another vessel." And he said to her, "Thereis not another vessel." So the oil ceased.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon every container was full to the brim! "Bring me another jar," she said to one of her sons. "There aren’t any more!" he told her. And then the olive oil stopped flowing.
verses.textEnNasb: When the containers were full, she said to her son, "Bring me another container." But he said to her, "There are no more containers." Then the oil stopped.
verses.textEn: When all the jars were full, she said to her son, "Bring me another one." But he replied, "There is not a jar left." Then the oil stopped flowing.

verses.textZh: 她去告诉神人，神人说："你去把油卖掉，还清你的债务，你和你的儿子可以靠着剩下的过活。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她去告诉神人，神人说："你去把油卖掉，还清你的债务，你和你的儿子可以靠着剩下的过活。"
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人去告诉神人，神人说：「你去卖油还债，所剩的你和你儿子可以靠着度日。」
verses.textEnNiv: She went and told the man of God, and he said, "Go, sell the oil and pay your debts. You and your sons can live on what is left."
verses.textEnEsv: She came and told the man of God, and he said, "Go, sell the oil and pay your debts, and you and your sons can live on the rest."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, "Go, sell the oil and pay your debt; and you and your sons live on the rest."
verses.textEnNlt: When she told the man of God what had happened, he said to her, "Now sell the olive oil and pay your debts, and you and your sons can live on what is left over."
verses.textEnNasb: So she came and told the man of God. And he said, "Go, sell the oil and pay your debt, and you and your sons can live on the rest."
verses.textEn: She went and told the man of God, and he said, "Go, sell the oil and pay your debts. You and your sons can live on what is left."

verses.textZh: 有一天，以利沙经过书念的时候，那里有一位贵妇坚持留他吃饭；于是以后每逢他从那里经过，他总进去吃饭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一天，以利沙经过书念的时候，那里有一位贵妇坚持留他吃饭；于是以后每逢他从那里经过，他总进去吃饭。
verses.textZhCuv: 一日，以利沙走到书念，在那里有一个大户的妇人强留他吃饭。此后，以利沙每从那里经过就进去吃饭。
verses.textEnNiv: One day Elisha went to Shunem. And a well-to-do woman was there, who urged him to stay for a meal. So whenever he came by, he stopped there to eat.
verses.textEnEsv: One day Elisha went on to Shunem, where a wealthy woman lived, who urged him to eat some food. So whenever he passed that way, he would turn in there to eat food.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened one day that Elisha went to Shunem, where there was a notable woman, and she persuaded him to eat some food. So it was, as often as he passed by, he would turn in there to eat some food.
verses.textEnNlt: One day Elisha went to the town of Shunem. A wealthy woman lived there, and she urged him to come to her home for a meal. After that, whenever he passed that way, he would stop there for something to eat.
verses.textEnNasb: Now a day came when Elisha went over to Shunem, where there was a prominent woman, and she urged him to eat food. And so it was, as often as he passed by, that he turned in there to eat food.
verses.textEn: One day Elisha went to Shunem. And a well-to-do woman was there, who urged him to stay for a meal. So whenever he came by, he stopped there to eat.

verses.textZh: 那妇人对她的丈夫说："你看，我知道那常从我们这里经过的，是个圣洁的神人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那妇人对她的丈夫说："你看，我知道那常从我们这里经过的，是个圣洁的神人。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人对丈夫说：「我看出那常从我们这里经过的是圣洁的神人。
verses.textEnNiv: She said to her husband, "I know that this man who often comes our way is a holy man of God.
verses.textEnEsv: And she said to her husband, "Behold now, I know that this is a holy man of God who is continually passing our way.
verses.textEnNkjv: And she said to her husband, "Look now, I know that this is a holy man of God, who passes by us regularly.
verses.textEnNlt: She said to her husband, "I am sure this man who stops in from time to time is a holy man of God.
verses.textEnNasb: And she said to her husband, "Behold now, I am aware that this is a holy man of God passing by us repeatedly.
verses.textEn: She said to her husband, "I know that this man who often comes our way is a holy man of God.

verses.textZh: 让我们盖一间有墙的小阁，为他在里面摆设睡床、桌子、椅子和灯盏；他到我们这里来的时候，就可以到那里休息。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 让我们盖一间有墙的小阁，为他在里面摆设睡床、桌子、椅子和灯盏；他到我们这里来的时候，就可以到那里休息。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们可以为他在墙上盖一间小楼，在其中安放床榻、桌子、椅子、灯台，他来到我们这里，就可以住在其间。」
verses.textEnNiv: Let’s make a small room on the roof and put in it a bed and a table, a chair and a lamp for him. Then he can stay there whenever he comes to us."
verses.textEnEsv: Let us make a small room on the roof with walls and put there for him a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp, so that whenever he comes to us, he can go in there."
verses.textEnNkjv: Please, let us make a small upper room on the wall; and let us put a bed for him there, and a table and a chair and a lampstand; so it will be, whenever he comes to us, he can turn in there."
verses.textEnNlt: Let’s build a small room for him on the roof and furnish it with a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp. Then he will have a place to stay whenever he comes by."
verses.textEnNasb: Please, let’s make a little walled upper room, and let’s set up a bed for him there, and a table, a chair, and a lampstand; then it shall be, when he comes to us, that he can turn in there."
verses.textEn: Let’s make a small room on the roof and put in it a bed and a table, a chair and a lamp for him. Then he can stay there whenever he comes to us."

verses.textZh: 有一天，以利沙来到那里，就上小阁休息，在那里躺下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一天，以利沙来到那里，就上小阁休息，在那里躺下。
verses.textZhCuv: 一日，以利沙来到那里，就进了那楼躺卧。
verses.textEnNiv: One day when Elisha came, he went up to his room and lay down there.
verses.textEnEsv: One day he came there, and he turned into the chamber and rested there.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened one day that he came there, and he turned in to the upper room and lay down there.
verses.textEnNlt: One day Elisha returned to Shunem, and he went up to this upper room to rest.
verses.textEnNasb: Now one day he came there, and turned in to the upper room and rested.
verses.textEn: One day when Elisha came, he went up to his room and lay down there.

verses.textZh: 他对他的仆人基哈西说："你去叫这书念的妇人来。"于是他叫了她来，站在他的面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对他的仆人基哈西说："你去叫这书念的妇人来。"于是他叫了她来，站在他的面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙吩咐仆人基哈西说：「你叫这书念妇人来。」他就把妇人叫了来，妇人站在以利沙面前。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to his servant Gehazi, "Call the Shunammite." So he called her, and she stood before him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to Gehazi his servant, "Call this Shunammite." When he had called her, she stood before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to Gehazi his servant, "Call this Shunammite woman." When he had called her, she stood before him.
verses.textEnNlt: He said to his servant Gehazi, "Tell the woman from Shunem I want to speak to her." When she appeared,
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to his servant Gehazi, "Call this Shunammite." And when he had called her, she stood before him.
verses.textEn: He said to his servant Gehazi, "Call the Shunammite." So he called her, and she stood before him.

verses.textZh: 他对他的仆人说："你对她说：‘看哪！你为我们费了这么多心思。我可以为你作些甚么呢？你有事要我替你向王或军长说的吗？’"她说："我住在自己的人民中间。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对他的仆人说："你对她说：‘看哪！你为我们费了这么多心思。我可以为你作些甚么呢？你有事要我替你向王或军长说的吗？’"她说："我住在自己的人民中间。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙吩咐仆人说：「你对她说：你既为我们费了许多心思，可以为你做什么呢？你向王或元帅有所求的没有？」她回答说：「我在我本乡安居无事。」
verses.textEnNiv: Elisha said to him, "Tell her, ‘You have gone to all this trouble for us. Now what can be done for you? Can we speak on your behalf to the king or the commander of the army?’ " She replied, "I have a home among my own people."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, "Say now to her, ‘See, you have taken all this trouble for us; what is to be done for you? Would you have a word spoken on your behalf to the king or to the commander of the army?’" She answered, "I dwell among my own people."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to him, "Say now to her, ‘Look, you have been concerned for us with all this care. What canI do for you? Do you want me to speak on your behalf to the king or to the commander of the army?’ " She answered, "I dwell among my own people."
verses.textEnNlt: Elisha said to Gehazi, "Tell her, ‘We appreciate the kind concern you have shown us. What can we do for you? Can we put in a good word for you to the king or to the commander of the army?’" "No," she replied, "my family takes good care of me."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to him, "Say now to her, ‘Behold, you have taken trouble for us with all this care; what can I do for you? Would you like me to speak for you to the king or to the commander of the army?’ " But she answered, "I live among my own people."
verses.textEn: Elisha said to him, "Tell her, ‘You have gone to all this trouble for us. Now what can be done for you? Can we speak on your behalf to the king or the commander of the army?’ " She replied, "I have a home among my own people."

verses.textZh: 于是他说："我到底可以为她作些甚么呢？"基哈西说："她没有儿子，而她的丈夫又老了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他说："我到底可以为她作些甚么呢？"基哈西说："她没有儿子，而她的丈夫又老了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙对仆人说：「究竟当为她做什么呢？」基哈西说：「她没有儿子，她丈夫也老了。」
verses.textEnNiv: "What can be done for her?" Elisha asked. Gehazi said, "She has no son, and her husband is old."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "What then is to be done for her?" Gehazi answered, "Well, she has no son, and her husband is old."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said, "What then is to be done for her?" And Gehazi answered, "Actually, she has no son, and her husband is old."
verses.textEnNlt: Later Elisha asked Gehazi, "What can we do for her?" Gehazi replied, "She doesn’t have a son, and her husband is an old man."
verses.textEnNasb: So he said, "What then is to be done for her?" And Gehazi answered, "It is a fact that she has no son, and her husband is old."
verses.textEn: "What can be done for her?" Elisha asked. Gehazi said, "She has no son, and her husband is old."

verses.textZh: 于是以利沙对他说："再叫她来。"他就再去叫了她来，她就站在门口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以利沙对他说："再叫她来。"他就再去叫了她来，她就站在门口。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙说：「再叫她来。」于是叫了她来，她就站在门口。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Elisha said, "Call her." So he called her, and she stood in the doorway.
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "Call her." And when he had called her, she stood in the doorway.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said, "Call her." When he had called her, she stood in the doorway.
verses.textEnNlt: "Call her back again," Elisha told him. When the woman returned, Elisha said to her as she stood in the doorway,
verses.textEnNasb: He then said, "Call her." When he had called her, she stood in the doorway.
verses.textEn: Then Elisha said, "Call her." So he called her, and she stood in the doorway.

verses.textZh: 以利沙说："明年这个时分，时候到了，你必怀抱一个儿子。"她说："神人哪！不要欺哄你的婢女。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙说："明年这个时分，时候到了，你必怀抱一个儿子。"她说："神人哪！不要欺哄你的婢女。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙说：「明年到这时候，你必抱一个儿子。」她说：「神人，我主啊，不要那样欺哄婢女。」
verses.textEnNiv: "About this time next year," Elisha said, "you will hold a son in your arms." "No, my lord!" she objected. "Please, man of God, don’t mislead your servant!"
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "At this season, about this time next year, you shall embrace a son." And she said, "No, my lord, O man of God; do not lie to your servant."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "About this time next year you shall embrace a son." And she said, "No, my lord. Man of God, do not lie to your maidservant!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Next year at this time you will be holding a son in your arms!" "No, my lord!" she cried. "O man of God, don’t deceive me and get my hopes up like that."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "At this season next year, you are going to embrace a son." And she said, "No, my lord, you man of God, do not lie to your servant."
verses.textEn: "About this time next year," Elisha said, "you will hold a son in your arms." "No, my lord!" she objected. "Please, man of God, don’t mislead your servant!"

verses.textZh: 这妇人果然怀了孕，到明年这个时分，时候到了，她就生了一个儿子，正如以利沙对她所说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这妇人果然怀了孕，到明年这个时分，时候到了，她就生了一个儿子，正如以利沙对她所说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人果然怀孕，到了那时候，生了一个儿子，正如以利沙所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: But the woman became pregnant, and the next year about that same time she gave birth to a son, just as Elisha had told her.
verses.textEnEsv: But the woman conceived, and she bore a son about that time the following spring, as Elisha had said to her.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the woman conceived, and bore a son when the appointed time had come, of which Elisha had told her.
verses.textEnNlt: But sure enough, the woman soon became pregnant. And at that time the following year she had a son, just as Elisha had said.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the woman conceived and gave birth to a son at that season the next year, as Elisha had told her.
verses.textEn: But the woman became pregnant, and the next year about that same time she gave birth to a son, just as Elisha had told her.

verses.textZh: 孩子渐渐长大。有一天，他出来到收割的人中找他的父亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子渐渐长大。有一天，他出来到收割的人中找他的父亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 孩子渐渐长大，一日到他父亲和收割的人那里，
verses.textEnNiv: The child grew, and one day he went out to his father, who was with the reapers.
verses.textEnEsv: When the child had grown, he went out one day to his father among the reapers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the child grew. Now it happened one day that he went out to his father, to the reapers.
verses.textEnNlt: One day when her child was older, he went out to help his father, who was working with the harvesters.
verses.textEnNasb: When the child was grown, the day came that he went out to his father, to the reapers.
verses.textEn: The child grew, and one day he went out to his father, who was with the reapers.

verses.textZh: 他对他的父亲说："我的头啊！我的头啊！"他的父亲对仆人说："把他抱到他母亲那里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对他的父亲说："我的头啊！我的头啊！"他的父亲对仆人说："把他抱到他母亲那里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他对父亲说：「我的头啊，我的头啊！」他父亲对仆人说：「把他抱到他母亲那里。」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to his father, "My head! My head!" His father told a servant, "Carry him to his mother."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to his father, "Oh, my head, my head!" The father said to his servant, "Carry him to his mother."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to his father, "My head, my head!" So he said to a servant, "Carry him to his mother."
verses.textEnNlt: Suddenly he cried out, "My head hurts! My head hurts!" His father said to one of the servants, "Carry him home to his mother."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to his father, "My head, my head!" And his father said to his servant, "Carry him to his mother."
verses.textEn: He said to his father, "My head! My head!" His father told a servant, "Carry him to his mother."

verses.textZh: 于是仆人把他抱着，送到他母亲那里。孩子坐在他母亲的双膝上，到中午就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是仆人把他抱着，送到他母亲那里。孩子坐在他母亲的双膝上，到中午就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 仆人抱去，交给他母亲；孩子坐在母亲的膝上，到晌午就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: After the servant had lifted him up and carried him to his mother, the boy sat on her lap until noon, and then he died.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had lifted him and brought him to his mother, the child sat on her lap till noon, and then he died.
verses.textEnNkjv: When he had taken him and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and then died.
verses.textEnNlt: So the servant took him home, and his mother held him on her lap. But around noontime he died.
verses.textEnNasb: When he had carried him and brought him to his mother, he sat on her lap until noon, and then he died.
verses.textEn: After the servant had lifted him up and carried him to his mother, the boy sat on her lap until noon, and then he died.

verses.textZh: 她把孩子抱上小阁，放在神人的床上；她把他关在里面，就出去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她把孩子抱上小阁，放在神人的床上；她把他关在里面，就出去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他母亲抱他上了楼，将他放在神人的床上，关上门出来，
verses.textEnNiv: She went up and laid him on the bed of the man of God, then shut the door and went out.
verses.textEnEsv: And she went up and laid him on the bed of the man of God and shut the door behind him and went out.
verses.textEnNkjv: And she went up and laid him on the bed of the man of God, shut thedoor upon him, and went out.
verses.textEnNlt: She carried him up and laid him on the bed of the man of God, then shut the door and left him there.
verses.textEnNasb: And she went up and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut the door behind him and left.
verses.textEn: She went up and laid him on the bed of the man of God, then shut the door and went out.

verses.textZh: 她呼唤她的丈夫，说："请你派一个仆人和一头驴子给我。我要赶到神人那里，立刻就回来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她呼唤她的丈夫，说："请你派一个仆人和一头驴子给我。我要赶到神人那里，立刻就回来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 呼叫她丈夫说：「你叫一个仆人给我牵一匹驴来，我要快快地去见神人，就回来。」
verses.textEnNiv: She called her husband and said, "Please send me one of the servants and a donkey so I can go to the man of God quickly and return."
verses.textEnEsv: Then she called to her husband and said, "Send me one of the servants and one of the donkeys, that I may quickly go to the man of God and come back again."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she called to her husband, and said, "Please send me one of the young men and one of the donkeys, that I may run to the man of God and come back."
verses.textEnNlt: She sent a message to her husband: "Send one of the servants and a donkey so that I can hurry to the man of God and come right back."
verses.textEnNasb: Then she called to her husband and said, "Please send me one of the servants and one of the donkeys, so that I may run to the man of God and return."
verses.textEn: She called her husband and said, "Please send me one of the servants and a donkey so I can go to the man of God quickly and return."

verses.textZh: 他说："为甚么你要在今天去见他呢？今天既不是月朔，也不是安息日。"她说："一切都平安。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："为甚么你要在今天去见他呢？今天既不是月朔，也不是安息日。"她说："一切都平安。"
verses.textZhCuv: 丈夫说：「今日不是月朔，也不是安息日，你为何要去见他呢？」妇人说：「平安无事。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Why go to him today?" he asked. "It’s not the New Moon or the Sabbath." "That’s all right," she said.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Why will you go to him today? It is neither new moon nor Sabbath." She said, "All is well."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said, "Why are you going to him today? Itis neither the New Moon nor the Sabbath." And she said, "Itis well."
verses.textEnNlt: "Why go today?" he asked. "It is neither a new moon festival nor a Sabbath." But she said, "It will be all right."
verses.textEnNasb: But he said, "Why are you going to him today? It is neither new moon nor Sabbath." So she just said, "It will be fine."
verses.textEn: "Why go to him today?" he asked. "It’s not the New Moon or the Sabbath." "That’s all right," she said.

verses.textZh: 于是她把驴套上鞍，对她的仆人说："你来赶驴子走吧，除非我告诉你，否则不要因为我慢下来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是她把驴套上鞍，对她的仆人说："你来赶驴子走吧，除非我告诉你，否则不要因为我慢下来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是备上驴，对仆人说：「你快快赶着走，我若不吩咐你，就不要迟慢。」
verses.textEnNiv: She saddled the donkey and said to her servant, "Lead on; don’t slow down for me unless I tell you."
verses.textEnEsv: Then she saddled the donkey, and she said to her servant, "Urge the animal on; do not slacken the pace for me unless I tell you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she saddled a donkey, and said to her servant, "Drive, and go forward; do not slacken the pace for me unless I tell you."
verses.textEnNlt: So she saddled the donkey and said to the servant, "Hurry! Don’t slow down unless I tell you to."
verses.textEnNasb: Then she saddled the donkey and said to her servant, "Drive the donkey and go on; do not slow down the pace for me unless I tell you."
verses.textEn: She saddled the donkey and said to her servant, "Lead on; don’t slow down for me unless I tell you."

verses.textZh: 于是她起程，去到迦密山神人那里。神人从远处看见她的时候，就对他的仆人基哈西说："看哪！书念的妇人在那边呢！
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是她起程，去到迦密山神人那里。神人从远处看见她的时候，就对他的仆人基哈西说："看哪！书念的妇人在那边呢！
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人就往迦密山去见神人。神人远远地看见她，对仆人基哈西说：「看哪，书念的妇人来了！
verses.textEnNiv: So she set out and came to the man of God at Mount Carmel. When he saw her in the distance, the man of God said to his servant Gehazi, "Look! There’s the Shunammite!
verses.textEnEsv: So she set out and came to the man of God at Mount Carmel. When the man of God saw her coming, he said to Gehazi his servant, "Look, there is the Shunammite.
verses.textEnNkjv: And so she departed, and went to the man of God at Mount Carmel. So it was, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to his servant Gehazi, "Look, the Shunammite woman!
verses.textEnNlt: As she approached the man of God at Mount Carmel, Elisha saw her in the distance. He said to Gehazi, "Look, the woman from Shunem is coming.
verses.textEnNasb: So she went on and came to the man of God at Mount Carmel. When the man of God saw her at a distance, he said to Gehazi his servant, "Behold, that person there is the Shunammite.
verses.textEn: So she set out and came to the man of God at Mount Carmel. When he saw her in the distance, the man of God said to his servant Gehazi, "Look! There’s the Shunammite!

verses.textZh: 现在你跑去迎接她，对她说：‘你平安吗？你的丈夫平安吗？你的儿子平安吗？’"她说："都平安。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你跑去迎接她，对她说：‘你平安吗？你的丈夫平安吗？你的儿子平安吗？’"她说："都平安。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你跑去迎接她，问她说：你平安吗？你丈夫平安吗？孩子平安吗？」她说：「平安。」
verses.textEnNiv: Run to meet her and ask her, ‘Are you all right? Is your husband all right? Is your child all right?’ " "Everything is all right," she said.
verses.textEnEsv: Run at once to meet her and say to her, ‘Is all well with you? Is all well with your husband? Is all well with the child?’" And she answered, "All is well."
verses.textEnNkjv: Please run now to meet her, and say to her, ‘Isit well with you? Isit well with your husband? Isit well with the child?’ " And she answered, "Itis well."
verses.textEnNlt: Run out to meet her and ask her, ‘Is everything all right with you, your husband, and your child?’" "Yes," the woman told Gehazi, "everything is fine."
verses.textEnNasb: Please run now to meet her and say to her, ‘Is it going well for you? Is it going well for your husband? Is it going well for the child?’ " Then she answered, "It is going well."
verses.textEn: Run to meet her and ask her, ‘Are you all right? Is your husband all right? Is your child all right?’ " "Everything is all right," she said.

verses.textZh: 她来到山上神人那里，就抱住神人的脚；基哈西上前要推开她，但神人说："由她吧，因为她的心灵很痛苦。耶和华隐瞒我，没有告诉我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她来到山上神人那里，就抱住神人的脚；基哈西上前要推开她，但神人说："由她吧，因为她的心灵很痛苦。耶和华隐瞒我，没有告诉我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人上了山，到神人那里，就抱住神人的脚。基哈西前来要推开她，神人说：「由她吧！因为她心里愁苦，耶和华向我隐瞒，没有指示我。」
verses.textEnNiv: When she reached the man of God at the mountain, she took hold of his feet. Gehazi came over to push her away, but the man of God said, "Leave her alone! She is in bitter distress, but the Lord has hidden it from me and has not told me why."
verses.textEnEsv: And when she came to the mountain to the man of God, she caught hold of his feet. And Gehazi came to push her away. But the man of God said, "Leave her alone, for she is in bitter distress, and the Lord has hidden it from me and has not told me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when she came to the man of God at the hill, she caught him by the feet, but Gehazi came near to push her away. But the man of God said, "Let her alone; for her soul is in deep distress, and the Lord has hidden it from me, and has not told me."
verses.textEnNlt: But when she came to the man of God at the mountain, she fell to the ground before him and caught hold of his feet. Gehazi began to push her away, but the man of God said, "Leave her alone. She is deeply troubled, but the Lord has not told me what it is."
verses.textEnNasb: But she came to the man of God at the hill and took hold of his feet. And Gehazi came up to push her away, but the man of God said, "Leave her alone, for her soul is troubled within her; and the Lord has concealed it from me and has not informed me."
verses.textEn: When she reached the man of God at the mountain, she took hold of his feet. Gehazi came over to push her away, but the man of God said, "Leave her alone! She is in bitter distress, but the Lord has hidden it from me and has not told me why."

verses.textZh: 她说："我有向我主求过儿子吗？我不是说过：‘不要欺哄我’的吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她说："我有向我主求过儿子吗？我不是说过：‘不要欺哄我’的吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人说：「我何尝向我主求过儿子呢？我岂没有说过，不要欺哄我吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Did I ask you for a son, my lord?" she said. "Didn’t I tell you, ‘Don’t raise my hopes’?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then she said, "Did I ask my lord for a son? Did I not say, ‘Do not deceive me?’"
verses.textEnNkjv: So she said, "Did I ask a son of my lord? Did I not say, ‘Do not deceive me’?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then she said, "Did I ask you for a son, my lord? And didn’t I say, ‘Don’t deceive me and get my hopes up’?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then she said, "Did I ask for a son from my lord? Did I not say, ‘Do not give me false hope’?"
verses.textEn: "Did I ask you for a son, my lord?" she said. "Didn’t I tell you, ‘Don’t raise my hopes’?"

verses.textZh: 神人对基哈西说："你束上腰，手里拿着我的手杖前去；不论遇见的是谁，都不要向他问安；若是有人向你问安，你也不要回答他，只要去把我的手杖放在孩子的脸上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神人对基哈西说："你束上腰，手里拿着我的手杖前去；不论遇见的是谁，都不要向他问安；若是有人向你问安，你也不要回答他，只要去把我的手杖放在孩子的脸上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙吩咐基哈西说：「你束上腰，手拿我的杖前去；若遇见人，不要向他问安；人若向你问安，也不要回答；要把我的杖放在孩子脸上。」
verses.textEnNiv: Elisha said to Gehazi, "Tuck your cloak into your belt, take my staff in your hand and run. Don’t greet anyone you meet, and if anyone greets you, do not answer. Lay my staff on the boy’s face."
verses.textEnEsv: He said to Gehazi, "Tie up your garment and take my staff in your hand and go. If you meet anyone, do not greet him, and if anyone greets you, do not reply. And lay my staff on the face of the child."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to Gehazi, "Get yourself ready, and take my staff in your hand, and be on your way. If you meet anyone, do not greet him; and if anyone greets you, do not answer him; but lay my staff on the face of the child."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elisha said to Gehazi, "Get ready to travel ; take my staff and go! Don’t talk to anyone along the way. Go quickly and lay the staff on the child’s face."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to Gehazi, " Get ready and take my staff in your hand, and go; if you meet anyone, do not greet him, and if anyone greets you, do not reply to him. And lay my staff on the boy’s face."
verses.textEn: Elisha said to Gehazi, "Tuck your cloak into your belt, take my staff in your hand and run. Don’t greet anyone you meet, and if anyone greets you, do not answer. Lay my staff on the boy’s face."

verses.textZh: 孩子的母亲说："我指着永活的耶和华和你的性命起誓，我决不会离开你。"神人只好起身随她而去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子的母亲说："我指着永活的耶和华和你的性命起誓，我决不会离开你。"神人只好起身随她而去。
verses.textZhCuv: 孩子的母亲说：「我指着永生的耶和华，又敢在你面前起誓，我必不离开你。」于是以利沙起身，随着她去了。
verses.textEnNiv: But the child’s mother said, "As surely as the Lord lives and as you live, I will not leave you." So he got up and followed her.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the mother of the child said, "As the Lord lives and as you yourself live, I will not leave you." So he arose and followed her.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the mother of the child said, "As the Lord lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you." So he arose and followed her.
verses.textEnNlt: But the boy’s mother said, "As surely as the Lord lives and you yourself live, I won’t go home unless you go with me." So Elisha returned with her.
verses.textEnNasb: The mother of the boy said, "As surely as the Lord lives and you yourself live, I will not leave you." So he got up and followed her.
verses.textEn: But the child’s mother said, "As surely as the Lord lives and as you live, I will not leave you." So he got up and followed her.

verses.textZh: 基哈西在他们前面去了，把手杖放在孩子的脸上，可是没有声音，也没有反应；于是他回来迎着以利沙，告诉他说："那孩子还没有醒过来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 基哈西在他们前面去了，把手杖放在孩子的脸上，可是没有声音，也没有反应；于是他回来迎着以利沙，告诉他说："那孩子还没有醒过来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 基哈西先去，把杖放在孩子脸上，却没有声音，也没有动静。基哈西就迎着以利沙回来，告诉他说：「孩子还没有醒过来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Gehazi went on ahead and laid the staff on the boy’s face, but there was no sound or response. So Gehazi went back to meet Elisha and told him, "The boy has not awakened."
verses.textEnEsv: Gehazi went on ahead and laid the staff on the face of the child, but there was no sound or sign of life. Therefore he returned to meet him and told him, "The child has not awakened."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Gehazi went on ahead of them, and laid the staff on the face of the child; but therewas neither voice nor hearing. Therefore he went back to meet him, and told him, saying, "The child has not awakened."
verses.textEnNlt: Gehazi hurried on ahead and laid the staff on the child’s face, but nothing happened. There was no sign of life. He returned to meet Elisha and told him, "The child is still dead."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Gehazi went on ahead of them and laid the staff on the boy’s face, but there was no sound or response. So he returned to meet him and informed him, saying, "The boy has not awakened."
verses.textEn: Gehazi went on ahead and laid the staff on the boy’s face, but there was no sound or response. So Gehazi went back to meet Elisha and told him, "The boy has not awakened."

verses.textZh: 以利沙来到书念妇人的家，看见孩子已经死了，躺在他的床上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙来到书念妇人的家，看见孩子已经死了，躺在他的床上。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙来到，进了屋子，看见孩子死了，放在自己的床上。
verses.textEnNiv: When Elisha reached the house, there was the boy lying dead on his couch.
verses.textEnEsv: When Elisha came into the house, he saw the child lying dead on his bed.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Elisha came into the house, there was the child, lying dead on his bed.
verses.textEnNlt: When Elisha arrived, the child was indeed dead, lying there on the prophet’s bed.
verses.textEnNasb: When Elisha entered the house, behold the boy was dead, laid on his bed.
verses.textEn: When Elisha reached the house, there was the boy lying dead on his couch.

verses.textZh: 于是他进去，把自己和孩子二人关在门内，然后向耶和华祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他进去，把自己和孩子二人关在门内，然后向耶和华祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就关上门，只有自己和孩子在里面，他便祈祷耶和华，
verses.textEnNiv: He went in, shut the door on the two of them and prayed to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: So he went in and shut the door behind the two of them and prayed to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: He went in therefore, shut the door behind the two of them, and prayed to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: He went in alone and shut the door behind him and prayed to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So he entered and shut the door behind them both, and he prayed to the Lord.
verses.textEn: He went in, shut the door on the two of them and prayed to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他又上床伏在孩子身上，使自己的口对着孩子的口，自己的眼对着孩子的眼，自己的手放在孩子的手上；他伏在孩子身上，孩子的身体就渐渐温暖起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又上床伏在孩子身上，使自己的口对着孩子的口，自己的眼对着孩子的眼，自己的手放在孩子的手上；他伏在孩子身上，孩子的身体就渐渐温暖起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 上床伏在孩子身上，口对口，眼对眼，手对手；既伏在孩子身上，孩子的身体就渐渐温和了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he got on the bed and lay on the boy, mouth to mouth, eyes to eyes, hands to hands. As he stretched himself out on him, the boy’s body grew warm.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he went up and lay on the child, putting his mouth on his mouth, his eyes on his eyes, and his hands on his hands. And as he stretched himself upon him, the flesh of the child became warm.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he went up and lay on the child, and put his mouth on his mouth, his eyes on his eyes, and his hands on his hands; and he stretched himself out on the child, and the flesh of the child became warm.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he lay down on the child’s body, placing his mouth on the child’s mouth, his eyes on the child’s eyes, and his hands on the child’s hands. And as he stretched out on him, the child’s body began to grow warm again!
verses.textEnNasb: Then he got up on the bed and lay on the child, and put his mouth on his mouth, his eyes on his eyes, his hands on his hands, and he bent down on him; and the flesh of the child became warm.
verses.textEn: Then he got on the bed and lay on the boy, mouth to mouth, eyes to eyes, hands to hands. As he stretched himself out on him, the boy’s body grew warm.

verses.textZh: 然后他下来在房内来回走了一趟，再上去，伏在孩子身上；那孩子打了七个喷嚏，跟着就张开了眼睛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后他下来在房内来回走了一趟，再上去，伏在孩子身上；那孩子打了七个喷嚏，跟着就张开了眼睛。
verses.textZhCuv: 然后他下来，在屋里来往走了一趟，又上去伏在孩子身上，孩子打了七个喷嚏，就睁开眼睛了。
verses.textEnNiv: Elisha turned away and walked back and forth in the room and then got on the bed and stretched out on him once more. The boy sneezed seven times and opened his eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he got up again and walked once back and forth in the house, and went up and stretched himself upon him. The child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: He returned and walked back and forth in the house, and again went up and stretched himself out on him; then the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: Elisha got up, walked back and forth across the room once, and then stretched himself out again on the child. This time the boy sneezed seven times and opened his eyes!
verses.textEnNasb: Then he returned and walked in the house back and forth once, and went up and bent down on him; and the boy sneezed seven times, then the boy opened his eyes.
verses.textEn: Elisha turned away and walked back and forth in the room and then got on the bed and stretched out on him once more. The boy sneezed seven times and opened his eyes.

verses.textZh: 神人呼唤基哈西，说："你去叫那书念的妇人来。"他就去叫她，她来到他那里，他就说："把你的儿子抱起来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神人呼唤基哈西，说："你去叫那书念的妇人来。"他就去叫她，她来到他那里，他就说："把你的儿子抱起来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙叫基哈西说：「你叫这书念妇人来」；于是叫了她来。以利沙说：「将你儿子抱起来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Elisha summoned Gehazi and said, "Call the Shunammite." And he did. When she came, he said, "Take your son."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he summoned Gehazi and said, "Call this Shunammite." So he called her. And when she came to him, he said, "Pick up your son."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he called Gehazi and said, "Call this Shunammite woman." So he called her. And when she came in to him, he said, "Pick up your son."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elisha summoned Gehazi. "Call the child’s mother!" he said. And when she came in, Elisha said, "Here, take your son!"
verses.textEnNasb: And he called Gehazi and said, "Call this Shunammite." So he called her. And when she came to him, he said, "Pick up your son."
verses.textEn: Elisha summoned Gehazi and said, "Call the Shunammite." And he did. When she came, he said, "Take your son."

verses.textZh: 于是她进去，在他的脚前下拜，俯伏在地上；然后把儿子抱起来，出去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是她进去，在他的脚前下拜，俯伏在地上；然后把儿子抱起来，出去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人就进来，在以利沙脚前俯伏于地，抱起她儿子出去了。
verses.textEnNiv: She came in, fell at his feet and bowed to the ground. Then she took her son and went out.
verses.textEnEsv: She came and fell at his feet, bowing to the ground. Then she picked up her son and went out.
verses.textEnNkjv: So she went in, fell at his feet, and bowed to the ground; then she picked up her son and went out.
verses.textEnNlt: She fell at his feet and bowed before him, overwhelmed with gratitude. Then she took her son in her arms and carried him downstairs.
verses.textEnNasb: Then she came in and fell at his feet and bowed down to the ground, and she picked up her son and left.
verses.textEn: She came in, fell at his feet and bowed to the ground. Then she took her son and went out.

verses.textZh: 以利沙又回到吉甲，那地正发生饥荒。先知的门徒坐在他面前。他对他的仆人说："把大锅放在火上，给先知的门徒们煮点东西吃。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙又回到吉甲，那地正发生饥荒。先知的门徒坐在他面前。他对他的仆人说："把大锅放在火上，给先知的门徒们煮点东西吃。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙又来到吉甲，那地正有饥荒。先知门徒坐在他面前，他吩咐仆人说：「你将大锅放在火上，给先知门徒熬汤。」
verses.textEnNiv: Elisha returned to Gilgal and there was a famine in that region. While the company of the prophets was meeting with him, he said to his servant, "Put on the large pot and cook some stew for these prophets."
verses.textEnEsv: And Elisha came again to Gilgal when there was a famine in the land. And as the sons of the prophets were sitting before him, he said to his servant, "Set on the large pot, and boil stew for the sons of the prophets."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Elisha returned to Gilgal, and therewas a famine in the land. Now the sons of the prophets were sitting before him; and he said to his servant, "Put on the large pot, and boil stew for the sons of the prophets."
verses.textEnNlt: Elisha now returned to Gilgal, and there was a famine in the land. One day as the group of prophets was seated before him, he said to his servant, "Put a large pot on the fire, and make some stew for the rest of the group."
verses.textEnNasb: When Elisha returned to Gilgal, there was a famine in the land. As the sons of the prophets were sitting in front of him, he said to his servant, "Put on the large pot and boil stew for the sons of the prophets."
verses.textEn: Elisha returned to Gilgal and there was a famine in that region. While the company of the prophets was meeting with him, he said to his servant, "Put on the large pot and cook some stew for these prophets."

verses.textZh: 有一个人到田野那里去采摘野菜。他找到一棵野瓜藤，就摘下藤上的野瓜装满了他的衣服。他回来，把瓜切了放入煮东西的锅中，他们不知道是甚么东西。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个人到田野那里去采摘野菜。他找到一棵野瓜藤，就摘下藤上的野瓜装满了他的衣服。他回来，把瓜切了放入煮东西的锅中，他们不知道是甚么东西。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个人去到田野掐菜，遇见一棵野瓜藤，就摘了一兜野瓜回来，切了搁在熬汤的锅中，因为他们不知道是什么东西；
verses.textEnNiv: One of them went out into the fields to gather herbs and found a wild vine and picked as many of its gourds as his garment could hold. When he returned, he cut them up into the pot of stew, though no one knew what they were.
verses.textEnEsv: One of them went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine and gathered from it his lap full of wild gourds, and came and cut them up into the pot of stew, not knowing what they were.
verses.textEnNkjv: So one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered from it a lapful of wild gourds, and came and sliced them into the pot of stew, though they did not know whattheywere.
verses.textEnNlt: One of the young men went out into the field to gather herbs and came back with a pocketful of wild gourds. He shredded them and put them into the pot without realizing they were poisonous.
verses.textEnNasb: Then one went out into the field to gather mallow, and found a wild vine and gathered from it his lap full of wild gourds; and he came and sliced them into the pot of stew, because they did not know what they were.
verses.textEn: One of them went out into the fields to gather herbs and found a wild vine and picked as many of its gourds as his garment could hold. When he returned, he cut them up into the pot of stew, though no one knew what they were.

verses.textZh: 后来他们倒出来给众人吃，他们在吃锅里的东西的时候，都惨叫起来，说："神人哪！锅中有致死的毒物！"他们就不能吃了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来他们倒出来给众人吃，他们在吃锅里的东西的时候，都惨叫起来，说："神人哪！锅中有致死的毒物！"他们就不能吃了。
verses.textZhCuv: 倒出来给众人吃，吃的时候，都喊叫说：「神人哪，锅中有致死的毒物！」所以众人不能吃了。
verses.textEnNiv: The stew was poured out for the men, but as they began to eat it, they cried out, "Man of God, there is death in the pot!" And they could not eat it.
verses.textEnEsv: And they poured out some for the men to eat. But while they were eating of the stew, they cried out, "O man of God, there is death in the pot!" And they could not eat it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they served it to the men to eat. Now it happened, as they were eating the stew, that they cried out and said, "Man of God, thereis death in the pot!" And they could not eat it.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of the stew was served to the men. But after they had eaten a bite or two they cried out, "Man of God, there’s poison in this stew!" So they would not eat it.
verses.textEnNasb: So they poured it out for the men to eat. But as they were eating the stew, they cried out and said, "You man of God, there is death in the pot!" And they were unable to eat.
verses.textEn: The stew was poured out for the men, but as they began to eat it, they cried out, "Man of God, there is death in the pot!" And they could not eat it.

verses.textZh: 他说："拿些面给我。"他把面放在锅中，说："倒出来给众人吃吧。"锅里就没有毒了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："拿些面给我。"他把面放在锅中，说："倒出来给众人吃吧。"锅里就没有毒了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙说：「拿点面来」，就把面撒在锅中，说：「倒出来，给众人吃吧！」锅中就没有毒了。
verses.textEnNiv: Elisha said, "Get some flour." He put it into the pot and said, "Serve it to the people to eat." And there was nothing harmful in the pot.
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "Then bring flour." And he threw it into the pot and said, "Pour some out for the men, that they may eat." And there was no harm in the pot.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said, "Then bring some flour." And he put it into the pot, and said, "Serve it to the people, that they may eat." And there was nothing harmful in the pot.
verses.textEnNlt: Elisha said, "Bring me some flour." Then he threw it into the pot and said, "Now it’s all right; go ahead and eat." And then it did not harm them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "Bring flour." And he threw it into the pot, and said, "Pour it out for the people that they may eat." Then there was nothing harmful in the pot.
verses.textEn: Elisha said, "Get some flour." He put it into the pot and said, "Serve it to the people to eat." And there was nothing harmful in the pot.

verses.textZh: 有一个人从巴力．沙利沙来，他带给神人二十个用初熟大麦做的饼，还有新穗子，装在他的袋子里；以利沙说："把这些给众人吃吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个人从巴力．沙利沙来，他带给神人二十个用初熟大麦做的饼，还有新穗子，装在他的袋子里；以利沙说："把这些给众人吃吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个人从巴力‧沙利沙来，带着初熟大麦做的饼二十个，并新穗子，装在口袋里送给神人。神人说：「把这些给众人吃。」
verses.textEnNiv: A man came from Baal Shalishah, bringing the man of God twenty loaves of barley bread baked from the first ripe grain, along with some heads of new grain. "Give it to the people to eat," Elisha said.
verses.textEnEsv: A man came from Baal-shalishah, bringing the man of God bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley and fresh ears of grain in his sack. And Elisha said, "Give to the men, that they may eat."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then a man came from Baal Shalisha, and brought the man of God bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley bread, and newly ripened grain in his knapsack. And he said, "Give it to the people, that they may eat."
verses.textEnNlt: One day a man from Baal-shalishah brought the man of God a sack of fresh grain and twenty loaves of barley bread made from the first grain of his harvest. Elisha said, "Give it to the people so they can eat."
verses.textEnNasb: Now a man came from Baal-shalishah, and brought the man of God bread of the first fruits, twenty loaves of barley and fresh grain in his sack. And Elisha said, "Give them to the people that they may eat."
verses.textEn: A man came from Baal Shalishah, bringing the man of God twenty loaves of barley bread baked from the first ripe grain, along with some heads of new grain. "Give it to the people to eat," Elisha said.

verses.textZh: 他的仆人说："我怎能把这一些食物摆在一百个人面前呢？"神人说："给众人吃吧，因为耶和华这样说：‘他们要吃，而且还有剩下的。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的仆人说："我怎能把这一些食物摆在一百个人面前呢？"神人说："给众人吃吧，因为耶和华这样说：‘他们要吃，而且还有剩下的。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 仆人说：「这一点岂可摆给一百人吃呢？」以利沙说：「你只管给众人吃吧！因为耶和华如此说，众人必吃了，还剩下。」
verses.textEnNiv: "How can I set this before a hundred men?" his servant asked. But Elisha answered, "Give it to the people to eat. For this is what the Lord says: ‘They will eat and have some left over.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: But his servant said, "How can I set this before a hundred men?" So he repeated, "Give them to the men, that they may eat, for thus says the Lord , ‘They shall eat and have some left.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: But his servant said, "What? Shall I set this before one hundred men?" He said again, "Give it to the people, that they may eat; for thus says the Lord: ‘They shall eat and have some left over.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "What?" his servant exclaimed. "Feed a hundred people with only this?" But Elisha repeated, "Give it to the people so they can eat, for this is what the Lord says: Everyone will eat, and there will even be some left over!"
verses.textEnNasb: But his attendant said, "How am I to serve this to a hundred men?" Nevertheless he said, "Give them to the people that they may eat, for this is what the Lord says: ‘They shall eat and have some left over.’ "
verses.textEn: "How can I set this before a hundred men?" his servant asked. But Elisha answered, "Give it to the people to eat. For this is what the Lord says: ‘They will eat and have some left over.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是仆人摆在众人面前，他们都吃，而且还有剩下的，正如耶和华所说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是仆人摆在众人面前，他们都吃，而且还有剩下的，正如耶和华所说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 仆人就摆在众人面前，他们吃了，果然还剩下，正如耶和华所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he set it before them, and they ate and had some left over, according to the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: So he set it before them. And they ate and had some left, according to the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So he set it before them; and they ate and had some left over, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: And when they gave it to the people, there was plenty for all and some left over, just as the Lord had promised.
verses.textEnNasb: So he served it to them, and they ate and had some left over, in accordance with the word of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then he set it before them, and they ate and had some left over, according to the word of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 亚兰王的军长乃缦在他的主人面前是一个大人物，很得王的赏识，因为耶和华曾藉他把胜利赐给亚兰。这个人是个勇猛的战士，可惜他是个痲风病人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚兰王的军长乃缦在他的主人面前是一个大人物，很得王的赏识，因为耶和华曾藉他把胜利赐给亚兰。这个人是个勇猛的战士，可惜他是个痲风病人。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚兰王的元帅乃缦在他主人面前为尊为大，因耶和华曾藉他使亚兰人得胜；他又是大能的勇士，只是长了大麻风。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Naaman was commander of the army of the king of Aram. He was a great man in the sight of his master and highly regarded, because through him the Lord had given victory to Aram. He was a valiant soldier, but he had leprosy.
verses.textEnEsv: Naaman, commander of the army of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master and in high favor, because by him the Lord had given victory to Syria. He was a mighty man of valor, but he was a leper.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Naaman, commander of the army of the king of Syria, was a great and honorable man in the eyes of his master, because by him the Lord had given victory to Syria. He was also a mighty man of valor, but a leper.
verses.textEnNlt: The king of Aram had great admiration for Naaman, the commander of his army, because through him the Lord had given Aram great victories. But though Naaman was a mighty warrior, he suffered from leprosy.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Naaman, commander of the army of the king of Aram, was a great man in the view of his master, and eminent, because by him the Lord had given victory to Aram. The man was also a valiant warrior, but afflicted with leprosy.
verses.textEn: Now Naaman was commander of the army of the king of Aram. He was a great man in the sight of his master and highly regarded, because through him the Lord had given victory to Aram. He was a valiant soldier, but he had leprosy.

verses.textZh: 亚兰人曾经出去结队抢掠，从以色列地掳了一个小女孩，她就侍候乃缦的妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚兰人曾经出去结队抢掠，从以色列地掳了一个小女孩，她就侍候乃缦的妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 先前亚兰人成群地出去，从以色列国掳了一个小女子，这女子就服事乃缦的妻。
verses.textEnNiv: Now bands of raiders from Aram had gone out and had taken captive a young girl from Israel, and she served Naaman’s wife.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Syrians on one of their raids had carried off a little girl from the land of Israel, and she worked in the service of Naaman’s wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Syrians had gone out on raids, and had brought back captive a young girl from the land of Israel. She waited on Naaman’s wife.
verses.textEnNlt: At this time Aramean raiders had invaded the land of Israel, and among their captives was a young girl who had been given to Naaman’s wife as a maid.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Arameans had gone out in bands and had taken captive a little girl from the land of Israel; and she waited on Naaman’s wife.
verses.textEn: Now bands of raiders from Aram had gone out and had taken captive a young girl from Israel, and she served Naaman’s wife.

verses.textZh: 她对她的女主人说："如果我的主人去见撒玛利亚的先知就好了，他必定能治好他的痲风。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她对她的女主人说："如果我的主人去见撒玛利亚的先知就好了，他必定能治好他的痲风。"
verses.textZhCuv: 她对主母说：「巴不得我主人去见撒马利亚的先知，必能治好他的大麻风。」
verses.textEnNiv: She said to her mistress, "If only my master would see the prophet who is in Samaria! He would cure him of his leprosy."
verses.textEnEsv: She said to her mistress, "Would that my lord were with the prophet who is in Samaria! He would cure him of his leprosy."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she said to her mistress, "If only my master were with the prophet who is in Samaria! For he would heal him of his leprosy."
verses.textEnNlt: One day the girl said to her mistress, "I wish my master would go to see the prophet in Samaria. He would heal him of his leprosy."
verses.textEnNasb: And she said to her mistress, "If only my master were with the prophet who is in Samaria! Then he would cure him of his leprosy."
verses.textEn: She said to her mistress, "If only my master would see the prophet who is in Samaria! He would cure him of his leprosy."

verses.textZh: 于是乃缦去告诉他的主人说："从以色列地掳回来的女孩子这样这样说。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是乃缦去告诉他的主人说："从以色列地掳回来的女孩子这样这样说。"
verses.textZhCuv: 乃缦进去，告诉他主人说，以色列国的女子如此如此说。
verses.textEnNiv: Naaman went to his master and told him what the girl from Israel had said.
verses.textEnEsv: So Naaman went in and told his lord, "Thus and so spoke the girl from the land of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Naaman went in and told his master, saying, "Thus and thus said the girl who is from the land of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: So Naaman told the king what the young girl from Israel had said.
verses.textEnNasb: And Naaman went in and told his master, saying, "The girl who is from the land of Israel spoke such and such."
verses.textEn: Naaman went to his master and told him what the girl from Israel had said.

verses.textZh: 亚兰王说："你去吧！我会送一封书信给以色列王的。"于是乃缦去了，手里带着三百公斤银子，约七十公斤金子和十套衣裳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚兰王说："你去吧！我会送一封书信给以色列王的。"于是乃缦去了，手里带着三百公斤银子，约七十公斤金子和十套衣裳。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚兰王说：「你可以去，我也达信于以色列王。」于是乃缦带银子十他连得，金子六千舍客勒，衣裳十套，就去了；
verses.textEnNiv: "By all means, go," the king of Aram replied. "I will send a letter to the king of Israel." So Naaman left, taking with him ten talents of silver, six thousand shekels of gold and ten sets of clothing.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Syria said, "Go now, and I will send a letter to the king of Israel." So he went, taking with him ten talents of silver, six thousand shekels of gold, and ten changes of clothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king of Syria said, "Go now, and I will send a letter to the king of Israel." So he departed and took with him ten talents of silver, six thousand shekels of gold, and ten changes of clothing.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go and visit the prophet," the king of Aram told him. "I will send a letter of introduction for you to take to the king of Israel." So Naaman started out, carrying as gifts 750 pounds of silver, 150 pounds of gold, and ten sets of clothing.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Aram said, "Go now, and I will send a letter to the king of Israel." So he departed and took with him ten talents of silver, six thousand shekels of gold, and ten changes of clothes.
verses.textEn: "By all means, go," the king of Aram replied. "I will send a letter to the king of Israel." So Naaman left, taking with him ten talents of silver, six thousand shekels of gold and ten sets of clothing.

verses.textZh: 他把信带到以色列王那里，信上说："这信既已达到你那里，你看见我差去见你的臣仆乃缦，你就要医好他的痲风。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把信带到以色列王那里，信上说："这信既已达到你那里，你看见我差去见你的臣仆乃缦，你就要医好他的痲风。"
verses.textZhCuv: 且带信给以色列王，信上说：「我打发臣仆乃缦去见你，你接到这信，就要治好他的大麻风。」
verses.textEnNiv: The letter that he took to the king of Israel read: "With this letter I am sending my servant Naaman to you so that you may cure him of his leprosy."
verses.textEnEsv: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, which read, "When this letter reaches you, know that I have sent to you Naaman my servant, that you may cure him of his leprosy."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he brought the letter to the king of Israel, which said, Now be advised, when this letter comes to you, that I have sent Naaman my servant to you, that you may heal him of his leprosy.
verses.textEnNlt: The letter to the king of Israel said: "With this letter I present my servant Naaman. I want you to heal him of his leprosy."
verses.textEnNasb: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, which said, "And now as this letter comes to you, behold, I have sent Naaman my servant to you, so that you may cure him of his leprosy."
verses.textEn: The letter that he took to the king of Israel read: "With this letter I am sending my servant Naaman to you so that you may cure him of his leprosy."

verses.textZh: 以色列王读了这信后，就撕裂自己的衣服，说："我是神，能使人死使人活吗？这人竟派人到我这里来，要我治好他的痲风。请你们想想看，他是要找机会攻击我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王读了这信后，就撕裂自己的衣服，说："我是神，能使人死使人活吗？这人竟派人到我这里来，要我治好他的痲风。请你们想想看，他是要找机会攻击我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王看了信就撕裂衣服，说：「我岂是神，能使人死使人活呢？这人竟打发人来，叫我治好他的大麻风。你们看一看，这人何以寻隙攻击我呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as the king of Israel read the letter, he tore his robes and said, "Am I God? Can I kill and bring back to life? Why does this fellow send someone to me to be cured of his leprosy? See how he is trying to pick a quarrel with me!"
verses.textEnEsv: And when the king of Israel read the letter, he tore his clothes and said, "Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man sends word to me to cure a man of his leprosy? Only consider, and see how he is seeking a quarrel with me."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, when the king of Israel read the letter, that he tore his clothes and said, "Am I God, to kill and make alive, that this man sends a man to me to heal him of his leprosy? Therefore please consider, and see how he seeks a quarrel with me."
verses.textEnNlt: When the king of Israel read the letter, he tore his clothes in dismay and said, "Am I God, that I can give life and take it away? Why is this man asking me to heal someone with leprosy? I can see that he’s just trying to pick a fight with me."
verses.textEnNasb: But when the king of Israel read the letter, he tore his clothes and said, "Am I God, to kill and to keep alive, that this man is sending word to me to cure a man of his leprosy? But consider now, and see how he is seeking a quarrel against me."
verses.textEn: As soon as the king of Israel read the letter, he tore his robes and said, "Am I God? Can I kill and bring back to life? Why does this fellow send someone to me to be cured of his leprosy? See how he is trying to pick a quarrel with me!"

verses.textZh: 神人以利沙听见以色列王撕裂自己的衣服，就打发人去见王说："你为甚么撕裂自己的衣服呢？请你把他送到我这里来吧！他就知道在以色列中有先知了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神人以利沙听见以色列王撕裂自己的衣服，就打发人去见王说："你为甚么撕裂自己的衣服呢？请你把他送到我这里来吧！他就知道在以色列中有先知了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神人以利沙听见以色列王撕裂衣服，就打发人去见王，说：「你为什么撕了衣服呢？可使那人到我这里来，他就知道以色列中有先知了。」
verses.textEnNiv: When Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had torn his robes, he sent him this message: "Why have you torn your robes? Have the man come to me and he will know that there is a prophet in Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: But when Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had torn his clothes, he sent to the king, saying, "Why have you torn your clothes? Let him come now to me, that he may know that there is a prophet in Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had torn his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, "Why have you torn your clothes? Please let him come to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: But when Elisha, the man of God, heard that the king of Israel had torn his clothes in dismay, he sent this message to him: "Why are you so upset? Send Naaman to me, and he will learn that there is a true prophet here in Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: Now it happened, when Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had torn his clothes, that he sent word to the king, saying, "Why did you tear your clothes? Just have him come to me, and he shall learn that there is a prophet in Israel."
verses.textEn: When Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had torn his robes, he sent him this message: "Why have you torn your robes? Have the man come to me and he will know that there is a prophet in Israel."

verses.textZh: 于是乃缦带着他的车马来到，停在以利沙的门前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是乃缦带着他的车马来到，停在以利沙的门前。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，乃缦带着车马到了以利沙的家，站在门前。
verses.textEnNiv: So Naaman went with his horses and chariots and stopped at the door of Elisha’s house.
verses.textEnEsv: So Naaman came with his horses and chariots and stood at the door of Elisha’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Naaman went with his horses and chariot, and he stood at the door of Elisha’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: So Naaman went with his horses and chariots and waited at the door of Elisha’s house.
verses.textEnNasb: So Naaman came with his horses and his chariots, and stood at the doorway of Elisha’s house.
verses.textEn: So Naaman went with his horses and chariots and stopped at the door of Elisha’s house.

verses.textZh: 以利沙差派一个使者去见他说："你去在约旦河中沐浴七次，你的身体就会复原，得着洁净。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙差派一个使者去见他说："你去在约旦河中沐浴七次，你的身体就会复原，得着洁净。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙打发一个使者，对乃缦说：「你去在约旦河中沐浴七回，你的肉就必复原，而得洁净。」
verses.textEnNiv: Elisha sent a messenger to say to him, "Go, wash yourself seven times in the Jordan, and your flesh will be restored and you will be cleansed."
verses.textEnEsv: And Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, "Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and your flesh shall be restored, and you shall be clean."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, "Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and your flesh shall be restored to you, and youshall be clean."
verses.textEnNlt: But Elisha sent a messenger out to him with this message: "Go and wash yourself seven times in the Jordan River. Then your skin will be restored, and you will be healed of your leprosy."
verses.textEnNasb: And Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, "Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and your flesh will be restored to you and you will be clean."
verses.textEn: Elisha sent a messenger to say to him, "Go, wash yourself seven times in the Jordan, and your flesh will be restored and you will be cleansed."

verses.textZh: 乃缦却发怒走了，他说："我以为他必会出来，站着求告耶和华他的神的名，向着患处摇手，洁净这痲风病。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乃缦却发怒走了，他说："我以为他必会出来，站着求告耶和华他的神的名，向着患处摇手，洁净这痲风病。
verses.textZhCuv: 乃缦却发怒走了，说：「我想他必定出来见我，站着求告耶和华－他神的名，在患处以上摇手，治好这大麻风。
verses.textEnNiv: But Naaman went away angry and said, "I thought that he would surely come out to me and stand and call on the name of the Lord his God, wave his hand over the spot and cure me of my leprosy.
verses.textEnEsv: But Naaman was angry and went away, saying, "Behold, I thought that he would surely come out to me and stand and call upon the name of the Lord his God, and wave his hand over the place and cure the leper.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Naaman became furious, and went away and said, "Indeed, I said to myself, ‘He will surely come out tome, and stand and call on the name of the Lord his God, and wave his hand over the place, and heal the leprosy.’
verses.textEnNlt: But Naaman became angry and stalked away. "I thought he would certainly come out to meet me!" he said. "I expected him to wave his hand over the leprosy and call on the name of the Lord his God and heal me!
verses.textEnNasb: But Naaman was furious and went away, and he said, "Behold, I thought, ‘He will certainly come out to me, and stand and call on the name of the Lord his God, and wave his hand over the site and cure the leprosy.’
verses.textEn: But Naaman went away angry and said, "I thought that he would surely come out to me and stand and call on the name of the Lord his God, wave his hand over the spot and cure me of my leprosy.

verses.textZh: 大马士革的亚罢拿河和法珥法河，不是比以色列一切河流更好吗？我不是可以在那里沐浴，得着洁净吗？"于是他掉过头来，气忿忿地走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大马士革的亚罢拿河和法珥法河，不是比以色列一切河流更好吗？我不是可以在那里沐浴，得着洁净吗？"于是他掉过头来，气忿忿地走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 大马士革的河亚罢拿和法珥法岂不比以色列的一切水更好吗？我在那里沐浴不得洁净吗？」于是气忿忿地转身去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Are not Abana and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Couldn’t I wash in them and be cleansed?" So he turned and went off in a rage.
verses.textEnEsv: Are not Abana and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Could I not wash in them and be clean?" So he turned and went away in a rage.
verses.textEnNkjv: Are not the Abanah and the Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Could I not wash in them and be clean?" So he turned and went away in a rage.
verses.textEnNlt: Aren’t the rivers of Damascus, the Abana and the Pharpar, better than any of the rivers of Israel? Why shouldn’t I wash in them and be healed?" So Naaman turned and went away in a rage.
verses.textEnNasb: Are Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, not better than all the waters of Israel? Could I not wash in them and be clean?" So he turned and went away in a rage.
verses.textEn: Are not Abana and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Couldn’t I wash in them and be cleansed?" So he turned and went off in a rage.

verses.textZh: 他的仆人上前，对他说："我父啊，先知如果吩咐你作一件大事，你不是照着行吗？何况他只是说：‘你去沐浴就得洁净’呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的仆人上前，对他说："我父啊，先知如果吩咐你作一件大事，你不是照着行吗？何况他只是说：‘你去沐浴就得洁净’呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他的仆人进前来，对他说：「我父啊，先知若吩咐你做一件大事，你岂不做吗？何况说你去沐浴而得洁净呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Naaman’s servants went to him and said, "My father, if the prophet had told you to do some great thing, would you not have done it? How much more, then, when he tells you, ‘Wash and be cleansed’!"
verses.textEnEsv: But his servants came near and said to him, "My father, it is a great word the prophet has spoken to you; will you not do it? Has he actually said to you, ‘Wash, and be clean’?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And his servants came near and spoke to him, and said, "My father, if the prophet had told you todo something great, would you not have done it? How much more then, when he says to you, ‘Wash, and be clean’?"
verses.textEnNlt: But his officers tried to reason with him and said, "Sir, if the prophet had told you to do something very difficult, wouldn’t you have done it? So you should certainly obey him when he says simply, ‘Go and wash and be cured!’"
verses.textEnNasb: Then his servants approached and spoke to him, saying, "My father, had the prophet told you to do some great thing, would you not have done it? How much more then, when he says to you, ‘Wash, and be clean’?"
verses.textEn: Naaman’s servants went to him and said, "My father, if the prophet had told you to do some great thing, would you not have done it? How much more, then, when he tells you, ‘Wash and be cleansed’!"

verses.textZh: 于是他下去，在约旦河里浸了七趟，正如神人所吩咐的。他的肌肉就复原，好象小孩子的肌肉，他就得了洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他下去，在约旦河里浸了七趟，正如神人所吩咐的。他的肌肉就复原，好象小孩子的肌肉，他就得了洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是乃缦下去，照着神人的话，在约旦河里沐浴七回；他的肉复原，好像小孩子的肉，他就洁净了。
verses.textEnNiv: So he went down and dipped himself in the Jordan seven times, as the man of God had told him, and his flesh was restored and became clean like that of a young boy.
verses.textEnEsv: So he went down and dipped himself seven times in the Jordan, according to the word of the man of God, and his flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he went down and dipped seven times in the Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God; and his flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
verses.textEnNlt: So Naaman went down to the Jordan River and dipped himself seven times, as the man of God had instructed him. And his skin became as healthy as the skin of a young child, and he was healed!
verses.textEnNasb: So he went down and dipped himself in the Jordan seven times, in accordance with the word of the man of God; and his flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
