verses.textEn: So he went down and dipped himself in the Jordan seven times, as the man of God had told him, and his flesh was restored and became clean like that of a young boy.

verses.textZh: 乃缦和他的随员又回到神人那里，他进去，站在他面前，说："看哪！现在我知道除了在以色列以外，全地都没有神。现在，请你收下你仆人一点礼物吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 乃缦和他的随员又回到神人那里，他进去，站在他面前，说："看哪！现在我知道除了在以色列以外，全地都没有神。现在，请你收下你仆人一点礼物吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 乃缦带着一切跟随他的人，回到神人那里，站在他面前，说：「如今我知道，除了以色列之外，普天下没有神。现在求你收点仆人的礼物。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Naaman and all his attendants went back to the man of God. He stood before him and said, "Now I know that there is no God in all the world except in Israel. So please accept a gift from your servant."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and he came and stood before him. And he said, "Behold, I know that there is no God in all the earth but in Israel; so accept now a present from your servant."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he returned to the man of God, he and all his aides, and came and stood before him; and he said, "Indeed, now I know that thereis no God in all the earth, except in Israel; now therefore, please take a gift from your servant."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Naaman and his entire party went back to find the man of God. They stood before him, and Naaman said, "Now I know that there is no God in all the world except in Israel. So please accept a gift from your servant."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he returned to the man of God with all his company, and came and stood before him. And he said, "Behold now, I know that there is no God in all the earth, except in Israel; so please accept a gift from your servant now."
verses.textEn: Then Naaman and all his attendants went back to the man of God. He stood before him and said, "Now I know that there is no God in all the world except in Israel. So please accept a gift from your servant."

verses.textZh: 以利沙说："我指着我所事奉永活的耶和华起誓，我决不收取任何礼物。"乃缦再三促请他接受，都被他拒绝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙说："我指着我所事奉永活的耶和华起誓，我决不收取任何礼物。"乃缦再三促请他接受，都被他拒绝。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙说：「我指着所事奉永生的耶和华起誓，我必不受。」乃缦再三地求他，他却不受。
verses.textEnNiv: The prophet answered, "As surely as the Lord lives, whom I serve, I will not accept a thing." And even though Naaman urged him, he refused.
verses.textEnEsv: But he said, "As the Lord lives, before whom I stand, I will receive none." And he urged him to take it, but he refused.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he said, "As the Lord lives, before whom I stand, I will receive nothing." And he urged him to take it, but he refused.
verses.textEnNlt: But Elisha replied, "As surely as the Lord lives, whom I serve, I will not accept any gifts." And though Naaman urged him to take the gift, Elisha refused.
verses.textEnNasb: But he said, "As surely as the Lord lives, before whom I stand, I will accept nothing." And he urged him to accept it, but he refused.
verses.textEn: The prophet answered, "As surely as the Lord lives, whom I serve, I will not accept a thing." And even though Naaman urged him, he refused.

verses.textZh: 乃缦说："你若是不肯收取，就请你赐你仆人两头驴子可以驮的泥土，因为你的仆人不再献燔祭或别的祭给别的神，只献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乃缦说："你若是不肯收取，就请你赐你仆人两头驴子可以驮的泥土，因为你的仆人不再献燔祭或别的祭给别的神，只献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 乃缦说：「你若不肯受，请将两骡子驮的土赐给仆人。从今以后，仆人必不再将燔祭或平安祭献与别神，只献给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: "If you will not," said Naaman, "please let me, your servant, be given as much earth as a pair of mules can carry, for your servant will never again make burnt offerings and sacrifices to any other god but the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then Naaman said, "If not, please let there be given to your servant two mule loads of earth, for from now on your servant will not offer burnt offering or sacrifice to any god but the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So Naaman said, "Then, if not, please let your servant be given two mule-loads of earth; for your servant will no longer offer either burnt offering or sacrifice to other gods, but to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Naaman said, "All right, but please allow me to load two of my mules with earth from this place, and I will take it back home with me. From now on I will never again offer burnt offerings or sacrifices to any other god except the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then Naaman said, "If not, please let your servant be given two mules’ load of earth; for your servant will no longer offer a burnt offering nor a sacrifice to other gods, but to the Lord.
verses.textEn: "If you will not," said Naaman, "please let me, your servant, be given as much earth as a pair of mules can carry, for your servant will never again make burnt offerings and sacrifices to any other god but the Lord .

verses.textZh: 但有一件事，求耶和华赦免你的仆人；我的主人到临门庙那里叩拜的时候，他总是靠在我的手臂上，因此，我也曾在临门庙叩拜。我在临门庙叩拜这事，求耶和华赦免你的仆人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但有一件事，求耶和华赦免你的仆人；我的主人到临门庙那里叩拜的时候，他总是靠在我的手臂上，因此，我也曾在临门庙叩拜。我在临门庙叩拜这事，求耶和华赦免你的仆人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有一件事，愿耶和华饶恕你仆人：我主人进临门庙叩拜的时候，我用手搀他在临门庙，我也屈身。我在临门庙屈身的这事，愿耶和华饶恕我。」
verses.textEnNiv: But may the Lord forgive your servant for this one thing: When my master enters the temple of Rimmon to bow down and he is leaning on my arm and I have to bow there also—when I bow down in the temple of Rimmon, may the Lord forgive your servant for this."
verses.textEnEsv: In this matter may the Lord pardon your servant: when my master goes into the house of Rimmon to worship there, leaning on my arm, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon, when I bow myself in the house of Rimmon, the Lord pardon your servant in this matter."
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet in this thing may the Lord pardon your servant: when my master goes into the temple of Rimmon to worship there, and he leans on my hand, and I bow down in the temple of Rimmon—when I bow down in the temple of Rimmon, may the Lord please pardon your servant in this thing."
verses.textEnNlt: However, may the Lord pardon me in this one thing: When my master the king goes into the temple of the god Rimmon to worship there and leans on my arm, may the Lord pardon me when I bow, too."
verses.textEnNasb: Regarding this matter may the Lord forgive your servant: when my master goes into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leans on my hand and I bow down in the house of Rimmon, when I bow down in the house of Rimmon, may the Lord please forgive your servant in this matter."
verses.textEn: But may the Lord forgive your servant for this one thing: When my master enters the temple of Rimmon to bow down and he is leaning on my arm and I have to bow there also—when I bow down in the temple of Rimmon, may the Lord forgive your servant for this."

verses.textZh: 以利沙说："你平平安安回去吧。"于是乃缦离开他去了，走了一段路程。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙说："你平平安安回去吧。"于是乃缦离开他去了，走了一段路程。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙对他说：「你可以平平安安地回去！」 乃缦就离开他去了；走了不远，
verses.textEnNiv: "Go in peace," Elisha said. After Naaman had traveled some distance,
verses.textEnEsv: He said to him, "Go in peace." But when Naaman had gone from him a short distance,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to him, "Go in peace." So he departed from him a short distance.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go in peace," Elisha said. So Naaman started home again.
verses.textEnNasb: He said to him, "Go in peace." So he went some distance from him.
verses.textEn: "Go in peace," Elisha said. After Naaman had traveled some distance,

verses.textZh: 神人以利沙的仆人基哈西心里说："看哪，我主人不肯从这亚兰人乃缦手中收取他带来的礼物；我指着永活的耶和华起誓，我要追上他，向他要些东西。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神人以利沙的仆人基哈西心里说："看哪，我主人不肯从这亚兰人乃缦手中收取他带来的礼物；我指着永活的耶和华起誓，我要追上他，向他要些东西。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神人以利沙的仆人基哈西心里说：「我主人不愿从这亚兰人乃缦手里受他带来的礼物，我指着永生的耶和华起誓，我必跑去追上他，向他要些。」
verses.textEnNiv: Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said to himself, "My master was too easy on Naaman, this Aramean, by not accepting from him what he brought. As surely as the Lord lives, I will run after him and get something from him."
verses.textEnEsv: Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, "See, my master has spared this Naaman the Syrian, in not accepting from his hand what he brought. As the Lord lives, I will run after him and get something from him."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, "Look, my master has spared Naaman this Syrian, while not receiving from his hands what he brought; but as the Lord lives, I will run after him and take something from him."
verses.textEnNlt: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha, the man of God, said to himself, "My master should not have let this Aramean get away without accepting any of his gifts. As surely as the Lord lives, I will chase after him and get something from him."
verses.textEnNasb: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, thought, "Behold, my master has spared this Naaman the Aramean, by not accepting from his hand what he brought. As the Lord lives, I will run after him and take something from him."
verses.textEn: Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said to himself, "My master was too easy on Naaman, this Aramean, by not accepting from him what he brought. As surely as the Lord lives, I will run after him and get something from him."

verses.textZh: 于是基哈西追赶乃缦。乃缦看见有人追上来，就下车迎着他，说："平安吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是基哈西追赶乃缦。乃缦看见有人追上来，就下车迎着他，说："平安吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是基哈西追赶乃缦。乃缦看见有人追赶，就急忙下车迎着他，说：「都平安吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: So Gehazi hurried after Naaman. When Naaman saw him running toward him, he got down from the chariot to meet him. "Is everything all right?" he asked.
verses.textEnEsv: So Gehazi followed Naaman. And when Naaman saw someone running after him, he got down from the chariot to meet him and said, "Is all well?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So Gehazi pursued Naaman. When Naaman saw him running after him, he got down from the chariot to meet him, and said, "Is all well?"
verses.textEnNlt: So Gehazi set off after Naaman. When Naaman saw Gehazi running after him, he climbed down from his chariot and went to meet him. "Is everything all right?" Naaman asked.
verses.textEnNasb: So Gehazi pursued Naaman. When Naaman saw someone running after him, he came down from the chariot to meet him and said, "Is everything well?"
verses.textEn: So Gehazi hurried after Naaman. When Naaman saw him running toward him, he got down from the chariot to meet him. "Is everything all right?" he asked.

verses.textZh: 他说："平安。我主人派我来说：‘刚才有两位年轻人，都是先知的门徒，从以法莲山地来到我这里，请你给他们三十公斤银子和两套衣服。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："平安。我主人派我来说：‘刚才有两位年轻人，都是先知的门徒，从以法莲山地来到我这里，请你给他们三十公斤银子和两套衣服。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「都平安。我主人打发我来说：『刚才有两个少年人，是先知门徒，从以法莲山地来见我，请你赐他们一他连得银子，两套衣裳。』」
verses.textEnNiv: "Everything is all right," Gehazi answered. "My master sent me to say, ‘Two young men from the company of the prophets have just come to me from the hill country of Ephraim. Please give them a talent of silver and two sets of clothing.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "All is well. My master has sent me to say, ‘There have just now come to me from the hill country of Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets. Please give them a talent of silver and two changes of clothing.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "All is well. My master has sent me, saying, ‘Indeed, just now two young men of the sons of the prophets have come to me from the mountains of Ephraim. Please give them a talent of silver and two changes of garments.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes," Gehazi said, "but my master has sent me to tell you that two young prophets from the hill country of Ephraim have just arrived. He would like 75 pounds of silver and two sets of clothing to give to them."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "Everything is well. My master has sent me, saying, ‘Behold, just now two young men of the sons of the prophets have come to me from the hill country of Ephraim. Please give them a talent of silver and two changes of clothes.’ "
verses.textEn: "Everything is all right," Gehazi answered. "My master sent me to say, ‘Two young men from the company of the prophets have just come to me from the hill country of Ephraim. Please give them a talent of silver and two sets of clothing.’ "

verses.textZh: 乃缦说："请你拿六十公斤吧。"他再三促请基哈西，并把六十公斤银子，装在两个袋子里，还有两套衣服，交给两个仆人。他们就在基哈西前面捧着走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乃缦说："请你拿六十公斤吧。"他再三促请基哈西，并把六十公斤银子，装在两个袋子里，还有两套衣服，交给两个仆人。他们就在基哈西前面捧着走。
verses.textZhCuv: 乃缦说：「请受二他连得」；再三地请受，便将二他连得银子装在两个口袋里，又将两套衣裳交给两个仆人；他们就在基哈西前头抬着走。
verses.textEnNiv: "By all means, take two talents," said Naaman. He urged Gehazi to accept them, and then tied up the two talents of silver in two bags, with two sets of clothing. He gave them to two of his servants, and they carried them ahead of Gehazi.
verses.textEnEsv: And Naaman said, "Be pleased to accept two talents." And he urged him and tied up two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of clothing, and laid them on two of his servants. And they carried them before Gehazi.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Naaman said, "Please, take two talents." And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of garments, and handed them to two of his servants; and they carried them on ahead of him.
verses.textEnNlt: "By all means, take twice as much silver," Naaman insisted. He gave him two sets of clothing, tied up the money in two bags, and sent two of his servants to carry the gifts for Gehazi.
verses.textEnNasb: Naaman said, "Be sure to take two talents." And he urged him, and tied up two talents of silver in two bags with two changes of clothes, and gave them to two of his servants; and they carried them before him.
verses.textEn: "By all means, take two talents," said Naaman. He urged Gehazi to accept them, and then tied up the two talents of silver in two bags, with two sets of clothing. He gave them to two of his servants, and they carried them ahead of Gehazi.

verses.textZh: 到达山冈后，他就从他们手中接过东西，存放在屋子里，然后打发他们离去，他们就走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到达山冈后，他就从他们手中接过东西，存放在屋子里，然后打发他们离去，他们就走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了山冈，基哈西从他们手中接过来，放在屋里，打发他们回去。
verses.textEnNiv: When Gehazi came to the hill, he took the things from the servants and put them away in the house. He sent the men away and they left.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he came to the hill, he took them from their hand and put them in the house, and he sent the men away, and they departed.
verses.textEnNkjv: When he came to the citadel, he took them from their hand, and stored them away in the house; then he let the men go, and they departed.
verses.textEnNlt: But when they arrived at the citadel, Gehazi took the gifts from the servants and sent the men back. Then he went and hid the gifts inside the house.
verses.textEnNasb: When he came to the hill, he took them from their hand and deposited them in the house, and he sent the men away, and they departed.
verses.textEn: When Gehazi came to the hill, he took the things from the servants and put them away in the house. He sent the men away and they left.

verses.textZh: 他进去，侍立在他主人面前，以利沙对他说："基哈西，你从哪里来？"他说："你的仆人没有到过甚么地方。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他进去，侍立在他主人面前，以利沙对他说："基哈西，你从哪里来？"他说："你的仆人没有到过甚么地方。"
verses.textZhCuv: 基哈西进去，站在他主人面前。以利沙问他说：「基哈西你从哪里来？」回答说：「仆人没有往哪里去。」
verses.textEnNiv: When he went in and stood before his master, Elisha asked him, "Where have you been, Gehazi?" "Your servant didn’t go anywhere," Gehazi answered.
verses.textEnEsv: He went in and stood before his master, and Elisha said to him, "Where have you been, Gehazi?" And he said, "Your servant went nowhere."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now he went in and stood before his master. Elisha said to him, "Where didyougo, Gehazi?" And he said, "Your servant did not go anywhere."
verses.textEnNlt: When he went in to his master, Elisha asked him, "Where have you been, Gehazi?" "I haven’t been anywhere," he replied.
verses.textEnNasb: But he went in and stood before his master. And Elisha said to him, "Where have you been, Gehazi?" And he said, "Your servant went nowhere."
verses.textEn: When he went in and stood before his master, Elisha asked him, "Where have you been, Gehazi?" "Your servant didn’t go anywhere," Gehazi answered.

verses.textZh: 以利沙对他说："那人下车转身迎着你的时候，我的心不是和你同去吗？现在不是收受银子、衣服、橄榄园、葡萄园、羊、牛、仆人和婢女的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙对他说："那人下车转身迎着你的时候，我的心不是和你同去吗？现在不是收受银子、衣服、橄榄园、葡萄园、羊、牛、仆人和婢女的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙对他说：「那人下车转回迎你的时候，我的心岂没有去呢？这岂是受银子、衣裳、买橄榄园、葡萄园、牛羊、仆婢的时候呢？
verses.textEnNiv: But Elisha said to him, "Was not my spirit with you when the man got down from his chariot to meet you? Is this the time to take money or to accept clothes—or olive groves and vineyards, or flocks and herds, or male and female slaves?
verses.textEnEsv: But he said to him, "Did not my heart go when the man turned from his chariot to meet you? Was it a time to accept money and garments, olive orchards and vineyards, sheep and oxen, male servants and female servants?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to him, "Did not my heart go withyou when the man turned back from his chariot to meet you? Isit time to receive money and to receive clothing, olive groves and vineyards, sheep and oxen, male and female servants?
verses.textEnNlt: But Elisha asked him, "Don’t you realize that I was there in spirit when Naaman stepped down from his chariot to meet you? Is this the time to receive money and clothing, olive groves and vineyards, sheep and cattle, and male and female servants?
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to him, "Did my heart not go with you, when the man turned from his chariot to meet you? Is it a time to accept money and to accept clothes, olive groves, vineyards, sheep, oxen, and male and female slaves?
verses.textEn: But Elisha said to him, "Was not my spirit with you when the man got down from his chariot to meet you? Is this the time to take money or to accept clothes—or olive groves and vineyards, or flocks and herds, or male and female slaves?

verses.textZh: 因此，乃缦的痲风要附在你的身上和你后裔的身上，直到永远。"基哈西从以利沙面前离去时，就长了痲风，好象雪那样白。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，乃缦的痲风要附在你的身上和你后裔的身上，直到永远。"基哈西从以利沙面前离去时，就长了痲风，好象雪那样白。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，乃缦的大麻风必沾染你和你的后裔，直到永远。」基哈西从以利沙面前退出去，就长了大麻风，像雪那样白。
verses.textEnNiv: Naaman’s leprosy will cling to you and to your descendants forever." Then Gehazi went from Elisha’s presence and his skin was leprous—it had become as white as snow.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the leprosy of Naaman shall cling to you and to your descendants forever." So he went out from his presence a leper, like snow.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the leprosy of Naaman shall cling to you and your descendants forever." And he went out from his presence leprous, aswhite as snow.
verses.textEnNlt: Because you have done this, you and your descendants will suffer from Naaman’s leprosy forever." When Gehazi left the room, he was covered with leprosy; his skin was white as snow.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, the leprosy of Naaman shall cling to you and to your descendants forever." So he went out from his presence afflicted with leprosy, as white as snow.
verses.textEn: Naaman’s leprosy will cling to you and to your descendants forever." Then Gehazi went from Elisha’s presence and his skin was leprous—it had become as white as snow.

verses.textZh: 众先知门徒对以利沙说："请看，我们在你面前居住的那一个地方，对我们来说实在是太窄小了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众先知门徒对以利沙说："请看，我们在你面前居住的那一个地方，对我们来说实在是太窄小了。
verses.textZhCuv: 先知门徒对以利沙说：「看哪，我们同你所住的地方过于窄小，
verses.textEnNiv: The company of the prophets said to Elisha, "Look, the place where we meet with you is too small for us.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the sons of the prophets said to Elisha, "See, the place where we dwell under your charge is too small for us.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of the prophets said to Elisha, "See now, the place where we dwell with you is too small for us.
verses.textEnNlt: One day the group of prophets came to Elisha and told him, "As you can see, this place where we meet with you is too small.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the sons of the prophets said to Elisha, "Behold now, the place before you where we are living is too cramped for us.
verses.textEn: The company of the prophets said to Elisha, "Look, the place where we meet with you is too small for us.

verses.textZh: 请你让我们到约旦河，每人从那里取一根木头，我们要在那里为自己建造一个地方居住。"以利沙说："你们去吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 请你让我们到约旦河，每人从那里取一根木头，我们要在那里为自己建造一个地方居住。"以利沙说："你们去吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 求你容我们往约旦河去，各人从那里取一根木料建造房屋居住。」他说：「你们去吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Let us go to the Jordan, where each of us can get a pole; and let us build a place there for us to meet." And he said, "Go."
verses.textEnEsv: Let us go to the Jordan and each of us get there a log, and let us make a place for us to dwell there." And he answered, "Go."
verses.textEnNkjv: Please, let us go to the Jordan, and let every man take a beam from there, and let us make there a place where we may dwell." So he answered, "Go."
verses.textEnNlt: Let’s go down to the Jordan River, where there are plenty of logs. There we can build a new place for us to meet." "All right," he told them, "go ahead."
verses.textEnNasb: Please let us go to the Jordan, and let us each take from there a beam, and let us construct a place there for ourselves, to live there." So he said, "Go."
verses.textEn: Let us go to the Jordan, where each of us can get a pole; and let us build a place there for us to meet." And he said, "Go."

verses.textZh: 有一个门徒说："请你和你的仆人们一起去。"他说："我会去的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个门徒说："请你和你的仆人们一起去。"他说："我会去的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一人说：「求你与仆人同去。」回答说：「我可以去。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then one of them said, "Won’t you please come with your servants?" "I will," Elisha replied.
verses.textEnEsv: Then one of them said, "Be pleased to go with your servants." And he answered, "I will go."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one said, "Please consent to go with your servants." And he answered, "I will go."
verses.textEnNlt: "Please come with us," someone suggested. "I will," he said.
verses.textEnNasb: Then one of them said, "Please agree and go with your servants." And he said, "I will go."
verses.textEn: Then one of them said, "Won’t you please come with your servants?" "I will," Elisha replied.

verses.textZh: 他就和他们同去。他们到了约旦河，就砍伐树木。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就和他们同去。他们到了约旦河，就砍伐树木。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是以利沙与他们同去。到了约旦河，就砍伐树木。
verses.textEnNiv: And he went with them. They went to the Jordan and began to cut down trees.
verses.textEnEsv: So he went with them. And when they came to the Jordan, they cut down trees.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he went with them. And when they came to the Jordan, they cut down trees.
verses.textEnNlt: So he went with them. When they arrived at the Jordan, they began cutting down trees.
verses.textEnNasb: So he went with them; and when they came to the Jordan, they cut down trees.
verses.textEn: And he went with them. They went to the Jordan and began to cut down trees.

verses.textZh: 有一个门徒砍伐木头的时候，斧头掉到水里去了。他就喊着说："惨啦！我主啊，这斧头是借回来的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个门徒砍伐木头的时候，斧头掉到水里去了。他就喊着说："惨啦！我主啊，这斧头是借回来的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一人砍树的时候，斧头掉在水里，他就呼叫说：「哀哉！我主啊，这斧子是借的。」
verses.textEnNiv: As one of them was cutting down a tree, the iron axhead fell into the water. "Oh no, my lord!" he cried out. "It was borrowed!"
verses.textEnEsv: But as one was felling a log, his axe head fell into the water, and he cried out, "Alas, my master! It was borrowed."
verses.textEnNkjv: But as one was cutting down a tree, the iron axhead fell into the water; and he cried out and said, "Alas, master! For it was borrowed."
verses.textEnNlt: But as one of them was cutting a tree, his ax head fell into the river. "Oh, sir!" he cried. "It was a borrowed ax!"
verses.textEnNasb: But it happened that as one of them was cutting down a beam, the axe head fell into the water; and he cried out and said, "Oh, my master! It was borrowed!"
verses.textEn: As one of them was cutting down a tree, the iron axhead fell into the water. "Oh no, my lord!" he cried out. "It was borrowed!"

verses.textZh: 神人说："掉在哪里呢？"于是他把那地点指给他看。他砍了一根木头，丢在那里，那斧头就浮上来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神人说："掉在哪里呢？"于是他把那地点指给他看。他砍了一根木头，丢在那里，那斧头就浮上来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 神人问说：「掉在哪里了？」他将那地方指给以利沙看。以利沙砍了一根木头，抛在水里，斧头就漂上来了。
verses.textEnNiv: The man of God asked, "Where did it fall?" When he showed him the place, Elisha cut a stick and threw it there, and made the iron float.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the man of God said, "Where did it fall?" When he showed him the place, he cut off a stick and threw it in there and made the iron float.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the man of God said, "Where did it fall?" And he showed him the place. So he cut off a stick, and threw it in there; and he made the iron float.
verses.textEnNlt: "Where did it fall?" the man of God asked. When he showed him the place, Elisha cut a stick and threw it into the water at that spot. Then the ax head floated to the surface.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the man of God said, "Where did it fall?" And when he showed him the place, he cut off a stick and threw it in there, and made the iron float.
verses.textEn: The man of God asked, "Where did it fall?" When he showed him the place, Elisha cut a stick and threw it there, and made the iron float.

verses.textZh: 以利沙说："你自己拿上来吧。"他就伸手把它拿住了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙说："你自己拿上来吧。"他就伸手把它拿住了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙说：「拿起来吧！」那人就伸手拿起来了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Lift it out," he said. Then the man reached out his hand and took it.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Take it up." So he reached out his hand and took it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore he said, "Pick it up for yourself." So he reached out his hand and took it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Grab it," Elisha said. And the man reached out and grabbed it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "Pick it up for yourself." So he reached out his hand and took it.
verses.textEn: "Lift it out," he said. Then the man reached out his hand and took it.

verses.textZh: 亚兰王与以色列人打仗，他和他的臣仆商议，说："我要在某处某处埋伏。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚兰王与以色列人打仗，他和他的臣仆商议，说："我要在某处某处埋伏。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚兰王与以色列人争战，和他的臣仆商议说：「我要在某处某处安营。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now the king of Aram was at war with Israel. After conferring with his officers, he said, "I will set up my camp in such and such a place."
verses.textEnEsv: Once when the king of Syria was warring against Israel, he took counsel with his servants, saying, "At such and such a place shall be my camp."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the king of Syria was making war against Israel; and he consulted with his servants, saying, "My camp willbe in such and such a place."
verses.textEnNlt: When the king of Aram was at war with Israel, he would confer with his officers and say, "We will mobilize our forces at such and such a place."
verses.textEnNasb: Now the king of Aram was making war against Israel; and he consulted with his servants, saying, "In such and such a place shall be my camp."
verses.textEn: Now the king of Aram was at war with Israel. After conferring with his officers, he said, "I will set up my camp in such and such a place."

verses.textZh: 神人就差派人去见以色列王说："你要小心，不要经过这个地方，因为亚兰人在那里埋伏。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神人就差派人去见以色列王说："你要小心，不要经过这个地方，因为亚兰人在那里埋伏。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神人打发人去见以色列王，说：「你要谨慎，不要从某处经过，因为亚兰人从那里下来了。」
verses.textEnNiv: The man of God sent word to the king of Israel: "Beware of passing that place, because the Arameans are going down there."
verses.textEnEsv: But the man of God sent word to the king of Israel, "Beware that you do not pass this place, for the Syrians are going down there."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the man of God sent to the king of Israel, saying, "Beware that you do not pass this place, for the Syrians are coming down there."
verses.textEnNlt: But immediately Elisha, the man of God, would warn the king of Israel, "Do not go near that place, for the Arameans are planning to mobilize their troops there."
verses.textEnNasb: But the man of God sent word to the king of Israel, saying, "Be careful that you do not pass this place, because the Arameans are coming down there."
verses.textEn: The man of God sent word to the king of Israel: "Beware of passing that place, because the Arameans are going down there."

verses.textZh: 以色列王派人到那地方，就是神人曾告诉他，警告他的，他就在那里小心防范；这样不止一两次。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王派人到那地方，就是神人曾告诉他，警告他的，他就在那里小心防范；这样不止一两次。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王差人去窥探神人所告诉所警戒他去的地方，就防备未受其害，不止一两次。
verses.textEnNiv: So the king of Israel checked on the place indicated by the man of God. Time and again Elisha warned the king, so that he was on his guard in such places.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Israel sent to the place about which the man of God told him. Thus he used to warn him, so that he saved himself there more than once or twice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king of Israel sent someone to the place of which the man of God had told him. Thus he warned him, and he was watchful there, not just once or twice.
verses.textEnNlt: So the king of Israel would send word to the place indicated by the man of God. Time and again Elisha warned the king, so that he would be on the alert there.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king of Israel sent scouts to the place about which the man of God had told him; so he warned him, so that he was on his guard there, more than once or twice.
verses.textEn: So the king of Israel checked on the place indicated by the man of God. Time and again Elisha warned the king, so that he was on his guard in such places.

verses.textZh: 亚兰王因为这事心中大感困惑，他召了他的臣仆来，对他们说："在我们中间有谁帮助以色列王，你们不告诉我吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚兰王因为这事心中大感困惑，他召了他的臣仆来，对他们说："在我们中间有谁帮助以色列王，你们不告诉我吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚兰王因这事心里惊疑，召了臣仆来，对他们说：「我们这里有谁帮助以色列王，你们不指给我吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: This enraged the king of Aram. He summoned his officers and demanded of them, "Tell me! Which of us is on the side of the king of Israel?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the mind of the king of Syria was greatly troubled because of this thing, and he called his servants and said to them, "Will you not show me who of us is for the king of Israel?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was greatly troubled by this thing; and he called his servants and said to them, "Will you not show me which of us is for the king of Israel?"
verses.textEnNlt: The king of Aram became very upset over this. He called his officers together and demanded, "Which of you is the traitor? Who has been informing the king of Israel of my plans?"
verses.textEnNasb: Now the heart of the king of Aram was enraged over this matter; and he called his servants and said to them, "Will you not tell me which of us is for the king of Israel?"
verses.textEn: This enraged the king of Aram. He summoned his officers and demanded of them, "Tell me! Which of us is on the side of the king of Israel?"

verses.textZh: 他的一位臣仆说："我主我王啊！不是的；只不过是以色列的以利沙先知，把你在你卧室内所说的话，告知了以色列王。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的一位臣仆说："我主我王啊！不是的；只不过是以色列的以利沙先知，把你在你卧室内所说的话，告知了以色列王。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个臣仆说：「我主，我王！无人帮助他，只有以色列中的先知以利沙，将王在卧房所说的话告诉以色列王了。」
verses.textEnNiv: "None of us, my lord the king," said one of his officers, "but Elisha, the prophet who is in Israel, tells the king of Israel the very words you speak in your bedroom."
verses.textEnEsv: And one of his servants said, "None, my lord, O king; but Elisha, the prophet who is in Israel, tells the king of Israel the words that you speak in your bedroom."
verses.textEnNkjv: And one of his servants said, "None, my lord, O king; but Elisha, the prophet who is in Israel, tells the king of Israel the words that you speak in your bedroom."
verses.textEnNlt: "It’s not us, my lord the king," one of the officers replied. "Elisha, the prophet in Israel, tells the king of Israel even the words you speak in the privacy of your bedroom!"
verses.textEnNasb: One of his servants said, "No, my lord, the king; but Elisha, the prophet who is in Israel, tells the king of Israel the words that you speak in your bedroom."
verses.textEn: "None of us, my lord the king," said one of his officers, "but Elisha, the prophet who is in Israel, tells the king of Israel the very words you speak in your bedroom."

verses.textZh: 于是王说："你们去看看他在哪里，我要派人把他捉住。"有人告诉他说："看哪！他正在多坍。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是王说："你们去看看他在哪里，我要派人把他捉住。"有人告诉他说："看哪！他正在多坍。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王说：「你们去探他在哪里，我好打发人去捉拿他。」有人告诉王说：「他在多坍。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Go, find out where he is," the king ordered, "so I can send men and capture him." The report came back: "He is in Dothan."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Go and see where he is, that I may send and seize him." It was told him, "Behold, he is in Dothan."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said, "Go and see where he is, that I may send and get him." And it was told him, saying, "Surely heis in Dothan."
verses.textEnNlt: "Go and find out where he is," the king commanded, "so I can send troops to seize him." And the report came back: "Elisha is at Dothan."
verses.textEnNasb: So he said, "Go and see where he is, so that I may send men and take him." And it was told to him, saying, "Behold, he is in Dothan."
verses.textEn: "Go, find out where he is," the king ordered, "so I can send men and capture him." The report came back: "He is in Dothan."

verses.textZh: 他就差派车马和一大队军兵往那里去，他们在夜间抵达，围困那城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就差派车马和一大队军兵往那里去，他们在夜间抵达，围困那城。

verses.textEnNiv: Then he sent horses and chariots and a strong force there. They went by night and surrounded the city.
verses.textEnEsv: So he sent there horses and chariots and a great army, and they came by night and surrounded the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore he sent horses and chariots and a great army there, and they came by night and surrounded the city.
verses.textEnNlt: So one night the king of Aram sent a great army with many chariots and horses to surround the city.

verses.textEn: Then he sent horses and chariots and a strong force there. They went by night and surrounded the city.

verses.textZh: 神人的侍从清早起来，走出屋子，看见军队、车马围住了城。神人的仆人对神人说："惨啦，我主啊！我们怎样办才好呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神人的侍从清早起来，走出屋子，看见军队、车马围住了城。神人的仆人对神人说："惨啦，我主啊！我们怎样办才好呢？"

verses.textEnNiv: When the servant of the man of God got up and went out early the next morning, an army with horses and chariots had surrounded the city. "Oh no, my lord! What shall we do?" the servant asked.
verses.textEnEsv: When the servant of the man of God rose early in the morning and went out, behold, an army with horses and chariots was all around the city. And the servant said, "Alas, my master! What shall we do?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the servant of the man of God arose early and went out, there was an army, surrounding the city with horses and chariots. And his servant said to him, "Alas, my master! What shall we do?"
verses.textEnNlt: When the servant of the man of God got up early the next morning and went outside, there were troops, horses, and chariots everywhere. "Oh, sir, what will we do now?" the young man cried to Elisha.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the attendant of the man of God had risen early and gone out, behold, an army with horses and chariots was circling the city. And his servant said to him, "This is hopeless, my master! What are we to do?"
verses.textEn: When the servant of the man of God got up and went out early the next morning, an army with horses and chariots had surrounded the city. "Oh no, my lord! What shall we do?" the servant asked.

verses.textZh: 神人说："不要惧怕，因为和我们在一起的比和他们在一起的更多。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神人说："不要惧怕，因为和我们在一起的比和他们在一起的更多。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神人说：「不要惧怕！与我们同在的比与他们同在的更多。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Don’t be afraid," the prophet answered. "Those who are with us are more than those who are with them."
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "Do not be afraid, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he answered, "Do not fear, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them."
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t be afraid!" Elisha told him. "For there are more on our side than on theirs!"
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "Do not be afraid, for those who are with us are greater than those who are with them."
verses.textEn: "Don’t be afraid," the prophet answered. "Those who are with us are more than those who are with them."

verses.textZh: 以利沙祷告，说："耶和华啊！请你打开他的眼睛，使他能看见。"于是耶和华打开了仆人的眼睛，他就看见；看哪！那山上布满了火马火车，围绕着以利沙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙祷告，说："耶和华啊！请你打开他的眼睛，使他能看见。"于是耶和华打开了仆人的眼睛，他就看见；看哪！那山上布满了火马火车，围绕着以利沙。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙祷告说：「耶和华啊，求你开这少年人的眼目，使他能看见。」耶和华开他的眼目，他就看见满山有火车火马围绕以利沙。
verses.textEnNiv: And Elisha prayed, "Open his eyes, Lord , so that he may see." Then the Lord opened the servant’s eyes, and he looked and saw the hills full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Elisha prayed and said, "O Lord , please open his eyes that he may see." So the Lord opened the eyes of the young man, and he saw, and behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Elisha prayed, and said, "Lord, I pray, open his eyes that he may see." Then the Lord opened the eyes of the young man, and he saw. And behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elisha prayed, "O Lord , open his eyes and let him see!" The Lord opened the young man’s eyes, and when he looked up, he saw that the hillside around Elisha was filled with horses and chariots of fire.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Elisha prayed and said, "Lord, please, open his eyes so that he may see." And the Lord opened the servant’s eyes, and he saw; and behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha.
verses.textEn: And Elisha prayed, "Open his eyes, Lord , so that he may see." Then the Lord opened the servant’s eyes, and he looked and saw the hills full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha.

verses.textZh: 亚兰人下来攻击以利沙，以利沙就祷告耶和华，说："求你击打这民族，使他们瞎眼。"于是耶和华击打他们，使他们瞎眼，正如以利沙所说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚兰人下来攻击以利沙，以利沙就祷告耶和华，说："求你击打这民族，使他们瞎眼。"于是耶和华击打他们，使他们瞎眼，正如以利沙所说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 敌人下到以利沙那里，以利沙祷告耶和华说：「求你使这些人的眼目昏迷。」耶和华就照以利沙的话，使他们的眼目昏迷。
verses.textEnNiv: As the enemy came down toward him, Elisha prayed to the Lord , "Strike this army with blindness." So he struck them with blindness, as Elisha had asked.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the Syrians came down against him, Elisha prayed to the Lord and said, "Please strike this people with blindness." So he struck them with blindness in accordance with the prayer of Elisha.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when theSyrians came down to him, Elisha prayed to the Lord, and said, "Strike this people, I pray, with blindness." And He struck them with blindness according to the word of Elisha.
verses.textEnNlt: As the Aramean army advanced toward him, Elisha prayed, "O Lord , please make them blind." So the Lord struck them with blindness as Elisha had asked.
verses.textEnNasb: And when they came down to him, Elisha prayed to the Lord and said, "Please strike this people with blindness." So He struck them with blindness in accordance with the word of Elisha.
verses.textEn: As the enemy came down toward him, Elisha prayed to the Lord , "Strike this army with blindness." So he struck them with blindness, as Elisha had asked.

verses.textZh: 以利沙对他们说："这不是那条路，这边不是那座城；你们跟着我来，我要把你们领到你们要寻找的人那里。"于是他把他们领到撒玛利亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙对他们说："这不是那条路，这边不是那座城；你们跟着我来，我要把你们领到你们要寻找的人那里。"于是他把他们领到撒玛利亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙对他们说：「这不是那道，也不是那城；你们跟我去，我必领你们到所寻找的人那里。」于是领他们到了撒马利亚。
verses.textEnNiv: Elisha told them, "This is not the road and this is not the city. Follow me, and I will lead you to the man you are looking for." And he led them to Samaria.
verses.textEnEsv: And Elisha said to them, "This is not the way, and this is not the city. Follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom you seek." And he led them to Samaria.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Elisha said to them, "This is not the way, nor is this the city. Follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom you seek." But he led them to Samaria.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elisha went out and told them, "You have come the wrong way! This isn’t the right city! Follow me, and I will take you to the man you are looking for." And he led them to the city of Samaria.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Elisha said to them, "This is not the way, nor is this the city; follow me and I will bring you to the man whom you seek." And he brought them to Samaria.
verses.textEn: Elisha told them, "This is not the road and this is not the city. Follow me, and I will lead you to the man you are looking for." And he led them to Samaria.

verses.textZh: 他们进入撒玛利亚的时候，以利沙就说："耶和华啊！求你开这些人的眼睛，使他们能看见。"于是耶和华开了他们的眼睛，他们就看见了。看哪！他们竟是在撒玛利亚城中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们进入撒玛利亚的时候，以利沙就说："耶和华啊！求你开这些人的眼睛，使他们能看见。"于是耶和华开了他们的眼睛，他们就看见了。看哪！他们竟是在撒玛利亚城中。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们进了撒马利亚，以利沙祷告说：「耶和华啊，求你开这些人的眼目，使他们能看见。」耶和华开他们的眼目，他们就看见了，不料，是在撒马利亚的城中。
verses.textEnNiv: After they entered the city, Elisha said, " Lord , open the eyes of these men so they can see." Then the Lord opened their eyes and they looked, and there they were, inside Samaria.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as they entered Samaria, Elisha said, "O Lord , open the eyes of these men, that they may see." So the Lord opened their eyes and they saw, and behold, they were in the midst of Samaria.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when they had come to Samaria, that Elisha said, "Lord, open the eyes of these men, that they may see." And the Lord opened their eyes, and they saw; and there theywere, inside Samaria!
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as they had entered Samaria, Elisha prayed, "O Lord , now open their eyes and let them see." So the Lord opened their eyes, and they discovered that they were in the middle of Samaria.
verses.textEnNasb: When they had come into Samaria, Elisha said, "Lord, open the eyes of these men, so that they may see." So the Lord opened their eyes, and they saw; and behold, they were in the midst of Samaria.
verses.textEn: After they entered the city, Elisha said, " Lord , open the eyes of these men so they can see." Then the Lord opened their eyes and they looked, and there they were, inside Samaria.

verses.textZh: 以色列王看见他们，就对以利沙说："我父啊，我可以击杀他们吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王看见他们，就对以利沙说："我父啊，我可以击杀他们吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王见了他们，就问以利沙说：「我父啊，我可以击杀他们吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: When the king of Israel saw them, he asked Elisha, "Shall I kill them, my father? Shall I kill them?"
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as the king of Israel saw them, he said to Elisha, "My father, shall I strike them down? Shall I strike them down?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the king of Israel saw them, he said to Elisha, "My father, shall I kill them? Shall I kill them?"
verses.textEnNlt: When the king of Israel saw them, he shouted to Elisha, "My father, should I kill them? Should I kill them?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Israel when he saw them, said to Elisha, "My father, shall I kill them? Shall I kill them?"
verses.textEn: When the king of Israel saw them, he asked Elisha, "Shall I kill them, my father? Shall I kill them?"

verses.textZh: 以利沙说："你不可击杀他们。你可以击杀你自己用刀用弓掳回来的人吗？你要在他们面前摆上食物和水，给他们吃喝，然后回到他们的主人那里去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙说："你不可击杀他们。你可以击杀你自己用刀用弓掳回来的人吗？你要在他们面前摆上食物和水，给他们吃喝，然后回到他们的主人那里去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 回答说：「不可击杀他们！就是你用刀用弓掳来的，岂可击杀他们吗 ？当在他们面前设摆饮食，使他们吃喝回到他们的主人那里。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not kill them," he answered. "Would you kill those you have captured with your own sword or bow? Set food and water before them so that they may eat and drink and then go back to their master."
verses.textEnEsv: He answered, "You shall not strike them down. Would you strike down those whom you have taken captive with your sword and with your bow? Set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink and go to their master."
verses.textEnNkjv: But he answered, "You shall not kill them. Would you kill those whom you have taken captive with your sword and your bow? Set food and water before them, that they may eat and drink and go to their master."
verses.textEnNlt: "Of course not!" Elisha replied. "Do we kill prisoners of war? Give them food and drink and send them home again to their master."
verses.textEnNasb: But he answered, "You shall not kill them. Would you kill those whom you have taken captive with your sword and your bow? Set bread and water before them, so that they may eat and drink, and go to their master."
verses.textEn: "Do not kill them," he answered. "Would you kill those you have captured with your own sword or bow? Set food and water before them so that they may eat and drink and then go back to their master."

verses.textZh: 于是王为他们预备盛大的宴会；他们吃喝完了，王打发他们离去，他们就回到他们的主人那里去了。从此，亚兰的军队不再侵犯以色列地了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是王为他们预备盛大的宴会；他们吃喝完了，王打发他们离去，他们就回到他们的主人那里去了。从此，亚兰的军队不再侵犯以色列地了。
verses.textZhCuv: 王就为他们预备了许多食物；他们吃喝完了，打发他们回到他们主人那里。从此，亚兰军不再犯以色列境了。
verses.textEnNiv: So he prepared a great feast for them, and after they had finished eating and drinking, he sent them away, and they returned to their master. So the bands from Aram stopped raiding Israel’s territory.
verses.textEnEsv: So he prepared for them a great feast, and when they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away, and they went to their master. And the Syrians did not come again on raids into the land of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he prepared a great feast for them; and after they ate and drank, he sent them away and they went to their master. So the bands of Syrian raiders came no more into the land of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: So the king made a great feast for them and then sent them home to their master. After that, the Aramean raiders stayed away from the land of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: So he provided a large feast for them; and when they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away, and they went to their master. And the marauding bands of Arameans did not come again into the land of Israel.
verses.textEn: So he prepared a great feast for them, and after they had finished eating and drinking, he sent them away, and they returned to their master. So the bands from Aram stopped raiding Israel’s territory.

verses.textZh: 后来，亚兰王便．哈达征召他全部的军队上来围困撒玛利亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，亚兰王便．哈达征召他全部的军队上来围困撒玛利亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，亚兰王便‧哈达聚集他的全军，上来围困撒马利亚。
verses.textEnNiv: Some time later, Ben-Hadad king of Aram mobilized his entire army and marched up and laid siege to Samaria.
verses.textEnEsv: Afterward Ben-hadad king of Syria mustered his entire army and went up and besieged Samaria.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened after this that Ben-Hadad king of Syria gathered all his army, and went up and besieged Samaria.
verses.textEnNlt: Some time later, however, King Ben-hadad of Aram mustered his entire army and besieged Samaria.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about after this, that Ben-hadad the king of Aram gathered all his army, and went up and besieged Samaria.
verses.textEn: Some time later, Ben-Hadad king of Aram mobilized his entire army and marched up and laid siege to Samaria.

verses.textZh: 于是撒玛利亚发生了极大的饥荒，敌军继续包围，以致一个驴头要卖九百克银子，两百克的鸽子粪也值六十克银子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是撒玛利亚发生了极大的饥荒，敌军继续包围，以致一个驴头要卖九百克银子，两百克的鸽子粪也值六十克银子。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是撒马利亚被围困，有饥荒，甚至一个驴头值银八十舍客勒，二升鸽子粪值银五舍客勒。
verses.textEnNiv: There was a great famine in the city; the siege lasted so long that a donkey’s head sold for eighty shekels of silver, and a quarter of a cab of seed pods for five shekels.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was a great famine in Samaria, as they besieged it, until a donkey’s head was sold for eighty shekels of silver, and the fourth part of a kab of dove’s dung for five shekels of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there was a great famine in Samaria; and indeed they besieged it until a donkey’s head was sold for eighty shekels of silver, and one-fourth of a kab of dove droppings for five shekels of silver.
verses.textEnNlt: As a result, there was a great famine in the city. The siege lasted so long that a donkey’s head sold for eighty pieces of silver, and a cup of dove’s dung sold for five pieces of silver.
verses.textEnNasb: So there was a severe famine in Samaria; and behold, they kept besieging it until a donkey’s head was sold for eighty shekels of silver, and a fourth of a kab of dove’s dung for five shekels of silver.
verses.textEn: There was a great famine in the city; the siege lasted so long that a donkey’s head sold for eighty shekels of silver, and a quarter of a cab of seed pods for five shekels.

verses.textZh: 以色列王在城墙上经过时，有一个妇人向他呼求说："我主我王啊，救救我！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王在城墙上经过时，有一个妇人向他呼求说："我主我王啊，救救我！"
verses.textZhCuv: 一日，以色列王在城上经过，有一个妇人向他呼叫说：「我主，我王啊！求你帮助。」
verses.textEnNiv: As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, "Help me, my lord the king!"
verses.textEnEsv: Now as the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried out to him, saying, "Help, my lord, O king!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, as the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried out to him, saying, "Help, my lord, O king!"
verses.textEnNlt: One day as the king of Israel was walking along the wall of the city, a woman called to him, "Please help me, my lord the king!"
verses.textEnNasb: And as the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried out to him, saying, "Help, my lord the king!"
verses.textEn: As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, "Help me, my lord the king!"

verses.textZh: 他说："如果耶和华不救你，我又从哪里救你？是从打谷场，或是从榨酒池呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："如果耶和华不救你，我又从哪里救你？是从打谷场，或是从榨酒池呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 王说：「耶和华不帮助你，我从何处帮助你？是从禾场，是从酒榨呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: The king replied, "If the Lord does not help you, where can I get help for you? From the threshing floor? From the winepress?"
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "If the Lord will not help you, how shall I help you? From the threshing floor, or from the winepress?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "If the Lord does not help you, where can I find help for you? From the threshing floor or from the winepress?"
verses.textEnNlt: He answered, "If the Lord doesn’t help you, what can I do? I have neither food from the threshing floor nor wine from the press to give you."
verses.textEnNasb: But he said, " If the Lord does not help you, from where am I to help you? From the threshing floor, or from the wine press?"
verses.textEn: The king replied, "If the Lord does not help you, where can I get help for you? From the threshing floor? From the winepress?"

verses.textZh: 王对她说："到底有甚么事呢？"她说："这妇人对我说：‘把你的儿子交出来，今日我们好把他吃了；明天我们可以吃我的儿子。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 王对她说："到底有甚么事呢？"她说："这妇人对我说：‘把你的儿子交出来，今日我们好把他吃了；明天我们可以吃我的儿子。’
verses.textZhCuv: 王问妇人说：「你有什么苦处？」她回答说：「这妇人对我说：『将你的儿子取来，我们今日可以吃，明日可以吃我的儿子。』
verses.textEnNiv: Then he asked her, "What’s the matter?" She answered, "This woman said to me, ‘Give up your son so we may eat him today, and tomorrow we’ll eat my son.’
verses.textEnEsv: And the king asked her, "What is your trouble?" She answered, "This woman said to me, ‘Give your son, that we may eat him today, and we will eat my son tomorrow.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king said to her, "What is troubling you?" And she answered, "This woman said to me, ‘Give your son, that we may eat him today, and we will eat my son tomorrow.’
verses.textEnNlt: But then the king asked, "What is the matter?" She replied, "This woman said to me: ‘Come on, let’s eat your son today, then we will eat my son tomorrow.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king said to her, "What is on your mind?" And she said, "This woman said to me, ‘Give your son so that we may eat him today, and we will eat my son tomorrow.’
verses.textEn: Then he asked her, "What’s the matter?" She answered, "This woman said to me, ‘Give up your son so we may eat him today, and tomorrow we’ll eat my son.’

verses.textZh: 于是我们把我的儿子煮了，把他吃了。第二日，我对她说：‘把你的儿子交出来，我们好把他吃了。’她却把她的儿子收藏起来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我们把我的儿子煮了，把他吃了。第二日，我对她说：‘把你的儿子交出来，我们好把他吃了。’她却把她的儿子收藏起来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们就煮了我的儿子吃了。次日我对她说：『要将你的儿子取来，我们可以吃。』她却将她的儿子藏起来了。」
verses.textEnNiv: So we cooked my son and ate him. The next day I said to her, ‘Give up your son so we may eat him,’ but she had hidden him."
verses.textEnEsv: So we boiled my son and ate him. And on the next day I said to her, ‘Give your son, that we may eat him.’ But she has hidden her son."
verses.textEnNkjv: So we boiled my son, and ate him. And I said to her on the next day, ‘Give your son, that we may eat him’; but she has hidden her son."
verses.textEnNlt: So we cooked my son and ate him. Then the next day I said to her, ‘Kill your son so we can eat him,’ but she has hidden her son."
verses.textEnNasb: So we cooked my son and ate him; and I said to her on the next day, ‘Give your son, so that we may eat him’; but she has hidden her son."
verses.textEn: So we cooked my son and ate him. The next day I said to her, ‘Give up your son so we may eat him,’ but she had hidden him."

verses.textZh: 王听见那妇人的话，就撕裂衣服，他当时正在城墙上，人民都看见他；看哪，他里面贴身穿著的是件麻衣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王听见那妇人的话，就撕裂衣服，他当时正在城墙上，人民都看见他；看哪，他里面贴身穿著的是件麻衣。
verses.textZhCuv: 王听见妇人的话，就撕裂衣服；（王在城上经过）百姓看见王贴身穿着麻衣。
verses.textEnNiv: When the king heard the woman’s words, he tore his robes. As he went along the wall, the people looked, and they saw that, under his robes, he had sackcloth on his body.
verses.textEnEsv: When the king heard the words of the woman, he tore his clothes—now he was passing by on the wall—and the people looked, and behold, he had sackcloth beneath on his body—
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, when the king heard the words of the woman, that he tore his clothes; and as he passed by on the wall, the people looked, and there underneath hehad sackcloth on his body.
verses.textEnNlt: When the king heard this, he tore his clothes in despair. And as the king walked along the wall, the people could see that he was wearing burlap under his robe next to his skin.
verses.textEnNasb: When the king heard the woman’s words, he tore his clothes—and he was passing by on the wall—and the people looked, and behold, he had sackcloth underneath on his body.
verses.textEn: When the king heard the woman’s words, he tore his robes. As he went along the wall, the people looked, and they saw that, under his robes, he had sackcloth on his body.

verses.textZh: 他说："如果今日沙法的儿子以利沙的头仍留在他身上，愿神惩罚我，而且加倍惩罚我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："如果今日沙法的儿子以利沙的头仍留在他身上，愿神惩罚我，而且加倍惩罚我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王说：「我今日若容沙法的儿子以利沙的头仍在他项上，愿神重重地降罚与我！」
verses.textEnNiv: He said, "May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if the head of Elisha son of Shaphat remains on his shoulders today!"
verses.textEnEsv: and he said, "May God do so to me and more also, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat remains on his shoulders today."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "God do so to me and more also, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat remains on him today!"
verses.textEnNlt: "May God strike me and even kill me if I don’t separate Elisha’s head from his shoulders this very day," the king vowed.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "May God do so to me and more so, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat remains on him today."
verses.textEn: He said, "May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if the head of Elisha son of Shaphat remains on his shoulders today!"

verses.textZh: 那时，以利沙正坐在自己的屋子里，众长老也和他坐在一起。王差派一个在他面前侍立的人去，那使者去到以利沙那里以前，以利沙对众长老说："你们看这凶手之子派人来取我的首级。你们留意那使者来到的时候，你们要把门关上，把他挡在门外。他主人的脚步声不是在他后面吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，以利沙正坐在自己的屋子里，众长老也和他坐在一起。王差派一个在他面前侍立的人去，那使者去到以利沙那里以前，以利沙对众长老说："你们看这凶手之子派人来取我的首级。你们留意那使者来到的时候，你们要把门关上，把他挡在门外。他主人的脚步声不是在他后面吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，以利沙正坐在家中，长老也与他同坐。王打发一个伺候他的人去；他还没有到，以利沙对长老说：「你们看这凶手之子，打发人来斩我的头；你们看着使者来到，就关上门，用门将他推出去。在他后头不是有他主人脚步的响声吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Now Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him. The king sent a messenger ahead, but before he arrived, Elisha said to the elders, "Don’t you see how this murderer is sending someone to cut off my head? Look, when the messenger comes, shut the door and hold it shut against him. Is not the sound of his master’s footsteps behind him?"
verses.textEnEsv: Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him. Now the king had dispatched a man from his presence, but before the messenger arrived Elisha said to the elders, "Do you see how this murderer has sent to take off my head? Look, when the messenger comes, shut the door and hold the door fast against him. Is not the sound of his master’s feet behind him?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him. And theking sent a man ahead of him, but before the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, "Do you see how this son of a murderer has sent someone to take away my head? Look, when the messenger comes, shut the door, and hold him fast at the door. Is not the sound of his master’s feet behind him?"
verses.textEnNlt: Elisha was sitting in his house with the elders of Israel when the king sent a messenger to summon him. But before the messenger arrived, Elisha said to the elders, "A murderer has sent a man to cut off my head. When he arrives, shut the door and keep him out. We will soon hear his master’s steps following him."
verses.textEnNasb: Now Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him. And the king sent a man from his presence; but before the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, "Do you see how this son of a murderer has sent a man to cut off my head? Look, when the messenger comes, shut the door and hold the door shut against him. Is the sound of his master’s feet not behind him?"
verses.textEn: Now Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him. The king sent a messenger ahead, but before he arrived, Elisha said to the elders, "Don’t you see how this murderer is sending someone to cut off my head? Look, when the messenger comes, shut the door and hold it shut against him. Is not the sound of his master’s footsteps behind him?"

verses.textZh: 他和众长老还在说话的时候，看哪，王 就下到他那里，说："看哪，这灾祸是从耶和华来的，我为甚么还仰望耶和华呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他和众长老还在说话的时候，看哪，王 就下到他那里，说："看哪，这灾祸是从耶和华来的，我为甚么还仰望耶和华呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 正说话的时候，使者来到，王也到了，说：「这灾祸是从耶和华那里来的，我何必再仰望耶和华呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: While he was still talking to them, the messenger came down to him. The king said, "This disaster is from the Lord . Why should I wait for the Lord any longer?"
verses.textEnEsv: And while he was still speaking with them, the messenger came down to him and said, "This trouble is from the Lord ! Why should I wait for the Lord any longer?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And while he was still talking with them, there was the messenger, coming down to him; and then theking said, "Surely this calamity is from the Lord; why should I wait for the Lord any longer?"
verses.textEnNlt: While Elisha was still saying this, the messenger arrived. And the king said, "All this misery is from the Lord ! Why should I wait for the Lord any longer?"
verses.textEnNasb: While he was still talking with them, behold, the messenger came down to him and he said, "Behold, this evil is from the Lord; why should I wait for the Lord any longer?"
verses.textEn: While he was still talking to them, the messenger came down to him. The king said, "This disaster is from the Lord . Why should I wait for the Lord any longer?"

verses.textZh: 以利沙说："你们要听耶和华的话。耶和华这样说：‘明日大约这个时候，在撒玛利亚的城门，三公斤面粉只卖十一克银子，六公斤大麦也只是卖十一克银子。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙说："你们要听耶和华的话。耶和华这样说：‘明日大约这个时候，在撒玛利亚的城门，三公斤面粉只卖十一克银子，六公斤大麦也只是卖十一克银子。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙说：「你们要听耶和华的话，耶和华如此说：明日约到这时候，在撒马利亚城门口，一细亚细面要卖银一舍客勒，二细亚大麦也要卖银一舍客勒。」
verses.textEnNiv: Elisha replied, "Hear the word of the Lord . This is what the Lord says: About this time tomorrow, a seah of the finest flour will sell for a shekel and two seahs of barley for a shekel at the gate of Samaria."
verses.textEnEsv: But Elisha said, "Hear the word of the Lord : thus says the Lord , Tomorrow about this time a seah of fine flour shall be sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley for a shekel, at the gate of Samaria."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Elisha said, "Hear the word of the Lord. Thus says the Lord: ‘Tomorrow about this time a seah of fine flour shall be sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley for a shekel, at the gate of Samaria.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Elisha replied, "Listen to this message from the Lord ! This is what the Lord says: By this time tomorrow in the markets of Samaria, six quarts of choice flour will cost only one piece of silver, and twelve quarts of barley grain will cost only one piece of silver. "
verses.textEnNasb: Then Elisha said, "Listen to the word of the Lord; this is what the Lord says: ‘About this time tomorrow a measure of fine flour will be sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, at the gate of Samaria.’ "
verses.textEn: Elisha replied, "Hear the word of the Lord . This is what the Lord says: About this time tomorrow, a seah of the finest flour will sell for a shekel and two seahs of barley for a shekel at the gate of Samaria."

verses.textZh: 但那搀扶王的官长回答神人，说："即使耶和华在天上开了窗户，也不会有这事发生。"以利沙说："看哪，你要亲眼看见，却吃不着。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但那搀扶王的官长回答神人，说："即使耶和华在天上开了窗户，也不会有这事发生。"以利沙说："看哪，你要亲眼看见，却吃不着。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个搀扶王的军长对神人说：「即便耶和华使天开了窗户，也不能有这事。」以利沙说：「你必亲眼看见，却不得吃。」
verses.textEnNiv: The officer on whose arm the king was leaning said to the man of God, "Look, even if the Lord should open the floodgates of the heavens, could this happen?" "You will see it with your own eyes," answered Elisha, "but you will not eat any of it!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then the captain on whose hand the king leaned said to the man of God, "If the Lord himself should make windows in heaven, could this thing be?" But he said, "You shall see it with your own eyes, but you shall not eat of it."
verses.textEnNkjv: So an officer on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God and said, "Look, if the Lord would make windows in heaven, could this thing be?" And he said, "In fact, you shall see it with your eyes, but you shall not eat of it."
verses.textEnNlt: The officer assisting the king said to the man of God, "That couldn’t happen even if the Lord opened the windows of heaven!" But Elisha replied, "You will see it happen with your own eyes, but you won’t be able to eat any of it!"
verses.textEnNasb: The royal officer on whose hand the king was leaning responded to the man of God and said, "Even if the Lord were to make windows in heaven, could this thing happen?" Then he said, "Behold, you are going to see it with your own eyes, but you will not eat any of it."
verses.textEn: The officer on whose arm the king was leaning said to the man of God, "Look, even if the Lord should open the floodgates of the heavens, could this happen?" "You will see it with your own eyes," answered Elisha, "but you will not eat any of it!"

verses.textZh: 有四个痲风病人在城门口那里，他们彼此说："我们为甚么坐在这里等死呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 有四个痲风病人在城门口那里，他们彼此说："我们为甚么坐在这里等死呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 在城门那里有四个长大麻风的人，他们彼此说：「我们为何坐在这里等死呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Now there were four men with leprosy at the entrance of the city gate. They said to each other, "Why stay here until we die?
verses.textEnEsv: Now there were four men who were lepers at the entrance to the gate. And they said to one another, "Why are we sitting here until we die?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate; and they said to one another, "Why are we sitting here until we die?
verses.textEnNlt: Now there were four men with leprosy sitting at the entrance of the city gates. "Why should we sit here waiting to die?" they asked each other.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate; and they said to one another, "Why are we sitting here until we die?
verses.textEn: Now there were four men with leprosy at the entrance of the city gate. They said to each other, "Why stay here until we die?

verses.textZh: 我们如果说：‘我们进城去吧！’城里正有饥荒，我们就要死在那里。我们如果坐在这里，也是要死。现在，让我们去投降亚兰人的军队吧；如果他们饶我们一命，我们就可以活着；如果他们要杀死我们，我们就死吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们如果说：‘我们进城去吧！’城里正有饥荒，我们就要死在那里。我们如果坐在这里，也是要死。现在，让我们去投降亚兰人的军队吧；如果他们饶我们一命，我们就可以活着；如果他们要杀死我们，我们就死吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若说，进城去吧！城里有饥荒，必死在那里；若在这里坐着不动，也必是死。来吧，我们去投降亚兰人的军队，他们若留我们的活命，就活着；若杀我们，就死了吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: If we say, ‘We’ll go into the city’—the famine is there, and we will die. And if we stay here, we will die. So let’s go over to the camp of the Arameans and surrender. If they spare us, we live; if they kill us, then we die."
verses.textEnEsv: If we say, ‘Let us enter the city,’ the famine is in the city, and we shall die there. And if we sit here, we die also. So now come, let us go over to the camp of the Syrians. If they spare our lives we shall live, and if they kill us we shall but die."
verses.textEnNkjv: If we say, ‘We will enter the city,’ the famine is in the city, and we shall die there. And if we sit here, we die also. Now therefore, come, let us surrender to the army of the Syrians. If they keep us alive, we shall live; and if they kill us, we shall only die."
verses.textEnNlt: "We will starve if we stay here, but with the famine in the city, we will starve if we go back there. So we might as well go out and surrender to the Aramean army. If they let us live, so much the better. But if they kill us, we would have died anyway."
verses.textEnNasb: If we say, ‘We will enter the city,’ then the famine is in the city and we will die there; but if we sit here, we will also die. Now then come, and let’s go over to the camp of the Arameans. If they spare us, we will live; and if they kill us, then we will die."
verses.textEn: If we say, ‘We’ll go into the city’—the famine is there, and we will die. And if we stay here, we will die. So let’s go over to the camp of the Arameans and surrender. If they spare us, we live; if they kill us, then we die."

verses.textZh: 于是他们在黄昏动身去到亚兰人的军营那里；他们来到亚兰人的军营外边，竟看不见一个人在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们在黄昏动身去到亚兰人的军营那里；他们来到亚兰人的军营外边，竟看不见一个人在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 黄昏的时候，他们起来往亚兰人的营盘去；到了营边，不见一人在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: At dusk they got up and went to the camp of the Arameans. When they reached the edge of the camp, no one was there,
verses.textEnEsv: So they arose at twilight to go to the camp of the Syrians. But when they came to the edge of the camp of the Syrians, behold, there was no one there.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they rose at twilight to go to the camp of the Syrians; and when they had come to the outskirts of the Syrian camp, to their surprise no one was there.
verses.textEnNlt: So at twilight they set out for the camp of the Arameans. But when they came to the edge of the camp, no one was there!
verses.textEnNasb: So they got up at twilight to go to the camp of the Arameans; when they came to the outskirts of the camp of the Arameans, behold, there was no one there.
verses.textEn: At dusk they got up and went to the camp of the Arameans. When they reached the edge of the camp, no one was there,

verses.textZh: 因为主使亚兰人的军队听见战车、战马和大军的声音；他们就彼此说："看哪，一定是以色列王雇用了赫人的众王和埃及人的众王来攻击我们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为主使亚兰人的军队听见战车、战马和大军的声音；他们就彼此说："看哪，一定是以色列王雇用了赫人的众王和埃及人的众王来攻击我们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为主使亚兰人的军队听见车马的声音，是大军的声音；他们就彼此说：「这必是以色列王贿买赫人的诸王和埃及人的诸王来攻击我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: for the Lord had caused the Arameans to hear the sound of chariots and horses and a great army, so that they said to one another, "Look, the king of Israel has hired the Hittite and Egyptian kings to attack us!"
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord had made the army of the Syrians hear the sound of chariots and of horses, the sound of a great army, so that they said to one another, "Behold, the king of Israel has hired against us the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Egypt to come against us."
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord had caused the army of the Syrians to hear the noise of chariots and the noise of horses—the noise of a great army; so they said to one another, "Look, the king of Israel has hired against us the kings of the Hittites and the kings of the Egyptians to attack us!"
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord had caused the Aramean army to hear the clatter of speeding chariots and the galloping of horses and the sounds of a great army approaching. "The king of Israel has hired the Hittites and Egyptians to attack us!" they cried to one another.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord had made the army of the Arameans hear a sound of chariots, a sound of horses, that is, the sound of a great army; and they said to one another, "Behold, the king of Israel has hired the kings of the Hittites and the kings of the Egyptians against us, to attack us!"
verses.textEn: for the Lord had caused the Arameans to hear the sound of chariots and horses and a great army, so that they said to one another, "Look, the king of Israel has hired the Hittite and Egyptian kings to attack us!"

verses.textZh: 于是他们在黄昏的时候起来逃跑，他们丢下他们的帐幕，他们的马匹和他们的驴子；军营仍在那里，他们却只顾逃命去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们在黄昏的时候起来逃跑，他们丢下他们的帐幕，他们的马匹和他们的驴子；军营仍在那里，他们却只顾逃命去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，在黄昏的时候他们起来逃跑，撇下帐棚、马、驴，营盘照旧，只顾逃命。
verses.textEnNiv: So they got up and fled in the dusk and abandoned their tents and their horses and donkeys. They left the camp as it was and ran for their lives.
verses.textEnEsv: So they fled away in the twilight and abandoned their tents, their horses, and their donkeys, leaving the camp as it was, and fled for their lives.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they arose and fled at twilight, and left the camp intact—their tents, their horses, and their donkeys—and they fled for their lives.
verses.textEnNlt: So they panicked and ran into the night, abandoning their tents, horses, donkeys, and everything else, as they fled for their lives.
verses.textEnNasb: So they got up and fled at twilight, and abandoned their tents, their horses, and their donkeys—indeed the camp itself, just as it was; and they fled for their lives.
verses.textEn: So they got up and fled in the dusk and abandoned their tents and their horses and donkeys. They left the camp as it was and ran for their lives.

verses.textZh: 这些患痲风病的人来到军营的外边，他们进入其中一座帐幕，又吃又喝，并且从那里取去金子、银子和衣服，然后离去，把东西收藏起来。他们再回去，进入另一座帐幕，从那里拿走财物，去收藏起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些患痲风病的人来到军营的外边，他们进入其中一座帐幕，又吃又喝，并且从那里取去金子、银子和衣服，然后离去，把东西收藏起来。他们再回去，进入另一座帐幕，从那里拿走财物，去收藏起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些长大麻风的到了营边，进了帐棚，吃了喝了，且从其中拿出金银和衣服来，去收藏了；回来又进了一座帐棚，从其中拿出财物来去收藏了。
verses.textEnNiv: The men who had leprosy reached the edge of the camp, entered one of the tents and ate and drank. Then they took silver, gold and clothes, and went off and hid them. They returned and entered another tent and took some things from it and hid them also.
verses.textEnEsv: And when these lepers came to the edge of the camp, they went into a tent and ate and drank, and they carried off silver and gold and clothing and went and hid them. Then they came back and entered another tent and carried off things from it and went and hid them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when these lepers came to the outskirts of the camp, they went into one tent and ate and drank, and carried from it silver and gold and clothing, and went and hid them; then they came back and entered another tent, and carried some from there also, and went and hid it.
verses.textEnNlt: When the men with leprosy arrived at the edge of the camp, they went into one tent after another, eating and drinking wine; and they carried off silver and gold and clothing and hid it.
verses.textEnNasb: When these men with leprosy came to the outskirts of the camp, they entered one tent and ate and drank, and carried from there silver, gold, and clothes, and they went and hid them; then they returned and entered another tent, and carried valuables from there also, and went and hid them.
verses.textEn: The men who had leprosy reached the edge of the camp, entered one of the tents and ate and drank. Then they took silver, gold and clothes, and went off and hid them. They returned and entered another tent and took some things from it and hid them also.

verses.textZh: 他们彼此说："我们这样作是不对的。今天是报好消息的日子，我们竟不出声，如果我们等到早上天亮，我们就算为有罪了。现在，来吧，我们要去通知王家。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们彼此说："我们这样作是不对的。今天是报好消息的日子，我们竟不出声，如果我们等到早上天亮，我们就算为有罪了。现在，来吧，我们要去通知王家。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，他们彼此说：「我们所做的不好！今日是有好信息的日子，我们竟不作声！若等到天亮，罪必临到我们。来吧，我们与王家报信去！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then they said to each other, "What we’re doing is not right. This is a day of good news and we are keeping it to ourselves. If we wait until daylight, punishment will overtake us. Let’s go at once and report this to the royal palace."
verses.textEnEsv: Then they said to one another, "We are not doing right. This day is a day of good news. If we are silent and wait until the morning light, punishment will overtake us. Now therefore come; let us go and tell the king’s household."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to one another, "We are not doing right. This day is a day of good news, and we remain silent. If we wait until morning light, some punishment will come upon us. Now therefore, come, let us go and tell the king’s household."
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, they said to each other, "This is not right. This is a day of good news, and we aren’t sharing it with anyone! If we wait until morning, some calamity will certainly fall upon us. Come on, let’s go back and tell the people at the palace."
verses.textEnNasb: Then they said to one another, "We are not doing the right thing. This day is a day of good news, but we are keeping silent about it; if we wait until the morning light, punishment will overtake us. Now then come, let’s go and inform the king’s household."
verses.textEn: Then they said to each other, "What we’re doing is not right. This is a day of good news and we are keeping it to ourselves. If we wait until daylight, punishment will overtake us. Let’s go at once and report this to the royal palace."

verses.textZh: 他们就去呼喊守城门的，告诉他们说："我们去过亚兰人的军营那里，看见那里一个人也没有，也没有人声。只有马仍拴着，驴仍拴着，帐幕都原封不动。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就去呼喊守城门的，告诉他们说："我们去过亚兰人的军营那里，看见那里一个人也没有，也没有人声。只有马仍拴着，驴仍拴着，帐幕都原封不动。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就去叫守城门的，告诉他们说：「我们到了亚兰人的营，不见一人在那里，也无人声，只有拴着的马和驴，帐棚都照旧。」
verses.textEnNiv: So they went and called out to the city gatekeepers and told them, "We went into the Aramean camp and no one was there—not a sound of anyone—only tethered horses and donkeys, and the tents left just as they were."
verses.textEnEsv: So they came and called to the gatekeepers of the city and told them, "We came to the camp of the Syrians, and behold, there was no one to be seen or heard there, nothing but the horses tied and the donkeys tied and the tents as they were."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they went and called to the gatekeepers of the city, and told them, saying, "We went to the Syrian camp, and surprisingly no one was there, not a human sound—only horses and donkeys tied, and the tents intact."
verses.textEnNlt: So they went back to the city and told the gatekeepers what had happened. "We went out to the Aramean camp," they said, "and no one was there! The horses and donkeys were tethered and the tents were all in order, but there wasn’t a single person around!"
verses.textEnNasb: So they came and called to the gatekeepers of the city, and told them, saying, "We came to the camp of the Arameans, and behold, there was no one there, nor a human voice; only the horses tied and the donkeys tied, and the tents just as they were."
verses.textEn: So they went and called out to the city gatekeepers and told them, "We went into the Aramean camp and no one was there—not a sound of anyone—only tethered horses and donkeys, and the tents left just as they were."

verses.textZh: 守城门的就喊叫起来，又往城内给王家报信。
verses.textZhCnvs: 守城门的就喊叫起来，又往城内给王家报信。
verses.textZhCuv: 守城门的叫了众守门的人来，他们就进去与王家报信。
verses.textEnNiv: The gatekeepers shouted the news, and it was reported within the palace.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the gatekeepers called out, and it was told within the king’s household.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the gatekeepers called out, and they told it to the king’s household inside.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the gatekeepers shouted the news to the people in the palace.
verses.textEnNasb: And the gatekeepers called and announced it inside the king’s house.
verses.textEn: The gatekeepers shouted the news, and it was reported within the palace.

verses.textZh: 王在夜间起来，对他的臣仆说："我告诉你们亚兰人对我们所作的是怎么一回事。他们知道我们闹饥荒，所以出到军营外在田野埋伏，心里说：‘他们必从城里出来。我们就可以活捉他们，进入城里去了。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王在夜间起来，对他的臣仆说："我告诉你们亚兰人对我们所作的是怎么一回事。他们知道我们闹饥荒，所以出到军营外在田野埋伏，心里说：‘他们必从城里出来。我们就可以活捉他们，进入城里去了。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 王夜间起来，对臣仆说：「我告诉你们亚兰人向我们如何行。他们知道我们饥饿，所以离营，埋伏在田野，说：『以色列人出城的时候，我们就活捉他们，得以进城。』」
verses.textEnNiv: The king got up in the night and said to his officers, "I will tell you what the Arameans have done to us. They know we are starving; so they have left the camp to hide in the countryside, thinking, ‘They will surely come out, and then we will take them alive and get into the city.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And the king rose in the night and said to his servants, "I will tell you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we are hungry. Therefore they have gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the open country, thinking, ‘When they come out of the city, we shall take them alive and get into the city.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king arose in the night and said to his servants, "Let me now tell you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we are hungry; therefore they have gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, ‘When they come out of the city, we shall catch them alive, and get into the city.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: The king got out of bed in the middle of the night and told his officers, "I know what has happened. The Arameans know we are starving, so they have left their camp and have hidden in the fields. They are expecting us to leave the city, and then they will take us alive and capture the city."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king got up in the night and said to his servants, "I will now tell you what the Arameans have done to us. They know that we are hungry; so they have left the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, ‘When they come out of the city, we will capture them alive and get into the city.’ "
verses.textEn: The king got up in the night and said to his officers, "I will tell you what the Arameans have done to us. They know we are starving; so they have left the camp to hide in the countryside, thinking, ‘They will surely come out, and then we will take them alive and get into the city.’ "

verses.textZh: 他的一位臣仆回答，说："请叫人拉五匹剩下的马来；看哪，牠们像所有剩下在这里的以色列人，都要像所有死去的以色列人一样；让我们打发人去看看吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的一位臣仆回答，说："请叫人拉五匹剩下的马来；看哪，牠们像所有剩下在这里的以色列人，都要像所有死去的以色列人一样；让我们打发人去看看吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个臣仆对王说：「我们不如用城里剩下之马中的五匹马（马和城里剩下的以色列人都是一样，快要灭绝），打发人去窥探。」
verses.textEnNiv: One of his officers answered, "Have some men take five of the horses that are left in the city. Their plight will be like that of all the Israelites left here—yes, they will only be like all these Israelites who are doomed. So let us send them to find out what happened."
verses.textEnEsv: And one of his servants said, "Let some men take five of the remaining horses, seeing that those who are left here will fare like the whole multitude of Israel who have already perished. Let us send and see."
verses.textEnNkjv: And one of his servants answered and said, "Please, let several men take five of the remaining horses which are left in the city. Look, they mayeitherbecome like all the multitude of Israel that are left in it; or indeed, Isay, they maybecome like all the multitude of Israel left from those who are consumed; so let us send them and see."
verses.textEnNlt: One of his officers replied, "We had better send out scouts to check into this. Let them take five of the remaining horses. If something happens to them, it will be no worse than if they stay here and die with the rest of us."
verses.textEnNasb: One of his servants responded and said, "Please, have some men take five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city. Behold, they will be in any case like all the multitude of Israel who are left in it; behold, they will be like all the multitude of Israel who have already perished, so let us send them and see."
verses.textEn: One of his officers answered, "Have some men take five of the horses that are left in the city. Their plight will be like that of all the Israelites left here—yes, they will only be like all these Israelites who are doomed. So let us send them to find out what happened."

verses.textZh: 于是他们取了两辆战车和马匹，王差人去追踪亚兰军，吩咐他们："去查看吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们取了两辆战车和马匹，王差人去追踪亚兰军，吩咐他们："去查看吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是取了两辆车和马，王差人去追寻亚兰军，说：「你们去窥探窥探。」
verses.textEnNiv: So they selected two chariots with their horses, and the king sent them after the Aramean army. He commanded the drivers, "Go and find out what has happened."
verses.textEnEsv: So they took two horsemen, and the king sent them after the army of the Syrians, saying, "Go and see."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they took two chariots with horses; and the king sent them in the direction of the Syrian army, saying, "Go and see."
verses.textEnNlt: So two chariots with horses were prepared, and the king sent scouts to see what had happened to the Aramean army.
