verses.textEnNasb: ‘I have certainly seen yesterday the blood of Naboth and the blood of his sons,’ declares the Lord, ‘and I will repay you on this property,’ declares the Lord. Now then, pick him up and throw him on the property, in accordance with the word of the Lord."
verses.textEn: ‘Yesterday I saw the blood of Naboth and the blood of his sons, declares the Lord , and I will surely make you pay for it on this plot of ground, declares the Lord .’ Now then, pick him up and throw him on that plot, in accordance with the word of the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 犹大王亚哈谢看见这一切，就沿着通往伯哈干的路逃走。耶户紧追着他，说："还有他！"他们就在靠近以伯莲的姑珥坡把他击伤在战车上。他逃到米吉多，就死在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王亚哈谢看见这一切，就沿着通往伯哈干的路逃走。耶户紧追着他，说："还有他！"他们就在靠近以伯莲的姑珥坡把他击伤在战车上。他逃到米吉多，就死在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王亚哈谢见这光景，就从园亭之路逃跑。耶户追赶他，说：「把这人也杀在车上。」到了靠近以伯莲姑珥的坡上击伤了他。他逃到米吉多，就死在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: When Ahaziah king of Judah saw what had happened, he fled up the road to Beth Haggan. Jehu chased him, shouting, "Kill him too!" They wounded him in his chariot on the way up to Gur near Ibleam, but he escaped to Megiddo and died there.
verses.textEnEsv: When Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled in the direction of Beth-haggan. And Jehu pursued him and said, "Shoot him also." And they shot him in the chariot at the ascent of Gur, which is by Ibleam. And he fled to Megiddo and died there.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when Ahaziah king of Judah saw this, he fled by the road to Beth Haggan. So Jehu pursued him, and said, "Shoot him also in the chariot." Andtheyshothim at the Ascent of Gur, which is by Ibleam. Then he fled to Megiddo, and died there.
verses.textEnNlt: When King Ahaziah of Judah saw what was happening, he fled along the road to Beth-haggan. Jehu rode after him, shouting, "Shoot him, too!" So they shot Ahaziah in his chariot at the Ascent of Gur, near Ibleam. He was able to go on as far as Megiddo, but he died there.
verses.textEnNasb: When Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by way of the garden house. But Jehu pursued him and said, " Shoot him too, in the chariot." So they shot him at the ascent of Gur, which is at Ibleam. But he fled to Megiddo and died there.
verses.textEn: When Ahaziah king of Judah saw what had happened, he fled up the road to Beth Haggan. Jehu chased him, shouting, "Kill him too!" They wounded him in his chariot on the way up to Gur near Ibleam, but he escaped to Megiddo and died there.

verses.textZh: 他的臣仆用车把他的尸体送到耶路撒冷，葬在大卫城他自己的坟墓，和他的祖先一同长眠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的臣仆用车把他的尸体送到耶路撒冷，葬在大卫城他自己的坟墓，和他的祖先一同长眠。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的臣仆用车将他的尸首送到耶路撒冷，葬在大卫城他自己的坟墓里，与他列祖同葬。
verses.textEnNiv: His servants took him by chariot to Jerusalem and buried him with his ancestors in his tomb in the City of David.
verses.textEnEsv: His servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his tomb with his fathers in the city of David.
verses.textEnNkjv: And his servants carried him in the chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his tomb with his fathers in the City of David.
verses.textEnNlt: His servants took him by chariot to Jerusalem, where they buried him with his ancestors in the City of David.
verses.textEnNasb: Then his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his grave with his fathers in the city of David.
verses.textEn: His servants took him by chariot to Jerusalem and buried him with his ancestors in his tomb in the City of David.

verses.textZh: 亚哈的儿子约兰第十一年，亚哈谢登基统治犹大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈的儿子约兰第十一年，亚哈谢登基统治犹大。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈谢登基作犹大王的时候，是在亚哈的儿子约兰第十一年。
verses.textEnNiv: (In the eleventh year of Joram son of Ahab, Ahaziah had become king of Judah.)
verses.textEnEsv: In the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab, Ahaziah began to reign over Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab, Ahaziah had become king over Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: Ahaziah had become king over Judah in the eleventh year of the reign of Joram son of Ahab.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the eleventh year of Joram, the son of Ahab, Ahaziah became king over Judah.
verses.textEn: (In the eleventh year of Joram son of Ahab, Ahaziah had become king of Judah.)

verses.textZh: 耶户到了耶斯列。耶洗别已经听闻，就涂眼梳头，从窗户里往外观望。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶户到了耶斯列。耶洗别已经听闻，就涂眼梳头，从窗户里往外观望。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户到了耶斯列；耶洗别听见就擦粉、梳头，从窗户里往外观看。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jehu went to Jezreel. When Jezebel heard about it, she put on eye makeup, arranged her hair and looked out of a window.
verses.textEnEsv: When Jehu came to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it. And she painted her eyes and adorned her head and looked out of the window.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Jehu had come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard ofit; and she put paint on her eyes and adorned her head, and looked through a window.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jezebel, the queen mother, heard that Jehu had come to Jezreel, she painted her eyelids and fixed her hair and sat at a window.
verses.textEnNasb: When Jehu came to Jezreel, Jezebel heard about it, and she put makeup on her eyes and adorned her head, and looked down through the window.
verses.textEn: Then Jehu went to Jezreel. When Jezebel heard about it, she put on eye makeup, arranged her hair and looked out of a window.

verses.textZh: 耶户进入城门的时候，她说："平安吗，杀主的心利？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶户进入城门的时候，她说："平安吗，杀主的心利？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户进门的时候，耶洗别说：「杀主人的心利啊，平安吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: As Jehu entered the gate, she asked, "Have you come in peace, you Zimri, you murderer of your master?"
verses.textEnEsv: And as Jehu entered the gate, she said, "Is it peace, you Zimri, murderer of your master?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, as Jehu entered at the gate, she said, "Isit peace, Zimri, murderer of your master?"
verses.textEnNlt: When Jehu entered the gate of the palace, she shouted at him, "Have you come in peace, you murderer? You’re just like Zimri, who murdered his master!"
verses.textEnNasb: As Jehu entered the gate, she said, "Is your intention peace, Zimri, his master’s murderer?"
verses.textEn: As Jehu entered the gate, she asked, "Have you come in peace, you Zimri, you murderer of your master?"

verses.textZh: 耶户抬头对着窗户，说："有谁拥护我？谁？"立时有两三个太监往外望着他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶户抬头对着窗户，说："有谁拥护我？谁？"立时有两三个太监往外望着他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户抬头向窗户观看，说：「谁顺从我？」有两三个太监从窗户往外看他。
verses.textEnNiv: He looked up at the window and called out, "Who is on my side? Who?" Two or three eunuchs looked down at him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he lifted up his face to the window and said, "Who is on my side? Who?" Two or three eunuchs looked out at him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he looked up at the window, and said, "Who is on my side? Who?" So two or three eunuchs looked out at him.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehu looked up and saw her at the window and shouted, "Who is on my side?" And two or three eunuchs looked out at him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he raised his face toward the window and said, "Who is with me, who?" And two or three officials looked down at him.
verses.textEn: He looked up at the window and called out, "Who is on my side? Who?" Two or three eunuchs looked down at him.

verses.textZh: 他说："把她拋下来！"他们就把她拋下去。她的血溅在墙上和马匹身上，牠们也践踏了她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："把她拋下来！"他们就把她拋下去。她的血溅在墙上和马匹身上，牠们也践踏了她。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户说：「把她扔下来！」他们就把她扔下来。她的血溅在墙上和马上；于是把她践踏了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Throw her down!" Jehu said. So they threw her down, and some of her blood spattered the wall and the horses as they trampled her underfoot.
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "Throw her down." So they threw her down. And some of her blood spattered on the wall and on the horses, and they trampled on her.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "Throw her down." So they threw her down, and some of her blood spattered on the wall and on the horses; and he trampled her underfoot.
verses.textEnNlt: "Throw her down!" Jehu yelled. So they threw her out the window, and her blood spattered against the wall and on the horses. And Jehu trampled her body under his horses’ hooves.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "Throw her down." So they threw her down, and some of her blood spattered on the wall and on the horses, and he trampled her underfoot.
verses.textEn: "Throw her down!" Jehu said. So they threw her down, and some of her blood spattered the wall and the horses as they trampled her underfoot.

verses.textZh: 耶户进入屋内，又吃又喝，然后说："你们去料理那被咒诅的妇人，把她埋了，因为她是王的女儿。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶户进入屋内，又吃又喝，然后说："你们去料理那被咒诅的妇人，把她埋了，因为她是王的女儿。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户进去，吃了喝了，吩咐说：「你们把这被咒诅的妇人葬埋了，因为她是王的女儿。」
verses.textEnNiv: Jehu went in and ate and drank. "Take care of that cursed woman," he said, "and bury her, for she was a king’s daughter."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he went in and ate and drank. And he said, "See now to this cursed woman and bury her, for she is a king’s daughter."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he had gone in, he ate and drank. Then he said, "Go now, see to this accursed woman, and bury her, for she was a king’s daughter."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehu went into the palace and ate and drank. Afterward he said, "Someone go and bury this cursed woman, for she is the daughter of a king."
verses.textEnNasb: When he came in, he ate and drank; and he said, "See now to this cursed woman and bury her, for she is a king’s daughter."
verses.textEn: Jehu went in and ate and drank. "Take care of that cursed woman," he said, "and bury her, for she was a king’s daughter."

verses.textZh: 于是他们去收殓她，却找不到她的尸体，只找到头骨、双脚和双掌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们去收殓她，却找不到她的尸体，只找到头骨、双脚和双掌。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就去葬埋她，只寻得她的头骨和脚，并手掌。
verses.textEnNiv: But when they went out to bury her, they found nothing except her skull, her feet and her hands.
verses.textEnEsv: But when they went to bury her, they found no more of her than the skull and the feet and the palms of her hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they went to bury her, but they found no more of her than the skull and the feet and the palms of her hands.
verses.textEnNlt: But when they went out to bury her, they found only her skull, her feet, and her hands.
verses.textEnNasb: So they went to bury her, but they found nothing of her except the skull, the feet, and the palms of her hands.
verses.textEn: But when they went out to bury her, they found nothing except her skull, her feet and her hands.

verses.textZh: 他们就回去，告诉他，他说："这正是耶和华借着他仆人提斯比人以利亚所说的话：‘野狗必在耶斯列的地方吃耶洗别的肉。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就回去，告诉他，他说："这正是耶和华借着他仆人提斯比人以利亚所说的话：‘野狗必在耶斯列的地方吃耶洗别的肉。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们回去告诉耶户，耶户说：「这正应验耶和华藉他仆人提斯比人以利亚所说的话，说：『在耶斯列田间，狗必吃耶洗别的肉；
verses.textEnNiv: They went back and told Jehu, who said, "This is the word of the Lord that he spoke through his servant Elijah the Tishbite: On the plot of ground at Jezreel dogs will devour Jezebel’s flesh.
verses.textEnEsv: When they came back and told him, he said, "This is the word of the Lord , which he spoke by his servant Elijah the Tishbite: ‘In the territory of Jezreel the dogs shall eat the flesh of Jezebel,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they came back and told him. And he said, "This is the word of the Lord, which He spoke by His servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, ‘On the plot ofground at Jezreel dogs shall eat the flesh of Jezebel;
verses.textEnNlt: When they returned and told Jehu, he stated, "This fulfills the message from the Lord , which he spoke through his servant Elijah from Tishbe: ‘At the plot of land in Jezreel, dogs will eat Jezebel’s body.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore they returned and informed him. And he said, "This is the word of the Lord, which He spoke by His servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, ‘On the property of Jezreel the dogs shall eat the flesh of Jezebel;
verses.textEn: They went back and told Jehu, who said, "This is the word of the Lord that he spoke through his servant Elijah the Tishbite: On the plot of ground at Jezreel dogs will devour Jezebel’s flesh.

verses.textZh: 耶洗别的尸体要像耶斯列田间的粪肥，以致人不能说：‘这是耶洗别。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶洗别的尸体要像耶斯列田间的粪肥，以致人不能说：‘这是耶洗别。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶洗别的尸首必在耶斯列田间如同粪土，甚至人不能说这是耶洗别。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Jezebel’s body will be like dung on the ground in the plot at Jezreel, so that no one will be able to say, ‘This is Jezebel.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: and the corpse of Jezebel shall be as dung on the face of the field in the territory of Jezreel, so that no one can say, This is Jezebel.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: and the corpse of Jezebel shall be as refuse on the surface of the field, in the plot at Jezreel, so that they shall not say, "Here lies Jezebel." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Her remains will be scattered like dung on the plot of land in Jezreel, so that no one will be able to recognize her.’"
verses.textEnNasb: and the corpse of Jezebel will be like dung on the face of the field in the property of Jezreel, so they cannot say, "This is Jezebel." ’ "
verses.textEn: Jezebel’s body will be like dung on the ground in the plot at Jezreel, so that no one will be able to say, ‘This is Jezebel.’ "

verses.textZh: 亚哈有七十个儿子在撒玛利亚。耶户写了一批信，送到撒玛利亚，对耶斯列的首领、长老和亚哈众子的导师说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈有七十个儿子在撒玛利亚。耶户写了一批信，送到撒玛利亚，对耶斯列的首领、长老和亚哈众子的导师说：
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈有七十个儿子在撒马利亚。耶户写信送到撒马利亚，通知耶斯列的首领，就是长老和教养亚哈众子的人，说：
verses.textEnNiv: Now there were in Samaria seventy sons of the house of Ahab. So Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria: to the officials of Jezreel, to the elders and to the guardians of Ahab’s children. He said,
verses.textEnEsv: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. So Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria, to the rulers of the city, to the elders, and to the guardians of the sons of Ahab, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote and sent letters to Samaria, to the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to those who reared Ahab’s sons, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Ahab had seventy sons living in the city of Samaria. So Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria, to the elders and officials of the city, and to the guardians of King Ahab’s sons. He said,
verses.textEnNasb: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria, to the officials of Jezreel, the elders, and to the guardians of the children of Ahab, saying,
verses.textEn: Now there were in Samaria seventy sons of the house of Ahab. So Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria: to the officials of Jezreel, to the elders and to the guardians of Ahab’s children. He said,

verses.textZh: "你们主人的儿子都在你们那里，你们也有战车、马匹、设防城和武器，那么这封信到达你们那里的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们主人的儿子都在你们那里，你们也有战车、马匹、设防城和武器，那么这封信到达你们那里的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们那里既有你们主人的众子和车马、器械、坚固城，
verses.textEnNiv: "You have your master’s sons with you and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city and weapons. Now as soon as this letter reaches you,
verses.textEnEsv: "Now then, as soon as this letter comes to you, seeing your master’s sons are with you, and there are with you chariots and horses, fortified cities also, and weapons,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as soon as this letter comes to you, since your master’s sons are with you, and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city also, and weapons,
verses.textEnNlt: "The king’s sons are with you, and you have at your disposal chariots, horses, a fortified city, and weapons. As soon as you receive this letter,
verses.textEnNasb: "And now, when this letter comes to you, since your master’s sons are with you, as well as the chariots and horses, and a fortified city and the weapons,
verses.textEn: "You have your master’s sons with you and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city and weapons. Now as soon as this letter reaches you,

verses.textZh: 你们就要看看在你们主人的儿子中，哪一个是最好最合适的，把他立在父亲的宝座上；你们又要为你们主人的家作战。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们就要看看在你们主人的儿子中，哪一个是最好最合适的，把他立在父亲的宝座上；你们又要为你们主人的家作战。"
verses.textZhCuv: 接了这信，就可以在你们主人的众子中选择一个贤能合宜的，使他坐他父亲的位，你们也可以为你们主人的家争战。」
verses.textEnNiv: choose the best and most worthy of your master’s sons and set him on his father’s throne. Then fight for your master’s house."
verses.textEnEsv: select the best and fittest of your master’s sons and set him on his father’s throne and fight for your master’s house."
verses.textEnNkjv: choose the best qualified of your master’s sons, set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: select the best qualified of your master’s sons to be your king, and prepare to fight for Ahab’s dynasty."
verses.textEnNasb: select the best and most capable of your master’s sons and seat him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house."
verses.textEn: choose the best and most worthy of your master’s sons and set him on his father’s throne. Then fight for your master’s house."

verses.textZh: 他们就十分害怕，说："看哪，两个王尚且不能在他面前站立得住，我们又怎能站得住呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就十分害怕，说："看哪，两个王尚且不能在他面前站立得住，我们又怎能站得住呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却甚惧怕，彼此说：「二王在他面前尚且站立不住，我们怎能站得住呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But they were terrified and said, "If two kings could not resist him, how can we?"
verses.textEnEsv: But they were exceedingly afraid and said, "Behold, the two kings could not stand before him. How then can we stand?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, "Look, two kings could not stand up to him; how then can we stand?"
verses.textEnNlt: But they were paralyzed with fear and said, "We’ve seen that two kings couldn’t stand against this man! What can we do?"
verses.textEnNasb: But they feared greatly and said, "Behold, the two kings did not stand firm before him; how then can we stand?"
verses.textEn: But they were terrified and said, "If two kings could not resist him, how can we?"

verses.textZh: 于是内务长、市长、长老和亚哈众子的导师送信给耶户说："我们是你的仆人，你吩咐我们的，我们都必照办；我们也不会立甚么人作王；你看怎样好，我们就怎样作。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是内务长、市长、长老和亚哈众子的导师送信给耶户说："我们是你的仆人，你吩咐我们的，我们都必照办；我们也不会立甚么人作王；你看怎样好，我们就怎样作。"
verses.textZhCuv: 家宰、邑宰，和长老，并教养众子的人，打发人去见耶户，说：「我们是你的仆人，凡你所吩咐我们的都必遵行，我们不立谁作王，你看怎样好就怎样行。」
verses.textEnNiv: So the palace administrator, the city governor, the elders and the guardians sent this message to Jehu: "We are your servants and we will do anything you say. We will not appoint anyone as king; you do whatever you think best."
verses.textEnEsv: So he who was over the palace, and he who was over the city, together with the elders and the guardians, sent to Jehu, saying, "We are your servants, and we will do all that you tell us. We will not make anyone king. Do whatever is good in your eyes."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he who was in charge of the house, and he who was in charge of the city, the elders also, and those who reared thesons, sent to Jehu, saying, "We are your servants, we will do all you tell us; but we will not make anyone king. Do whatis good in your sight."
verses.textEnNlt: So the palace and city administrators, together with the elders and the guardians of the king’s sons, sent this message to Jehu: "We are your servants and will do anything you tell us. We will not make anyone king; do whatever you think is best."
verses.textEnNasb: And the one who was in charge of the household, and the one who was in charge of the city, and the elders, and the guardians of the children, sent word to Jehu, saying, "We are your servants, and everything that you tell us we will do. We will not appoint any man king; do what is good in your sight."
verses.textEn: So the palace administrator, the city governor, the elders and the guardians sent this message to Jehu: "We are your servants and we will do anything you say. We will not appoint anyone as king; you do whatever you think best."

verses.textZh: 于是耶户写第二封信给他们说："如果你们是归从我，听我的话的，就要把你们主人的儿子们的头颅取下，明天大约这个时候，带来耶斯列给我。"那时，王的七十个儿子是住在抚养他们的城中的大臣那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶户写第二封信给他们说："如果你们是归从我，听我的话的，就要把你们主人的儿子们的头颅取下，明天大约这个时候，带来耶斯列给我。"那时，王的七十个儿子是住在抚养他们的城中的大臣那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户又给他们写信说：「你们若归顺我，听从我的话，明日这时候，要将你们主人众子的首级带到耶斯列来见我。」那时王的儿子七十人都住在教养他们那城中的尊贵人家里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jehu wrote them a second letter, saying, "If you are on my side and will obey me, take the heads of your master’s sons and come to me in Jezreel by this time tomorrow." Now the royal princes, seventy of them, were with the leading men of the city, who were rearing them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he wrote to them a second letter, saying, "If you are on my side, and if you are ready to obey me, take the heads of your master’s sons and come to me at Jezreel tomorrow at this time." Now the king’s sons, seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, who were bringing them up.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he wrote a second letter to them, saying: If you are for me and will obey my voice, take the heads of the men, your master’s sons, and come to me at Jezreel by this time tomorrow. Now the king’s sons, seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, who were rearing them.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehu responded with a second letter: "If you are on my side and are going to obey me, bring the heads of your master’s sons to me at Jezreel by this time tomorrow." Now the seventy sons of the king were being cared for by the leaders of Samaria, where they had been raised since childhood.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he wrote them a letter a second time, saying, "If you are on my side, and will listen to my voice, take the heads of the men, your master’s sons, and come to me at Jezreel about this time tomorrow." Now the king’s sons, seventy men, were with the great people of the city, who were raising them.
verses.textEn: Then Jehu wrote them a second letter, saying, "If you are on my side and will obey me, take the heads of your master’s sons and come to me in Jezreel by this time tomorrow." Now the royal princes, seventy of them, were with the leading men of the city, who were rearing them.

verses.textZh: 这信到达他们那里的时候，他们就拿住王的众子，把这七十人杀了，然后把他们的头放在篮子里，送到耶斯列耶户那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这信到达他们那里的时候，他们就拿住王的众子，把这七十人杀了，然后把他们的头放在篮子里，送到耶斯列耶户那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 信一到，他们就把王的七十个儿子杀了，将首级装在筐里，送到在耶斯列的耶户那里。
verses.textEnNiv: When the letter arrived, these men took the princes and slaughtered all seventy of them. They put their heads in baskets and sent them to Jehu in Jezreel.
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as the letter came to them, they took the king’s sons and slaughtered them, seventy persons, and put their heads in baskets and sent them to him at Jezreel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when the letter came to them, that they took the king’s sons and slaughtered seventy persons, put their heads in baskets and sent them to him at Jezreel.
verses.textEnNlt: When the letter arrived, the leaders killed all seventy of the king’s sons. They placed their heads in baskets and presented them to Jehu at Jezreel.
verses.textEnNasb: When the letter came to them, they took the king’s sons and slaughtered them, seventy men, and put their heads in baskets, and sent them to him at Jezreel.
verses.textEn: When the letter arrived, these men took the princes and slaughtered all seventy of them. They put their heads in baskets and sent them to Jehu in Jezreel.

verses.textZh: 有使者来告诉耶户说："王的众子的头送到了。"他说："把它们分作两堆放在城门口，直到早上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有使者来告诉耶户说："王的众子的头送到了。"他说："把它们分作两堆放在城门口，直到早上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有使者来告诉耶户说：「他们将王众子的首级送来了。」耶户说：「将首级在城门口堆作两堆，搁到明日。」
verses.textEnNiv: When the messenger arrived, he told Jehu, "They have brought the heads of the princes." Then Jehu ordered, "Put them in two piles at the entrance of the city gate until morning."
verses.textEnEsv: When the messenger came and told him, "They have brought the heads of the king’s sons," he said, "Lay them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until the morning."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then a messenger came and told him, saying, "They have brought the heads of the king’s sons." And he said, "Lay them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until morning."
verses.textEnNlt: A messenger went to Jehu and said, "They have brought the heads of the king’s sons." So Jehu ordered, "Pile them in two heaps at the entrance of the city gate, and leave them there until morning."
verses.textEnNasb: When the messenger came and informed him, saying, "They have brought the heads of the king’s sons," he said, "Put them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until morning."
verses.textEn: When the messenger arrived, he told Jehu, "They have brought the heads of the princes." Then Jehu ordered, "Put them in two piles at the entrance of the city gate until morning."

verses.textZh: 第二天早上的时候，耶户出来，站着对众民说："你们都是无罪的，看哪，是我自己背叛了我的主人，把他杀了，但这所有的人又是谁击杀的呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天早上的时候，耶户出来，站着对众民说："你们都是无罪的，看哪，是我自己背叛了我的主人，把他杀了，但这所有的人又是谁击杀的呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 次日早晨，耶户出来，站着对众民说：「你们都是公义的，我背叛我主人，将他杀了；这些人却是谁杀的呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The next morning Jehu went out. He stood before all the people and said, "You are innocent. It was I who conspired against my master and killed him, but who killed all these?
verses.textEnEsv: Then in the morning, when he went out, he stood and said to all the people, "You are innocent. It was I who conspired against my master and killed him, but who struck down all these?
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, in the morning, that he went out and stood, and said to all the people, "You are righteous. Indeed I conspired against my master and killed him; but who killed all these?
verses.textEnNlt: In the morning he went out and spoke to the crowd that had gathered around them. "You are not to blame," he told them. "I am the one who conspired against my master and killed him. But who killed all these?
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the morning he went out and stood and said to all the people, "You are innocent; behold, I conspired against my master and killed him, but who killed all these?
verses.textEn: The next morning Jehu went out. He stood before all the people and said, "You are innocent. It was I who conspired against my master and killed him, but who killed all these?

verses.textZh: 你们要知道耶和华的话，就是耶和华所说攻击亚哈家的话，一句也没有落空；耶和华借着他的仆人以利亚所说的话，他都作成了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要知道耶和华的话，就是耶和华所说攻击亚哈家的话，一句也没有落空；耶和华借着他的仆人以利亚所说的话，他都作成了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 由此可知，耶和华指着亚哈家所说的话一句没有落空，因为耶和华藉他仆人以利亚所说的话都成就了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Know, then, that not a word the Lord has spoken against the house of Ahab will fail. The Lord has done what he announced through his servant Elijah."
verses.textEnEsv: Know then that there shall fall to the earth nothing of the word of the Lord , which the Lord spoke concerning the house of Ahab, for the Lord has done what he said by his servant Elijah."
verses.textEnNkjv: Know now that nothing shall fall to the earth of the word of the Lord which the Lord spoke concerning the house of Ahab; for the Lord has done what He spoke by His servant Elijah."
verses.textEnNlt: You can be sure that the message of the Lord that was spoken concerning Ahab’s family will not fail. The Lord declared through his servant Elijah that this would happen."
verses.textEnNasb: Know then that nothing of the word of the Lord, which the Lord spoke concerning the house of Ahab, shall fall to the earth, for the Lord has done what He spoke through His servant Elijah."
verses.textEn: Know, then, that not a word the Lord has spoken against the house of Ahab will fail. The Lord has done what he announced through his servant Elijah."

verses.textZh: 于是耶户击杀了亚哈家在耶斯列剩下的人，还有他所有的大臣、有关的人、祭司，没有一个给他存留。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶户击杀了亚哈家在耶斯列剩下的人，还有他所有的大臣、有关的人、祭司，没有一个给他存留。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡亚哈家在耶斯列所剩下的人和他的大臣、密友、祭司，耶户尽都杀了，没有留下一个。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jehu killed everyone in Jezreel who remained of the house of Ahab, as well as all his chief men, his close friends and his priests, leaving him no survivor.
verses.textEnEsv: So Jehu struck down all who remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, all his great men and his close friends and his priests, until he left him none remaining.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jehu killed all who remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men and his close acquaintances and his priests, until he left him none remaining.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehu killed all who were left of Ahab’s relatives living in Jezreel and all his important officials, his personal friends, and his priests. So Ahab was left without a single survivor.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jehu killed all who remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men, his acquaintances, and his priests, until he left him without a survivor.
verses.textEn: So Jehu killed everyone in Jezreel who remained of the house of Ahab, as well as all his chief men, his close friends and his priests, leaving him no survivor.

verses.textZh: 耶户动身，往撒玛利亚去。在路上，他经过牧羊人的伯艾吉那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶户动身，往撒玛利亚去。在路上，他经过牧羊人的伯艾吉那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户起身往撒马利亚去。在路上、牧人剪羊毛之处，
verses.textEnNiv: Jehu then set out and went toward Samaria. At Beth Eked of the Shepherds,
verses.textEnEsv: Then he set out and went to Samaria. On the way, when he was at Beth-eked of the Shepherds,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he arose and departed and went to Samaria. On the way, at Beth Eked of the Shepherds,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehu set out for Samaria. Along the way, while he was at Beth-eked of the Shepherds,
verses.textEnNasb: Then he set out and went to Samaria. On the way while he was at Beth-eked of the shepherds,
verses.textEn: Jehu then set out and went toward Samaria. At Beth Eked of the Shepherds,

verses.textZh: 他遇见了犹大王亚哈谢的兄弟们。他说："你们是谁？"他们说："我们是亚哈谢的兄弟。我们下来要向王的众子和太后的众子请安。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他遇见了犹大王亚哈谢的兄弟们。他说："你们是谁？"他们说："我们是亚哈谢的兄弟。我们下来要向王的众子和太后的众子请安。"
verses.textZhCuv: 遇见犹大王亚哈谢的弟兄，问他们说：「你们是谁？」回答说：「我们是亚哈谢的弟兄，现在下去要问王和太后的众子安。」
verses.textEnNiv: he met some relatives of Ahaziah king of Judah and asked, "Who are you?" They said, "We are relatives of Ahaziah, and we have come down to greet the families of the king and of the queen mother."
verses.textEnEsv: Jehu met the relatives of Ahaziah king of Judah, and he said, "Who are you?" And they answered, "We are the relatives of Ahaziah, and we came down to visit the royal princes and the sons of the queen mother."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jehu met with the brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, "Who are you?" So they answered, "We are the brothers of Ahaziah; we have come down to greet the sons of the king and the sons of the queen mother."
verses.textEnNlt: he met some relatives of King Ahaziah of Judah. "Who are you?" he asked them. And they replied, "We are relatives of King Ahaziah. We are going to visit the sons of King Ahab and the sons of the queen mother."
verses.textEnNasb: Jehu encountered the relatives of Ahaziah king of Judah, and he said, "Who are you?" And they answered, "We are the relatives of Ahaziah; and we have come down to greet the sons of the king and the sons of the queen mother."
verses.textEn: he met some relatives of Ahaziah king of Judah and asked, "Who are you?" They said, "We are relatives of Ahaziah, and we have come down to greet the families of the king and of the queen mother."

verses.textZh: 他说："活捉他们！"他的手下就活捉了他们，在伯艾吉的坑边杀了他们；一共是四十二个人，没有留下一人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："活捉他们！"他的手下就活捉了他们，在伯艾吉的坑边杀了他们；一共是四十二个人，没有留下一人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户吩咐说：「活捉他们！」跟从的人就活捉了他们，将他们杀在剪羊毛之处的坑边，共四十二人，没有留下一个。
verses.textEnNiv: "Take them alive!" he ordered. So they took them alive and slaughtered them by the well of Beth Eked—forty-two of them. He left no survivor.
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "Take them alive." And they took them alive and slaughtered them at the pit of Beth-eked, forty-two persons, and he spared none of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "Take them alive!" So they took them alive, and killed them at the well of Beth Eked, forty-two men; and he left none of them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Take them alive!" Jehu shouted to his men. And they captured all forty-two of them and killed them at the well of Beth-eked. None of them escaped.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "Take them alive." So they took them alive, and slaughtered them at the pit of Beth-eked, forty-two men; and he left none of them.
verses.textEn: "Take them alive!" he ordered. So they took them alive and slaughtered them by the well of Beth Eked—forty-two of them. He left no survivor.

verses.textZh: 他又从那里往前行，看见利甲的儿子约拿达来迎接他。耶户向他请安，然后说："你的心对我忠诚，就像我的心对你的心一样吗？"约拿达说："是的。"耶户说："如果是的话，伸出你的手来。"他伸出他的手，耶户就把他拉上他的战车。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又从那里往前行，看见利甲的儿子约拿达来迎接他。耶户向他请安，然后说："你的心对我忠诚，就像我的心对你的心一样吗？"约拿达说："是的。"耶户说："如果是的话，伸出你的手来。"他伸出他的手，耶户就把他拉上他的战车。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户从那里前行，恰遇利甲的儿子约拿达来迎接他，耶户问他安，对他说：「你诚心待我像我诚心待你吗？」约拿达回答说：「是。」耶户说：「若是这样，你向我伸手」，他就伸手；耶户拉他上车。
verses.textEnNiv: After he left there, he came upon Jehonadab son of Rekab, who was on his way to meet him. Jehu greeted him and said, "Are you in accord with me, as I am with you?" "I am," Jehonadab answered. "If so," said Jehu, "give me your hand." So he did, and Jehu helped him up into the chariot.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he departed from there, he met Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him. And he greeted him and said to him, "Is your heart true to my heart as mine is to yours?" And Jehonadab answered, "It is." Jehu said, "If it is, give me your hand." So he gave him his hand. And Jehu took him up with him into the chariot.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when he departed from there, he met Jehonadab the son of Rechab, coming to meet him; and he greeted him and said to him, "Is your heart right, as my heart is toward your heart?" And Jehonadab answered, "It is." Jehusaid, "If it is, give me your hand." So he gave him his hand, and he took him up to him into the chariot.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jehu left there, he met Jehonadab son of Recab, who was coming to meet him. After they had greeted each other, Jehu said to him, "Are you as loyal to me as I am to you?" "Yes, I am," Jehonadab replied. "If you are," Jehu said, "then give me your hand." So Jehonadab put out his hand, and Jehu helped him into the chariot.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when he had gone from there, he encountered Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him; and he greeted him and said to him, "Is your heart right, just as my heart is with your heart?" And Jehonadab answered, "It is." Jehu said, "If it is, give me your hand." And he gave him his hand, and he pulled him up to him into the chariot.
verses.textEn: After he left there, he came upon Jehonadab son of Rekab, who was on his way to meet him. Jehu greeted him and said, "Are you in accord with me, as I am with you?" "I am," Jehonadab answered. "If so," said Jehu, "give me your hand." So he did, and Jehu helped him up into the chariot.

verses.textZh: 耶户说："你和我一起去，看看我对耶和华的热诚。"于是用自己的战车载他同去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶户说："你和我一起去，看看我对耶和华的热诚。"于是用自己的战车载他同去。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户说：「你和我同去，看我为耶和华怎样热心」；于是请他坐在车上，
verses.textEnNiv: Jehu said, "Come with me and see my zeal for the Lord ." Then he had him ride along in his chariot.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Come with me, and see my zeal for the Lord ." So he had him ride in his chariot.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "Come with me, and see my zeal for the Lord." So they had him ride in his chariot.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehu said, "Now come with me, and see how devoted I am to the Lord ." So Jehonadab rode along with him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "Come with me and see my zeal for the Lord." So he had him ride in his chariot.
verses.textEn: Jehu said, "Come with me and see my zeal for the Lord ." Then he had him ride along in his chariot.

verses.textZh: 他来到撒玛利亚，就击杀亚哈家所有在撒玛利亚剩下的人，把他们完全消灭，正如耶和华对以利亚所说的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他来到撒玛利亚，就击杀亚哈家所有在撒玛利亚剩下的人，把他们完全消灭，正如耶和华对以利亚所说的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了撒马利亚，就把撒马利亚的亚哈家剩下的人都杀了，直到灭尽，正如耶和华对以利亚所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jehu came to Samaria, he killed all who were left there of Ahab’s family; he destroyed them, according to the word of the Lord spoken to Elijah.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he came to Samaria, he struck down all who remained to Ahab in Samaria, till he had wiped them out, according to the word of the Lord that he spoke to Elijah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he came to Samaria, he killed all who remained to Ahab in Samaria, till he had destroyed them, according to the word of the Lord which He spoke to Elijah.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jehu arrived in Samaria, he killed everyone who was left there from Ahab’s family, just as the Lord had promised through Elijah.
verses.textEnNasb: When he came to Samaria, he killed all who remained to Ahab in Samaria, until he had eliminated them, in accordance with the word of the Lord which He spoke to Elijah.
verses.textEn: When Jehu came to Samaria, he killed all who were left there of Ahab’s family; he destroyed them, according to the word of the Lord spoken to Elijah.

verses.textZh: 耶户集合众民，对他们说："从前亚哈信奉巴力还算是少，耶户要信奉更多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶户集合众民，对他们说："从前亚哈信奉巴力还算是少，耶户要信奉更多。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户招聚众民，对他们说：「亚哈事奉巴力还冷淡，耶户却更热心。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jehu brought all the people together and said to them, "Ahab served Baal a little; Jehu will serve him much.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jehu assembled all the people and said to them, "Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him much.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jehu gathered all the people together, and said to them, "Ahab served Baal a little, Jehu will serve him much.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehu called a meeting of all the people of the city and said to them, "Ahab’s worship of Baal was nothing compared to the way I will worship him!
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jehu gathered all the people and said to them, "Ahab served Baal a little; Jehu will serve him much.
verses.textEn: Then Jehu brought all the people together and said to them, "Ahab served Baal a little; Jehu will serve him much.

verses.textZh: 现在，所有的巴力先知、所有信奉他的和他所有的祭司都要给我召来，不要走漏一人；因为我要向巴力献一个极大的祭，缺席的必不得活。"耶户用诡计这样行，是要除灭所有信奉巴力的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，所有的巴力先知、所有信奉他的和他所有的祭司都要给我召来，不要走漏一人；因为我要向巴力献一个极大的祭，缺席的必不得活。"耶户用诡计这样行，是要除灭所有信奉巴力的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我要给巴力献大祭。应当叫巴力的众先知和一切拜巴力的人，并巴力的众祭司，都到我这里来，不可缺少一个；凡不来的必不得活。」耶户这样行，是用诡计要杀尽拜巴力的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Now summon all the prophets of Baal, all his servants and all his priests. See that no one is missing, because I am going to hold a great sacrifice for Baal. Anyone who fails to come will no longer live." But Jehu was acting deceptively in order to destroy the servants of Baal.
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore call to me all the prophets of Baal, all his worshipers and all his priests. Let none be missing, for I have a great sacrifice to offer to Baal. Whoever is missing shall not live." But Jehu did it with cunning in order to destroy the worshipers of Baal.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, call to me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests. Let no one be missing, for I have a great sacrifice for Baal. Whoever is missing shall not live." But Jehu acted deceptively, with the intent of destroying the worshipers of Baal.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, summon all the prophets and worshipers of Baal, and call together all his priests. See to it that every one of them comes, for I am going to offer a great sacrifice to Baal. Anyone who fails to come will be put to death." But Jehu’s cunning plan was to destroy all the worshipers of Baal.
verses.textEnNasb: Now, summon to me all the prophets of Baal, all his worshipers and all his priests; let no one go missing, because I have a great sacrifice for Baal; whoever is missing shall not live." But Jehu did it in deception, in order to eliminate the worshipers of Baal.
verses.textEn: Now summon all the prophets of Baal, all his servants and all his priests. See that no one is missing, because I am going to hold a great sacrifice for Baal. Anyone who fails to come will no longer live." But Jehu was acting deceptively in order to destroy the servants of Baal.

verses.textZh: 耶户又说："要为巴力召开一个严肃会。"于是众人宣告召开大会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶户又说："要为巴力召开一个严肃会。"于是众人宣告召开大会。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户说：「要为巴力宣告严肃会！」于是宣告了。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehu said, "Call an assembly in honor of Baal." So they proclaimed it.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jehu ordered, "Sanctify a solemn assembly for Baal." So they proclaimed it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jehu said, "Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal." So they proclaimed it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehu ordered, "Prepare a solemn assembly to worship Baal!" So they did.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jehu said, "Proclaim a holy assembly for Baal." And they proclaimed it.
verses.textEn: Jehu said, "Call an assembly in honor of Baal." So they proclaimed it.

verses.textZh: 耶户派人走遍以色列各地，所有信奉巴力的人都来了，没有一个不来的。他们都进了巴力庙，以致巴力庙从这边到那边都塞满了人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶户派人走遍以色列各地，所有信奉巴力的人都来了，没有一个不来的。他们都进了巴力庙，以致巴力庙从这边到那边都塞满了人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户差人走遍以色列地；凡拜巴力的人都来齐了，没有一个不来的。他们进了巴力庙，巴力庙中从前边直到后边都满了人。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he sent word throughout Israel, and all the servants of Baal came; not one stayed away. They crowded into the temple of Baal until it was full from one end to the other.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jehu sent throughout all Israel, and all the worshipers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left who did not come. And they entered the house of Baal, and the house of Baal was filled from one end to the other.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jehu sent throughout all Israel; and all the worshipers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left who did not come. So they came into the temple of Baal, and the temple of Baal was full from one end to the other.
verses.textEnNlt: He sent messengers throughout all Israel summoning those who worshiped Baal. They all came—not a single one remained behind—and they filled the temple of Baal from one end to the other.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jehu sent word throughout Israel, and all the worshipers of Baal came, so that there was not a person left who did not come. And when they entered the house of Baal, the house of Baal was filled from one end to the other.
verses.textEn: Then he sent word throughout Israel, and all the servants of Baal came; not one stayed away. They crowded into the temple of Baal until it was full from one end to the other.

verses.textZh: 耶户对掌管衣橱的说："把礼服拿出来，给所有拜巴力的人穿。"他就把礼服拿出来给他们穿上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶户对掌管衣橱的说："把礼服拿出来，给所有拜巴力的人穿。"他就把礼服拿出来给他们穿上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户吩咐掌管礼服的人说：「拿出礼服来，给一切拜巴力的人穿。」他就拿出礼服来给了他们。
verses.textEnNiv: And Jehu said to the keeper of the wardrobe, "Bring robes for all the servants of Baal." So he brought out robes for them.
verses.textEnEsv: He said to him who was in charge of the wardrobe, "Bring out the vestments for all the worshipers of Baal." So he brought out the vestments for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to the one in charge of the wardrobe, "Bring out vestments for all the worshipers of Baal." So he brought out vestments for them.
verses.textEnNlt: And Jehu instructed the keeper of the wardrobe, "Be sure that every worshiper of Baal wears one of these robes." So robes were given to them.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to the one who was in charge of the wardrobe, "Bring out garments for all the worshipers of Baal." So he brought out the garments for them.
verses.textEn: And Jehu said to the keeper of the wardrobe, "Bring robes for all the servants of Baal." So he brought out robes for them.

verses.textZh: 耶户和利甲的儿子约拿达来到巴力的庙中。他对信奉巴力的人说："搜查看看，这里不要有信奉耶和华的人和你们同在一起，只可以有信奉巴力的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶户和利甲的儿子约拿达来到巴力的庙中。他对信奉巴力的人说："搜查看看，这里不要有信奉耶和华的人和你们同在一起，只可以有信奉巴力的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户和利甲的儿子约拿达进了巴力庙，对拜巴力的人说：「你们察看察看，在你们这里不可有耶和华的仆人，只可容留拜巴力的人。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jehu and Jehonadab son of Rekab went into the temple of Baal. Jehu said to the servants of Baal, "Look around and see that no one who serves the Lord is here with you—only servants of Baal."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jehu went into the house of Baal with Jehonadab the son of Rechab, and he said to the worshipers of Baal, "Search, and see that there is no servant of the Lord here among you, but only the worshipers of Baal."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jehu and Jehonadab the son of Rechab went into the temple of Baal, and said to the worshipers of Baal, "Search and see that no servants of the Lord are here with you, but only the worshipers of Baal."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehu went into the temple of Baal with Jehonadab son of Recab. Jehu said to the worshipers of Baal, "Make sure no one who worships the Lord is here—only those who worship Baal."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jehu entered the house of Baal with Jehonadab the son of Rechab; and he said to the worshipers of Baal, "Search carefully and see to it that there is here with you none of the servants of the Lord, but only the worshipers of Baal."
verses.textEn: Then Jehu and Jehonadab son of Rekab went into the temple of Baal. Jehu said to the servants of Baal, "Look around and see that no one who serves the Lord is here with you—only servants of Baal."

verses.textZh: 他们进去献祭和献燔祭。耶户布置了八十个人在外面，说："如果我带来交在你们手中的人，有一个从他们中间逃脱了，你们就要以命抵命。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们进去献祭和献燔祭。耶户布置了八十个人在外面，说："如果我带来交在你们手中的人，有一个从他们中间逃脱了，你们就要以命抵命。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户和约拿达进去，献平安祭和燔祭。 耶户先安派八十人在庙外，吩咐说：「我将这些人交在你们手中，若有一人脱逃，谁放的必叫他偿命！」
verses.textEnNiv: So they went in to make sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had posted eighty men outside with this warning: "If one of you lets any of the men I am placing in your hands escape, it will be your life for his life."
verses.textEnEsv: Then they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had stationed eighty men outside and said, "The man who allows any of those whom I give into your hands to escape shall forfeit his life."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had appointed for himself eighty men on the outside, and had said, "If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escapes, whoeverletshimescape, it shall be his life for the life of the other."
verses.textEnNlt: So they were all inside the temple to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had stationed eighty of his men outside the building and had warned them, "If you let anyone escape, you will pay for it with your own life."
verses.textEnNasb: Then they entered to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had stationed for himself eighty men outside, and he had said, "The one who allows any of the men whom I bring into your hands to escape shall give up his life in exchange."
verses.textEn: So they went in to make sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had posted eighty men outside with this warning: "If one of you lets any of the men I am placing in your hands escape, it will be your life for his life."

verses.textZh: 耶户献完了燔祭，就对卫兵和军长说："你们进去，杀死他们，一个也不让他们出来。"卫兵和军长于是用刀击杀他们，又把他们的尸体拋出去，然后往巴力庙的内室去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶户献完了燔祭，就对卫兵和军长说："你们进去，杀死他们，一个也不让他们出来。"卫兵和军长于是用刀击杀他们，又把他们的尸体拋出去，然后往巴力庙的内室去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户献完了燔祭，就出来吩咐护卫兵和众军长说：「你们进去杀他们，不容一人出来！」护卫兵和军长就用刀杀他们，将尸首抛出去，便到巴力庙的城去了，
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as Jehu had finished making the burnt offering, he ordered the guards and officers: "Go in and kill them; let no one escape." So they cut them down with the sword. The guards and officers threw the bodies out and then entered the inner shrine of the temple of Baal.
verses.textEnEsv: So as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, Jehu said to the guard and to the officers, "Go in and strike them down; let not a man escape." So when they put them to the sword, the guard and the officers cast them out and went into the inner room of the house of Baal,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, "Go in and kill them; let no one come out!" And they killed them with the edge of the sword; then the guards and the officers threw them out, and went into the inner room of the temple of Baal.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as Jehu had finished sacrificing the burnt offering, he commanded his guards and officers, "Go in and kill all of them. Don’t let a single one escape!" So they killed them all with their swords, and the guards and officers dragged their bodies outside. Then Jehu’s men went into the innermost fortress of the temple of Baal.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it came about, as soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the royal officers, "Go in, kill them; let none come out." So they killed them with the edge of the sword; and the guard and the royal officers threw them out, and went to the sanctuary of the house of Baal.
verses.textEn: As soon as Jehu had finished making the burnt offering, he ordered the guards and officers: "Go in and kill them; let no one escape." So they cut them down with the sword. The guards and officers threw the bodies out and then entered the inner shrine of the temple of Baal.

verses.textZh: 他们又把巴力庙内的神柱搬出去烧了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又把巴力庙内的神柱搬出去烧了。
verses.textZhCuv: 将巴力庙中的柱像都拿出来烧了；
verses.textEnNiv: They brought the sacred stone out of the temple of Baal and burned it.
verses.textEnEsv: and they brought out the pillar that was in the house of Baal and burned it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they brought the sacred pillars out of the temple of Baal and burned them.
verses.textEnNlt: They dragged out the sacred pillar used in the worship of Baal and burned it.
verses.textEnNasb: They brought out the memorial stones of the house of Baal and burned them.
verses.textEn: They brought the sacred stone out of the temple of Baal and burned it.

verses.textZh: 他们毁坏了巴力的神柱，又拆毁了巴力庙，作为厕所，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们毁坏了巴力的神柱，又拆毁了巴力庙，作为厕所，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 毁坏了巴力柱像，拆毁了巴力庙作为厕所，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: They demolished the sacred stone of Baal and tore down the temple of Baal, and people have used it for a latrine to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: And they demolished the pillar of Baal, and demolished the house of Baal, and made it a latrine to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they broke down the sacred pillar of Baal, and tore down the temple of Baal and made it a refuse dump to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: They smashed the sacred pillar and wrecked the temple of Baal, converting it into a public toilet, as it remains to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: They also tore down the memorial stone of Baal and tore down the house of Baal, and made it a latrine as it is to this day.
verses.textEn: They demolished the sacred stone of Baal and tore down the temple of Baal, and people have used it for a latrine to this day.

verses.textZh: 这样，耶户从以色列中消灭了巴力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，耶户从以色列中消灭了巴力。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，耶户在以色列中灭了巴力。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jehu destroyed Baal worship in Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus Jehu wiped out Baal from Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal from Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: In this way, Jehu destroyed every trace of Baal worship from Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jehu eradicated Baal from Israel.
verses.textEn: So Jehu destroyed Baal worship in Israel.

verses.textZh: 只是耶户没有离弃尼八的儿子耶罗波安的罪，就是他使以色列人陷于罪中的那些罪，敬拜在伯特利和但的金牛犊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是耶户没有离弃尼八的儿子耶罗波安的罪，就是他使以色列人陷于罪中的那些罪，敬拜在伯特利和但的金牛犊。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是耶户不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，就是拜伯特利和但的金牛犊。
verses.textEnNiv: However, he did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit—the worship of the golden calves at Bethel and Dan.
verses.textEnEsv: But Jehu did not turn aside from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which he made Israel to sin—that is, the golden calves that were in Bethel and in Dan.
verses.textEnNkjv: However Jehu did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who had made Israel sin, thatis, from the golden calves that were at Bethel and Dan.
verses.textEnNlt: He did not, however, destroy the gold calves at Bethel and Dan, with which Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to sin.
verses.textEnNasb: However, as for the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, into which he misled Israel, from these Jehu did not desist, including the golden calves that were at Bethel and at Dan.
verses.textEn: However, he did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit—the worship of the golden calves at Bethel and Dan.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对耶户说："因为你办好了我看为正的事，照我的一切心意对付亚哈家，你的子孙要坐在以色列的王位上，直到第四代。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对耶户说："因为你办好了我看为正的事，照我的一切心意对付亚哈家，你的子孙要坐在以色列的王位上，直到第四代。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对耶户说：「因你办好我眼中看为正的事，照我的心意待亚哈家，你的子孙必接续你坐以色列的国位，直到四代。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Jehu, "Because you have done well in accomplishing what is right in my eyes and have done to the house of Ahab all I had in mind to do, your descendants will sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Jehu, "Because you have done well in carrying out what is right in my eyes, and have done to the house of Ahab according to all that was in my heart, your sons of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Jehu, "Because you have done well in doing whatis right in My sight, and have done to the house of Ahab all that was in My heart, your sons shall sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation."
verses.textEnNlt: Nonetheless the Lord said to Jehu, "You have done well in following my instructions to destroy the family of Ahab. Therefore, your descendants will be kings of Israel down to the fourth generation."
verses.textEnNasb: Yet the Lord said to Jehu, "Because you have done well in performing what is right in My eyes, and have done to the house of Ahab in accordance with everything that was in My heart, your sons to the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel."
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Jehu, "Because you have done well in accomplishing what is right in my eyes and have done to the house of Ahab all I had in mind to do, your descendants will sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation."

verses.textZh: 可是耶户没有尽心遵行耶和华以色列神的律法，离弃耶罗波安使以色列人陷于罪中的那些罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是耶户没有尽心遵行耶和华以色列神的律法，离弃耶罗波安使以色列人陷于罪中的那些罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是耶户不尽心遵守耶和华－以色列神的律法，不离开耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet Jehu was not careful to keep the law of the Lord , the God of Israel, with all his heart. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam, which he had caused Israel to commit.
verses.textEnEsv: But Jehu was not careful to walk in the law of the Lord , the God of Israel, with all his heart. He did not turn from the sins of Jeroboam, which he made Israel to sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the Lord God of Israel with all his heart; for he did not depart from the sins of Jeroboam, who had made Israel sin.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jehu did not obey the Law of the Lord , the God of Israel, with all his heart. He refused to turn from the sins that Jeroboam had led Israel to commit.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jehu was not careful to walk in the Law of the Lord, the God of Israel, with all his heart; he did not desist from the sins of Jeroboam, into which he misled Israel.
verses.textEn: Yet Jehu was not careful to keep the law of the Lord , the God of Israel, with all his heart. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam, which he had caused Israel to commit.

verses.textZh: 在那些日子，耶和华开始削弱以色列，哈薛在以色列各处的边境攻击他们：
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那些日子，耶和华开始削弱以色列，哈薛在以色列各处的边境攻击他们：
verses.textZhCuv: 在那些日子，耶和华才割裂以色列国，使哈薛攻击以色列的境界，
verses.textEnNiv: In those days the Lord began to reduce the size of Israel. Hazael overpowered the Israelites throughout their territory
verses.textEnEsv: In those days the Lord began to cut off parts of Israel. Hazael defeated them throughout the territory of Israel:
verses.textEnNkjv: In those days the Lord began to cut off parts of Israel; and Hazael conquered them in all the territory of Israel
verses.textEnNlt: At about that time the Lord began to cut down the size of Israel’s territory. King Hazael conquered several sections of the country
verses.textEnNasb: In those days the Lord began to cut off pieces from Israel; and Hazael defeated them throughout the territory of Israel:
verses.textEn: In those days the Lord began to reduce the size of Israel. Hazael overpowered the Israelites throughout their territory

verses.textZh: 从约旦河以东，基列的全地，迦得人、流本人和玛拿西人之地，从靠近亚嫩河的亚罗珥起，至基列和巴珊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从约旦河以东，基列的全地，迦得人、流本人和玛拿西人之地，从靠近亚嫩河的亚罗珥起，至基列和巴珊。
verses.textZhCuv: 乃是约旦河东、基列全地，从靠近亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥起，就是基列和巴珊的迦得人、吕便人、玛拿西人之地。
verses.textEnNiv: east of the Jordan in all the land of Gilead (the region of Gad, Reuben and Manasseh), from Aroer by the Arnon Gorge through Gilead to Bashan.
verses.textEnEsv: from the Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the Valley of the Arnon, that is, Gilead and Bashan.
verses.textEnNkjv: from the Jordan eastward: all the land of Gilead—Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh—from Aroer, which is by the River Arnon, including Gilead and Bashan.
verses.textEnNlt: east of the Jordan River, including all of Gilead, Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh. He conquered the area from the town of Aroer by the Arnon Gorge to as far north as Gilead and Bashan.
verses.textEnNasb: from the Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, the Reubenites, and the Manassites; from Aroer, which is by the Valley of the Arnon, that is, Gilead and Bashan.
verses.textEn: east of the Jordan in all the land of Gilead (the region of Gad, Reuben and Manasseh), from Aroer by the Arnon Gorge through Gilead to Bashan.

verses.textZh: 耶户其余的事迹和他所行的一切，以及他的一切英雄事迹，不是都写在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶户其余的事迹和他所行的一切，以及他的一切英雄事迹，不是都写在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户其余的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力都写在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Jehu’s reign, all he did, and all his achievements, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu and all that he did, and all his might, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, all that he did, and all his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Jehu’s reign—everything he did and all his achievements—are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Jehu and everything that he did and all his might, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Jehu’s reign, all he did, and all his achievements, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

verses.textZh: 耶户和他的祖先同享安息，葬在撒玛利亚，他儿子约哈斯接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶户和他的祖先同享安息，葬在撒玛利亚，他儿子约哈斯接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户与他列祖同睡，葬在撒马利亚；他儿子约哈斯接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehu rested with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: So Jehu slept with his fathers, and they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jehu rested with his fathers, and they buried him in Samaria. Then Jehoahaz his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jehu died, he was buried in Samaria. Then his son Jehoahaz became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jehu lay down with his fathers, and they buried him in Samaria. And his son Jehoahaz became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Jehu rested with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 耶户在撒玛利亚作王统治以色列共二十八年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶户在撒玛利亚作王统治以色列共二十八年。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户在撒马利亚作以色列王二十八年。
verses.textEnNiv: The time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.
verses.textEnEsv: The time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the period that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.
verses.textEnNlt: In all, Jehu reigned over Israel from Samaria for twenty-eight years.
verses.textEnNasb: So the time which Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.
verses.textEn: The time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.

verses.textZh: 亚哈谢的母亲亚他利雅看见自己的儿子死了，就起来消灭王室所有的后裔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈谢的母亲亚他利雅看见自己的儿子死了，就起来消灭王室所有的后裔。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈谢的母亲亚她利雅见她儿子死了，就起来剿灭王室。
verses.textEnNiv: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she proceeded to destroy the whole royal family.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal family.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal heirs.
verses.textEnNlt: When Athaliah, the mother of King Ahaziah of Judah, learned that her son was dead, she began to destroy the rest of the royal family.
verses.textEnNasb: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and eliminated all the royal children.
verses.textEn: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she proceeded to destroy the whole royal family.

verses.textZh: 但约兰王的女儿，亚哈谢的妹妹约示巴，把亚哈谢的儿子约阿施从正要被杀的王子中偷了出来，把他和他的乳母藏在卧室里面；他们把他收藏起来，躲避亚他利雅，免得他被杀死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但约兰王的女儿，亚哈谢的妹妹约示巴，把亚哈谢的儿子约阿施从正要被杀的王子中偷了出来，把他和他的乳母藏在卧室里面；他们把他收藏起来，躲避亚他利雅，免得他被杀死。
verses.textZhCuv: 但约兰王的女儿，亚哈谢的妹子约示巴，将亚哈谢的儿子约阿施从那被杀的王子中偷出来，把他和他的乳母都藏在卧房里，躲避亚她利雅，免得被杀。
verses.textEnNiv: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Jehoram and sister of Ahaziah, took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the royal princes, who were about to be murdered. She put him and his nurse in a bedroom to hide him from Athaliah; so he was not killed.
verses.textEnEsv: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the king’s sons who were being put to death, and she put him and his nurse in a bedroom. Thus they hid him from Athaliah, so that he was not put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king’s sons whowere being murdered; and they hid him and his nurse in the bedroom, from Athaliah, so that he was not killed.
verses.textEnNlt: But Ahaziah’s sister Jehosheba, the daughter of King Jehoram, took Ahaziah’s infant son, Joash, and stole him away from among the rest of the king’s children, who were about to be killed. She put Joash and his nurse in a bedroom, and they hid him from Athaliah, so the child was not murdered.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah and abducted him from among the king’s sons who were being put to death, and put him and his nurse in the bedroom. So they hid him from Athaliah, and he was not put to death.
verses.textEn: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Jehoram and sister of Ahaziah, took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the royal princes, who were about to be murdered. She put him and his nurse in a bedroom to hide him from Athaliah; so he was not killed.

verses.textZh: 约阿施和他的乳母在耶和华的殿中躲藏了六年；亚他利雅却作王统治那地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约阿施和他的乳母在耶和华的殿中躲藏了六年；亚他利雅却作王统治那地。
verses.textZhCuv: 约阿施和他的乳母藏在耶和华的殿里六年；亚她利雅篡了国位。
verses.textEnNiv: He remained hidden with his nurse at the temple of the Lord for six years while Athaliah ruled the land.
verses.textEnEsv: And he remained with her six years, hidden in the house of the Lord , while Athaliah reigned over the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he was hidden with her in the house of the Lord for six years, while Athaliah reigned over the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Joash remained hidden in the Temple of the Lord for six years while Athaliah ruled over the land.
verses.textEnNasb: So he was kept hidden with her in the house of the Lord for six years, while Athaliah was reigning over the land.
verses.textEn: He remained hidden with his nurse at the temple of the Lord for six years while Athaliah ruled the land.

verses.textZh: 在第七年，耶何耶大派人把迦利人和卫兵的众百夫长带来，领他们进入耶和华的殿中，和他们立约，使他们在耶和华的殿里起誓，然后把王子带出来和他们见面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在第七年，耶何耶大派人把迦利人和卫兵的众百夫长带来，领他们进入耶和华的殿中，和他们立约，使他们在耶和华的殿里起誓，然后把王子带出来和他们见面。
verses.textZhCuv: 第七年，耶何耶大打发人叫迦利人 和护卫兵的众百夫长来，领他们进了耶和华的殿，与他们立约，使他们在耶和华殿里起誓，又将王的儿子指给他们看，
verses.textEnNiv: In the seventh year Jehoiada sent for the commanders of units of a hundred, the Carites and the guards and had them brought to him at the temple of the Lord . He made a covenant with them and put them under oath at the temple of the Lord . Then he showed them the king’s son.
verses.textEnEsv: But in the seventh year Jehoiada sent and brought the captains of the Carites and of the guards, and had them come to him in the house of the Lord . And he made a covenant with them and put them under oath in the house of the Lord , and he showed them the king’s son.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the seventh year Jehoiada sent and brought the captains of hundreds—of the bodyguards and the escorts—and brought them into the house of the Lord to him. And he made a covenant with them and took an oath from them in the house of the Lord, and showed them the king’s son.
verses.textEnNlt: In the seventh year of Athaliah’s reign, Jehoiada the priest summoned the commanders, the Carite mercenaries, and the palace guards to come to the Temple of the Lord . He made a solemn pact with them and made them swear an oath of loyalty there in the Lord ’s Temple; then he showed them the king’s son.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the seventh year Jehoiada sent orders and brought the captains of hundreds of the Carites and of the guards, and brought them to himself at the house of the Lord. Then he made a covenant with them and put them under oath at the house of the Lord, and showed them the king’s son.
verses.textEn: In the seventh year Jehoiada sent for the commanders of units of a hundred, the Carites and the guards and had them brought to him at the temple of the Lord . He made a covenant with them and put them under oath at the temple of the Lord . Then he showed them the king’s son.

verses.textZh: 他又吩咐他们说："你们要这样作：你们在安息日值班的，三分之一要守卫王宫；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又吩咐他们说："你们要这样作：你们在安息日值班的，三分之一要守卫王宫；
verses.textZhCuv: 吩咐他们说：「你们当这样行：凡安息日进班的三分之一要看守王宫，
verses.textEnNiv: He commanded them, saying, "This is what you are to do: You who are in the three companies that are going on duty on the Sabbath—a third of you guarding the royal palace,
verses.textEnEsv: And he commanded them, "This is the thing that you shall do: one third of you, those who come off duty on the Sabbath and guard the king’s house
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he commanded them, saying, "This is what you shall do: one-third of you who come on duty on the Sabbath shall be keeping watch over the king’s house,
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoiada told them, "This is what you must do. A third of you who are on duty on the Sabbath are to guard the royal palace itself.
verses.textEnNasb: And he commanded them, saying, "This is the thing that you shall do: a third of you, who come in on the Sabbath and keep watch over the king’s house
verses.textEn: He commanded them, saying, "This is what you are to do: You who are in the three companies that are going on duty on the Sabbath—a third of you guarding the royal palace,

verses.textZh: 三分之一要在苏珥门；三分之一要在卫兵院的后门；你们要轮班把守王宫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 三分之一要在苏珥门；三分之一要在卫兵院的后门；你们要轮班把守王宫。
verses.textZhCuv: 三分之一要在苏珥门，三分之一要在护卫兵院的后门。这样把守王宫，拦阻闲人。
verses.textEnNiv: a third at the Sur Gate, and a third at the gate behind the guard, who take turns guarding the temple—
verses.textEnEsv: ( another third being at the gate Sur and a third at the gate behind the guards) shall guard the palace.
verses.textEnNkjv: one-third shallbe at the gate of Sur, and one-third at the gate behind the escorts. You shall keep the watch of the house, lest it be broken down.
verses.textEnNlt: Another third of you are to stand guard at the Sur Gate. And the final third must stand guard behind the palace guard. These three groups will all guard the palace.
verses.textEnNasb: (a third also shall be at the gate Sur, and a third at the gate behind the guards), shall keep watch over the house for defense.
verses.textEn: a third at the Sur Gate, and a third at the gate behind the guard, who take turns guarding the temple—

verses.textZh: 你们在安息日不用当值的两班人，要为王的缘故守卫耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们在安息日不用当值的两班人，要为王的缘故守卫耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们安息日所有出班的三分之二要在耶和华的殿里护卫王；
verses.textEnNiv: and you who are in the other two companies that normally go off Sabbath duty are all to guard the temple for the king.
verses.textEnEsv: And the two divisions of you, which come on duty in force on the Sabbath and guard the house of the Lord on behalf of the king,
verses.textEnNkjv: The two contingents of you who go off duty on the Sabbath shall keep the watch of the house of the Lord for the king.
verses.textEnNlt: The other two units who are off duty on the Sabbath must stand guard for the king at the Lord ’s Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: And two parts of you, all who go out on the Sabbath, shall also keep watch over the house of the Lord for the king.
verses.textEn: and you who are in the other two companies that normally go off Sabbath duty are all to guard the temple for the king.

verses.textZh: 你们要在四周围护着王，各人手中要拿着自己的武器。擅自闯入班次的，必被处死。王出入的时候，你们要紧随左右。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要在四周围护着王，各人手中要拿着自己的武器。擅自闯入班次的，必被处死。王出入的时候，你们要紧随左右。"
verses.textZhCuv: 各人手拿兵器，四围护卫王。凡擅入你们班次的必当治死，王出入的时候，你们当跟随他。」
verses.textEnNiv: Station yourselves around the king, each of you with weapon in hand. Anyone who approaches your ranks is to be put to death. Stay close to the king wherever he goes."
verses.textEnEsv: shall surround the king, each with his weapons in his hand. And whoever approaches the ranks is to be put to death. Be with the king when he goes out and when he comes in."
verses.textEnNkjv: But you shall surround the king on all sides, every man with his weapons in his hand; and whoever comes within range, let him be put to death. You are to be with the king as he goes out and as he comes in."
verses.textEnNlt: Form a bodyguard around the king and keep your weapons in hand. Kill anyone who tries to break through. Stay with the king wherever he goes."
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall surround the king, each with his weapons in his hand; and whoever comes within the ranks shall be put to death. And you are to be with the king when he goes out and when he comes in."
verses.textEn: Station yourselves around the king, each of you with weapon in hand. Anyone who approaches your ranks is to be put to death. Stay close to the king wherever he goes."

verses.textZh: 于是众百夫长照着耶何耶大祭司的一切吩咐去行。他们各自率领人马，无论在安息日值班或不用当值的，都来到耶何耶大祭司那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是众百夫长照着耶何耶大祭司的一切吩咐去行。他们各自率领人马，无论在安息日值班或不用当值的，都来到耶何耶大祭司那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 众百夫长就照着祭司耶何耶大一切所吩咐的去行，各带所管安息日进班出班的人来见祭司耶何耶大。
verses.textEnNiv: The commanders of units of a hundred did just as Jehoiada the priest ordered. Each one took his men—those who were going on duty on the Sabbath and those who were going off duty—and came to Jehoiada the priest.
verses.textEnEsv: The captains did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded, and they each brought his men who were to go off duty on the Sabbath, with those who were to come on duty on the Sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the captains of the hundreds did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded. Each of them took his men who were to be on duty on the Sabbath, with those who were going off duty on the Sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.
verses.textEnNlt: So the commanders did everything as Jehoiada the priest ordered. The commanders took charge of the men reporting for duty that Sabbath, as well as those who were going off duty. They brought them all to Jehoiada the priest,
verses.textEnNasb: So the captains of hundreds acted in accordance with everything that Jehoiada the priest commanded. And each one of them took his men who were to come in on the Sabbath, along with those who were to go out on the Sabbath, and they came to Jehoiada the priest.
verses.textEn: The commanders of units of a hundred did just as Jehoiada the priest ordered. Each one took his men—those who were going on duty on the Sabbath and those who were going off duty—and came to Jehoiada the priest.

verses.textZh: 耶何耶大就把藏在耶和华殿里，属于大卫王的矛枪和盾牌交给众百夫长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶何耶大就把藏在耶和华殿里，属于大卫王的矛枪和盾牌交给众百夫长。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司便将耶和华殿里所藏大卫王的枪和盾牌交给百夫长。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he gave the commanders the spears and shields that had belonged to King David and that were in the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest gave to the captains the spears and shields that had been King David’s, which were in the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priest gave the captains of hundreds the spears and shields which hadbelonged to King David, that were in the temple of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: and he supplied them with the spears and small shields that had once belonged to King David and were stored in the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then the priest gave the captains of hundreds the spears and shields that had been King David’s, which were in the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then he gave the commanders the spears and shields that had belonged to King David and that were in the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 各卫兵手持兵器，从殿的右面到殿的左面，面对祭坛和殿，围绕着王侍立。
verses.textZhCnvs: 各卫兵手持兵器，从殿的右面到殿的左面，面对祭坛和殿，围绕着王侍立。
verses.textZhCuv: 护卫兵手中各拿兵器，在坛和殿那里，从殿右直到殿左，站在王子的四围。
verses.textEnNiv: The guards, each with weapon in hand, stationed themselves around the king—near the altar and the temple, from the south side to the north side of the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: And the guards stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, from the south side of the house to the north side of the house, around the altar and the house on behalf of the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the escorts stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, all around the king, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, by the altar and the house.
verses.textEnNlt: The palace guards stationed themselves around the king, with their weapons ready. They formed a line from the south side of the Temple around to the north side and all around the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: The guards stood, each with his weapons in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, by the altar and by the house, around the king.
verses.textEn: The guards, each with weapon in hand, stationed themselves around the king—near the altar and the temple, from the south side to the north side of the temple.

verses.textZh: 耶何耶大领王子出来，把王冠戴在他的头上，又把约书交给他。他们就拥立他为王，用膏膏他，并且拍掌，说："愿王万岁！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶何耶大领王子出来，把王冠戴在他的头上，又把约书交给他。他们就拥立他为王，用膏膏他，并且拍掌，说："愿王万岁！"
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司领王子出来，给他戴上冠冕，将律法书交给他，膏他作王；众人就拍掌说：「愿王万岁！」
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoiada brought out the king’s son and put the crown on him; he presented him with a copy of the covenant and proclaimed him king. They anointed him, and the people clapped their hands and shouted, "Long live the king!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then he brought out the king’s son and put the crown on him and gave him the testimony. And they proclaimed him king and anointed him, and they clapped their hands and said, "Long live the king!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And he brought out the king’s son, put the crown on him, and gavehim the Testimony; they made him king and anointed him, and they clapped their hands and said, "Long live the king!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehoiada brought out Joash, the king’s son, placed the crown on his head, and presented him with a copy of God’s laws. They anointed him and proclaimed him king, and everyone clapped their hands and shouted, "Long live the king!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then he brought the king’s son out, and put the crown on him and gave him the testimony; and they made him king and anointed him, and they clapped their hands and said, "Long live the king!"
verses.textEn: Jehoiada brought out the king’s son and put the crown on him; he presented him with a copy of the covenant and proclaimed him king. They anointed him, and the people clapped their hands and shouted, "Long live the king!"

verses.textZh: 亚他利雅听见卫兵和民众的声音，就进到耶和华的殿、众民那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚他利雅听见卫兵和民众的声音，就进到耶和华的殿、众民那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚她利雅听见护卫兵和民的声音，就到民那里，进耶和华的殿，
verses.textEnNiv: When Athaliah heard the noise made by the guards and the people, she went to the people at the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: When Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she went into the house of the Lord to the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the escorts and the people, she came to the people in the temple of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: When Athaliah heard the noise made by the palace guards and the people, she hurried to the Lord ’s Temple to see what was happening.
verses.textEnNasb: When Athaliah heard the noise of the guards and of the people, she came to the people at the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: When Athaliah heard the noise made by the guards and the people, she went to the people at the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 她看见王子按着规例站在柱旁那里，首领和号手在王的旁边，当地所有的人民欢乐吹号。亚他利雅于是撕裂衣服，呼叫："反了！反了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她看见王子按着规例站在柱旁那里，首领和号手在王的旁边，当地所有的人民欢乐吹号。亚他利雅于是撕裂衣服，呼叫："反了！反了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 看见王照例站在柱旁，百夫长和吹号的人侍立在王左右，国中的众民欢乐吹号；亚她利雅就撕裂衣服，喊叫说：「反了！反了！」
verses.textEnNiv: She looked and there was the king, standing by the pillar, as the custom was. The officers and the trumpeters were beside the king, and all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets. Then Athaliah tore her robes and called out, "Treason! Treason!"
verses.textEnEsv: And when she looked, there was the king standing by the pillar, according to the custom, and the captains and the trumpeters beside the king, and all the people of the land rejoicing and blowing trumpets. And Athaliah tore her clothes and cried, "Treason! Treason!"
verses.textEnNkjv: When she looked, there was the king standing by a pillar according to custom; and the leaders and the trumpeters were by the king. All the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets. So Athaliah tore her clothes and cried out, "Treason! Treason!"
verses.textEnNlt: When she arrived, she saw the newly crowned king standing in his place of authority by the pillar, as was the custom at times of coronation. The commanders and trumpeters were surrounding him, and people from all over the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets. When Athaliah saw all this, she tore her clothes in despair and shouted, "Treason! Treason!"
verses.textEnNasb: And she looked, and behold, the king was standing by the pillar according to the custom, with the captains and the trumpeters beside the king; and all the people of the land were joyful and were blowing trumpets. Then Athaliah tore her clothes and cried out, "Conspiracy! Conspiracy!"
verses.textEn: She looked and there was the king, standing by the pillar, as the custom was. The officers and the trumpeters were beside the king, and all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets. Then Athaliah tore her robes and called out, "Treason! Treason!"

verses.textZh: 耶何耶大祭司吩咐众百夫长，就是统领军兵的，对他们说："把她从各班军兵中赶出去，跟随她的，都要用刀杀死。"因为祭司说："不可在耶和华的殿内杀死她。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶何耶大祭司吩咐众百夫长，就是统领军兵的，对他们说："把她从各班军兵中赶出去，跟随她的，都要用刀杀死。"因为祭司说："不可在耶和华的殿内杀死她。"
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司耶何耶大吩咐管辖军兵的百夫长说：「将她赶出班外，凡跟随她的必用刀杀死！」因为祭司说「不可在耶和华殿里杀她」，
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoiada the priest ordered the commanders of units of a hundred, who were in charge of the troops: "Bring her out between the ranks and put to the sword anyone who follows her." For the priest had said, "She must not be put to death in the temple of the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains who were set over the army, "Bring her out between the ranks, and put to death with the sword anyone who follows her." For the priest said, "Let her not be put to death in the house of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds, the officers of the army, and said to them, "Take her outside under guard, and slay with the sword whoever follows her." For the priest had said, "Do not let her be killed in the house of the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehoiada the priest ordered the commanders who were in charge of the troops, "Take her to the soldiers in front of the Temple, and kill anyone who tries to rescue her." For the priest had said, "She must not be killed in the Temple of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: And Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of hundreds who were appointed over the army and said to them, "Bring her out between the ranks, and whoever follows her, put to death with the sword!" For the priest said, "She is not to be put to death at the house of the Lord."
