verses.textEn: Jehoiada the priest ordered the commanders of units of a hundred, who were in charge of the troops: "Bring her out between the ranks and put to the sword anyone who follows her." For the priest had said, "She must not be put to death in the temple of the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 于是他们下手拿住她；她回到王宫的马门的时候，就在那里被人杀死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们下手拿住她；她回到王宫的马门的时候，就在那里被人杀死。
verses.textZhCuv: 众兵就闪开让她去；她从马路上王宫去，便在那里被杀。
verses.textEnNiv: So they seized her as she reached the place where the horses enter the palace grounds, and there she was put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: So they laid hands on her; and she went through the horses’ entrance to the king’s house, and there she was put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they seized her; and she went by way of the horses’ entrance into the king’s house, and there she was killed.
verses.textEnNlt: So they seized her and led her out to the gate where horses enter the palace grounds, and she was killed there.
verses.textEnNasb: So they seized her, and when they brought her to the horses’ entrance of the king’s house, she was put to death there.
verses.textEn: So they seized her as she reached the place where the horses enter the palace grounds, and there she was put to death.

verses.textZh: 耶何耶大又使王和人民与耶和华立约，好使他们作耶和华的人民；又使王与人民立约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶何耶大又使王和人民与耶和华立约，好使他们作耶和华的人民；又使王与人民立约。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶何耶大使王和民与耶和华立约，作耶和华的民；又使王与民立约。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoiada then made a covenant between the Lord and the king and people that they would be the Lord ’s people. He also made a covenant between the king and the people.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the Lord and the king and people, that they should be the Lord ’s people, and also between the king and the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jehoiada made a covenant between the Lord, the king, and the people, that they should be the Lord’s people, and also between the king and the people.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehoiada made a covenant between the Lord and the king and the people that they would be the Lord ’s people. He also made a covenant between the king and the people.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jehoiada made a covenant between the Lord, the king, and the people, that they would be the Lord’s people, and between the king and the people.
verses.textEn: Jehoiada then made a covenant between the Lord and the king and people that they would be the Lord ’s people. He also made a covenant between the king and the people.

verses.textZh: 然后当地所有的人民都来到巴力庙，把它拆毁，把它的坛和像完全打碎，又在祭坛前把巴力的祭司玛坦杀了。耶何耶大祭司又设立官员管理耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后当地所有的人民都来到巴力庙，把它拆毁，把它的坛和像完全打碎，又在祭坛前把巴力的祭司玛坦杀了。耶何耶大祭司又设立官员管理耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是国民都到巴力庙，拆毁了庙，打碎坛和像，又在坛前将巴力的祭司玛坦杀了。祭司耶何耶大派官看守耶和华的殿，
verses.textEnNiv: All the people of the land went to the temple of Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols to pieces and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars. Then Jehoiada the priest posted guards at the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the people of the land went to the house of Baal and tore it down; his altars and his images they broke in pieces, and they killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest posted watchmen over the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the people of the land went to the temple of Baal, and tore it down. They thoroughly broke in pieces its altars and images, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest appointed officers over the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: And all the people of the land went over to the temple of Baal and tore it down. They demolished the altars and smashed the idols to pieces, and they killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars. Jehoiada the priest stationed guards at the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And all the people of the land came to the house of Baal and tore it down; they thoroughly smashed his altars and his images in pieces, and they killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. Then the priest appointed sentries over the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: All the people of the land went to the temple of Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols to pieces and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars. Then Jehoiada the priest posted guards at the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他又率领众百夫长、迦利人、卫兵和当地所有的人民，护送王从耶和华的殿下来，经卫兵的门进入王宫。这样，约阿施就坐上了王位。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又率领众百夫长、迦利人、卫兵和当地所有的人民，护送王从耶和华的殿下来，经卫兵的门进入王宫。这样，约阿施就坐上了王位。
verses.textZhCuv: 又率领百夫长和迦利人 与护卫兵，以及国中的众民，请王从耶和华殿下来，由护卫兵的门进入王宫，他就坐了王位。
verses.textEnNiv: He took with him the commanders of hundreds, the Carites, the guards and all the people of the land, and together they brought the king down from the temple of the Lord and went into the palace, entering by way of the gate of the guards. The king then took his place on the royal throne.
verses.textEnEsv: And he took the captains, the Carites, the guards, and all the people of the land, and they brought the king down from the house of the Lord , marching through the gate of the guards to the king’s house. And he took his seat on the throne of the kings.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he took the captains of hundreds, the bodyguards, the escorts, and all the people of the land; and they brought the king down from the house of the Lord, and went by way of the gate of the escorts to the king’s house. Then he sat on the throne of the kings.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the commanders, the Carite mercenaries, the palace guards, and all the people of the land escorted the king from the Temple of the Lord . They went through the gate of the guards and into the palace, and the king took his seat on the royal throne.
verses.textEnNasb: And he took the captains of hundreds and the Carites, and the guards and all the people of the land; and they brought the king down from the house of the Lord, and came by way of the gate of the guards to the king’s house. And he sat on the throne of the kings.
verses.textEn: He took with him the commanders of hundreds, the Carites, the guards and all the people of the land, and together they brought the king down from the temple of the Lord and went into the palace, entering by way of the gate of the guards. The king then took his place on the royal throne.

verses.textZh: 当地所有的人民都欢乐，阖城平静；至于亚他利雅，他们在王宫用刀把她杀死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当地所有的人民都欢乐，阖城平静；至于亚他利雅，他们在王宫用刀把她杀死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 国民都欢乐，合城都安静。众人已将亚她利雅在王宫那里用刀杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: All the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was calm, because Athaliah had been slain with the sword at the palace.
verses.textEnEsv: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet after Athaliah had been put to death with the sword at the king’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the people of the land rejoiced; and the city was quiet, for they had slain Athaliah with the sword in the king’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was peaceful because Athaliah had been killed at the king’s palace.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the people of the land rejoiced and the city was peaceful. For they had put Athaliah to death with the sword at the king’s house.
verses.textEn: All the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was calm, because Athaliah had been slain with the sword at the palace.

verses.textZh: 约阿施作王的时候，只有七岁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约阿施作王的时候，只有七岁。
verses.textZhCuv: 约阿施登基的时候年方七岁。
verses.textEnNiv: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign.
verses.textEnEsv: Jehoash was seven years old when he began to reign.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jehoash was seven years old when he became king.
verses.textEnNlt: Joash was seven years old when he became king.
verses.textEnNasb: Jehoash was seven years old when he became king.
verses.textEn: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign.

verses.textZh: 耶户在位第七年，约阿施登基，在耶路撒冷作王四十年。他母亲名叫西比亚，是从别是巴来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶户在位第七年，约阿施登基，在耶路撒冷作王四十年。他母亲名叫西比亚，是从别是巴来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶户第七年，约阿施登基，在耶路撒冷作王四十年。他母亲名叫西比亚，是别是巴人。
verses.textEnNiv: In the seventh year of Jehu, Joash became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem forty years. His mother’s name was Zibiah; she was from Beersheba.
verses.textEnEsv: In the seventh year of Jehu, Jehoash began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah of Beersheba.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the seventh year of Jehu, Jehoash became king, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah of Beersheba.
verses.textEnNlt: Joash began to rule over Judah in the seventh year of King Jehu’s reign in Israel. He reigned in Jerusalem forty years. His mother was Zibiah from Beersheba.
verses.textEnNasb: In the seventh year of Jehu, Jehoash became king, and he reigned for forty years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Zibiah of Beersheba.
verses.textEn: In the seventh year of Jehu, Joash became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem forty years. His mother’s name was Zibiah; she was from Beersheba.

verses.textZh: 在耶何耶大祭司教导他的日子，他就行耶和华看为正的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶何耶大祭司教导他的日子，他就行耶和华看为正的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 约阿施在祭司耶何耶大教训他的时候，就行耶和华眼中看为正的事；
verses.textEnNiv: Joash did what was right in the eyes of the Lord all the years Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jehoash did what was right in the eyes of the Lord all his days, because Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jehoash did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord all the days in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
verses.textEnNlt: All his life Joash did what was pleasing in the Lord ’s sight because Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
verses.textEnNasb: Jehoash did what was right in the sight of the Lord all his days that Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
verses.textEn: Joash did what was right in the eyes of the Lord all the years Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

verses.textZh: 只是邱坛没有废去，人民仍在邱坛献祭焚香。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是邱坛没有废去，人民仍在邱坛献祭焚香。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是邱坛还没有废去，百姓仍在那里献祭烧香。
verses.textEnNiv: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, the high places were not taken away; the people continued to sacrifice and make offerings on the high places.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the high places were not taken away; the people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet even so, he did not destroy the pagan shrines, and the people still offered sacrifices and burned incense there.
verses.textEnNasb: Only the high places did not end; the people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.
verses.textEn: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.

verses.textZh: 约阿施对众祭司说："所有分别为圣，奉到耶和华殿里的银子，或是各被数点之人的赎价，或是各种的赎价，或是各人随着心意，奉到耶和华殿里的银子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 约阿施对众祭司说："所有分别为圣，奉到耶和华殿里的银子，或是各被数点之人的赎价，或是各种的赎价，或是各人随着心意，奉到耶和华殿里的银子，
verses.textZhCuv: 约阿施对众祭司说：「凡奉到耶和华殿分别为圣之物所值通用的银子，或各人当纳的身价，或乐意奉到耶和华殿的银子，
verses.textEnNiv: Joash said to the priests, "Collect all the money that is brought as sacred offerings to the temple of the Lord —the money collected in the census, the money received from personal vows and the money brought voluntarily to the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: Jehoash said to the priests, "All the money of the holy things that is brought into the house of the Lord , the money for which each man is assessed—the money from the assessment of persons—and the money that a man’s heart prompts him to bring into the house of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jehoash said to the priests, "All the money of the dedicated gifts that are brought into the house of the Lord—each man’s census money, each man’s assessment money—and all the money that a man purposes in his heart to bring into the house of the Lord,
verses.textEnNlt: One day King Joash said to the priests, "Collect all the money brought as a sacred offering to the Lord ’s Temple, whether it is a regular assessment, a payment of vows, or a voluntary gift.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jehoash said to the priests, "All the money of the sacred offerings which is brought into the house of the Lord, in current money, both the money of each man’s assessment and all the money which anyone’s heart prompts him to bring into the house of the Lord,
verses.textEn: Joash said to the priests, "Collect all the money that is brought as sacred offerings to the temple of the Lord —the money collected in the census, the money received from personal vows and the money brought voluntarily to the temple.

verses.textZh: 各祭司可向自己熟悉的人收取。他们要修理殿内毁坏的地方，就是一切发现有毁坏的地方。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 各祭司可向自己熟悉的人收取。他们要修理殿内毁坏的地方，就是一切发现有毁坏的地方。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当从所认识的人收了来，修理殿的一切破坏之处。」
verses.textEnNiv: Let every priest receive the money from one of the treasurers, then use it to repair whatever damage is found in the temple."
verses.textEnEsv: let the priests take, each from his donor, and let them repair the house wherever any need of repairs is discovered."
verses.textEnNkjv: let the priests take it themselves, each from his constituency; and let them repair the damages of the temple, wherever any dilapidation is found."
verses.textEnNlt: Let the priests take some of that money to pay for whatever repairs are needed at the Temple."
verses.textEnNasb: the priests are to take it for themselves, each from his acquaintance; and they shall repair damage to the house wherever any damage is found."
verses.textEn: Let every priest receive the money from one of the treasurers, then use it to repair whatever damage is found in the temple."

verses.textZh: 可是到了约阿施王在位二十三年的时候，祭司还未修好圣殿毁坏的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是到了约阿施王在位二十三年的时候，祭司还未修好圣殿毁坏的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 无奈到了约阿施王二十三年，祭司仍未修理殿的破坏之处。
verses.textEnNiv: But by the twenty-third year of King Joash the priests still had not repaired the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: But by the twenty-third year of King Jehoash, the priests had made no repairs on the house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it was so, by the twenty-third year of King Jehoash, that the priests had not repaired the damages of the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: But by the twenty-third year of Joash’s reign, the priests still had not repaired the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: But it came about that in the twenty-third year of King Jehoash, the priests had not repaired any damage to the house.
verses.textEn: But by the twenty-third year of King Joash the priests still had not repaired the temple.

verses.textZh: 于是约阿施王召了耶何耶大祭司和众祭司来，说："你们为甚么不修理圣殿毁坏的地方呢？现在不要向你们熟识的人收取银子，却要把所收的交出来，修理圣殿毁坏的地方。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约阿施王召了耶何耶大祭司和众祭司来，说："你们为甚么不修理圣殿毁坏的地方呢？现在不要向你们熟识的人收取银子，却要把所收的交出来，修理圣殿毁坏的地方。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以约阿施王召了大祭司耶何耶大和众祭司来，对他们说：「你们怎么不修理殿的破坏之处呢？从今以后，你们不要从所认识的人再收银子，要将所收的交出来，修理殿的破坏之处。」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore King Joash summoned Jehoiada the priest and the other priests and asked them, "Why aren’t you repairing the damage done to the temple? Take no more money from your treasurers, but hand it over for repairing the temple."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore King Jehoash summoned Jehoiada the priest and the other priests and said to them, "Why are you not repairing the house? Now therefore take no more money from your donors, but hand it over for the repair of the house."
verses.textEnNkjv: So King Jehoash called Jehoiada the priest and the other priests, and said to them, "Why have you not repaired the damages of the temple? Now therefore, do not take more money from your constituency, but deliver it for repairing the damages of the temple."
verses.textEnNlt: So King Joash called for Jehoiada and the other priests and asked them, "Why haven’t you repaired the Temple? Don’t use any more money for your own needs. From now on, it must all be spent on Temple repairs."
verses.textEnNasb: So King Jehoash summoned Jehoiada the priest, and the other priests, and said to them, "Why do you not repair damage to the house? Now then, you are not to take any more money from your acquaintances, but give it up for the damage to the house."
verses.textEn: Therefore King Joash summoned Jehoiada the priest and the other priests and asked them, "Why aren’t you repairing the damage done to the temple? Take no more money from your treasurers, but hand it over for repairing the temple."

verses.textZh: 众祭司答应不再从人民收取银子，也不修理圣殿毁坏的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众祭司答应不再从人民收取银子，也不修理圣殿毁坏的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 众祭司答应不再收百姓的银子，也不修理殿的破坏之处。
verses.textEnNiv: The priests agreed that they would not collect any more money from the people and that they would not repair the temple themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: So the priests agreed that they should take no more money from the people, and that they should not repair the house.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priests agreed that they would neither receive more money from the people, nor repair the damages of the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: So the priests agreed not to accept any more money from the people, and they also agreed to let others take responsibility for repairing the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: The priests then agreed that they would not take any more money from the people, nor would they repair damage to the house.
verses.textEn: The priests agreed that they would not collect any more money from the people and that they would not repair the temple themselves.

verses.textZh: 耶何耶大祭司搬来了一个箱子，在它的顶上钻了一个孔，把它放在祭坛旁边，在圣殿入口的右边。守门的祭司把奉到耶和华殿所有的银子都投进箱里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶何耶大祭司搬来了一个箱子，在它的顶上钻了一个孔，把它放在祭坛旁边，在圣殿入口的右边。守门的祭司把奉到耶和华殿所有的银子都投进箱里。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司耶何耶大取了一个柜子，在柜盖上钻了一个窟窿，放于坛旁，在进耶和华殿的右边；守门的祭司将奉到耶和华殿的一切银子投在柜里。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid. He placed it beside the altar, on the right side as one enters the temple of the Lord . The priests who guarded the entrance put into the chest all the money that was brought to the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in the lid of it and set it beside the altar on the right side as one entered the house of the Lord . And the priests who guarded the threshold put in it all the money that was brought into the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jehoiada the priest took a chest, bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into the house of the Lord; and the priests who kept the door put there all the money brought into the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehoiada the priest bored a hole in the lid of a large chest and set it on the right-hand side of the altar at the entrance of the Temple of the Lord . The priests guarding the entrance put all of the people’s contributions into the chest.
verses.textEnNasb: Instead, Jehoiada the priest took a chest and drilled a hole in its lid and put it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into the house of the Lord; and the priests who guarded the threshold put in it all the money that was brought into the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid. He placed it beside the altar, on the right side as one enters the temple of the Lord . The priests who guarded the entrance put into the chest all the money that was brought to the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他们看见箱内的银子多起来的时候，就叫王的书记和大祭司上来，他们就数点在耶和华殿里所得的银子，装在袋中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们看见箱内的银子多起来的时候，就叫王的书记和大祭司上来，他们就数点在耶和华殿里所得的银子，装在袋中。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们见柜里的银子多了，便叫王的书记和大祭司上来，将耶和华殿里的银子数算包起来。
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever they saw that there was a large amount of money in the chest, the royal secretary and the high priest came, counted the money that had been brought into the temple of the Lord and put it into bags.
verses.textEnEsv: And whenever they saw that there was much money in the chest, the king’s secretary and the high priest came up and they bagged and counted the money that was found in the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, whenever they saw that therewas much money in the chest, that the king’s scribe and the high priest came up and put it in bags, and counted the money that was found in the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Whenever the chest became full, the court secretary and the high priest counted the money that had been brought to the Lord ’s Temple and put it into bags.
verses.textEnNasb: When they saw that there was a great amount of money in the chest, the king’s scribe and the high priest went up and tied it up in bags, and counted the money that was found in the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Whenever they saw that there was a large amount of money in the chest, the royal secretary and the high priest came, counted the money that had been brought into the temple of the Lord and put it into bags.

verses.textZh: 他们把所称的银子交在耶和华殿中管理工匠的监工手里，然后他们支付给在耶和华殿作工的木匠和建筑工人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把所称的银子交在耶和华殿中管理工匠的监工手里，然后他们支付给在耶和华殿作工的木匠和建筑工人，
verses.textZhCuv: 把所平的银子交给督工的，就是耶和华殿里办事的人；他们把银子转交修理耶和华殿的木匠和工人，
verses.textEnNiv: When the amount had been determined, they gave the money to the men appointed to supervise the work on the temple. With it they paid those who worked on the temple of the Lord —the carpenters and builders,
verses.textEnEsv: Then they would give the money that was weighed out into the hands of the workmen who had the oversight of the house of the Lord . And they paid it out to the carpenters and the builders who worked on the house of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they gave the money, which had been apportioned, into the hands of those who did the work, who had the oversight of the house of the Lord; and they paid it out to the carpenters and builders who worked on the house of the Lord,
verses.textEnNlt: Then they gave the money to the construction supervisors, who used it to pay the people working on the Lord ’s Temple—the carpenters, the builders,
verses.textEnNasb: And they handed the money which was assessed over to those who did the work, who had the oversight of the house of the Lord; and they paid it out to the carpenters and the builders who worked on the house of the Lord;
verses.textEn: When the amount had been determined, they gave the money to the men appointed to supervise the work on the temple. With it they paid those who worked on the temple of the Lord —the carpenters and builders,

verses.textZh: 以及泥匠和石匠；又用来购买木材和凿好的石头，来修理耶和华殿里毁坏的地方，以及支付一切修理耶和华殿的开支。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以及泥匠和石匠；又用来购买木材和凿好的石头，来修理耶和华殿里毁坏的地方，以及支付一切修理耶和华殿的开支。
verses.textZhCuv: 并瓦匠、石匠，又买木料和凿成的石头，修理耶和华殿的破坏之处，以及修理殿的各样使用。
verses.textEnNiv: the masons and stonecutters. They purchased timber and blocks of dressed stone for the repair of the temple of the Lord , and met all the other expenses of restoring the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: and to the masons and the stonecutters, as well as to buy timber and quarried stone for making repairs on the house of the Lord , and for any outlay for the repairs of the house.
verses.textEnNkjv: and to masons and stonecutters, and for buying timber and hewn stone, to repair the damage of the house of the Lord, and for all that was paid out to repair the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: the masons, and the stonecutters. They also used the money to buy the timber and the finished stone needed for repairing the Lord ’s Temple, and they paid any other expenses related to the Temple’s restoration.
verses.textEnNasb: and to the masons and the stonecutters, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the damage to the house of the Lord, and for everything that was laid out for the house to repair it.
verses.textEn: the masons and stonecutters. They purchased timber and blocks of dressed stone for the repair of the temple of the Lord , and met all the other expenses of restoring the temple.

verses.textZh: 但耶和华殿里的银杯、烛剪、碗、号或任何金银器皿，都没有用奉到耶和华殿里的银子来做。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶和华殿里的银杯、烛剪、碗、号或任何金银器皿，都没有用奉到耶和华殿里的银子来做。
verses.textZhCuv: 但那奉到耶和华殿的银子，没有用以做耶和华殿里的银杯、蜡剪、碗、号，和别样的金银器皿，
verses.textEnNiv: The money brought into the temple was not spent for making silver basins, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, trumpets or any other articles of gold or silver for the temple of the Lord ;
verses.textEnEsv: But there were not made for the house of the Lord basins of silver, snuffers, bowls, trumpets, or any vessels of gold, or of silver, from the money that was brought into the house of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: However there were not made for the house of the Lord basins of silver, trimmers, sprinkling-bowls, trumpets, any articles of gold or articles of silver, from the money brought into the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The money brought to the Temple was not used for making silver bowls, lamp snuffers, basins, trumpets, or other articles of gold or silver for the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: However there were not made for the house of the Lord silver cups, shears, bowls, trumpets, any receptacles of gold, or receptacles of silver from the money which was brought into the house of the Lord;
verses.textEn: The money brought into the temple was not spent for making silver basins, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, trumpets or any other articles of gold or silver for the temple of the Lord ;

verses.textZh: 他们只把银子交给工匠，用来修理耶和华殿里毁坏的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们只把银子交给工匠，用来修理耶和华殿里毁坏的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 乃将那银子交给督工的人修理耶和华的殿；
verses.textEnNiv: it was paid to the workers, who used it to repair the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: for that was given to the workmen who were repairing the house of the Lord with it.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they gave that to the workmen, and they repaired the house of the Lord with it.
verses.textEnNlt: It was paid to the workmen, who used it for the Temple repairs.
verses.textEnNasb: for they gave that to those who did the work, and with it they repaired the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: it was paid to the workers, who used it to repair the temple.

verses.textZh: 他们没有要求经手把银子转付工匠的人交代帐目，因为他们办事诚实。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们没有要求经手把银子转付工匠的人交代帐目，因为他们办事诚实。
verses.textZhCuv: 且将银子交给办事的人转交做工的人，不与他们算账，因为他们办事诚实。
verses.textEnNiv: They did not require an accounting from those to whom they gave the money to pay the workers, because they acted with complete honesty.
verses.textEnEsv: And they did not ask for an accounting from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to pay out to the workmen, for they dealt honestly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover they did not require an account from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to be paid to workmen, for they dealt faithfully.
verses.textEnNlt: No accounting of this money was required from the construction supervisors, because they were honest and trustworthy men.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, they did not require an accounting from the men into whose hands they gave the money to pay to those who did the work, because they acted faithfully.
verses.textEn: They did not require an accounting from those to whom they gave the money to pay the workers, because they acted with complete honesty.

verses.textZh: 但是赎愆祭和赎罪祭的银子，他们没有奉入耶和华的殿，这些银子是属于祭司的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是赎愆祭和赎罪祭的银子，他们没有奉入耶和华的殿，这些银子是属于祭司的。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有赎愆祭、赎罪祭的银子没有奉到耶和华的殿，都归祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: The money from the guilt offerings and sin offerings was not brought into the temple of the Lord ; it belonged to the priests.
verses.textEnEsv: The money from the guilt offerings and the money from the sin offerings was not brought into the house of the Lord ; it belonged to the priests.
verses.textEnNkjv: The money from the trespass offerings and the money from the sin offerings was not brought into the house of the Lord. It belonged to the priests.
verses.textEnNlt: However, the money that was contributed for guilt offerings and sin offerings was not brought into the Lord ’s Temple. It was given to the priests for their own use.
verses.textEnNasb: The money from the guilt offerings and the money from the sin offerings was not brought into the house of the Lord; it belonged to the priests.
verses.textEn: The money from the guilt offerings and sin offerings was not brought into the temple of the Lord ; it belonged to the priests.

verses.textZh: 那时亚兰王哈薛上来，攻打迦特，把它夺取了。他又决心上来攻打耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时亚兰王哈薛上来，攻打迦特，把它夺取了。他又决心上来攻打耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，亚兰王哈薛上来攻打迦特，攻取了，就定意上来攻打耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: About this time Hazael king of Aram went up and attacked Gath and captured it. Then he turned to attack Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: At that time Hazael king of Syria went up and fought against Gath and took it. But when Hazael set his face to go up against Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNkjv: Hazael king of Syria went up and fought against Gath, and took it; then Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: About this time King Hazael of Aram went to war against Gath and captured it. Then he turned to attack Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hazael the king of Aram went up and fought against Gath and captured it, and Hazael was intent on going up against Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: About this time Hazael king of Aram went up and attacked Gath and captured it. Then he turned to attack Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 犹大王约阿施于是拿出所有的圣物，就是他的祖先犹大王约沙法、约兰和亚哈谢所献的圣物，以及他自己所献的圣物，还有耶和华殿和王宫宝库里所有的金子，送给亚兰王哈薛，哈薛就离开耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王约阿施于是拿出所有的圣物，就是他的祖先犹大王约沙法、约兰和亚哈谢所献的圣物，以及他自己所献的圣物，还有耶和华殿和王宫宝库里所有的金子，送给亚兰王哈薛，哈薛就离开耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王约阿施将他列祖犹大王约沙法、约兰、亚哈谢所分别为圣的物和自己所分别为圣的物，并耶和华殿与王宫府库里所有的金子都送给亚兰王哈薛；哈薛就不上耶路撒冷来了。
verses.textEnNiv: But Joash king of Judah took all the sacred objects dedicated by his predecessors—Jehoshaphat, Jehoram and Ahaziah, the kings of Judah—and the gifts he himself had dedicated and all the gold found in the treasuries of the temple of the Lord and of the royal palace, and he sent them to Hazael king of Aram, who then withdrew from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Jehoash king of Judah took all the sacred gifts that Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah his fathers, the kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own sacred gifts, and all the gold that was found in the treasuries of the house of the Lord and of the king’s house, and sent these to Hazael king of Syria. Then Hazael went away from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jehoash king of Judah took all the sacred things that his fathers, Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own sacred things, and all the gold found in the treasuries of the house of the Lord and in the king’s house, and sent them to Hazael king of Syria. Then he went away from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: King Joash collected all the sacred objects that Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, and Ahaziah, the previous kings of Judah, had dedicated, along with what he himself had dedicated. He sent them all to Hazael, along with all the gold in the treasuries of the Lord ’s Temple and the royal palace. So Hazael called off his attack on Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jehoash king of Judah took all the sacred offerings that Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had consecrated, and his own sacred offerings, and all the gold that was found among the treasuries of the house of the Lord and of the king’s house, and sent them to Hazael king of Aram. Then he withdrew from Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: But Joash king of Judah took all the sacred objects dedicated by his predecessors—Jehoshaphat, Jehoram and Ahaziah, the kings of Judah—and the gifts he himself had dedicated and all the gold found in the treasuries of the temple of the Lord and of the royal palace, and he sent them to Hazael king of Aram, who then withdrew from Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 约阿施其余的事迹和他所行的一切，不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 约阿施其余的事迹和他所行的一切，不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 约阿施其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of the reign of Joash, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Joash and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Joash’s reign and everything he did are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Joash and everything that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of the reign of Joash, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

verses.textZh: 约阿施的臣仆起来背叛，他们在米罗宫内，他下到悉拉的时候，击杀了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约阿施的臣仆起来背叛，他们在米罗宫内，他下到悉拉的时候，击杀了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 约阿施的臣仆起来背叛，在下悉拉的米罗宫那里将他杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: His officials conspired against him and assassinated him at Beth Millo, on the road down to Silla.
verses.textEnEsv: His servants arose and made a conspiracy and struck down Joash in the house of Millo, on the way that goes down to Silla.
verses.textEnNkjv: And his servants arose and formed a conspiracy, and killed Joash in the house of the Millo, which goes down to Silla.
verses.textEnNlt: Joash’s officers plotted against him and assassinated him at Beth-millo on the road to Silla.
verses.textEnNasb: And his servants rose up and formed a conspiracy; and they struck and killed Joash at the house of Millo as he was going down to Silla.
verses.textEn: His officials conspired against him and assassinated him at Beth Millo, on the road down to Silla.

verses.textZh: 他的臣仆示米押的儿子约撒甲和朔默的儿子约萨拔击杀他，他就死了。人把他埋葬在大卫城，和他的祖先在一起。他的儿子亚玛谢接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的臣仆示米押的儿子约撒甲和朔默的儿子约萨拔击杀他，他就死了。人把他埋葬在大卫城，和他的祖先在一起。他的儿子亚玛谢接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 杀他的那臣仆就是示米押的儿子约撒甲和朔默的儿子约萨拔。众人将他葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子亚玛谢接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: The officials who murdered him were Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer. He died and was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. And Amaziah his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: It was Jozacar the son of Shimeath and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, who struck him down, so that he died. And they buried him with his fathers in the city of David, and Amaziah his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him. So he died, and they buried him with his fathers in the City of David. Then Amaziah his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: The assassins were Jozacar son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer—both trusted advisers. Joash was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. Then his son Amaziah became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: For Jozacar the son of Shimeath and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David, and his son Amaziah became king in his place.
verses.textEn: The officials who murdered him were Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer. He died and was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. And Amaziah his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 犹大王亚哈谢的儿子约阿施在位第二十三年，耶户的儿子约哈斯在撒玛利亚登基，统治以色列共十七年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王亚哈谢的儿子约阿施在位第二十三年，耶户的儿子约哈斯在撒玛利亚登基，统治以色列共十七年。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王亚哈谢的儿子约阿施二十三年，耶户的儿子约哈斯在撒马利亚登基作以色列王十七年。
verses.textEnNiv: In the twenty-third year of Joash son of Ahaziah king of Judah, Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned seventeen years.
verses.textEnEsv: In the twenty-third year of Joash the son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and he reigned seventeen years.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the twenty-third year of Joash the son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, Jehoahaz the son of Jehu became king over Israel in Samaria, andreigned seventeen years.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoahaz son of Jehu began to rule over Israel in the twenty-third year of King Joash’s reign in Judah. He reigned in Samaria seventeen years.
verses.textEnNasb: In the twenty-third year of Joash the son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, Jehoahaz the son of Jehu became king over Israel at Samaria, and he reigned for seventeen years.
verses.textEn: In the twenty-third year of Joash son of Ahaziah king of Judah, Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned seventeen years.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，随从尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷于罪中的那些罪，不肯转离。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，随从尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷于罪中的那些罪，不肯转离。
verses.textZhCuv: 约哈斯行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，总不离开。
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord by following the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit, and he did not turn away from them.
verses.textEnEsv: He did what was evil in the sight of the Lord and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which he made Israel to sin; he did not depart from them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who had made Israel sin. He did not depart from them.
verses.textEnNlt: But he did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight. He followed the example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, continuing the sins that Jeroboam had led Israel to commit.
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, into which he misled Israel; he did not turn from them.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord by following the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit, and he did not turn away from them.

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华的怒气向以色列发作，常把他们交在亚兰王哈薛的手中和哈薛的儿子便．哈达的手中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华的怒气向以色列发作，常把他们交在亚兰王哈薛的手中和哈薛的儿子便．哈达的手中。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，将他们屡次交在亚兰王哈薛和他儿子便哈达的手里。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord ’s anger burned against Israel, and for a long time he kept them under the power of Hazael king of Aram and Ben-Hadad his son.
verses.textEnEsv: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel, and he gave them continually into the hand of Hazael king of Syria and into the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the anger of the Lord was aroused against Israel, and He delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Ben-Hadad the son of Hazael, all their days.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord was very angry with Israel, and he allowed King Hazael of Aram and his son Ben-hadad to defeat them repeatedly.
verses.textEnNasb: So the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel, and He continually handed them over to Hazael king of Aram, and to Ben-hadad, the son of Hazael.
verses.textEn: So the Lord ’s anger burned against Israel, and for a long time he kept them under the power of Hazael king of Aram and Ben-Hadad his son.

verses.textZh: 约哈斯恳求耶和华，耶和华垂听他的祷告，因为看见了以色列所受的压迫，就是亚兰王对他们的压迫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约哈斯恳求耶和华，耶和华垂听他的祷告，因为看见了以色列所受的压迫，就是亚兰王对他们的压迫。
verses.textZhCuv: 约哈斯恳求耶和华，耶和华就应允他，因为见以色列人所受亚兰王的欺压。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jehoahaz sought the Lord ’s favor, and the Lord listened to him, for he saw how severely the king of Aram was oppressing Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jehoahaz sought the favor of the Lord , and the Lord listened to him, for he saw the oppression of Israel, how the king of Syria oppressed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jehoahaz pleaded with the Lord, and the Lord listened to him; for He saw the oppression of Israel, because the king of Syria oppressed them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehoahaz prayed for the Lord ’s help, and the Lord heard his prayer, for he could see how severely the king of Aram was oppressing Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jehoahaz appeased the Lord, and the Lord listened to him; for He saw the oppression of Israel, how the king of Aram oppressed them.
verses.textEn: Then Jehoahaz sought the Lord ’s favor, and the Lord listened to him, for he saw how severely the king of Aram was oppressing Israel.

verses.textZh: 耶和华就赐给以色列一位拯救者，他救他们脱离亚兰王的手，于是以色列人可以在自己的家安居，好象以前一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华就赐给以色列一位拯救者，他救他们脱离亚兰王的手，于是以色列人可以在自己的家安居，好象以前一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华赐给以色列人一位拯救者，使他们脱离亚兰人的手；于是以色列人仍旧安居在家里。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord provided a deliverer for Israel, and they escaped from the power of Aram. So the Israelites lived in their own homes as they had before.
verses.textEnEsv: (Therefore the Lord gave Israel a savior, so that they escaped from the hand of the Syrians, and the people of Israel lived in their homes as formerly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord gave Israel a deliverer, so that they escaped from under the hand of the Syrians; and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents as before.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord provided someone to rescue the Israelites from the tyranny of the Arameans. Then Israel lived in safety again as they had in former days.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord gave Israel a savior, so that they escaped from under the hand of the Arameans; and the sons of Israel lived in their tents as previously.
verses.textEn: The Lord provided a deliverer for Israel, and they escaped from the power of Aram. So the Israelites lived in their own homes as they had before.

verses.textZh: 可是他们没有离开耶罗波安家使以色列人陷于罪中的那些罪，仍然行在罪中；亚舍拉依然立在撒玛利亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是他们没有离开耶罗波安家使以色列人陷于罪中的那些罪，仍然行在罪中；亚舍拉依然立在撒玛利亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，他们不离开耶罗波安家使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，仍然去行，并且在撒马利亚留下亚舍拉。
verses.textEnNiv: But they did not turn away from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, which he had caused Israel to commit; they continued in them. Also, the Asherah pole remained standing in Samaria.
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, they did not depart from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, which he made Israel to sin, but walked in them; and the Asherah also remained in Samaria.)
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless they did not depart from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who had made Israel sin, but walked in them; and the wooden image also remained in Samaria.
verses.textEnNlt: But they continued to sin, following the evil example of Jeroboam. They also allowed the Asherah pole in Samaria to remain standing.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless they did not abandon the sins of the house of Jeroboam, into which he misled Israel; rather, they walked in them; and the Asherah also remained standing in Samaria.
verses.textEn: But they did not turn away from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, which he had caused Israel to commit; they continued in them. Also, the Asherah pole remained standing in Samaria.

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华没有给约哈斯留下余民，只剩下骑兵五十人，战车十辆和步兵一万人，因为亚兰王毁灭他们，践踏他们好象禾场上的尘土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华没有给约哈斯留下余民，只剩下骑兵五十人，战车十辆和步兵一万人，因为亚兰王毁灭他们，践踏他们好象禾场上的尘土。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚兰王灭绝约哈斯的民，践踏他们如禾场上的尘沙，只给约哈斯留下五十马兵，十辆战车，一万步兵。
verses.textEnNiv: Nothing had been left of the army of Jehoahaz except fifty horsemen, ten chariots and ten thousand foot soldiers, for the king of Aram had destroyed the rest and made them like the dust at threshing time.
verses.textEnEsv: For there was not left to Jehoahaz an army of more than fifty horsemen and ten chariots and ten thousand footmen, for the king of Syria had destroyed them and made them like the dust at threshing.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He left of the army of Jehoahaz only fifty horsemen, ten chariots, and ten thousand foot soldiers; for the king of Syria had destroyed them and made them like the dust at threshing.
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, Jehoahaz’s army was reduced to 50 charioteers, 10 chariots, and 10,000 foot soldiers. The king of Aram had killed the others, trampling them like dust under his feet.
verses.textEnNasb: For he left to Jehoahaz no more of the army than fifty horsemen, ten chariots, and ten thousand infantry, because the king of Aram had eliminated them and made them like the dust at threshing.
verses.textEn: Nothing had been left of the army of Jehoahaz except fifty horsemen, ten chariots and ten thousand foot soldiers, for the king of Aram had destroyed the rest and made them like the dust at threshing time.

verses.textZh: 约哈斯其余的事迹和他所行的一切，以及他的英勇事迹，不是都写在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 约哈斯其余的事迹和他所行的一切，以及他的英勇事迹，不是都写在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 约哈斯其余的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力都写在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of the reign of Jehoahaz, all he did and his achievements, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz and all that he did, and his might, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, all that he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Jehoahaz’s reign—everything he did and the extent of his power—are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did and his might, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of the reign of Jehoahaz, all he did and his achievements, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

verses.textZh: 约哈斯和他的祖先一同长眠，葬在撒玛利亚。他的儿子约阿施接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约哈斯和他的祖先一同长眠，葬在撒玛利亚。他的儿子约阿施接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 约哈斯与他列祖同睡，葬在撒马利亚。他儿子约阿施接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoahaz rested with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria. And Jehoash his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: So Jehoahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in Samaria, and Joash his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jehoahaz rested with his fathers, and they buried him in Samaria. Then Joash his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jehoahaz died, he was buried in Samaria. Then his son Jehoash became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jehoahaz lay down with his fathers, and they buried him in Samaria; and his son Joash became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Jehoahaz rested with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria. And Jehoash his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 犹大王约阿施在位第三十七年，约哈斯的儿子约阿施在撒玛利亚登基，统治以色列共十六年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王约阿施在位第三十七年，约哈斯的儿子约阿施在撒玛利亚登基，统治以色列共十六年。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王约阿施三十七年，约哈斯的儿子约阿施在撒马利亚登基作以色列王十六年。
verses.textEnNiv: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash son of Jehoahaz became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned sixteen years.
verses.textEnEsv: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and he reigned sixteen years.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz became king over Israel in Samaria, andreigned sixteen years.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoash son of Jehoahaz began to rule over Israel in the thirty-seventh year of King Joash’s reign in Judah. He reigned in Samaria sixteen years.
verses.textEnNasb: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz became king over Israel in Samaria, and he reigned for sixteen years.
verses.textEn: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash son of Jehoahaz became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned sixteen years.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，不转离尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷于罪中的一切罪，仍然行在罪中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，不转离尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷于罪中的一切罪，仍然行在罪中。
verses.textZhCuv: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的一切罪，仍然去行。
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord and did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit; he continued in them.
verses.textEnEsv: He also did what was evil in the sight of the Lord . He did not depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which he made Israel to sin, but he walked in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord. He did not depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel sin, but walked in them.
verses.textEnNlt: But he did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight. He refused to turn from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had led Israel to commit.
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord; he did not turn away from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, into which he misled Israel; rather, he walked in them.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord and did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit; he continued in them.

verses.textZh: 约阿施其余的事迹和他所行的一切，以及他与犹大王亚玛谢作战时的英勇事迹，不是都写在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 约阿施其余的事迹和他所行的一切，以及他与犹大王亚玛谢作战时的英勇事迹，不是都写在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 约阿施其余的事，凡他所行的和他与犹大王亚玛谢争战的勇力，都写在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of the reign of Jehoash, all he did and his achievements, including his war against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Joash and all that he did, and the might with which he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, all that he did, and his might with which he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Jehoash’s reign and everything he did, including the extent of his power and his war with King Amaziah of Judah, are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Joash and all that he did, and his might with which he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of the reign of Jehoash, all he did and his achievements, including his war against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

verses.textZh: 约阿施和他的祖先一同长眠后，耶罗波安坐上了他的王位。他把约阿施葬在撒玛利亚，和以色列诸王在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约阿施和他的祖先一同长眠后，耶罗波安坐上了他的王位。他把约阿施葬在撒玛利亚，和以色列诸王在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 约阿施与他列祖同睡，耶罗波安坐了他的位。约阿施与以色列诸王一同葬在撒马利亚。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoash rested with his ancestors, and Jeroboam succeeded him on the throne. Jehoash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joash slept with his fathers, and Jeroboam sat on his throne. And Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joash rested with his fathers. Then Jeroboam sat on his throne. And Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jehoash died, he was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. Then his son Jeroboam II became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joash lay down with his fathers, and Jeroboam sat on his throne; and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
verses.textEn: Jehoash rested with his ancestors, and Jeroboam succeeded him on the throne. Jehoash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

verses.textZh: 以利沙患了必死的病。以色列王约阿施下到他那里，伏在他的脸上哭，说："父啊，父啊！以色列的战车和骑兵啊！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙患了必死的病。以色列王约阿施下到他那里，伏在他的脸上哭，说："父啊，父啊！以色列的战车和骑兵啊！"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙得了必死的病，以色列王约阿施下来看他，伏在他脸上哭泣，说：「我父啊！我父啊！以色列的战车马兵啊！」
verses.textEnNiv: Now Elisha had been suffering from the illness from which he died. Jehoash king of Israel went down to see him and wept over him. "My father! My father!" he cried. "The chariots and horsemen of Israel!"
verses.textEnEsv: Now when Elisha had fallen sick with the illness of which he was to die, Joash king of Israel went down to him and wept before him, crying, "My father, my father! The chariots of Israel and its horsemen!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Elisha had become sick with the illness of which he would die. Then Joash the king of Israel came down to him, and wept over his face, and said, "O my father, my father, the chariots of Israel and their horsemen!"
verses.textEnNlt: When Elisha was in his last illness, King Jehoash of Israel visited him and wept over him. "My father! My father! I see the chariots and charioteers of Israel!" he cried.
verses.textEnNasb: When Elisha became sick with the illness of which he was to die, Joash the king of Israel came down to him, and wept over him and said, "My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!"
verses.textEn: Now Elisha had been suffering from the illness from which he died. Jehoash king of Israel went down to see him and wept over him. "My father! My father!" he cried. "The chariots and horsemen of Israel!"

verses.textZh: 以利沙对他说："拿弓箭来！"他就把弓箭拿给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙对他说："拿弓箭来！"他就把弓箭拿给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙对他说：「你取弓箭来。」王就取了弓箭来；
verses.textEnNiv: Elisha said, "Get a bow and some arrows," and he did so.
verses.textEnEsv: And Elisha said to him, "Take a bow and arrows." So he took a bow and arrows.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Elisha said to him, "Take a bow and some arrows." So he took himself a bow and some arrows.
verses.textEnNlt: Elisha told him, "Get a bow and some arrows." And the king did as he was told.
verses.textEnNasb: And Elisha said to him, "Take a bow and arrows." So he took a bow and arrows.
verses.textEn: Elisha said, "Get a bow and some arrows," and he did so.

verses.textZh: 他对以色列王说："把你的手放在弓上吧！"他就把手放在弓上，以利沙又把自己的手放在王的手上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对以色列王说："把你的手放在弓上吧！"他就把手放在弓上，以利沙又把自己的手放在王的手上。
verses.textZhCuv: 又对以色列王说：「你用手拿弓。」王就用手拿弓。以利沙按手在王的手上，
verses.textEnNiv: "Take the bow in your hands," he said to the king of Israel. When he had taken it, Elisha put his hands on the king’s hands.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to the king of Israel, "Draw the bow," and he drew it. And Elisha laid his hands on the king’s hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to the king of Israel, "Put your hand on the bow." So he put his hand onit, and Elisha put his hands on the king’s hands.
verses.textEnNlt: Elisha told him, "Put your hand on the bow," and Elisha laid his own hands on the king’s hands.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Elisha said to the king of Israel, "Lay your hand on the bow." And he laid his hand on it, then Elisha put his hands on the king’s hands.
verses.textEn: "Take the bow in your hands," he said to the king of Israel. When he had taken it, Elisha put his hands on the king’s hands.

verses.textZh: 他说："打开向东的窗户。"他就打开了。以利沙说："放箭吧！"他就放箭。以利沙说："这是耶和华胜利的箭，耶和华得胜亚兰人的箭。你要在亚弗击杀亚兰人，直到完全灭绝。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："打开向东的窗户。"他就打开了。以利沙说："放箭吧！"他就放箭。以利沙说："这是耶和华胜利的箭，耶和华得胜亚兰人的箭。你要在亚弗击杀亚兰人，直到完全灭绝。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「你开朝东的窗户。」他就开了。以利沙说：「射箭吧！」他就射箭。以利沙说：「这是耶和华的得胜箭，就是战胜亚兰人的箭；因为你必在亚弗攻打亚兰人，直到灭尽他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Open the east window," he said, and he opened it. "Shoot!" Elisha said, and he shot. "The Lord ’s arrow of victory, the arrow of victory over Aram!" Elisha declared. "You will completely destroy the Arameans at Aphek."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Open the window eastward," and he opened it. Then Elisha said, "Shoot," and he shot. And he said, "The Lord ’s arrow of victory, the arrow of victory over Syria! For you shall fight the Syrians in Aphek until you have made an end of them."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "Open the east window"; and he opened it. Then Elisha said, "Shoot"; and he shot. And he said, "The arrow of the Lord’s deliverance and the arrow of deliverance from Syria; for you must strike the Syrians at Aphek till you have destroyed them."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he commanded, "Open that eastern window," and he opened it. Then he said, "Shoot!" So he shot an arrow. Elisha proclaimed, "This is the Lord ’s arrow, an arrow of victory over Aram, for you will completely conquer the Arameans at Aphek."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "Open the window toward the east," and he opened it. Then Elisha said, "Shoot!" So he shot. And he said, "The Lord’s arrow of victory, and the arrow of victory over Aram; for you will defeat the Arameans at Aphek until you have put an end to them."
verses.textEn: "Open the east window," he said, and he opened it. "Shoot!" Elisha said, and he shot. "The Lord ’s arrow of victory, the arrow of victory over Aram!" Elisha declared. "You will completely destroy the Arameans at Aphek."

verses.textZh: 他又说："拿箭来！"他就拿了来。他对以色列王说："你击打地吧！"他就击打地，打了三次就站起来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又说："拿箭来！"他就拿了来。他对以色列王说："你击打地吧！"他就击打地，打了三次就站起来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙又说：「取几枝箭来。」他就取了来。以利沙说：「打地吧！」他打了三次，便止住了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said, "Take the arrows," and the king took them. Elisha told him, "Strike the ground." He struck it three times and stopped.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Take the arrows," and he took them. And he said to the king of Israel, "Strike the ground with them." And he struck three times and stopped.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "Take the arrows"; so he took them. And he said to the king of Israel, "Strike the ground"; so he struck three times, and stopped.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said, "Now pick up the other arrows and strike them against the ground." So the king picked them up and struck the ground three times.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "Take the arrows," and he took them. And he said to the king of Israel, "Strike the ground," and he struck it three times and stopped.
verses.textEn: Then he said, "Take the arrows," and the king took them. Elisha told him, "Strike the ground." He struck it three times and stopped.

verses.textZh: 神人就对他发怒，说："你应该击打五次或者六次，那样就能打败亚兰人，直到完全消灭他们。现在，你只可以打败亚兰人三次了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神人就对他发怒，说："你应该击打五次或者六次，那样就能打败亚兰人，直到完全消灭他们。现在，你只可以打败亚兰人三次了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神人向他发怒，说：「应当击打五六次，就能攻打亚兰人直到灭尽；现在只能打败亚兰人三次。」
verses.textEnNiv: The man of God was angry with him and said, "You should have struck the ground five or six times; then you would have defeated Aram and completely destroyed it. But now you will defeat it only three times."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the man of God was angry with him and said, "You should have struck five or six times; then you would have struck down Syria until you had made an end of it, but now you will strike down Syria only three times."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the man of God was angry with him, and said, "You should have struck five or six times; then you would have struck Syria till you had destroyed it! But now you will strike Syria only three times."
verses.textEnNlt: But the man of God was angry with him. "You should have struck the ground five or six times!" he exclaimed. "Then you would have beaten Aram until it was entirely destroyed. Now you will be victorious only three times."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the man of God became angry at him and said, "You should have struck five or six times, then you would have struck Aram until you put an end to it. But now you shall strike Aram only three times."
verses.textEn: The man of God was angry with him and said, "You should have struck the ground five or six times; then you would have defeated Aram and completely destroyed it. But now you will defeat it only three times."

verses.textZh: 以利沙死了，也埋葬了。摩押人常在每年春天入侵以色列地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙死了，也埋葬了。摩押人常在每年春天入侵以色列地。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙死了，人将他葬埋。到了新年，有一群摩押人犯境，
verses.textEnNiv: Elisha died and was buried. Now Moabite raiders used to enter the country every spring.
verses.textEnEsv: So Elisha died, and they buried him. Now bands of Moabites used to invade the land in the spring of the year.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Elisha died, and they buried him. And the raiding bands from Moab invaded the land in the spring of the year.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elisha died and was buried. Groups of Moabite raiders used to invade the land each spring.
verses.textEnNasb: And Elisha died, and they buried him. Now the marauding bands of the Moabites would invade the land in the spring of the year.
verses.textEn: Elisha died and was buried. Now Moabite raiders used to enter the country every spring.

verses.textZh: 有人正在埋葬死人的时候，看见一群来侵略的人，他们就把死尸丢在以利沙的坟上，随即走了。死尸碰着以利沙的骨头就复活了，双脚站了起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人正在埋葬死人的时候，看见一群来侵略的人，他们就把死尸丢在以利沙的坟上，随即走了。死尸碰着以利沙的骨头就复活了，双脚站了起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人正葬死人，忽然看见一群人，就把死人抛在以利沙的坟墓里，一碰着以利沙的骸骨，死人就复活，站起来了。
verses.textEnNiv: Once while some Israelites were burying a man, suddenly they saw a band of raiders; so they threw the man’s body into Elisha’s tomb. When the body touched Elisha’s bones, the man came to life and stood up on his feet.
verses.textEnEsv: And as a man was being buried, behold, a marauding band was seen and the man was thrown into the grave of Elisha, and as soon as the man touched the bones of Elisha, he revived and stood on his feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, as they were burying a man, that suddenly they spied a band ofraiders; and they put the man in the tomb of Elisha; and when the man was let down and touched the bones of Elisha, he revived and stood on his feet.
verses.textEnNlt: Once when some Israelites were burying a man, they spied a band of these raiders. So they hastily threw the corpse into the tomb of Elisha and fled. But as soon as the body touched Elisha’s bones, the dead man revived and jumped to his feet!
verses.textEnNasb: And as they were burying a man, behold, they saw a marauding band; and they threw the man into the grave of Elisha. And when the man touched the bones of Elisha he revived and stood up on his feet.
verses.textEn: Once while some Israelites were burying a man, suddenly they saw a band of raiders; so they threw the man’s body into Elisha’s tomb. When the body touched Elisha’s bones, the man came to life and stood up on his feet.

verses.textZh: 约哈斯在位的日子，亚兰王哈薛一直都欺压以色列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约哈斯在位的日子，亚兰王哈薛一直都欺压以色列。
verses.textZhCuv: 约哈斯年间，亚兰王哈薛屡次欺压以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: Hazael king of Aram oppressed Israel throughout the reign of Jehoahaz.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.
verses.textEnNlt: King Hazael of Aram had oppressed Israel during the entire reign of King Jehoahaz.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Hazael king of Aram had oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.
verses.textEn: Hazael king of Aram oppressed Israel throughout the reign of Jehoahaz.

verses.textZh: 但耶和华仍然施恩给他们，怜悯他们，眷顾他们，这是因为他与亚伯拉罕、以撒和雅各所立的约，不愿意毁灭他们，把他们从自己的面前丢弃，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶和华仍然施恩给他们，怜悯他们，眷顾他们，这是因为他与亚伯拉罕、以撒和雅各所立的约，不愿意毁灭他们，把他们从自己的面前丢弃，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华却因与亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各所立的约，仍施恩给以色列人，怜恤他们，眷顾他们，不肯灭尽他们，尚未赶逐他们离开自己面前。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord was gracious to them and had compassion and showed concern for them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. To this day he has been unwilling to destroy them or banish them from his presence.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord was gracious to them and had compassion on them, and he turned toward them, because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them, nor has he cast them from his presence until now.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord was gracious to them, had compassion on them, and regarded them, because of His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not yet destroy them or cast them from His presence.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord was gracious and merciful to the people of Israel, and they were not totally destroyed. He pitied them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. And to this day he still has not completely destroyed them or banished them from his presence.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord was gracious to them and had compassion on them and turned to them because of His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; and He was unwilling to eliminate them or cast them away from His presence until now.
verses.textEn: But the Lord was gracious to them and had compassion and showed concern for them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. To this day he has been unwilling to destroy them or banish them from his presence.

verses.textZh: 亚兰王哈薛死了，他的儿子便．哈达接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚兰王哈薛死了，他的儿子便．哈达接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚兰王哈薛死了，他儿子便‧哈达接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Hazael king of Aram died, and Ben-Hadad his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: When Hazael king of Syria died, Ben-hadad his son became king in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Hazael king of Syria died. Then Ben-Hadad his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: King Hazael of Aram died, and his son Ben-hadad became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: When Hazael king of Aram died, his son Ben-hadad became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Hazael king of Aram died, and Ben-Hadad his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 约哈斯的儿子约阿施从哈薛的儿子便．哈达手中，把哈薛在战争时从约阿施的父亲约哈斯手中夺去的城市收复。约阿施三次打败便．哈达，收复以色列的城市。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约哈斯的儿子约阿施从哈薛的儿子便．哈达手中，把哈薛在战争时从约阿施的父亲约哈斯手中夺去的城市收复。约阿施三次打败便．哈达，收复以色列的城市。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前哈薛和约阿施的父亲约哈斯争战，攻取了些城邑，现在约哈斯的儿子约阿施三次打败哈薛的儿子便哈达，就收回了以色列的城邑。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jehoash son of Jehoahaz recaptured from Ben-Hadad son of Hazael the towns he had taken in battle from his father Jehoahaz. Three times Jehoash defeated him, and so he recovered the Israelite towns.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again from Ben-hadad the son of Hazael the cities that he had taken from Jehoahaz his father in war. Three times Joash defeated him and recovered the cities of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz recaptured from the hand of Ben-Hadad, the son of Hazael, the cities which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times Joash defeated him and recaptured the cities of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehoash son of Jehoahaz recaptured from Ben-hadad son of Hazael the towns that had been taken from Jehoash’s father, Jehoahaz. Jehoash defeated Ben-hadad on three occasions, and he recovered the Israelite towns.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz again took from the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael the cities which he had taken in war from the hand of his father Jehoahaz. Three times Joash defeated him and recovered the cities of Israel.
verses.textEn: Then Jehoash son of Jehoahaz recaptured from Ben-Hadad son of Hazael the towns he had taken in battle from his father Jehoahaz. Three times Jehoash defeated him, and so he recovered the Israelite towns.

verses.textZh: 以色列王约哈斯的儿子约阿施在位第二年，犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢登基作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王约哈斯的儿子约阿施在位第二年，犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢登基作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王约哈斯的儿子约阿施第二年，犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢登基。
verses.textEnNiv: In the second year of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel, Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah began to reign.
verses.textEnEsv: In the second year of Joash the son of Joahaz, king of Israel, Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, began to reign.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the second year of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, became king.
verses.textEnNlt: Amaziah son of Joash began to rule over Judah in the second year of the reign of King Jehoash of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: In the second year of Joash son of Joahaz king of Israel, Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah became king.
verses.textEn: In the second year of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel, Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah began to reign.

verses.textZh: 他登基的时候是二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王共二十九年。他母亲名叫约耶但，是从耶路撒冷来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他登基的时候是二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王共二十九年。他母亲名叫约耶但，是从耶路撒冷来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他母亲名叫约耶但，是耶路撒冷人。
verses.textEnNiv: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan; she was from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddin of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother was Jehoaddin from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned for twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jehoaddin of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan; she was from Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为正的事；只是不像他的祖先大卫，却是照着他父亲约阿施所行的一切去行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为正的事；只是不像他的祖先大卫，却是照着他父亲约阿施所行的一切去行。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛谢行耶和华眼中看为正的事，但不如他祖大卫，乃效法他父约阿施一切所行的；
verses.textEnNiv: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , but not as his father David had done. In everything he followed the example of his father Joash.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , yet not like David his father. He did in all things as Joash his father had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord, yet not like his father David; he did everything as his father Joash had done.
verses.textEnNlt: Amaziah did what was pleasing in the Lord ’s sight, but not like his ancestor David. Instead, he followed the example of his father, Joash.
verses.textEnNasb: He did what was right in the sight of the Lord, yet not like his father David; he acted in accordance with everything that his father Joash had done.
verses.textEn: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , but not as his father David had done. In everything he followed the example of his father Joash.

verses.textZh: 只是邱坛还没有废去，人民仍在邱坛献祭焚香。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是邱坛还没有废去，人民仍在邱坛献祭焚香。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是邱坛还没有废去，百姓仍在那里献祭烧香。
verses.textEnNiv: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.
verses.textEnEsv: But the high places were not removed; the people still sacrificed and made offerings on the high places.
verses.textEnNkjv: However the high places were not taken away, and the people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.
verses.textEnNlt: Amaziah did not destroy the pagan shrines, and the people still offered sacrifices and burned incense there.
verses.textEnNasb: Only the high places were not eliminated; the people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.
verses.textEn: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.

verses.textZh: 当国家在他手中稳定以后，他就把那些击杀他父王的臣仆杀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当国家在他手中稳定以后，他就把那些击杀他父王的臣仆杀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 国一坚定，就把杀他父王的臣仆杀了，
verses.textEnNiv: After the kingdom was firmly in his grasp, he executed the officials who had murdered his father the king.
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as the royal power was firmly in his hand, he struck down his servants who had struck down the king his father.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, as soon as the kingdom was established in his hand, that he executed his servants who had murdered his father the king.
verses.textEnNlt: When Amaziah was well established as king, he executed the officials who had assassinated his father.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about, as soon as the kingdom was firmly in his hand, that he killed his servants who had killed the king, his father.
verses.textEn: After the kingdom was firmly in his grasp, he executed the officials who had murdered his father the king.

verses.textZh: 但他们的儿子没有处死，这是按照摩西律法书上所写，是耶和华的吩咐："不可因儿子的罪处死父亲，也不可因父亲的罪处死儿子；各人要因自己的罪而死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们的儿子没有处死，这是按照摩西律法书上所写，是耶和华的吩咐："不可因儿子的罪处死父亲，也不可因父亲的罪处死儿子；各人要因自己的罪而死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 却没有治死杀王之人的儿子，是照摩西律法书上耶和华所吩咐的说：「不可因子杀父，也不可因父杀子，各人要为本身的罪而死。」
verses.textEnNiv: Yet he did not put the children of the assassins to death, in accordance with what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses where the Lord commanded: "Parents are not to be put to death for their children, nor children put to death for their parents; each will die for their own sin."
verses.textEnEsv: But he did not put to death the children of the murderers, according to what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, where the Lord commanded, "Fathers shall not be put to death because of their children, nor shall children be put to death because of their fathers. But each one shall die for his own sin."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the children of the murderers he did not execute, according to what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, in which the Lord commanded, saying, "Fathers shall not be put to death for their children, nor shall children be put to death for their fathers; but a person shall be put to death for his own sin."
verses.textEnNlt: However, he did not kill the children of the assassins, for he obeyed the command of the Lord as written by Moses in the Book of the Law: "Parents must not be put to death for the sins of their children, nor children for the sins of their parents. Those deserving to die must be put to death for their own crimes."
verses.textEnNasb: But he did not put the sons of the murderers to death, in obedience to what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, as the Lord commanded, saying, "The fathers shall not be put to death for the sons, nor the sons be put to death for the fathers; but each shall be put to death for his own sin."
verses.textEn: Yet he did not put the children of the assassins to death, in accordance with what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses where the Lord commanded: "Parents are not to be put to death for their children, nor children put to death for their parents; each will die for their own sin."

verses.textZh: 他在盐谷击杀了一万以东人，又攻取了西拉，然后把它的名字改称为约帖，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在盐谷击杀了一万以东人，又攻取了西拉，然后把它的名字改称为约帖，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛谢在盐谷杀了以东人一万，又攻取了西拉，改名叫约帖，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: He was the one who defeated ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt and captured Sela in battle, calling it Joktheel, the name it has to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: He struck down ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt and took Sela by storm, and called it Joktheel, which is its name to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: He killed ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and took Sela by war, and called its name Joktheel to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: Amaziah also killed 10,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt. He also conquered Sela and changed its name to Joktheel, as it is called to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: He killed ten thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and took Sela by war, and named it Joktheel, as it is to this day.
verses.textEn: He was the one who defeated ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt and captured Sela in battle, calling it Joktheel, the name it has to this day.

verses.textZh: 那时，亚玛谢派使者去见耶户的孙子、约哈斯的儿子以色列王约阿施说："来，我们在战场相见吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，亚玛谢派使者去见耶户的孙子、约哈斯的儿子以色列王约阿施说："来，我们在战场相见吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，亚玛谢差遣使者去见耶户的孙子约哈斯的儿子以色列王约阿施，说：「你来，我们二人相见于战场。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, with the challenge: "Come, let us face each other in battle."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz, son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, "Come, let us look one another in the face."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, "Come, let us face one another inbattle."
verses.textEnNlt: One day Amaziah sent messengers with this challenge to Israel’s king Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz and grandson of Jehu: "Come and meet me in battle!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, "Come, let’s face each other in combat."
verses.textEn: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, with the challenge: "Come, let us face each other in battle."

verses.textZh: 以色列王约阿施派人去见犹大王亚玛谢说："黎巴嫩的蒺藜派人去见黎巴嫩的香柏树说：‘请你把你的女儿给我的儿子作妻子吧！’后来有黎巴嫩的野兽经过，就把蒺藜踩倒了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王约阿施派人去见犹大王亚玛谢说："黎巴嫩的蒺藜派人去见黎巴嫩的香柏树说：‘请你把你的女儿给我的儿子作妻子吧！’后来有黎巴嫩的野兽经过，就把蒺藜踩倒了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王约阿施差遣使者去见犹大王亚玛谢，说：「黎巴嫩的蒺藜差遣使者去见黎巴嫩的香柏树，说：将你的女儿给我儿子为妻。后来黎巴嫩有一只野兽经过，把蒺藜践踏了。
verses.textEnNiv: But Jehoash king of Israel replied to Amaziah king of Judah: "A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle underfoot.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jehoash king of Israel sent word to Amaziah king of Judah, "A thistle on Lebanon sent to a cedar on Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son for a wife,’ and a wild beast of Lebanon passed by and trampled down the thistle.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jehoash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, "The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son as wife’; and a wild beast that was in Lebanon passed by and trampled the thistle.
verses.textEnNlt: But King Jehoash of Israel replied to King Amaziah of Judah with this story: "Out in the Lebanon mountains, a thistle sent a message to a mighty cedar tree: ‘Give your daughter in marriage to my son.’ But just then a wild animal of Lebanon came by and stepped on the thistle, crushing it!
verses.textEnNasb: But Jehoash king of Israel sent messengers to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, "The thorn bush that was in Lebanon sent word to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ But a wild animal that was in Lebanon passed by and trampled the thorn bush.
verses.textEn: But Jehoash king of Israel replied to Amaziah king of Judah: "A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle underfoot.

verses.textZh: 不错，你打败了以东人，你的心就高傲。你尽管自己夸耀，安坐家中就是了。为甚么要惹祸，使你覆亡，也使犹大跟你一起覆亡呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 不错，你打败了以东人，你的心就高傲。你尽管自己夸耀，安坐家中就是了。为甚么要惹祸，使你覆亡，也使犹大跟你一起覆亡呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 你打败了以东人就心高气傲，你以此为荣耀，在家里安居就罢了，为何要惹祸，使自己和犹大国一同败亡呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: You have indeed defeated Edom and now you are arrogant. Glory in your victory, but stay at home! Why ask for trouble and cause your own downfall and that of Judah also?"
verses.textEnEsv: You have indeed struck down Edom, and your heart has lifted you up. Be content with your glory, and stay at home, for why should you provoke trouble so that you fall, you and Judah with you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: You have indeed defeated Edom, and your heart has lifted you up. Glory inthat, and stay at home; for why should you meddle with trouble so that you fall—you and Judah with you?"
verses.textEnNlt: "You have indeed defeated Edom, and you are proud of it. But be content with your victory and stay at home! Why stir up trouble that will only bring disaster on you and the people of Judah?"
verses.textEnNasb: You have indeed defeated Edom, and your heart is elated. Enjoy the glory and stay home; for why should you get involved in trouble so that you would fall, you and Judah with you?"
verses.textEn: You have indeed defeated Edom and now you are arrogant. Glory in your victory, but stay at home! Why ask for trouble and cause your own downfall and that of Judah also?"

verses.textZh: 但是亚玛谢不听他的话。于是以色列王约阿施上来，和犹大王亚玛谢在属犹大的伯．示麦相见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是亚玛谢不听他的话。于是以色列王约阿施上来，和犹大王亚玛谢在属犹大的伯．示麦相见。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛谢却不肯听这话。于是以色列王约阿施上来，在犹大的伯‧示麦与犹大王亚玛谢相见于战场。
verses.textEnNiv: Amaziah, however, would not listen, so Jehoash king of Israel attacked. He and Amaziah king of Judah faced each other at Beth Shemesh in Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: But Amaziah would not listen. So Jehoash king of Israel went up, and he and Amaziah king of Judah faced one another in battle at Beth-shemesh, which belongs to Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Amaziah would not heed. Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went out; so he and Amaziah king of Judah faced one another at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: But Amaziah refused to listen, so King Jehoash of Israel mobilized his army against King Amaziah of Judah. The two armies drew up their battle lines at Beth-shemesh in Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: But Amaziah would not listen. So Jehoash king of Israel went up; and they faced each other, he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Beth-shemesh, which belongs to Judah.
verses.textEn: Amaziah, however, would not listen, so Jehoash king of Israel attacked. He and Amaziah king of Judah faced each other at Beth Shemesh in Judah.

verses.textZh: 犹大人被以色列人击败，各人逃回自己的家去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大人被以色列人击败，各人逃回自己的家去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大人败在以色列人面前，各自逃回家里去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Judah was routed by Israel, and every man fled to his home.
