verses.textEnEsv: And Judah was defeated by Israel, and every man fled to his home.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Judah was defeated by Israel, and every man fled to his tent.
verses.textEnNlt: Judah was routed by the army of Israel, and its army scattered and fled for home.
verses.textEnNasb: And Judah was defeated by Israel, and they fled, every man to his tent.
verses.textEn: Judah was routed by Israel, and every man fled to his home.

verses.textZh: 以色列王约阿施在伯．示麦捉住了亚哈谢的孙子、约阿施的儿子犹大王亚玛谢。他们来到耶路撒冷，拆毁了耶路撒冷一段城墙，从以法莲门直到角门，共两百公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王约阿施在伯．示麦捉住了亚哈谢的孙子、约阿施的儿子犹大王亚玛谢。他们来到耶路撒冷，拆毁了耶路撒冷一段城墙，从以法莲门直到角门，共两百公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王约阿施在伯‧示麦擒住亚哈谢的孙子、约阿施的儿子犹大王亚玛谢，就来到耶路撒冷，拆毁耶路撒冷的城墙，从以法莲门直到角门共四百肘，
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh. Then Jehoash went to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate—a section about four hundred cubits long.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash, son of Ahaziah, at Beth-shemesh, and came to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem for four hundred cubits, from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash, the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh; and he went to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Gate of Ephraim to the Corner Gate—four hundred cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: King Jehoash of Israel captured Judah’s king, Amaziah son of Joash and grandson of Ahaziah, at Beth-shemesh. Then he marched to Jerusalem, where he demolished 600 feet of Jerusalem’s wall, from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth-shemesh, and came to Jerusalem and tore down the wall of Jerusalem from the Gate of Ephraim to the Corner Gate, four hundred cubits.
verses.textEn: Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh. Then Jehoash went to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate—a section about four hundred cubits long.

verses.textZh: 又掠去耶和华殿里和王宫的宝库里找到的所有金子、银子和一切器皿，还有人质，就回撒玛利亚去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又掠去耶和华殿里和王宫的宝库里找到的所有金子、银子和一切器皿，还有人质，就回撒玛利亚去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 又将耶和华殿里与王宫府库里所有的金银和器皿都拿了去，并带人去为质，就回撒马利亚去了。
verses.textEnNiv: He took all the gold and silver and all the articles found in the temple of the Lord and in the treasuries of the royal palace. He also took hostages and returned to Samaria.
verses.textEnEsv: And he seized all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of the Lord and in the treasuries of the king’s house, also hostages, and he returned to Samaria.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he took all the gold and silver, all the articles that were found in the house of the Lord and in the treasuries of the king’s house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.
verses.textEnNlt: He carried off all the gold and silver and all the articles from the Temple of the Lord . He also seized the treasures from the royal palace, along with hostages, and then returned to Samaria.
verses.textEnNasb: And he took all the gold and silver and all the utensils which were found in the house of the Lord, and in the treasuries of the king’s house, the hostages as well, and returned to Samaria.
verses.textEn: He took all the gold and silver and all the articles found in the temple of the Lord and in the treasuries of the royal palace. He also took hostages and returned to Samaria.

verses.textZh: 约阿施其余的事迹和他的英勇事迹，就是与犹大王亚玛谢作战的事，不是都写在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 约阿施其余的事迹和他的英勇事迹，就是与犹大王亚玛谢作战的事，不是都写在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 约阿施其余所行的事和他的勇力，并与犹大王亚玛谢争战的事，都写在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of the reign of Jehoash, what he did and his achievements, including his war against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash that he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did—his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah—are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Jehoash’s reign and everything he did, including the extent of his power and his war with King Amaziah of Judah, are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Jehoash that he did, and his might and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of the reign of Jehoash, what he did and his achievements, including his war against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

verses.textZh: 约阿施和他的祖先一同长眠，他和以色列诸王一样，葬在撒玛利亚。他的儿子耶罗波安接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约阿施和他的祖先一同长眠，他和以色列诸王一样，葬在撒玛利亚。他的儿子耶罗波安接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 约阿施与他列祖同睡，葬在撒马利亚，以色列诸王的坟地里。他儿子耶罗波安接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoash rested with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. And Jeroboam his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jehoash slept with his fathers and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel, and Jeroboam his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jehoash rested with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. Then Jeroboam his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jehoash died, he was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. And his son Jeroboam II became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jehoash lay down with his fathers and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and his son Jeroboam became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Jehoash rested with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. And Jeroboam his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 以色列王约哈斯的儿子约阿施死后，犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢仍活了十五年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王约哈斯的儿子约阿施死后，犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢仍活了十五年。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王约哈斯的儿子约阿施死后，犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢又活了十五年。
verses.textEnNiv: Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived for fifteen years after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, lived fifteen years after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, lived fifteen years after the death of Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: King Amaziah of Judah lived for fifteen years after the death of King Jehoash of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived for fifteen years after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.
verses.textEn: Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived for fifteen years after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.

verses.textZh: 亚玛谢其余的事迹不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚玛谢其余的事迹不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛谢其余的事都写在犹大列王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Amaziah’s reign, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the deeds of Amaziah, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Amaziah’s reign are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Amaziah, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Amaziah’s reign, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

verses.textZh: 在耶路撒冷有人阴谋反叛他，他就逃到拉吉去。他们派人跟踪他到拉吉，就在那里把他杀死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶路撒冷有人阴谋反叛他，他就逃到拉吉去。他们派人跟踪他到拉吉，就在那里把他杀死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷有人背叛亚玛谢，他就逃到拉吉；叛党却打发人到拉吉将他杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: They conspired against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish, but they sent men after him to Lachish and killed him there.
verses.textEnEsv: And they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish. But they sent after him to Lachish and put him to death there.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they formed a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.
verses.textEnNlt: There was a conspiracy against Amaziah’s life in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish. But his enemies sent assassins after him, and they killed him there.
verses.textEnNasb: They formed a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish; but they sent men to Lachish after him and they killed him there.
verses.textEn: They conspired against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish, but they sent men after him to Lachish and killed him there.

verses.textZh: 他们把他的尸首驮在马背上运回来，葬在耶路撒冷，在大卫的城里，和他的祖先在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把他的尸首驮在马背上运回来，葬在耶路撒冷，在大卫的城里，和他的祖先在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 人就用马将他的尸首驮到耶路撒冷，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。
verses.textEnNiv: He was brought back by horse and was buried in Jerusalem with his ancestors, in the City of David.
verses.textEnEsv: And they brought him on horses; and he was buried in Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they brought him on horses, and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the City of David.
verses.textEnNlt: They brought his body back to Jerusalem on a horse, and he was buried with his ancestors in the City of David.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they carried him on horses, and he was buried in Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David.
verses.textEn: He was brought back by horse and was buried in Jerusalem with his ancestors, in the City of David.

verses.textZh: 犹大的众民选立了亚撒利雅；他只有十六岁，他们就立他接续他父亲亚玛谢作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大的众民选立了亚撒利雅；他只有十六岁，他们就立他接续他父亲亚玛谢作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大众民立亚玛谢的儿子亚撒利雅 接续他父作王，那时他年十六岁。
verses.textEnNiv: Then all the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.
verses.textEnNlt: All the people of Judah had crowned Amaziah’s sixteen-year-old son, Uzziah, as king in place of his father, Amaziah.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.
verses.textEn: Then all the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.

verses.textZh: 亚玛谢和他的祖先一同长眠以后，亚撒利雅重建了以拉他，并且收归犹大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚玛谢和他的祖先一同长眠以后，亚撒利雅重建了以拉他，并且收归犹大。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛谢与他列祖同睡之后，亚撒利雅收回以拉他仍归犹大，又重新修理。
verses.textEnNiv: He was the one who rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah after Amaziah rested with his ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: He built Elath and restored it to Judah, after the king slept with his fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: He built Elath and restored it to Judah, after the king rested with his fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: After his father’s death, Uzziah rebuilt the town of Elath and restored it to Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: He built Elath and restored it to Judah after the king lay down with his fathers.
verses.textEn: He was the one who rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah after Amaziah rested with his ancestors.

verses.textZh: 犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢十五年，以色列王约阿施的儿子耶罗波安在撒玛利亚登基，他作王共四十一年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢十五年，以色列王约阿施的儿子耶罗波安在撒玛利亚登基，他作王共四十一年。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢十五年，以色列王约阿施的儿子耶罗波安在撒马利亚登基，作王四十一年。
verses.textEnNiv: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah, Jeroboam son of Jehoash king of Israel became king in Samaria, and he reigned forty-one years.
verses.textEnEsv: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel, began to reign in Samaria, and he reigned forty-one years.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel, became king in Samaria, andreigned forty-one years.
verses.textEnNlt: Jeroboam II, the son of Jehoash, began to rule over Israel in the fifteenth year of King Amaziah’s reign in Judah. He reigned in Samaria forty-one years.
verses.textEnNasb: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah, Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel became king in Samaria, and reigned for forty-one years.
verses.textEn: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah, Jeroboam son of Jehoash king of Israel became king in Samaria, and he reigned forty-one years.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，不转离尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷于罪中的一切罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，不转离尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷于罪中的一切罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的一切罪。
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord and did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was evil in the sight of the Lord . He did not depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which he made Israel to sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord; he did not depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who had made Israel sin.
verses.textEnNlt: He did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight. He refused to turn from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had led Israel to commit.
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord; he did not abandon all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, into which he misled Israel.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord and did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.

verses.textZh: 他收复以色列的边境，从哈马口直到亚拉巴海，正如耶和华以色列的神的话，就是借着他的仆人迦特希弗人亚米太的儿子约拿先知所说的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他收复以色列的边境，从哈马口直到亚拉巴海，正如耶和华以色列的神的话，就是借着他的仆人迦特希弗人亚米太的儿子约拿先知所说的；
verses.textZhCuv: 他收回以色列边界之地，从哈马口直到亚拉巴海，正如耶和华－以色列的神藉他仆人迦特希弗人亚米太的儿子先知约拿所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: He was the one who restored the boundaries of Israel from Lebo Hamath to the Dead Sea, in accordance with the word of the Lord , the God of Israel, spoken through his servant Jonah son of Amittai, the prophet from Gath Hepher.
verses.textEnEsv: He restored the border of Israel from Lebo-hamath as far as the Sea of the Arabah, according to the word of the Lord , the God of Israel, which he spoke by his servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet, who was from Gath-hepher.
verses.textEnNkjv: He restored the territory of Israel from the entrance of Hamath to the Sea of the Arabah, according to the word of the Lord God of Israel, which He had spoken through His servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet who was from Gath Hepher.
verses.textEnNlt: Jeroboam II recovered the territories of Israel between Lebo-hamath and the Dead Sea, just as the Lord , the God of Israel, had promised through Jonah son of Amittai, the prophet from Gath-hepher.
verses.textEnNasb: He restored the border of Israel from the entrance of Hamath as far as the Sea of the Arabah, in accordance with the word of the Lord, the God of Israel, which He spoke through His servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet, who was from Gath-hepher.
verses.textEn: He was the one who restored the boundaries of Israel from Lebo Hamath to the Dead Sea, in accordance with the word of the Lord , the God of Israel, spoken through his servant Jonah son of Amittai, the prophet from Gath Hepher.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华看见以色列十分艰苦，无论是自由的或为奴的都没有了，也没有帮助以色列的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华看见以色列十分艰苦，无论是自由的或为奴的都没有了，也没有帮助以色列的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华看见以色列人甚是艰苦，无论困住的、自由的都没有了，也无人帮助以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord had seen how bitterly everyone in Israel, whether slave or free, was suffering; there was no one to help them.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord saw that the affliction of Israel was very bitter, for there was none left, bond or free, and there was none to help Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord saw that the affliction of Israel was very bitter; and whether bond or free, there was no helper for Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord saw the bitter suffering of everyone in Israel, and that there was no one in Israel, slave or free, to help them.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord saw the misery of Israel, which was very bitter; for there was neither bond nor free spared, nor was there any helper for Israel.
verses.textEn: The Lord had seen how bitterly everyone in Israel, whether slave or free, was suffering; there was no one to help them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华没有定命要将以色列的名从天下涂抹，所以借着约阿施的儿子耶罗波安的手拯救他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华没有定命要将以色列的名从天下涂抹，所以借着约阿施的儿子耶罗波安的手拯救他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华并没有说要将以色列的名从天下涂抹，乃藉约阿施的儿子耶罗波安拯救他们。
verses.textEnNiv: And since the Lord had not said he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven, he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam son of Jehoash.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord had not said that he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven, so he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord did not say that He would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven; but He saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.
verses.textEnNlt: And because the Lord had not said he would blot out the name of Israel completely, he used Jeroboam II, the son of Jehoash, to save them.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet the Lord did not say that He would wipe out the name of Israel from under heaven, but He saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.
verses.textEn: And since the Lord had not said he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven, he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam son of Jehoash.

verses.textZh: 耶罗波安其余的事迹和他所行的一切，以及他作战时的英勇，怎样收复大马士革和原属犹大的哈马归以色列，不是都写在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶罗波安其余的事迹和他所行的一切，以及他作战时的英勇，怎样收复大马士革和原属犹大的哈马归以色列，不是都写在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶罗波安其余的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力，他怎样争战，怎样收回大马士革和先前属犹大的哈马归以色列，都写在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Jeroboam’s reign, all he did, and his military achievements, including how he recovered for Israel both Damascus and Hamath, which had belonged to Judah, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam and all that he did, and his might, how he fought, and how he restored Damascus and Hamath to Judah in Israel, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did—his might, how he made war, and how he recaptured for Israel, from Damascus and Hamath, whathadbelonged to Judah—are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in the reign of Jeroboam II and everything he did—including the extent of his power, his wars, and how he recovered for Israel both Damascus and Hamath, which had belonged to Judah —are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Jeroboam and all that he did and his might, how he fought and how he recovered for Israel Damascus and Hamath, which had belonged to Judah, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Jeroboam’s reign, all he did, and his military achievements, including how he recovered for Israel both Damascus and Hamath, which had belonged to Judah, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

verses.textZh: 耶罗波安和他的祖先以色列诸王一同长眠。他的儿子撒迦利雅就接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶罗波安和他的祖先以色列诸王一同长眠。他的儿子撒迦利雅就接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶罗波安与他列祖以色列诸王同睡。他儿子撒迦利雅接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Jeroboam rested with his ancestors, the kings of Israel. And Zechariah his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers, the kings of Israel, and Zechariah his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jeroboam rested with his fathers, the kings of Israel. Then Zechariah his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jeroboam II died, he was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. Then his son Zechariah became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jeroboam lay down with his fathers, with the kings of Israel, and his son Zechariah became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Jeroboam rested with his ancestors, the kings of Israel. And Zechariah his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 以色列王耶罗波安在位第二十七年，犹大王亚玛谢的儿子亚撒利雅登基作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王耶罗波安在位第二十七年，犹大王亚玛谢的儿子亚撒利雅登基作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王耶罗波安二十七年，犹大王亚玛谢的儿子亚撒利雅登基，
verses.textEnNiv: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah began to reign.
verses.textEnEsv: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah the son of Amaziah, king of Judah, began to reign.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah the son of Amaziah, king of Judah, became king.
verses.textEnNlt: Uzziah son of Amaziah began to rule over Judah in the twenty-seventh year of the reign of King Jeroboam II of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah became king.
verses.textEn: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah began to reign.

verses.textZh: 他登基的时候才十六岁，他在耶路撒冷作王五十二年。他母亲名叫耶可利雅，是来自耶路撒冷的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他登基的时候才十六岁，他在耶路撒冷作王五十二年。他母亲名叫耶可利雅，是来自耶路撒冷的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他登基的时候年十六岁，在耶路撒冷作王五十二年。他母亲名叫耶可利雅，是耶路撒冷人。
verses.textEnNiv: He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two years. His mother’s name was Jekoliah; she was from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: He was sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jecholiah of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two years. His mother was Jecoliah from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned for fifty-two years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two years. His mother’s name was Jekoliah; she was from Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为正的事，就像他父亲亚玛谢所行的一切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为正的事，就像他父亲亚玛谢所行的一切。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒利雅行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他父亲亚玛谢一切所行的；
verses.textEnNiv: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father Amaziah had done.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , according to all that his father Amaziah had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father Amaziah had done,
verses.textEnNlt: He did what was pleasing in the Lord ’s sight, just as his father, Amaziah, had done.
verses.textEnNasb: He did what was right in the sight of the Lord, in accordance with everything that his father Amaziah had done.
verses.textEn: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father Amaziah had done.

verses.textZh: 只是邱坛还没有废去，人民仍在邱坛献祭焚香。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是邱坛还没有废去，人民仍在邱坛献祭焚香。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是邱坛还没有废去，百姓仍在那里献祭烧香。
verses.textEnNiv: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and made offerings on the high places.
verses.textEnNkjv: except that the high places were not removed; the people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.
verses.textEnNlt: But he did not destroy the pagan shrines, and the people still offered sacrifices and burned incense there.
verses.textEnNasb: Only the high places were not eliminated; the people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.
verses.textEn: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.

verses.textZh: 耶和华击打王，他就患了痲风病，直到他死的日子。于是他住在隔离的房子，他的儿子约坦执掌朝务，治理国民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华击打王，他就患了痲风病，直到他死的日子。于是他住在隔离的房子，他的儿子约坦执掌朝务，治理国民。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华降灾与王，使他长大麻风，直到死日，他就住在别的宫里。他的儿子约坦管理家事，治理国民。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord afflicted the king with leprosy until the day he died, and he lived in a separate house. Jotham the king’s son had charge of the palace and governed the people of the land.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord touched the king, so that he was a leper to the day of his death, and he lived in a separate house. And Jotham the king’s son was over the household, governing the people of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord struck the king, so that he was a leper until the day of his death; so he dwelt in an isolated house. And Jotham the king’s son was over the royal house, judging the people of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord struck the king with leprosy, which lasted until the day he died. He lived in isolation in a separate house. The king’s son Jotham was put in charge of the royal palace, and he governed the people of the land.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord afflicted the king, so that he had leprosy to the day of his death. And he lived in a separate house, while Jotham the king’s son was in charge of the household, judging the people of the land.
verses.textEn: The Lord afflicted the king with leprosy until the day he died, and he lived in a separate house. Jotham the king’s son had charge of the palace and governed the people of the land.

verses.textZh: 亚撒利雅其余的事迹和他所行的一切，不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒利雅其余的事迹和他所行的一切，不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒利雅其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Azariah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Uzziah’s reign and everything he did are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Azariah and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Azariah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

verses.textZh: 亚撒利雅和他的祖先一同长眠，葬在大卫的城，和他的祖先在一起。他的儿子约坦接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒利雅和他的祖先一同长眠，葬在大卫的城，和他的祖先在一起。他的儿子约坦接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒利雅与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子约坦接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Azariah rested with his ancestors and was buried near them in the City of David. And Jotham his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Azariah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David, and Jotham his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Azariah rested with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the City of David. Then Jotham his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Uzziah died, he was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. And his son Jotham became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: And Azariah lay down with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David, and his son Jotham became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Azariah rested with his ancestors and was buried near them in the City of David. And Jotham his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 犹大王亚撒利雅在位第三十八年，耶罗波安的儿子撒迦利雅在撒玛利亚登基，统治以色列共六个月。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王亚撒利雅在位第三十八年，耶罗波安的儿子撒迦利雅在撒玛利亚登基，统治以色列共六个月。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王亚撒利雅三十八年，耶罗波安的儿子撒迦利雅在撒马利亚作以色列王六个月。
verses.textEnNiv: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned six months.
verses.textEnEsv: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah the son of Jeroboam reigned over Israel in Samaria six months.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah the son of Jeroboam reigned over Israel in Samaria six months.
verses.textEnNlt: Zechariah son of Jeroboam II began to rule over Israel in the thirty-eighth year of King Uzziah’s reign in Judah. He reigned in Samaria six months.
verses.textEnNasb: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah the son of Jeroboam became king over Israel in Samaria for six months.
verses.textEn: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned six months.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，好象他祖先所行的，没有转离尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷于罪中的那些罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，好象他祖先所行的，没有转离尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷于罪中的那些罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他列祖所行的，不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , as his predecessors had done. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , as his fathers had done. He did not depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which he made Israel to sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, as his fathers had done; he did not depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who had made Israel sin.
verses.textEnNlt: Zechariah did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight, as his ancestors had done. He refused to turn from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had led Israel to commit.
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord, just as his fathers had done; he did not desist from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, into which he misled Israel.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , as his predecessors had done. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.

verses.textZh: 雅比的儿子沙龙阴谋反叛他，在人民面前把他杀死，接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅比的儿子沙龙阴谋反叛他，在人民面前把他杀死，接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅比的儿子沙龙背叛他，在百姓面前击杀他，篡了他的位。
verses.textEnNiv: Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against Zechariah. He attacked him in front of the people, assassinated him and succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him and struck him down at Ibleam and put him to death and reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and struck and killed him in front of the people; and he reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against Zechariah, assassinated him in public, and became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and struck him in the presence of the people and killed him, and reigned in his place.
verses.textEn: Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against Zechariah. He attacked him in front of the people, assassinated him and succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 撒迦利雅其余的事迹，看哪，都写在以色列诸王的年代志上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒迦利雅其余的事迹，看哪，都写在以色列诸王的年代志上。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒迦利雅其余的事都写在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: The other events of Zechariah’s reign are written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the deeds of Zechariah, behold, they are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Zechariah, indeed they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Zechariah’s reign are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Zechariah, behold they are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEn: The other events of Zechariah’s reign are written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel.

verses.textZh: 这就是耶和华曾论到有关耶户的话说："你的子孙必坐在以色列的王位上，直到第四代。"这话果然应验了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就是耶和华曾论到有关耶户的话说："你的子孙必坐在以色列的王位上，直到第四代。"这话果然应验了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是从前耶和华应许耶户说：「你的子孙必坐以色列的国位直到四代。」这话果然应验了。
verses.textEnNiv: So the word of the Lord spoken to Jehu was fulfilled: "Your descendants will sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation."
verses.textEnEsv: (This was the promise of the Lord that he gave to Jehu, "Your sons shall sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation." And so it came to pass.)
verses.textEnNkjv: This was the word of the Lord which He spoke to Jehu, saying, "Your sons shall sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation." And so it was.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord ’s message to Jehu came true: "Your descendants will be kings of Israel down to the fourth generation."
verses.textEnNasb: This is the word of the Lord which He spoke to Jehu, saying, "Your sons to the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel." And so it was.
verses.textEn: So the word of the Lord spoken to Jehu was fulfilled: "Your descendants will sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation."

verses.textZh: 犹大王乌西雅在位第三十九年，雅比的儿子沙龙登基作王；他在撒玛利亚作王一个月。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王乌西雅在位第三十九年，雅比的儿子沙龙登基作王；他在撒玛利亚作王一个月。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王乌西雅 三十九年，雅比的儿子沙龙登基在撒马利亚作王一个月。
verses.textEnNiv: Shallum son of Jabesh became king in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah, and he reigned in Samaria one month.
verses.textEnEsv: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah, and he reigned one month in Samaria.
verses.textEnNkjv: Shallum the son of Jabesh became king in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah; and he reigned a full month in Samaria.
verses.textEnNlt: Shallum son of Jabesh began to rule over Israel in the thirty-ninth year of King Uzziah’s reign in Judah. Shallum reigned in Samaria only one month.
verses.textEnNasb: Shallum the son of Jabesh became king in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah, and he reigned for one month in Samaria.
verses.textEn: Shallum son of Jabesh became king in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah, and he reigned in Samaria one month.

verses.textZh: 迦底的儿子米拿现从得撒上去，到撒玛利亚攻击雅比人沙龙，把他杀死，接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦底的儿子米拿现从得撒上去，到撒玛利亚攻击雅比人沙龙，把他杀死，接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦底的儿子米拿现从得撒上撒马利亚，杀了雅比的儿子沙龙，篡了他的位。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Menahem son of Gadi went from Tirzah up to Samaria. He attacked Shallum son of Jabesh in Samaria, assassinated him and succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Menahem the son of Gadi came up from Tirzah and came to Samaria, and he struck down Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria and put him to death and reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, came to Samaria, and struck Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria and killed him; and he reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Menahem son of Gadi went to Samaria from Tirzah and assassinated him, and he became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah and came to Samaria, and struck Shallum son of Jabesh in Samaria, and killed him and became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Then Menahem son of Gadi went from Tirzah up to Samaria. He attacked Shallum son of Jabesh in Samaria, assassinated him and succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 沙龙其余的事迹和他反叛的经过，看哪，都写在以色列诸王的年代志上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沙龙其余的事迹和他反叛的经过，看哪，都写在以色列诸王的年代志上。
verses.textZhCuv: 沙龙其余的事和他背叛的情形都写在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: The other events of Shallum’s reign, and the conspiracy he led, are written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the deeds of Shallum, and the conspiracy that he made, behold, they are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Shallum, and the conspiracy which he led, indeed they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Shallum’s reign, including his conspiracy, are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Shallum and his conspiracy which he formed, behold, they are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEn: The other events of Shallum’s reign, and the conspiracy he led, are written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel.

verses.textZh: 那时，米拿现从得撒开始，攻打提斐萨和城中所有的人，以及它的四境；因为他们不给他打开城门，所以他攻击它，把所有的孕妇剖腹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，米拿现从得撒开始，攻打提斐萨和城中所有的人，以及它的四境；因为他们不给他打开城门，所以他攻击它，把所有的孕妇剖腹。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时米拿现从得撒起攻打提斐萨和其四境，击杀城中一切的人，剖开其中所有的孕妇，都因他们没有给他开城。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time Menahem, starting out from Tirzah, attacked Tiphsah and everyone in the city and its vicinity, because they refused to open their gates. He sacked Tiphsah and ripped open all the pregnant women.
verses.textEnEsv: At that time Menahem sacked Tiphsah and all who were in it and its territory from Tirzah on, because they did not open it to him. Therefore he sacked it, and he ripped open all the women in it who were pregnant.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then from Tirzah, Menahem attacked Tiphsah, all who were there, and its territory. Because they did not surrender, therefore he attacked it. All the women there who were with child he ripped open.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time Menahem destroyed the town of Tappuah and all the surrounding countryside as far as Tirzah, because its citizens refused to surrender the town. He killed the entire population and ripped open the pregnant women.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Menahem attacked Tiphsah and all who were in it and its borders from Tirzah, because they did not open up to him; so he attacked it and ripped up all its women who were pregnant.
verses.textEn: At that time Menahem, starting out from Tirzah, attacked Tiphsah and everyone in the city and its vicinity, because they refused to open their gates. He sacked Tiphsah and ripped open all the pregnant women.

verses.textZh: 犹大王亚撒利雅在位第三十九年，迦底的儿子米拿现在撒玛利亚登基，统治以色列共十年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王亚撒利雅在位第三十九年，迦底的儿子米拿现在撒玛利亚登基，统治以色列共十年。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王亚撒利雅三十九年，迦底的儿子米拿现登基，在撒马利亚作以色列王十年。
verses.textEnNiv: In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem son of Gadi became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria ten years.
verses.textEnEsv: In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem the son of Gadi began to reign over Israel, and he reigned ten years in Samaria.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem the son of Gadi became king over Israel, andreigned ten years in Samaria.
verses.textEnNlt: Menahem son of Gadi began to rule over Israel in the thirty-ninth year of King Uzziah’s reign in Judah. He reigned in Samaria ten years.
verses.textEnNasb: In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem the son of Gadi became king over Israel and reigned for ten years in Samaria.
verses.textEn: In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem son of Gadi became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria ten years.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，他在位的日子，没有转离尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷于罪中的那些罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，他在位的日子，没有转离尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷于罪中的那些罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，终身不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord . During his entire reign he did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was evil in the sight of the Lord . He did not depart all his days from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which he made Israel to sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord; he did not depart all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who had made Israel sin.
verses.textEnNlt: But Menahem did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight. During his entire reign, he refused to turn from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had led Israel to commit.
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord; for all his days he did not desist from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, into which he misled Israel.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord . During his entire reign he did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.

verses.textZh: 亚述王普勒来攻打以色列地，米拿现给普勒三万公斤银子，请普勒帮助他坚固王位。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述王普勒来攻打以色列地，米拿现给普勒三万公斤银子，请普勒帮助他坚固王位。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述王普勒来攻击以色列国，米拿现给他一千他连得银子，请普勒帮助他坚定国位。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Pul king of Assyria invaded the land, and Menahem gave him a thousand talents of silver to gain his support and strengthen his own hold on the kingdom.
verses.textEnEsv: Pul the king of Assyria came against the land, and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that he might help him to confirm his hold on the royal power.
verses.textEnNkjv: Pul king of Assyria came against the land; and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to strengthen the kingdom under his control.
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Tiglath-pileser of Assyria invaded the land. But Menahem paid him thirty-seven tons of silver to gain his support in tightening his grip on royal power.
verses.textEnNasb: Pul, the king of Assyria, came against the land, and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver so that his hand might be with him to strengthen the kingdom under his rule.
verses.textEn: Then Pul king of Assyria invaded the land, and Menahem gave him a thousand talents of silver to gain his support and strengthen his own hold on the kingdom.

verses.textZh: 米拿现向以色列人，就是所有大财主强索银子，每人五百七十克，好献给亚述王。于是亚述王回去了，不在以色列地停留。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米拿现向以色列人，就是所有大财主强索银子，每人五百七十克，好献给亚述王。于是亚述王回去了，不在以色列地停留。
verses.textZhCuv: 米拿现向以色列一切大富户索要银子，使他们各出五十舍客勒，就给了亚述王。于是亚述王回去，不在国中停留。
verses.textEnNiv: Menahem exacted this money from Israel. Every wealthy person had to contribute fifty shekels of silver to be given to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria withdrew and stayed in the land no longer.
verses.textEnEsv: Menahem exacted the money from Israel, that is, from all the wealthy men, fifty shekels of silver from every man, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back and did not stay there in the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Menahem exacted the money from Israel, from all the very wealthy, from each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and did not stay there in the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Menahem extorted the money from the rich of Israel, demanding that each of them pay fifty pieces of silver to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned from attacking Israel and did not stay in the land.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Menahem collected the money from Israel, from all the mighty men of wealth, from each man fifty shekels of silver to pay the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria returned and did not stay there in the land.
verses.textEn: Menahem exacted this money from Israel. Every wealthy person had to contribute fifty shekels of silver to be given to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria withdrew and stayed in the land no longer.

verses.textZh: 米拿现其余的事迹和他所行的一切，不是都写在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 米拿现其余的事迹和他所行的一切，不是都写在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 米拿现其余的事，凡他所行的都写在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Menahem’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the deeds of Menahem and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Menahem’s reign and everything he did are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Menahem and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Menahem’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

verses.textZh: 米拿现和他的祖先一同长眠，他的儿子比加辖接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米拿现和他的祖先一同长眠，他的儿子比加辖接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 米拿现与他列祖同睡。他儿子比加辖接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Menahem rested with his ancestors. And Pekahiah his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Menahem slept with his fathers, and Pekahiah his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Menahem rested with his fathers. Then Pekahiah his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Menahem died, his son Pekahiah became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: And Menahem lay down with his fathers, and his son Pekahiah became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Menahem rested with his ancestors. And Pekahiah his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 犹大王亚撒利雅在位第五十年，米拿现的儿子比加辖在撒玛利亚登基，统治以色列二年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王亚撒利雅在位第五十年，米拿现的儿子比加辖在撒玛利亚登基，统治以色列二年。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王亚撒利雅五十年，米拿现的儿子比加辖在撒马利亚登基作以色列王二年。
verses.textEnNiv: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah son of Menahem became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned two years.
verses.textEnEsv: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and he reigned two years.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah the son of Menahem became king over Israel in Samaria, andreigned two years.
verses.textEnNlt: Pekahiah son of Menahem began to rule over Israel in the fiftieth year of King Uzziah’s reign in Judah. He reigned in Samaria two years.
verses.textEnNasb: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah the son of Menahem became king over Israel in Samaria, and reigned for two years.
verses.textEn: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah son of Menahem became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned two years.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，不转离尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷于罪中的那些罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，不转离尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷于罪中的那些罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Pekahiah did evil in the eyes of the Lord . He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was evil in the sight of the Lord . He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which he made Israel to sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord; he did not depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who had made Israel sin.
verses.textEnNlt: But Pekahiah did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight. He refused to turn from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had led Israel to commit.
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord; he did not desist from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, into which he misled Israel.
verses.textEn: Pekahiah did evil in the eyes of the Lord . He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.

verses.textZh: 比加辖的军长，利玛利的儿子比加阴谋背叛他，在撒玛利亚王宫的卫所击杀他；与比加同谋的，有亚珥歌伯和亚利耶，以及和他一起的五十个基列人；比加把他杀死，接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 比加辖的军长，利玛利的儿子比加阴谋背叛他，在撒玛利亚王宫的卫所击杀他；与比加同谋的，有亚珥歌伯和亚利耶，以及和他一起的五十个基列人；比加把他杀死，接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 比加辖的将军、利玛利的儿子比加背叛他，在撒马利亚王宫里的卫所杀了他。亚珥歌伯和亚利耶并基列的五十人帮助比加；比加击杀他，篡了他的位。
verses.textEnNiv: One of his chief officers, Pekah son of Remaliah, conspired against him. Taking fifty men of Gilead with him, he assassinated Pekahiah, along with Argob and Arieh, in the citadel of the royal palace at Samaria. So Pekah killed Pekahiah and succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Pekah the son of Remaliah, his captain, conspired against him with fifty men of the people of Gilead, and struck him down in Samaria, in the citadel of the king’s house with Argob and Arieh; he put him to death and reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pekah the son of Remaliah, an officer of his, conspired against him and killed him in Samaria, in the citadel of the king’s house, along with Argob and Arieh; and with him were fifty men of Gilead. He killed him and reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pekah son of Remaliah, the commander of Pekahiah’s army, conspired against him. With fifty men from Gilead, Pekah assassinated the king, along with Argob and Arieh, in the citadel of the palace at Samaria. And Pekah reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pekah the son of Remaliah, his officer, conspired against him and struck him in Samaria, in the castle of the king’s house with Argob and Arieh; and with him were fifty men of the Gileadites, and he killed him and became king in his place.
verses.textEn: One of his chief officers, Pekah son of Remaliah, conspired against him. Taking fifty men of Gilead with him, he assassinated Pekahiah, along with Argob and Arieh, in the citadel of the royal palace at Samaria. So Pekah killed Pekahiah and succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 比加辖其余的事迹和他所行的一切，看哪，都写在以色列诸王的年代志上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 比加辖其余的事迹和他所行的一切，看哪，都写在以色列诸王的年代志上。
verses.textZhCuv: 比加辖其余的事，凡他所行的都写在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: The other events of Pekahiah’s reign, and all he did, are written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the deeds of Pekahiah and all that he did, behold, they are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, indeed they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Pekahiah’s reign and everything he did are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Pekahiah and everything that he did, behold, they are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEn: The other events of Pekahiah’s reign, and all he did, are written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel.

verses.textZh: 犹大王亚撒利雅在位第五十二年，利玛利的儿子比加在撒玛利亚作王统治以色列共二十年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王亚撒利雅在位第五十二年，利玛利的儿子比加在撒玛利亚作王统治以色列共二十年。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王亚撒利雅五十二年，利玛利的儿子比加在撒马利亚登基作以色列王二十年。
verses.textEnNiv: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah son of Remaliah became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned twenty years.
verses.textEnEsv: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and he reigned twenty years.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah the son of Remaliah became king over Israel in Samaria, andreigned twenty years.
verses.textEnNlt: Pekah son of Remaliah began to rule over Israel in the fifty-second year of King Uzziah’s reign in Judah. He reigned in Samaria twenty years.
verses.textEnNasb: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah the son of Remaliah became king over Israel in Samaria, and he reigned for twenty years.
verses.textEn: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah son of Remaliah became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned twenty years.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，不转离尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷于罪中的那些罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，不转离尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷于罪中的那些罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord . He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was evil in the sight of the Lord . He did not depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which he made Israel to sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord; he did not depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who had made Israel sin.
verses.textEnNlt: But Pekah did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight. He refused to turn from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had led Israel to commit.
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord; he did not desist from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, into which he misled Israel.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord . He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.

verses.textZh: 以色列王比加在位的日子，亚述王提革拉．毘列色前来，攻取了以云、亚伯．伯．玛迦、亚挪、基低斯、夏琐、基列、加利利和拿弗他利全地，把居民掳到亚述去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王比加在位的日子，亚述王提革拉．毘列色前来，攻取了以云、亚伯．伯．玛迦、亚挪、基低斯、夏琐、基列、加利利和拿弗他利全地，把居民掳到亚述去。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王比加年间，亚述王提革拉‧毗列色来夺了以云、亚伯‧伯‧玛迦、亚挪、基低斯、夏琐、基列、加利利，和拿弗他利全地，将这些地方的居民都掳到亚述去了。
verses.textEnNiv: In the time of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maakah, Janoah, Kedesh and Hazor. He took Gilead and Galilee, including all the land of Naphtali, and deported the people to Assyria.
verses.textEnEsv: In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria came and captured Ijon, Abel-beth-maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali, and he carried the people captive to Assyria.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maachah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali; and he carried them captive to Assyria.
verses.textEnNlt: During Pekah’s reign, King Tiglath-pileser of Assyria attacked Israel again, and he captured the towns of Ijon, Abel-beth-maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, and Hazor. He also conquered the regions of Gilead, Galilee, and all of Naphtali, and he took the people to Assyria as captives.
verses.textEnNasb: In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath-pileser the king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel-beth-maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali; and he led their populations into exile to Assyria.
verses.textEn: In the time of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maakah, Janoah, Kedesh and Hazor. He took Gilead and Galilee, including all the land of Naphtali, and deported the people to Assyria.

verses.textZh: 乌西雅的儿子约坦在位第二十年，以拉的儿子何细亚阴谋背叛利玛利的儿子比加，击打他，把他杀死，接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌西雅的儿子约坦在位第二十年，以拉的儿子何细亚阴谋背叛利玛利的儿子比加，击打他，把他杀死，接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌西雅的儿子约坦二十年，以拉的儿子何细亚背叛利玛利的儿子比加，击杀他，篡了他的位。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Hoshea son of Elah conspired against Pekah son of Remaliah. He attacked and assassinated him, and then succeeded him as king in the twentieth year of Jotham son of Uzziah.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah and struck him down and put him to death and reigned in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hoshea the son of Elah led a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and struck and killed him; so he reigned in his place in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Hoshea son of Elah conspired against Pekah and assassinated him. He began to rule over Israel in the twentieth year of Jotham son of Uzziah.
verses.textEnNasb: And Hoshea the son of Elah formed a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and struck him and put him to death, and he became king in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.
verses.textEn: Then Hoshea son of Elah conspired against Pekah son of Remaliah. He attacked and assassinated him, and then succeeded him as king in the twentieth year of Jotham son of Uzziah.

verses.textZh: 比加其余的事迹和他所行的一切，看哪，都写在以色列诸王的年代志上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 比加其余的事迹和他所行的一切，看哪，都写在以色列诸王的年代志上。
verses.textZhCuv: 比加其余的事，凡他所行的都写在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Pekah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Pekah and all that he did, behold, they are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, indeed they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Pekah’s reign and everything he did are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Pekah and all that he did, behold, they are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Pekah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

verses.textZh: 以色列王利玛利的儿子比加在位第二年，乌西雅的儿子约坦登基作犹大王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王利玛利的儿子比加在位第二年，乌西雅的儿子约坦登基作犹大王。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王利玛利的儿子比加第二年，犹大王乌西雅的儿子约坦登基。
verses.textEnNiv: In the second year of Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel, Jotham son of Uzziah king of Judah began to reign.
verses.textEnEsv: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, Jotham the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, began to reign.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, Jotham the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, began to reign.
verses.textEnNlt: Jotham son of Uzziah began to rule over Judah in the second year of King Pekah’s reign in Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel, Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah became king.
verses.textEn: In the second year of Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel, Jotham son of Uzziah king of Judah began to reign.

verses.textZh: 他登基的时候是二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年。他母亲名叫耶路沙，是撒督的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他登基的时候是二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年。他母亲名叫耶路沙，是撒督的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 他登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年。他母亲名叫耶路沙，是撒督的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. His mother’s name was Jerusha daughter of Zadok.
verses.textEnEsv: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerusha the daughter of Zadok.
verses.textEnNkjv: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerusha the daughter of Zadok.
verses.textEnNlt: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. His mother was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.
verses.textEnNasb: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned for sixteen years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Jerusha the daughter of Zadok.
verses.textEn: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. His mother’s name was Jerusha daughter of Zadok.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为正的事，效法他父亲乌西雅一切所行的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为正的事，效法他父亲乌西雅一切所行的。
verses.textZhCuv: 约坦行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他父亲乌西雅一切所行的；
verses.textEnNiv: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father Uzziah had done.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord; he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
verses.textEnNlt: Jotham did what was pleasing in the Lord ’s sight. He did everything his father, Uzziah, had done.
verses.textEnNasb: He did what was right in the sight of the Lord; he acted in accordance with everything that his father Uzziah had done.
verses.textEn: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father Uzziah had done.

verses.textZh: 只是他没有把邱坛废去，国民仍在邱坛献祭焚香。他就是那建造耶和华殿的上门的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是他没有把邱坛废去，国民仍在邱坛献祭焚香。他就是那建造耶和华殿的上门的。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是邱坛还没有废去，百姓仍在那里献祭烧香。约坦建立耶和华殿的上门。
verses.textEnNiv: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there. Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, the high places were not removed. The people still sacrificed and made offerings on the high places. He built the upper gate of the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: However the high places were not removed; the people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places. He built the Upper Gate of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But he did not destroy the pagan shrines, and the people still offered sacrifices and burned incense there. He rebuilt the upper gate of the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Only the high places were not eliminated; the people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places. He built the upper gate of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there. Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 约坦所行其余的事迹，不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 约坦所行其余的事迹，不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 约坦其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Jotham’s reign, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Jotham’s reign and everything he did are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Jotham which he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Jotham’s reign, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

verses.textZh: 在那些日子，耶和华开始派遣亚兰王利汛和利玛利的儿子比加去攻击犹大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那些日子，耶和华开始派遣亚兰王利汛和利玛利的儿子比加去攻击犹大。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那些日子，耶和华才使亚兰王利汛和利玛利的儿子比加去攻击犹大。
verses.textEnNiv: (In those days the Lord began to send Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah against Judah.)
verses.textEnEsv: In those days the Lord began to send Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah against Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: In those days the Lord began to send Rezin king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah against Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: In those days the Lord began to send King Rezin of Aram and King Pekah of Israel to attack Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: In those days the Lord began to send Rezin the king of Aram and Pekah the son of Remaliah against Judah.
verses.textEn: (In those days the Lord began to send Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah against Judah.)

verses.textZh: 约坦和他的祖先一同长眠，也和他的祖先葬在一起，在他祖宗大卫的城里。他的儿子亚哈斯接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约坦和他的祖先一同长眠，也和他的祖先葬在一起，在他祖宗大卫的城里。他的儿子亚哈斯接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 约坦与他列祖同睡，葬在他祖大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子亚哈斯接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Jotham rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David, the city of his father. And Ahaz his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: Jotham slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father, and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jotham rested with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the City of David his father. Then Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jotham died, he was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. And his son Ahaz became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jotham lay down with his fathers, and he was buried with his fathers in the city of his father David; and his son Ahaz became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Jotham rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David, the city of his father. And Ahaz his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 利玛利的儿子比加在位第十七年，犹大王约坦的儿子亚哈斯登基作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利玛利的儿子比加在位第十七年，犹大王约坦的儿子亚哈斯登基作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 利玛利的儿子比加十七年，犹大王约坦的儿子亚哈斯登基。
verses.textEnNiv: In the seventeenth year of Pekah son of Remaliah, Ahaz son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.
verses.textEnEsv: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah, Ahaz the son of Jotham, king of Judah, began to reign.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah, Ahaz the son of Jotham, king of Judah, began to reign.
verses.textEnNlt: Ahaz son of Jotham began to rule over Judah in the seventeenth year of King Pekah’s reign in Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah, Ahaz the son of Jotham, king of Judah, became king.
verses.textEn: In the seventeenth year of Pekah son of Remaliah, Ahaz son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

verses.textZh: 亚哈斯登基的时候是二十岁，他在耶路撒冷作王十六年。但是他不像他祖宗大卫行耶和华他的神看为正的事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈斯登基的时候是二十岁，他在耶路撒冷作王十六年。但是他不像他祖宗大卫行耶和华他的神看为正的事，
verses.textZhCuv: 他登基的时候年二十岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年；不像他祖大卫行耶和华－他神眼中看为正的事，
verses.textEnNiv: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. Unlike David his father, he did not do what was right in the eyes of the Lord his God.
verses.textEnEsv: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And he did not do what was right in the eyes of the Lord his God, as his father David had done,
verses.textEnNkjv: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem; and he did not do whatwas right in the sight of the Lord his God, as his father David haddone.
verses.textEnNlt: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. He did not do what was pleasing in the sight of the Lord his God, as his ancestor David had done.
verses.textEnNasb: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned for sixteen years in Jerusalem; and he did not do what was right in the sight of the Lord his God, as his father David had done.
verses.textEn: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. Unlike David his father, he did not do what was right in the eyes of the Lord his God.

verses.textZh: 反倒跟随以色列诸王的道路，甚至焚烧他的儿子为祭，好象耶和华在以色列人面前驱逐的外族人所行可憎恶的事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 反倒跟随以色列诸王的道路，甚至焚烧他的儿子为祭，好象耶和华在以色列人面前驱逐的外族人所行可憎恶的事，
verses.textZhCuv: 却效法以色列诸王所行的，又照着耶和华从以色列人面前赶出的外邦人所行可憎的事，使他的儿子经火，
verses.textEnNiv: He followed the ways of the kings of Israel and even sacrificed his son in the fire, engaging in the detestable practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: but he walked in the way of the kings of Israel. He even burned his son as an offering, according to the despicable practices of the nations whom the Lord drove out before the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel; indeed he made his son pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the Lord had cast out from before the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, he followed the example of the kings of Israel, even sacrificing his own son in the fire. In this way, he followed the detestable practices of the pagan nations the Lord had driven from the land ahead of the Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and he even made his son pass through the fire, in accordance with the abominations of the nations whom the Lord had driven out before the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: He followed the ways of the kings of Israel and even sacrificed his son in the fire, engaging in the detestable practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 并且在邱坛上，在山冈上和所有青翠的树下献祭和焚香。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且在邱坛上，在山冈上和所有青翠的树下献祭和焚香。
verses.textZhCuv: 并在邱坛上、山冈上、各青翠树下献祭烧香。
verses.textEnNiv: He offered sacrifices and burned incense at the high places, on the hilltops and under every spreading tree.
verses.textEnEsv: And he sacrificed and made offerings on the high places and on the hills and under every green tree.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he sacrificed and burned incense on the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.
verses.textEnNlt: He offered sacrifices and burned incense at the pagan shrines and on the hills and under every green tree.
verses.textEnNasb: And he sacrificed and burned incense on the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.
verses.textEn: He offered sacrifices and burned incense at the high places, on the hilltops and under every spreading tree.

verses.textZh: 那时，亚兰王利汛与以色列王利玛利的儿子比加上来攻打耶路撒冷。他们把亚哈斯围困起来，却不能战胜他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，亚兰王利汛与以色列王利玛利的儿子比加上来攻打耶路撒冷。他们把亚哈斯围困起来，却不能战胜他。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚兰王利汛和以色列王利玛利的儿子比加上来攻打耶路撒冷，围困亚哈斯，却不能胜他。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel marched up to fight against Jerusalem and besieged Ahaz, but they could not overpower him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, came up to wage war on Jerusalem, and they besieged Ahaz but could not conquer him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, came up to Jerusalem to make war; and they besieged Ahaz but could not overcome him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Rezin of Aram and King Pekah of Israel came up to attack Jerusalem. They besieged Ahaz but could not conquer him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Rezin the king of Aram and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem for war; and they besieged Ahaz, but were not capable of fighting him.
verses.textEn: Then Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel marched up to fight against Jerusalem and besieged Ahaz, but they could not overpower him.

verses.textZh: 当时，亚兰王利汛收复以拉他归与亚兰。他把犹大人逐出以拉他，亚兰人来到以拉他住在那里，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时，亚兰王利汛收复以拉他归与亚兰。他把犹大人逐出以拉他，亚兰人来到以拉他住在那里，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时亚兰王利汛收回以拉他归与亚兰，将犹大人从以拉他赶出去。亚兰人 就来到以拉他，住在那里，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time, Rezin king of Aram recovered Elath for Aram by driving out the people of Judah. Edomites then moved into Elath and have lived there to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: At that time Rezin the king of Syria recovered Elath for Syria and drove the men of Judah from Elath, and the Edomites came to Elath, where they dwell to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: At that time Rezin king of Syria captured Elath for Syria, and drove the men of Judah from Elath. Then the Edomites went to Elath, and dwell there to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time the king of Edom recovered the town of Elath for Edom. He drove out the people of Judah and sent Edomites to live there, as they do to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time Rezin king of Aram restored Elath to Aram, and drove the Judeans away from Elath; and the Arameans came to Elath and have lived there to this day.
verses.textEn: At that time, Rezin king of Aram recovered Elath for Aram by driving out the people of Judah. Edomites then moved into Elath and have lived there to this day.

verses.textZh: 于是亚哈斯差派使者去见亚述王提革拉．毘列色，说："我是你的臣仆，你的儿子，求你上来，救我脱离那起来攻击我的亚兰王和以色列王的手。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚哈斯差派使者去见亚述王提革拉．毘列色，说："我是你的臣仆，你的儿子，求你上来，救我脱离那起来攻击我的亚兰王和以色列王的手。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈斯差遣使者去见亚述王提革拉‧毗列色，说：「我是你的仆人、你的儿子。现在亚兰王和以色列王攻击我，求你来救我脱离他们的手。」
verses.textEnNiv: Ahaz sent messengers to say to Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria, "I am your servant and vassal. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Aram and of the king of Israel, who are attacking me."
verses.textEnEsv: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, "I am your servant and your son. Come up and rescue me from the hand of the king of Syria and from the hand of the king of Israel, who are attacking me."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria, saying, "I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me from the hand of the king of Syria and from the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me."
verses.textEnNlt: King Ahaz sent messengers to King Tiglath-pileser of Assyria with this message: "I am your servant and your vassal. Come up and rescue me from the attacking armies of Aram and Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, "I am your servant and your son; come up and save me from the hand of the king of Aram, and from the hand of the king of Israel, who are rising up against me."
verses.textEn: Ahaz sent messengers to say to Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria, "I am your servant and vassal. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Aram and of the king of Israel, who are attacking me."

verses.textZh: 亚哈斯拿耶和华殿里和王宫宝库内找到的金子和银子，送给亚述王作礼物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈斯拿耶和华殿里和王宫宝库内找到的金子和银子，送给亚述王作礼物。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈斯将耶和华殿里和王宫府库里所有的金银都送给亚述王为礼物。
verses.textEnNiv: And Ahaz took the silver and gold found in the temple of the Lord and in the treasuries of the royal palace and sent it as a gift to the king of Assyria.
verses.textEnEsv: Ahaz also took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the Lord and in the treasures of the king’s house and sent a present to the king of Assyria.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the Lord, and in the treasuries of the king’s house, and sent itas a present to the king of Assyria.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Ahaz took the silver and gold from the Temple of the Lord and the palace treasury and sent it as a payment to the Assyrian king.
verses.textEnNasb: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the Lord and in the treasuries of the king’s house, and sent a gift to the king of Assyria.
verses.textEn: And Ahaz took the silver and gold found in the temple of the Lord and in the treasuries of the royal palace and sent it as a gift to the king of Assyria.

verses.textZh: 于是亚述王答应了他。亚述王上去攻打大马士革，把城攻取，把居民掳到吉珥，又把利汛杀死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚述王答应了他。亚述王上去攻打大马士革，把城攻取，把居民掳到吉珥，又把利汛杀死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述王应允了他，就上去攻打大马士革，将城攻取，杀了利汛，把居民掳到吉珥。
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Assyria complied by attacking Damascus and capturing it. He deported its inhabitants to Kir and put Rezin to death.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Assyria listened to him. The king of Assyria marched up against Damascus and took it, carrying its people captive to Kir, and he killed Rezin.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king of Assyria heeded him; for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus and took it, carried itspeople captive to Kir, and killed Rezin.
verses.textEnNlt: So the king of Assyria attacked the Aramean capital of Damascus and led its population away as captives, resettling them in Kir. He also killed King Rezin.
verses.textEnNasb: So the king of Assyria listened to him; and the king of Assyria went up against Damascus and captured it, and led the people of it into exile to Kir, and put Rezin to death.
verses.textEn: The king of Assyria complied by attacking Damascus and capturing it. He deported its inhabitants to Kir and put Rezin to death.

verses.textZh: 亚哈斯王到大马士革会见亚述王提革拉．毘列色，看见在大马士革的祭坛。亚哈斯王就派人把祭坛的图样、结构和详尽的做法送到乌利亚祭司那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈斯王到大马士革会见亚述王提革拉．毘列色，看见在大马士革的祭坛。亚哈斯王就派人把祭坛的图样、结构和详尽的做法送到乌利亚祭司那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈斯王上大马士革去迎接亚述王提革拉‧毗列色，在大马士革看见一座坛，就照坛的规模样式作法画了图样，送到祭司乌利亚那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria. He saw an altar in Damascus and sent to Uriah the priest a sketch of the altar, with detailed plans for its construction.
verses.textEnEsv: When King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, he saw the altar that was at Damascus. And King Ahaz sent to Uriah the priest a model of the altar, and its pattern, exact in all its details.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that was at Damascus; and King Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the design of the altar and its pattern, according to all its workmanship.
verses.textEnNlt: King Ahaz then went to Damascus to meet with King Tiglath-pileser of Assyria. While he was there, he took special note of the altar. Then he sent a model of the altar to Uriah the priest, along with its design in full detail.
verses.textEnNasb: Now King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and he saw the altar which was at Damascus; and King Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the pattern of the altar and its model, according to all its workmanship.
verses.textEn: Then King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria. He saw an altar in Damascus and sent to Uriah the priest a sketch of the altar, with detailed plans for its construction.

verses.textZh: 于是乌利亚祭司按着亚哈斯王从大马士革送回来的一切指示建造祭坛。在亚哈斯王从大马士革回来以前，乌利亚祭司就照样做了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是乌利亚祭司按着亚哈斯王从大马士革送回来的一切指示建造祭坛。在亚哈斯王从大马士革回来以前，乌利亚祭司就照样做了。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司乌利亚照着亚哈斯王从大马士革送来的图样，在亚哈斯王没有从大马士革回来之先，建筑一座坛。
verses.textEnNiv: So Uriah the priest built an altar in accordance with all the plans that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus and finished it before King Ahaz returned.
verses.textEnEsv: And Uriah the priest built the altar; in accordance with all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus, so Uriah the priest made it, before King Ahaz arrived from Damascus.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus. So Urijah the priest made it before King Ahaz came back from Damascus.
verses.textEnNlt: Uriah followed the king’s instructions and built an altar just like it, and it was ready before the king returned from Damascus.
verses.textEnNasb: So Urijah the priest built an altar; according to everything that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus, in that way Urijah the priest made it, before the coming of King Ahaz from Damascus.
verses.textEn: So Uriah the priest built an altar in accordance with all the plans that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus and finished it before King Ahaz returned.

verses.textZh: 王从大马士革回来，看见了那祭坛，于是王走到祭坛旁边，登上台阶，
verses.textZhCnvs: 王从大马士革回来，看见了那祭坛，于是王走到祭坛旁边，登上台阶，
verses.textZhCuv: 王从大马士革回来看见坛，就近前来，在坛上献祭；
verses.textEnNiv: When the king came back from Damascus and saw the altar, he approached it and presented offerings on it.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the king came from Damascus, the king viewed the altar. Then the king drew near to the altar and went up on it
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the king came back from Damascus, the king saw the altar; and the king approached the altar and made offerings on it.
verses.textEnNlt: When the king returned, he inspected the altar and made offerings on it.
verses.textEnNasb: And when the king came from Damascus, the king saw the altar; then the king approached the altar and went up to it,
verses.textEn: When the king came back from Damascus and saw the altar, he approached it and presented offerings on it.

verses.textZh: 烧他的燔祭和素祭，又浇上他的奠祭，并且把他的平安祭牲的血洒在祭坛上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 烧他的燔祭和素祭，又浇上他的奠祭，并且把他的平安祭牲的血洒在祭坛上。
verses.textZhCuv: 烧燔祭、素祭、浇奠祭，将平安祭牲的血洒在坛上，
verses.textEnNiv: He offered up his burnt offering and grain offering, poured out his drink offering, and splashed the blood of his fellowship offerings against the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: and burned his burnt offering and his grain offering and poured his drink offering and threw the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he burned his burnt offering and his grain offering; and he poured his drink offering and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: He presented a burnt offering and a grain offering, he poured out a liquid offering, and he sprinkled the blood of peace offerings on the altar.
