verses.textEnNasb: and burned his burnt offering and his meal offering, and poured out his drink offering and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.
verses.textEn: He offered up his burnt offering and grain offering, poured out his drink offering, and splashed the blood of his fellowship offerings against the altar.

verses.textZh: 至于耶和华面前的铜祭坛，他把它从殿前，从新坛与耶和华殿中间移至新坛的北边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于耶和华面前的铜祭坛，他把它从殿前，从新坛与耶和华殿中间移至新坛的北边。
verses.textZhCuv: 又将耶和华面前的铜坛从耶和华殿和新坛的中间搬到新坛的北边。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the bronze altar that stood before the Lord , he brought it from the front of the temple—from between the new altar and the temple of the Lord —and put it on the north side of the new altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And the bronze altar that was before the Lord he removed from the front of the house, from the place between his altar and the house of the Lord , and put it on the north side of his altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also brought the bronze altar which was before the Lord, from the front of the temple—from between the new altar and the house of the Lord—and put it on the north side of the new altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Ahaz removed the old bronze altar from its place in front of the Lord ’s Temple, between the entrance and the new altar, and placed it on the north side of the new altar.
verses.textEnNasb: And the bronze altar, which was before the Lord, he brought from the front of the house, from between his altar and the house of the Lord, and he put it on the north side of his altar.
verses.textEn: As for the bronze altar that stood before the Lord , he brought it from the front of the temple—from between the new altar and the temple of the Lord —and put it on the north side of the new altar.

verses.textZh: 亚哈斯王吩咐乌利亚祭司说："要在这大祭坛上焚烧早晨的燔祭、黄昏的素祭、王的燔祭牲和素祭、所有国民的燔祭和素祭；也要在坛上浇上他们的奠祭，以及所有燔祭牲和平安祭牲的血。至于铜祭坛，我要用来求问神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈斯王吩咐乌利亚祭司说："要在这大祭坛上焚烧早晨的燔祭、黄昏的素祭、王的燔祭牲和素祭、所有国民的燔祭和素祭；也要在坛上浇上他们的奠祭，以及所有燔祭牲和平安祭牲的血。至于铜祭坛，我要用来求问神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈斯王吩咐祭司乌利亚说：「早晨的燔祭、晚上的素祭，王的燔祭、素祭，国内众民的燔祭、素祭、奠祭都要烧在大坛上。燔祭牲和平安祭牲的血也要洒在这坛上，只是铜坛我要用以求问耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: King Ahaz then gave these orders to Uriah the priest: "On the large new altar, offer the morning burnt offering and the evening grain offering, the king’s burnt offering and his grain offering, and the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their grain offering and their drink offering. Splash against this altar the blood of all the burnt offerings and sacrifices. But I will use the bronze altar for seeking guidance."
verses.textEnEsv: And King Ahaz commanded Uriah the priest, saying, "On the great altar burn the morning burnt offering and the evening grain offering and the king’s burnt offering and his grain offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their grain offering and their drink offering. And throw on it all the blood of the burnt offering and all the blood of the sacrifice, but the bronze altar shall be for me to inquire by."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, "On the great new altar burn the morning burnt offering, the evening grain offering, the king’s burnt sacrifice, and his grain offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, their grain offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle on it all the blood of the burnt offering and all the blood of the sacrifice. And the bronze altar shall be for me to inquire by."
verses.textEnNlt: He told Uriah the priest, "Use the new altar for the morning sacrifices of burnt offering, the evening grain offering, the king’s burnt offering and grain offering, and the burnt offerings of all the people, as well as their grain offerings and liquid offerings. Sprinkle the blood from all the burnt offerings and sacrifices on the new altar. The bronze altar will be for my personal use only."
verses.textEnNasb: Then King Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, "Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, the evening meal offering, the king’s burnt offering and his meal offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, their meal offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle on it all the blood of the burnt offering and all the blood of the sacrifice. But the bronze altar shall be for me, for making inquiries."
verses.textEn: King Ahaz then gave these orders to Uriah the priest: "On the large new altar, offer the morning burnt offering and the evening grain offering, the king’s burnt offering and his grain offering, and the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their grain offering and their drink offering. Splash against this altar the blood of all the burnt offerings and sacrifices. But I will use the bronze altar for seeking guidance."

verses.textZh: 乌利亚祭司就照着亚哈斯王一切所吩咐的去行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌利亚祭司就照着亚哈斯王一切所吩咐的去行。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司乌利亚就照着亚哈斯王所吩咐的行了。
verses.textEnNiv: And Uriah the priest did just as King Ahaz had ordered.
verses.textEnEsv: Uriah the priest did all this, as King Ahaz commanded.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that King Ahaz commanded.
verses.textEnNlt: Uriah the priest did just as King Ahaz commanded him.
verses.textEnNasb: So Urijah the priest acted in accordance with everything that King Ahaz commanded.
verses.textEn: And Uriah the priest did just as King Ahaz had ordered.

verses.textZh: 亚哈斯又砍掉盆座的边缘，把洗濯盆拿下来，又把铜海从驮着铜海的铜牛上取下来，放在铺了石的地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈斯又砍掉盆座的边缘，把洗濯盆拿下来，又把铜海从驮着铜海的铜牛上取下来，放在铺了石的地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈斯王打掉盆座四面镶着的心子，把盆从座上挪下来，又将铜海从驮海的铜牛上搬下来，放在铺石地；
verses.textEnNiv: King Ahaz cut off the side panels and removed the basins from the movable stands. He removed the Sea from the bronze bulls that supported it and set it on a stone base.
verses.textEnEsv: And King Ahaz cut off the frames of the stands and removed the basin from them, and he took down the sea from off the bronze oxen that were under it and put it on a stone pedestal.
verses.textEnNkjv: And King Ahaz cut off the panels of the carts, and removed the lavers from them; and he took down the Sea from the bronze oxen that were under it, and put it on a pavement of stones.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king removed the side panels and basins from the portable water carts. He also removed the great bronze basin called the Sea from the backs of the bronze oxen and placed it on the stone pavement.
verses.textEnNasb: Then King Ahaz cut off the borders of the stands, and removed the wash basin from them; he also took down the Sea from the bronze oxen which were under it and put it on a pavement of stone.
verses.textEn: King Ahaz cut off the side panels and removed the basins from the movable stands. He removed the Sea from the bronze bulls that supported it and set it on a stone base.

verses.textZh: 又因亚述王的缘故，他把耶和华殿里为安息日而建造的廊子，和王从外边进殿的廊子，从耶和华的殿内拆除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又因亚述王的缘故，他把耶和华殿里为安息日而建造的廊子，和王从外边进殿的廊子，从耶和华的殿内拆除。
verses.textZhCuv: 又因亚述王的缘故，将耶和华殿为安息日所盖的廊子和王从外入殿的廊子挪移，围绕耶和华的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: He took away the Sabbath canopy that had been built at the temple and removed the royal entryway outside the temple of the Lord , in deference to the king of Assyria.
verses.textEnEsv: And the covered way for the Sabbath that had been built inside the house and the outer entrance for the king he caused to go around the house of the Lord , because of the king of Assyria.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also he removed the Sabbath pavilion which they had built in the temple, and he removed the king’s outer entrance from the house of the Lord, on account of the king of Assyria.
verses.textEnNlt: In deference to the king of Assyria, he also removed the canopy that had been constructed inside the palace for use on the Sabbath day, as well as the king’s outer entrance to the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And the covered way for the Sabbath which they had built in the house, and the outer entry of the king, he removed from the house of the Lord because of the king of Assyria.
verses.textEn: He took away the Sabbath canopy that had been built at the temple and removed the royal entryway outside the temple of the Lord , in deference to the king of Assyria.

verses.textZh: 亚哈斯所行其余的事迹，不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈斯所行其余的事迹，不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈斯其余所行的事都写在犹大列王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of the reign of Ahaz, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Ahaz’s reign and everything he did are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of the reign of Ahaz, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

verses.textZh: 亚哈斯和他的祖先一同长眠，葬在大卫城和他的祖先在一起。他的儿子希西家接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈斯和他的祖先一同长眠，葬在大卫城和他的祖先在一起。他的儿子希西家接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈斯与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子希西家接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Ahaz rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David. And Hezekiah his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ahaz slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of David, and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ahaz rested with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the City of David. Then Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Ahaz died, he was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. Then his son Hezekiah became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: So Ahaz lay down with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David; and his son Hezekiah reigned in his place.
verses.textEn: Ahaz rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David. And Hezekiah his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 犹大王亚哈斯在位第十二年，以拉的儿子何细亚在撒玛利亚登基，统治以色列九年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王亚哈斯在位第十二年，以拉的儿子何细亚在撒玛利亚登基，统治以色列九年。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王亚哈斯十二年，以拉的儿子何细亚在撒马利亚登基作以色列王九年。
verses.textEnNiv: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned nine years.
verses.textEnEsv: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea the son of Elah began to reign in Samaria over Israel, and he reigned nine years.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea the son of Elah became king of Israel in Samaria, andhereigned nine years.
verses.textEnNlt: Hoshea son of Elah began to rule over Israel in the twelfth year of King Ahaz’s reign in Judah. He reigned in Samaria nine years.
verses.textEnNasb: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea the son of Elah became king over Israel in Samaria, and reigned for nine years.
verses.textEn: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned nine years.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，只是不像他以前的以色列诸王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，只是不像他以前的以色列诸王。
verses.textZhCuv: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，只是不像在他以前的以色列诸王。
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , but not like the kings of Israel who preceded him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , yet not as the kings of Israel who were before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, but not as the kings of Israel who were before him.
verses.textEnNlt: He did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight, but not to the same extent as the kings of Israel who ruled before him.
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord, only not as the kings of Israel who preceded him.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , but not like the kings of Israel who preceded him.

verses.textZh: 亚述王撒缦以色上来攻击他，他就臣服于他，并且向他进贡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述王撒缦以色上来攻击他，他就臣服于他，并且向他进贡。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述王撒缦以色上来攻击何细亚，何细亚就服事他，给他进贡。
verses.textEnNiv: Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up to attack Hoshea, who had been Shalmaneser’s vassal and had paid him tribute.
verses.textEnEsv: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria. And Hoshea became his vassal and paid him tribute.
verses.textEnNkjv: Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against him; and Hoshea became his vassal, and paid him tribute money.
verses.textEnNlt: King Shalmaneser of Assyria attacked King Hoshea, so Hoshea was forced to pay heavy tribute to Assyria.
verses.textEnNasb: Shalmaneser the king of Assyria marched against him, and Hoshea became his servant and paid him tribute.
verses.textEn: Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up to attack Hoshea, who had been Shalmaneser’s vassal and had paid him tribute.

verses.textZh: 后来，亚述王发觉何细亚阴谋反叛：他曾派使者去见埃及王梭，并且不再向亚述王献上贡物，像过去每年一样。亚述王就拿住他，把他囚在牢里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，亚述王发觉何细亚阴谋反叛：他曾派使者去见埃及王梭，并且不再向亚述王献上贡物，像过去每年一样。亚述王就拿住他，把他囚在牢里。
verses.textZhCuv: 何细亚背叛，差人去见埃及王梭，不照往年所行的与亚述王进贡。亚述王知道了，就把他锁禁，囚在监里。
verses.textEnNiv: But the king of Assyria discovered that Hoshea was a traitor, for he had sent envoys to So king of Egypt, and he no longer paid tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year. Therefore Shalmaneser seized him and put him in prison.
verses.textEnEsv: But the king of Assyria found treachery in Hoshea, for he had sent messengers to So, king of Egypt, and offered no tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year. Therefore the king of Assyria shut him up and bound him in prison.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king of Assyria uncovered a conspiracy by Hoshea; for he had sent messengers to So, king of Egypt, and brought no tribute to the king of Assyria, as hehaddone year by year. Therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.
verses.textEnNlt: But Hoshea stopped paying the annual tribute and conspired against the king of Assyria by asking King So of Egypt to help him shake free of Assyria’s power. When the king of Assyria discovered this treachery, he seized Hoshea and put him in prison.
verses.textEnNasb: But the king of Assyria uncovered a conspiracy by Hoshea, who had sent messengers to So, king of Egypt, and had then brought no tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year; so the king of Assyria arrested him and confined him in prison.
verses.textEn: But the king of Assyria discovered that Hoshea was a traitor, for he had sent envoys to So king of Egypt, and he no longer paid tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year. Therefore Shalmaneser seized him and put him in prison.

verses.textZh: 亚述王上来攻击以色列全国各地，并且到撒玛利亚来，围城三年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述王上来攻击以色列全国各地，并且到撒玛利亚来，围城三年。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述王上来攻击以色列遍地，上到撒马利亚，围困三年。
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Assyria invaded the entire land, marched against Samaria and laid siege to it for three years.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king of Assyria invaded all the land and came to Samaria, and for three years he besieged it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the king of Assyria went throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria and besieged it for three years.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king of Assyria invaded the entire land, and for three years he besieged the city of Samaria.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Assyria invaded the entire land, and went up to Samaria and besieged it for three years.
verses.textEn: The king of Assyria invaded the entire land, marched against Samaria and laid siege to it for three years.

verses.textZh: 何细亚在位第九年，亚述王占领了撒玛利亚，把以色列人掳到亚述去，安置他们在哈腊，在哈博河和歌散河一带，以及在玛代人的各城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 何细亚在位第九年，亚述王占领了撒玛利亚，把以色列人掳到亚述去，安置他们在哈腊，在哈博河和歌散河一带，以及在玛代人的各城。
verses.textZhCuv: 何细亚第九年亚述王攻取了撒马利亚，将以色列人掳到亚述，把他们安置在哈腊与歌散的哈博河边，并米底亚人的城邑。
verses.textEnNiv: In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria captured Samaria and deported the Israelites to Assyria. He settled them in Halah, in Gozan on the Habor River and in the towns of the Medes.
verses.textEnEsv: In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria captured Samaria, and he carried the Israelites away to Assyria and placed them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria took Samaria and carried Israel away to Assyria, and placed them in Halah and by the Habor, the River of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, in the ninth year of King Hoshea’s reign, Samaria fell, and the people of Israel were exiled to Assyria. They were settled in colonies in Halah, along the banks of the Habor River in Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
verses.textEnNasb: In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria captured Samaria and led the people of Israel into exile to Assyria, and settled them in Halah and Habor, on the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
verses.textEn: In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria captured Samaria and deported the Israelites to Assyria. He settled them in Halah, in Gozan on the Habor River and in the towns of the Medes.

verses.textZh: 这是因为以色列人得罪了那曾带领他们从埃及王法老的手下离开埃及的耶和华他们的神，去敬畏别的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是因为以色列人得罪了那曾带领他们从埃及王法老的手下离开埃及的耶和华他们的神，去敬畏别的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是因以色列人得罪那领他们出埃及地、脱离埃及王法老手的耶和华－他们的神，去敬畏别神，
verses.textEnNiv: All this took place because the Israelites had sinned against the Lord their God, who had brought them up out of Egypt from under the power of Pharaoh king of Egypt. They worshiped other gods
verses.textEnEsv: And this occurred because the people of Israel had sinned against the Lord their God, who had brought them up out of the land of Egypt from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods
verses.textEnNkjv: For so it was that the children of Israel had sinned against the Lord their God, who had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and they had feared other gods,
verses.textEnNlt: This disaster came upon the people of Israel because they worshiped other gods. They sinned against the Lord their God, who had brought them safely out of Egypt and had rescued them from the power of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Now this came about because the sons of Israel had sinned against the Lord their God, who had brought them up from the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh, king of Egypt; and they had feared other gods.
verses.textEn: All this took place because the Israelites had sinned against the Lord their God, who had brought them up out of Egypt from under the power of Pharaoh king of Egypt. They worshiped other gods

verses.textZh: 他们随从耶和华从以色列人面前驱逐的外族人的风俗，以及以色列诸王奉行的风俗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们随从耶和华从以色列人面前驱逐的外族人的风俗，以及以色列诸王奉行的风俗。
verses.textZhCuv: 随从耶和华在他们面前所赶出外邦人的风俗和以色列诸王所立的条规。
verses.textEnNiv: and followed the practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before them, as well as the practices that the kings of Israel had introduced.
verses.textEnEsv: and walked in the customs of the nations whom the Lord drove out before the people of Israel, and in the customs that the kings of Israel had practiced.
verses.textEnNkjv: and had walked in the statutes of the nations whom the Lord had cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.
verses.textEnNlt: They had followed the practices of the pagan nations the Lord had driven from the land ahead of them, as well as the practices the kings of Israel had introduced.
verses.textEnNasb: They also followed the customs of the nations whom the Lord had driven out from the sons of Israel, and in the customs of the kings of Israel which they had introduced.
verses.textEn: and followed the practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before them, as well as the practices that the kings of Israel had introduced.

verses.textZh: 以色列人暗中做了不对的事，违背耶和华他们的神，并且在他们所有的城市，从哨站到设防城，为他们自己建筑邱坛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人暗中做了不对的事，违背耶和华他们的神，并且在他们所有的城市，从哨站到设防城，为他们自己建筑邱坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人暗中行不正的事，违背耶和华－他们的神，在他们所有的城邑，从了望楼直到坚固城，建筑邱坛；
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites secretly did things against the Lord their God that were not right. From watchtower to fortified city they built themselves high places in all their towns.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel did secretly against the Lord their God things that were not right. They built for themselves high places in all their towns, from watchtower to fortified city.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the children of Israel secretly did against the Lord their God things that were not right, and they built for themselves high places in all their cities, from watchtower to fortified city.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Israel had also secretly done many things that were not pleasing to the Lord their God. They built pagan shrines for themselves in all their towns, from the smallest outpost to the largest walled city.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Israel did things secretly against the Lord their God which were not right. Moreover, they built for themselves high places in all their towns, from watchtower to fortified city.
verses.textEn: The Israelites secretly did things against the Lord their God that were not right. From watchtower to fortified city they built themselves high places in all their towns.

verses.textZh: 又在各高山顶上和每一棵青翠的树下竖立神柱和亚舍拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又在各高山顶上和每一棵青翠的树下竖立神柱和亚舍拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 在各高冈上、各青翠树下立柱像和木偶；
verses.textEnNiv: They set up sacred stones and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every spreading tree.
verses.textEnEsv: They set up for themselves pillars and Asherim on every high hill and under every green tree,
verses.textEnNkjv: They set up for themselves sacred pillars and wooden images on every high hill and under every green tree.
verses.textEnNlt: They set up sacred pillars and Asherah poles at the top of every hill and under every green tree.
verses.textEnNasb: And they set up for themselves memorial stones and Asherim on every high hill and under every green tree,
verses.textEn: They set up sacred stones and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every spreading tree.

verses.textZh: 他们在各邱坛上献祭和焚香，好象耶和华从他们的面前掳去的外族人一样，又行恶事，使耶和华发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在各邱坛上献祭和焚香，好象耶和华从他们的面前掳去的外族人一样，又行恶事，使耶和华发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 在邱坛上烧香，效法耶和华在他们面前赶出的外邦人所行的，又行恶事惹动耶和华的怒气；
verses.textEnNiv: At every high place they burned incense, as the nations whom the Lord had driven out before them had done. They did wicked things that aroused the Lord ’s anger.
verses.textEnEsv: and there they made offerings on all the high places, as the nations did whom the Lord carried away before them. And they did wicked things, provoking the Lord to anger,
verses.textEnNkjv: There they burned incense on all the high places, like the nations whom the Lord had carried away before them; and they did wicked things to provoke the Lord to anger,
verses.textEnNlt: They offered sacrifices on all the hilltops, just like the nations the Lord had driven from the land ahead of them. So the people of Israel had done many evil things, arousing the Lord ’s anger.
verses.textEnNasb: and there they burned incense on all the high places as the nations did that the Lord had taken into exile before them; and they did evil things, provoking the Lord.
verses.textEn: At every high place they burned incense, as the nations whom the Lord had driven out before them had done. They did wicked things that aroused the Lord ’s anger.

verses.textZh: 他们又服事雕刻的偶像，耶和华曾警告他们不可以行这事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又服事雕刻的偶像，耶和华曾警告他们不可以行这事。
verses.textZhCuv: 且事奉偶像，就是耶和华警戒他们不可行的。
verses.textEnNiv: They worshiped idols, though the Lord had said, "You shall not do this."
verses.textEnEsv: and they served idols, of which the Lord had said to them, "You shall not do this."
verses.textEnNkjv: for they served idols, of which the Lord had said to them, "You shall not do this thing."
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, they worshiped idols, despite the Lord ’s specific and repeated warnings.
verses.textEnNasb: They served idols, concerning which the Lord had said to them, "You shall not do this thing."
verses.textEn: They worshiped idols, though the Lord had said, "You shall not do this."

verses.textZh: 耶和华曾借着他的众先知和先见警告以色列人和犹大人说："从你们的恶道上转回吧！谨守我的吩咐和我的律例，就是我曾吩咐你们的祖先，和借着我的仆人众先知传递给你们的一切律法。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华曾借着他的众先知和先见警告以色列人和犹大人说："从你们的恶道上转回吧！谨守我的吩咐和我的律例，就是我曾吩咐你们的祖先，和借着我的仆人众先知传递给你们的一切律法。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但耶和华藉众先知、先见劝戒以色列人和犹大人说：「当离开你们的恶行，谨守我的诫命律例，遵行我吩咐你们列祖，并藉我仆人众先知所传给你们的律法。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord warned Israel and Judah through all his prophets and seers: "Turn from your evil ways. Observe my commands and decrees, in accordance with the entire Law that I commanded your ancestors to obey and that I delivered to you through my servants the prophets."
verses.textEnEsv: Yet the Lord warned Israel and Judah by every prophet and every seer, saying, "Turn from your evil ways and keep my commandments and my statutes, in accordance with all the Law that I commanded your fathers, and that I sent to you by my servants the prophets."
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet the Lord testified against Israel and against Judah, by all of His prophets, every seer, saying, "Turn from your evil ways, and keep My commandments and My statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by My servants the prophets."
verses.textEnNlt: Again and again the Lord had sent his prophets and seers to warn both Israel and Judah: "Turn from all your evil ways. Obey my commands and decrees—the entire law that I commanded your ancestors to obey, and that I gave you through my servants the prophets."
verses.textEnNasb: Yet the Lord warned Israel and Judah through all His prophets and every seer, saying, "Turn back from your evil ways and keep My commandments and My statutes in accordance with all the Law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you through My servants the prophets."
verses.textEn: The Lord warned Israel and Judah through all his prophets and seers: "Turn from your evil ways. Observe my commands and decrees, in accordance with the entire Law that I commanded your ancestors to obey and that I delivered to you through my servants the prophets."

verses.textZh: 可是他们不听从，反而硬着自己的颈项，好象他们的祖先，不信服耶和华他们的神；
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是他们不听从，反而硬着自己的颈项，好象他们的祖先，不信服耶和华他们的神；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却不听从，竟硬着颈项，效法他们列祖，不信服耶和华－他们的神，
verses.textEnNiv: But they would not listen and were as stiff-necked as their ancestors, who did not trust in the Lord their God.
verses.textEnEsv: But they would not listen, but were stubborn, as their fathers had been, who did not believe in the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless they would not hear, but stiffened their necks, like the necks of their fathers, who did not believe in the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Israelites would not listen. They were as stubborn as their ancestors who had refused to believe in the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNasb: However, they did not listen, but stiffened their neck like their fathers, who did not believe in the Lord their God.
verses.textEn: But they would not listen and were as stiff-necked as their ancestors, who did not trust in the Lord their God.

verses.textZh: 厌弃他的律例和他与他们的祖先订立的约，以及他对他们的警戒；却信从虚无的神，自己成为虚妄，跟从他们周围的外族人，耶和华曾吩咐他们不可跟从他们的行为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 厌弃他的律例和他与他们的祖先订立的约，以及他对他们的警戒；却信从虚无的神，自己成为虚妄，跟从他们周围的外族人，耶和华曾吩咐他们不可跟从他们的行为。
verses.textZhCuv: 厌弃他的律例和他与他们列祖所立的约，并劝戒他们的话，随从虚无的神，自己成为虚妄，效法周围的外邦人，就是耶和华嘱咐他们不可效法的；
verses.textEnNiv: They rejected his decrees and the covenant he had made with their ancestors and the statutes he had warned them to keep. They followed worthless idols and themselves became worthless. They imitated the nations around them although the Lord had ordered them, "Do not do as they do."
verses.textEnEsv: They despised his statutes and his covenant that he made with their fathers and the warnings that he gave them. They went after false idols and became false, and they followed the nations that were around them, concerning whom the Lord had commanded them that they should not do like them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they rejected His statutes and His covenant that He had made with their fathers, and His testimonies which He had testified against them; they followed idols, became idolaters, and went after the nations who were all around them, concerning whom the Lord had charged them that they should not do like them.
verses.textEnNlt: They rejected his decrees and the covenant he had made with their ancestors, and they despised all his warnings. They worshiped worthless idols, so they became worthless themselves. They followed the example of the nations around them, disobeying the Lord ’s command not to imitate them.
verses.textEnNasb: They rejected His statutes and His covenant which He made with their fathers, and His warnings which He gave them. And they followed idols and became empty, and followed the nations that surrounded them, about which the Lord had commanded them not to do as they did.
verses.textEn: They rejected his decrees and the covenant he had made with their ancestors and the statutes he had warned them to keep. They followed worthless idols and themselves became worthless. They imitated the nations around them although the Lord had ordered them, "Do not do as they do."

verses.textZh: 他们丢弃耶和华他们神的一切吩咐，为自己做了两个牛犊的铸像，又做亚舍拉，并且敬拜天上的万象和服事巴力；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们丢弃耶和华他们神的一切吩咐，为自己做了两个牛犊的铸像，又做亚舍拉，并且敬拜天上的万象和服事巴力；
verses.textZhCuv: 离弃耶和华－他们神的一切诫命，为自己铸了两个牛犊的像，立了亚舍拉，敬拜天上的万象，事奉巴力，
verses.textEnNiv: They forsook all the commands of the Lord their God and made for themselves two idols cast in the shape of calves, and an Asherah pole. They bowed down to all the starry hosts, and they worshiped Baal.
verses.textEnEsv: And they abandoned all the commandments of the Lord their God, and made for themselves metal images of two calves; and they made an Asherah and worshiped all the host of heaven and served Baal.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they left all the commandments of the Lord their God, made for themselves a molded image and two calves, made a wooden image and worshiped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.
verses.textEnNlt: They rejected all the commands of the Lord their God and made two calves from metal. They set up an Asherah pole and worshiped Baal and all the forces of heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: And they abandoned all the commandments of the Lord their God and made for themselves cast metal images: two calves. And they made an Asherah, and worshiped all the heavenly lights, and served Baal.
verses.textEn: They forsook all the commands of the Lord their God and made for themselves two idols cast in the shape of calves, and an Asherah pole. They bowed down to all the starry hosts, and they worshiped Baal.

verses.textZh: 他们又把儿女用火烧为祭，并且占卜，行法术，出卖自己去行耶和华看为恶的事，使他发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又把儿女用火烧为祭，并且占卜，行法术，出卖自己去行耶和华看为恶的事，使他发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 又使他们的儿女经火，用占卜，行法术卖了自己，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，惹动他的怒气。
verses.textEnNiv: They sacrificed their sons and daughters in the fire. They practiced divination and sought omens and sold themselves to do evil in the eyes of the Lord , arousing his anger.
verses.textEnEsv: And they burned their sons and their daughters as offerings and used divination and omens and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the Lord , provoking him to anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they caused their sons and daughters to pass through the fire, practiced witchcraft and soothsaying, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke Him to anger.
verses.textEnNlt: They even sacrificed their own sons and daughters in the fire. They consulted fortune-tellers and practiced sorcery and sold themselves to evil, arousing the Lord ’s anger.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they made their sons and their daughters pass through the fire, and they practiced divination and interpreting omens, and gave themselves over to do evil in the sight of the Lord, provoking Him.
verses.textEn: They sacrificed their sons and daughters in the fire. They practiced divination and sought omens and sold themselves to do evil in the eyes of the Lord , arousing his anger.

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华向以色列人大大发怒，把他们从自己面前赶走，只剩下犹大一个支派。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华向以色列人大大发怒，把他们从自己面前赶走，只剩下犹大一个支派。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华向以色列人大大发怒，从自己面前赶出他们，只剩下犹大一个支派。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord was very angry with Israel and removed them from his presence. Only the tribe of Judah was left,
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the Lord was very angry with Israel and removed them out of his sight. None was left but the tribe of Judah only.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Lord was very angry with Israel, and removed them from His sight; there was none left but the tribe of Judah alone.
verses.textEnNlt: Because the Lord was very angry with Israel, he swept them away from his presence. Only the tribe of Judah remained in the land.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord was very angry with Israel, and He removed them from His sight; no one was left except the tribe of Judah.
verses.textEn: So the Lord was very angry with Israel and removed them from his presence. Only the tribe of Judah was left,

verses.textZh: 连犹大人也不持守耶和华他们的神的吩咐，随从以色列人所行的习俗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 连犹大人也不持守耶和华他们的神的吩咐，随从以色列人所行的习俗。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大人也不遵守耶和华－他们神的诫命，随从以色列人所立的条规。
verses.textEnNiv: and even Judah did not keep the commands of the Lord their God. They followed the practices Israel had introduced.
verses.textEnEsv: Judah also did not keep the commandments of the Lord their God, but walked in the customs that Israel had introduced.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Judah did not keep the commandments of the Lord their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.
verses.textEnNlt: But even the people of Judah refused to obey the commands of the Lord their God, for they followed the evil practices that Israel had introduced.
verses.textEnNasb: Judah did not keep the commandments of the Lord their God either, but they followed the customs which Israel had introduced.
verses.textEn: and even Judah did not keep the commands of the Lord their God. They followed the practices Israel had introduced.

verses.textZh: 耶和华就厌弃以色列人的后裔，使他们受苦，把他们交在抢掠他们的人的手中，直到把他们从自己的面前完全丢弃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华就厌弃以色列人的后裔，使他们受苦，把他们交在抢掠他们的人的手中，直到把他们从自己的面前完全丢弃。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华就厌弃以色列全族，使他们受苦，把他们交在抢夺他们的人手中，以致赶出他们离开自己面前，
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore the Lord rejected all the people of Israel; he afflicted them and gave them into the hands of plunderers, until he thrust them from his presence.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord rejected all the descendants of Israel and afflicted them and gave them into the hand of plunderers, until he had cast them out of his sight.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord rejected all the descendants of Israel, afflicted them, and delivered them into the hand of plunderers, until He had cast them from His sight.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord rejected all the descendants of Israel. He punished them by handing them over to their attackers until he had banished Israel from his presence.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord rejected all the descendants of Israel and afflicted them and handed them over to plunderers, until He had cast them out of His sight.
verses.textEn: Therefore the Lord rejected all the people of Israel; he afflicted them and gave them into the hands of plunderers, until he thrust them from his presence.

verses.textZh: 因为他自从使以色列从大卫家分裂出来后，他们就立了尼八的儿子耶罗波安作王，耶罗波安却引诱以色列人不去跟从耶和华，又使他们犯了大罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他自从使以色列从大卫家分裂出来后，他们就立了尼八的儿子耶罗波安作王，耶罗波安却引诱以色列人不去跟从耶和华，又使他们犯了大罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 将以色列国从大卫家夺回；他们就立尼八的儿子耶罗波安作王。耶罗波安引诱以色列人不随从耶和华，陷在大罪里。
verses.textEnNiv: When he tore Israel away from the house of David, they made Jeroboam son of Nebat their king. Jeroboam enticed Israel away from following the Lord and caused them to commit a great sin.
verses.textEnEsv: When he had torn Israel from the house of David, they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king. And Jeroboam drove Israel from following the Lord and made them commit great sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He tore Israel from the house of David, and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king. Then Jeroboam drove Israel from following the Lord, and made them commit a great sin.
verses.textEnNlt: For when the Lord tore Israel away from the kingdom of David, they chose Jeroboam son of Nebat as their king. But Jeroboam drew Israel away from following the Lord and made them commit a great sin.
verses.textEnNasb: When He had torn Israel from the house of David, they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king. Then Jeroboam drove Israel away from following the Lord and misled them into a great sin.
verses.textEn: When he tore Israel away from the house of David, they made Jeroboam son of Nebat their king. Jeroboam enticed Israel away from following the Lord and caused them to commit a great sin.

verses.textZh: 以色列人就随从耶罗波安所犯的一切罪恶，总不转离；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人就随从耶罗波安所犯的一切罪恶，总不转离；
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人犯耶罗波安所犯的一切罪，总不离开，
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites persisted in all the sins of Jeroboam and did not turn away from them
verses.textEnEsv: The people of Israel walked in all the sins that Jeroboam did. They did not depart from them,
verses.textEnNkjv: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they did not depart from them,
verses.textEnNlt: And the people of Israel persisted in all the evil ways of Jeroboam. They did not turn from these sins
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he committed; they did not desist from them
verses.textEn: The Israelites persisted in all the sins of Jeroboam and did not turn away from them

verses.textZh: 以致最后耶和华把以色列人从自己的面前赶走，就像他借着自己的仆人众先知所说的。于是以色列人被掳离开自己的国土，往亚述去，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以致最后耶和华把以色列人从自己的面前赶走，就像他借着自己的仆人众先知所说的。于是以色列人被掳离开自己的国土，往亚述去，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 以致耶和华从自己面前赶出他们，正如藉他仆人众先知所说的。这样，以色列人从本地被掳到亚述，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: until the Lord removed them from his presence, as he had warned through all his servants the prophets. So the people of Israel were taken from their homeland into exile in Assyria, and they are still there.
verses.textEnEsv: until the Lord removed Israel out of his sight, as he had spoken by all his servants the prophets. So Israel was exiled from their own land to Assyria until this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: until the Lord removed Israel out of His sight, as He had said by all His servants the prophets. So Israel was carried away from their own land to Assyria, asitis to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: until the Lord finally swept them away from his presence, just as all his prophets had warned. So Israel was exiled from their land to Assyria, where they remain to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: until the Lord removed Israel from His sight, just as He had spoken through all His servants the prophets. So Israel went into exile from their own land to Assyria until this day.
verses.textEn: until the Lord removed them from his presence, as he had warned through all his servants the prophets. So the people of Israel were taken from their homeland into exile in Assyria, and they are still there.

verses.textZh: 亚述王从巴比伦、古他、亚瓦、哈马和西法瓦音带人来，安置在撒玛利亚的城市，代替以色列人。他们就得了撒玛利亚作产业，住在它的城市中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述王从巴比伦、古他、亚瓦、哈马和西法瓦音带人来，安置在撒玛利亚的城市，代替以色列人。他们就得了撒玛利亚作产业，住在它的城市中。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述王从巴比伦、古他、亚瓦、哈马，和西法瓦音迁移人来，安置在撒马利亚的城邑，代替以色列人；他们就得了撒马利亚，住在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, Kuthah, Avva, Hamath and Sepharvaim and settled them in the towns of Samaria to replace the Israelites. They took over Samaria and lived in its towns.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the people of Israel. And they took possession of Samaria and lived in its cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, Cuthah, Ava, Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel; and they took possession of Samaria and dwelt in its cities.
verses.textEnNlt: The king of Assyria transported groups of people from Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim and resettled them in the towns of Samaria, replacing the people of Israel. They took possession of Samaria and lived in its towns.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim, and settled them in the cities of Samaria in place of the sons of Israel. So they took possession of Samaria and lived in its cities.
verses.textEn: The king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, Kuthah, Avva, Hamath and Sepharvaim and settled them in the towns of Samaria to replace the Israelites. They took over Samaria and lived in its towns.

verses.textZh: 他们开始在那里居住的时候，并不敬畏耶和华，所以耶和华派狮子到他们中间，咬死他们好些人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们开始在那里居住的时候，并不敬畏耶和华，所以耶和华派狮子到他们中间，咬死他们好些人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们才住那里的时候，不敬畏耶和华，所以耶和华叫狮子进入他们中间，咬死了些人。
verses.textEnNiv: When they first lived there, they did not worship the Lord ; so he sent lions among them and they killed some of the people.
verses.textEnEsv: And at the beginning of their dwelling there, they did not fear the Lord . Therefore the Lord sent lions among them, which killed some of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it was so, at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they did not fear the Lord; therefore the Lord sent lions among them, which killed some of them.
verses.textEnNlt: But since these foreign settlers did not worship the Lord when they first arrived, the Lord sent lions among them, which killed some of them.
verses.textEnNasb: And at the beginning of their living there, they did not fear the Lord; therefore the Lord sent lions among them that were killing some of them.
verses.textEn: When they first lived there, they did not worship the Lord ; so he sent lions among them and they killed some of the people.

verses.textZh: 有人告诉亚述王说："你所掳去，安置在撒玛利亚各城市的众民族不知道当地的神的规矩，所以他派狮子到他们中间。看哪，狮子咬死他们，因为他们不知道当地的神的规矩。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉亚述王说："你所掳去，安置在撒玛利亚各城市的众民族不知道当地的神的规矩，所以他派狮子到他们中间。看哪，狮子咬死他们，因为他们不知道当地的神的规矩。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉亚述王说：「你所迁移安置在撒马利亚各城的那些民，不知道那地之神的规矩，所以那神叫狮子进入他们中间，咬死他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: It was reported to the king of Assyria: "The people you deported and resettled in the towns of Samaria do not know what the god of that country requires. He has sent lions among them, which are killing them off, because the people do not know what he requires."
verses.textEnEsv: So the king of Assyria was told, "The nations that you have carried away and placed in the cities of Samaria do not know the law of the god of the land. Therefore he has sent lions among them, and behold, they are killing them, because they do not know the law of the god of the land."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they spoke to the king of Assyria, saying, "The nations whom you have removed and placed in the cities of Samaria do not know the rituals of the God of the land; therefore He has sent lions among them, and indeed, they are killing them because they do not know the rituals of the God of the land."
verses.textEnNlt: So a message was sent to the king of Assyria: "The people you have sent to live in the towns of Samaria do not know the religious customs of the God of the land. He has sent lions among them to destroy them because they have not worshiped him correctly."
verses.textEnNasb: So they spoke to the king of Assyria, saying, "The nations whom you have taken into exile and settled in the cities of Samaria do not know the custom of the God of the land; so He has sent lions among them, and behold, they are killing them because they do not know the custom of the God of the land."
verses.textEn: It was reported to the king of Assyria: "The people you deported and resettled in the towns of Samaria do not know what the god of that country requires. He has sent lions among them, which are killing them off, because the people do not know what he requires."

verses.textZh: 于是亚述王下令："我从那里掳来的祭司中，要叫一个回到那里去。他要去住在那里，教导他们当地的神的规矩。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚述王下令："我从那里掳来的祭司中，要叫一个回到那里去。他要去住在那里，教导他们当地的神的规矩。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述王就吩咐说：「叫所掳来的祭司回去一个，使他住在那里，将那地之神的规矩指教那些民。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king of Assyria gave this order: "Have one of the priests you took captive from Samaria go back to live there and teach the people what the god of the land requires."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king of Assyria commanded, "Send there one of the priests whom you carried away from there, and let him go and dwell there and teach them the law of the god of the land."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, "Send there one of the priests whom you brought from there; let him go and dwell there, and let him teach them the rituals of the God of the land."
verses.textEnNlt: The king of Assyria then commanded, "Send one of the exiled priests back to Samaria. Let him live there and teach the new residents the religious customs of the God of the land."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Assyria issued commands, saying, "Take one of the priests there whom you led into exile, and have him go and live there; and have him teach them the custom of the God of the land."
verses.textEn: Then the king of Assyria gave this order: "Have one of the priests you took captive from Samaria go back to live there and teach the people what the god of the land requires."

verses.textZh: 于是从撒玛利亚被掳来的祭司中，有一个回去，住在伯特利，教导他们怎样敬畏耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是从撒玛利亚被掳来的祭司中，有一个回去，住在伯特利，教导他们怎样敬畏耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是有一个从撒马利亚掳去的祭司回来，住在伯特利，指教他们怎样敬畏耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: So one of the priests who had been exiled from Samaria came to live in Bethel and taught them how to worship the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: So one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and lived in Bethel and taught them how they should fear the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So one of the priests who had been exiled from Samaria returned to Bethel and taught the new residents how to worship the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So one of the priests whom they had led into exile from Samaria came and lived in Bethel, and taught them how they were to fear the Lord.
verses.textEn: So one of the priests who had been exiled from Samaria came to live in Bethel and taught them how to worship the Lord .

verses.textZh: 但各族的人仍然制造自己的神像，安放在撒玛利亚人所造各邱坛的庙中；各族人在他们所居住的城市都这样作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但各族的人仍然制造自己的神像，安放在撒玛利亚人所造各邱坛的庙中；各族人在他们所居住的城市都这样作。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，各族之人在所住的城里各为自己制造神像，安置在撒马利亚人所造有邱坛的殿中。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, each national group made its own gods in the several towns where they settled, and set them up in the shrines the people of Samaria had made at the high places.
verses.textEnEsv: But every nation still made gods of its own and put them in the shrines of the high places that the Samaritans had made, every nation in the cities in which they lived.
verses.textEnNkjv: However every nation continued to make gods of its own, and put them in the shrines on the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in the cities where they dwelt.
verses.textEnNlt: But these various groups of foreigners also continued to worship their own gods. In town after town where they lived, they placed their idols at the pagan shrines that the people of Samaria had built.
verses.textEnNasb: But every nation was still making gods of its own, and they put them in the houses of the high places which the people of Samaria had made, every nation in their cities in which they lived.
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, each national group made its own gods in the several towns where they settled, and set them up in the shrines the people of Samaria had made at the high places.

verses.textZh: 巴比伦人做了疏割．比讷像，古他人做了匿甲像，哈马人做了亚示玛像，
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴比伦人做了疏割．比讷像，古他人做了匿甲像，哈马人做了亚示玛像，
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦人造疏割‧比讷像；古他人造匿甲像；哈马人造亚示玛像；
verses.textEnNiv: The people from Babylon made Sukkoth Benoth, those from Kuthah made Nergal, and those from Hamath made Ashima;
verses.textEnEsv: The men of Babylon made Succoth-benoth, the men of Cuth made Nergal, the men of Hamath made Ashima,
verses.textEnNkjv: The men of Babylon made Succoth Benoth, the men of Cuth made Nergal, the men of Hamath made Ashima,
verses.textEnNlt: Those from Babylon worshiped idols of their god Succoth-benoth. Those from Cuthah worshiped their god Nergal. And those from Hamath worshiped Ashima.
verses.textEnNasb: The men of Babylon made Succoth-benoth, the men of Cuth made Nergal, the men of Hamath made Ashima,
verses.textEn: The people from Babylon made Sukkoth Benoth, those from Kuthah made Nergal, and those from Hamath made Ashima;

verses.textZh: 亚瓦人做了匿哈和他珥他像，西法瓦音人用火焚烧自己的儿女，献给西法瓦音的神亚得米勒和亚拿米勒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚瓦人做了匿哈和他珥他像，西法瓦音人用火焚烧自己的儿女，献给西法瓦音的神亚得米勒和亚拿米勒。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚瓦人造匿哈和他珥他像；西法瓦音人用火焚烧儿女，献给西法瓦音的神亚得米勒和亚拿米勒。
verses.textEnNiv: the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire as sacrifices to Adrammelek and Anammelek, the gods of Sepharvaim.
verses.textEnEsv: and the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the Sepharvites burned their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
verses.textEnNlt: The Avvites worshiped their gods Nibhaz and Tartak. And the people from Sepharvaim even burned their own children as sacrifices to their gods Adrammelech and Anammelech.
verses.textEnNasb: and the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the Sepharvites were burning their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
verses.textEn: the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire as sacrifices to Adrammelek and Anammelek, the gods of Sepharvaim.

verses.textZh: 他们也惧怕耶和华，所以从他们中间选立邱坛的祭司，替他们在邱坛的庙里献祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们也惧怕耶和华，所以从他们中间选立邱坛的祭司，替他们在邱坛的庙里献祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们惧怕耶和华，也从他们中间立邱坛的祭司，为他们在有邱坛的殿中献祭。
verses.textEnNiv: They worshiped the Lord , but they also appointed all sorts of their own people to officiate for them as priests in the shrines at the high places.
verses.textEnEsv: They also feared the Lord and appointed from among themselves all sorts of people as priests of the high places, who sacrificed for them in the shrines of the high places.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they feared the Lord, and from every class they appointed for themselves priests of the high places, who sacrificed for them in the shrines of the high places.
verses.textEnNlt: These new residents worshiped the Lord , but they also appointed from among themselves all sorts of people as priests to offer sacrifices at their places of worship.
verses.textEnNasb: They also feared the Lord and appointed from their entire population priests of the high places, who acted for them in the houses of the high places.
verses.textEn: They worshiped the Lord , but they also appointed all sorts of their own people to officiate for them as priests in the shrines at the high places.

verses.textZh: 他们既惧怕耶和华，又服事他们的神；从哪个民族掳来的，就按照哪个民族的习俗服事他们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们既惧怕耶和华，又服事他们的神；从哪个民族掳来的，就按照哪个民族的习俗服事他们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们又惧怕耶和华，又事奉自己的神，从何邦迁移，就随何邦的风俗。
verses.textEnNiv: They worshiped the Lord , but they also served their own gods in accordance with the customs of the nations from which they had been brought.
verses.textEnEsv: So they feared the Lord but also served their own gods, after the manner of the nations from among whom they had been carried away.
verses.textEnNkjv: They feared the Lord, yet served their own gods—according to the rituals of the nations from among whom they were carried away.
verses.textEnNlt: And though they worshiped the Lord , they continued to follow their own gods according to the religious customs of the nations from which they came.
verses.textEnNasb: They feared the Lord, yet they were serving their own gods in accordance with the custom of the nations from among whom they had been taken into exile.
verses.textEn: They worshiped the Lord , but they also served their own gods in accordance with the customs of the nations from which they had been brought.

verses.textZh: 直到今日，他们仍是按照他们初时的习俗去行；他们不敬畏耶和华，行事不按他们的规例和典章，也不按耶和华曾吩咐雅各的子孙的律法和诫命。耶和华曾给雅各起名为以色列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 直到今日，他们仍是按照他们初时的习俗去行；他们不敬畏耶和华，行事不按他们的规例和典章，也不按耶和华曾吩咐雅各的子孙的律法和诫命。耶和华曾给雅各起名为以色列。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们直到如今仍照先前的风俗去行，不专心敬畏耶和华，不全守自己的规矩、典章，也不遵守耶和华吩咐雅各后裔的律法、诫命。（雅各，就是从前耶和华起名叫以色列的。）
verses.textEnNiv: To this day they persist in their former practices. They neither worship the Lord nor adhere to the decrees and regulations, the laws and commands that the Lord gave the descendants of Jacob, whom he named Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: To this day they do according to the former manner. They do not fear the Lord , and they do not follow the statutes or the rules or the law or the commandment that the Lord commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: To this day they continue practicing the former rituals; they do not fear the Lord, nor do they follow their statutes or their ordinances, or the law and commandment which the Lord had commanded the children of Jacob, whom He named Israel,
verses.textEnNlt: And this is still going on today. They continue to follow their former practices instead of truly worshiping the Lord and obeying the decrees, regulations, instructions, and commands he gave the descendants of Jacob, whose name he changed to Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: To this day they act in accordance with the earlier customs: they do not fear the Lord, nor do they follow their statutes, their ordinances, the Law, or the commandments which the Lord commanded the sons of Jacob, whom He named Israel.
verses.textEn: To this day they persist in their former practices. They neither worship the Lord nor adhere to the decrees and regulations, the laws and commands that the Lord gave the descendants of Jacob, whom he named Israel.

verses.textZh: 耶和华曾经和他们立约，又吩咐他们说："你们不可崇敬别的神，不可跪拜他们，不可服事他们，也不可向他们献祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华曾经和他们立约，又吩咐他们说："你们不可崇敬别的神，不可跪拜他们，不可服事他们，也不可向他们献祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华曾与他们立约，嘱咐他们说：「不可敬畏别神，不可跪拜事奉他，也不可向他献祭。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord made a covenant with the Israelites, he commanded them: "Do not worship any other gods or bow down to them, serve them or sacrifice to them.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord made a covenant with them and commanded them, "You shall not fear other gods or bow yourselves to them or serve them or sacrifice to them,
verses.textEnNkjv: with whom the Lord had made a covenant and charged them, saying: "You shall not fear other gods, nor bow down to them nor serve them nor sacrifice to them;
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord had made a covenant with the descendants of Jacob and commanded them: "Do not worship any other gods or bow before them or serve them or offer sacrifices to them.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord made a covenant with them and commanded them, saying, "You shall not fear other gods, nor bow down to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them.
verses.textEn: When the Lord made a covenant with the Israelites, he commanded them: "Do not worship any other gods or bow down to them, serve them or sacrifice to them.

verses.textZh: 但那曾用大能和伸出的膀臂把你们从埃及地领出来的耶和华，你们应当敬畏他，跪拜他和向他献祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但那曾用大能和伸出的膀臂把你们从埃及地领出来的耶和华，你们应当敬畏他，跪拜他和向他献祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 但那用大能和伸出来的膀臂领你们出埃及地的耶和华，你们当敬畏，跪拜，向他献祭。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord , who brought you up out of Egypt with mighty power and outstretched arm, is the one you must worship. To him you shall bow down and to him offer sacrifices.
verses.textEnEsv: but you shall fear the Lord , who brought you out of the land of Egypt with great power and with an outstretched arm. You shall bow yourselves to him, and to him you shall sacrifice.
verses.textEnNkjv: but the Lord, who brought you up from the land of Egypt with great power and an outstretched arm, Him you shall fear, Him you shall worship, and to Him you shall offer sacrifice.
verses.textEnNlt: But worship only the Lord , who brought you out of Egypt with great strength and a powerful arm. Bow down to him alone, and offer sacrifices only to him.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord, who brought you up from the land of Egypt with great power and with an outstretched arm, Him you shall fear, and to Him you shall bow down, and to Him you shall sacrifice.
verses.textEn: But the Lord , who brought you up out of Egypt with mighty power and outstretched arm, is the one you must worship. To him you shall bow down and to him offer sacrifices.

verses.textZh: 他写给你们的律例、典章、律法和诫命，你们要永远谨守遵行，不要崇敬别的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他写给你们的律例、典章、律法和诫命，你们要永远谨守遵行，不要崇敬别的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 他给你们写的律例、典章、律法、诫命，你们应当永远谨守遵行，不可敬畏别神。
verses.textEnNiv: You must always be careful to keep the decrees and regulations, the laws and commands he wrote for you. Do not worship other gods.
verses.textEnEsv: And the statutes and the rules and the law and the commandment that he wrote for you, you shall always be careful to do. You shall not fear other gods,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the statutes, the ordinances, the law, and the commandment which He wrote for you, you shall be careful to observe forever; you shall not fear other gods.
verses.textEnNlt: Be careful at all times to obey the decrees, regulations, instructions, and commands that he wrote for you. You must not worship other gods.
verses.textEnNasb: And the statutes, the ordinances, the Law, and the commandment which He wrote for you, you shall take care to do always; and you shall not fear other gods.
verses.textEn: You must always be careful to keep the decrees and regulations, the laws and commands he wrote for you. Do not worship other gods.

verses.textZh: 我和你们所立的约你们不可忘记，不要崇敬别的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我和你们所立的约你们不可忘记，不要崇敬别的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我－耶和华与你们所立的约你们不可忘记，也不可敬畏别神。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not forget the covenant I have made with you, and do not worship other gods.
verses.textEnEsv: and you shall not forget the covenant that I have made with you. You shall not fear other gods,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the covenant that I have made with you, you shall not forget, nor shall you fear other gods.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not forget the covenant I made with you, and do not worship other gods.
verses.textEnNasb: The covenant that I have made with you, you shall not forget, nor shall you fear other gods.
verses.textEn: Do not forget the covenant I have made with you, and do not worship other gods.

verses.textZh: 但要敬畏耶和华你们的神，他必救你们脱离所有仇敌的手。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但要敬畏耶和华你们的神，他必救你们脱离所有仇敌的手。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但要敬畏耶和华－你们的神，他必救你们脱离一切仇敌的手。」
verses.textEnNiv: Rather, worship the Lord your God; it is he who will deliver you from the hand of all your enemies."
verses.textEnEsv: but you shall fear the Lord your God, and he will deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord your God you shall fear; and He will deliver you from the hand of all your enemies."
verses.textEnNlt: You must worship only the Lord your God. He is the one who will rescue you from all your enemies."
verses.textEnNasb: But you shall fear the Lord your God; and He will save you from the hand of all your enemies."
verses.textEn: Rather, worship the Lord your God; it is he who will deliver you from the hand of all your enemies."

verses.textZh: 可是他们没有听从，仍然照着他们起初的习俗去行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是他们没有听从，仍然照着他们起初的习俗去行。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却不听从，仍照先前的风俗去行。
verses.textEnNiv: They would not listen, however, but persisted in their former practices.
verses.textEnEsv: However, they would not listen, but they did according to their former manner.
verses.textEnNkjv: However they did not obey, but they followed their former rituals.
verses.textEnNlt: But the people would not listen and continued to follow their former practices.
verses.textEnNasb: However, they did not listen, but they kept acting in accordance with their earlier custom.
verses.textEn: They would not listen, however, but persisted in their former practices.

verses.textZh: 这样，这些民族一方面敬畏耶和华；另一方面又继续服事他们的偶像。他们的子子孙孙继续照着他们的祖先所行的去行，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，这些民族一方面敬畏耶和华；另一方面又继续服事他们的偶像。他们的子子孙孙继续照着他们的祖先所行的去行，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 如此这些民又惧怕耶和华，又事奉他们的偶像。他们子子孙孙也都照样行，效法他们的祖宗，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: Even while these people were worshiping the Lord , they were serving their idols. To this day their children and grandchildren continue to do as their ancestors did.
verses.textEnEsv: So these nations feared the Lord and also served their carved images. Their children did likewise, and their children’s children—as their fathers did, so they do to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So these nations feared the Lord, yet served their carved images; also their children and their children’s children have continued doing as their fathers did, even to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: So while these new residents worshiped the Lord , they also worshiped their idols. And to this day their descendants do the same.
verses.textEnNasb: So while these nations feared the Lord, they also served their idols; their children likewise and their grandchildren, just as their fathers did, they do to this day.
verses.textEn: Even while these people were worshiping the Lord , they were serving their idols. To this day their children and grandchildren continue to do as their ancestors did.

verses.textZh: 以色列王以拉的儿子何细亚在位第三年，犹大王亚哈斯的儿子希西家登基作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王以拉的儿子何细亚在位第三年，犹大王亚哈斯的儿子希西家登基作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王以拉的儿子何细亚第三年，犹大王亚哈斯的儿子希西家登基。
verses.textEnNiv: In the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Hezekiah son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.
verses.textEnEsv: In the third year of Hoshea son of Elah, king of Israel, Hezekiah the son of Ahaz, king of Judah, began to reign.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea the son of Elah, king of Israel, that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz, king of Judah, began to reign.
verses.textEnNlt: Hezekiah son of Ahaz began to rule over Judah in the third year of King Hoshea’s reign in Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about in the third year of Hoshea, the son of Elah king of Israel, that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah became king.
verses.textEn: In the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Hezekiah son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.

verses.textZh: 他登基的时候是二十五岁；他在耶路撒冷作王二十九年，他母亲名叫亚比，是撒迦利雅的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他登基的时候是二十五岁；他在耶路撒冷作王二十九年，他母亲名叫亚比，是撒迦利雅的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 他登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他母亲名叫亚比，是撒迦利雅的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Abijah daughter of Zechariah.
verses.textEnEsv: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abi the daughter of Zechariah.
verses.textEnNkjv: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abi the daughter of Zechariah.
verses.textEnNlt: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.
verses.textEnNasb: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned for twenty-nine years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Abi the daughter of Zechariah.
verses.textEn: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Abijah daughter of Zechariah.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为正的事，效法他的祖宗大卫一切所行的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为正的事，效法他的祖宗大卫一切所行的。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他祖大卫一切所行的。
verses.textEnNiv: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father David had done.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , according to all that David his father had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father David had done.
verses.textEnNlt: He did what was pleasing in the Lord ’s sight, just as his ancestor David had done.
verses.textEnNasb: He did what was right in the sight of the Lord, in accordance with everything that his father David had done.
verses.textEn: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father David had done.

verses.textZh: 他废去邱坛，打碎神柱，砍掉亚舍拉；他又打碎摩西所做的铜蛇，因为直到那些日子，以色列人仍然向它焚香，称它作尼忽士但。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他废去邱坛，打碎神柱，砍掉亚舍拉；他又打碎摩西所做的铜蛇，因为直到那些日子，以色列人仍然向它焚香，称它作尼忽士但。
verses.textZhCuv: 他废去邱坛，毁坏柱像，砍下木偶，打碎摩西所造的铜蛇，因为到那时以色列人仍向铜蛇烧香。希西家叫铜蛇为铜块 。
verses.textEnNiv: He removed the high places, smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles. He broke into pieces the bronze snake Moses had made, for up to that time the Israelites had been burning incense to it. (It was called Nehushtan. )
verses.textEnEsv: He removed the high places and broke the pillars and cut down the Asherah. And he broke in pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made, for until those days the people of Israel had made offerings to it (it was called Nehushtan).
verses.textEnNkjv: He removed the high places and broke the sacred pillars, cut down the wooden image and broke in pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made; for until those days the children of Israel burned incense to it, and called it Nehushtan.
verses.textEnNlt: He removed the pagan shrines, smashed the sacred pillars, and cut down the Asherah poles. He broke up the bronze serpent that Moses had made, because the people of Israel had been offering sacrifices to it. The bronze serpent was called Nehushtan.
verses.textEnNasb: He removed the high places and smashed the memorial stones to pieces, and cut down the Asherah. He also crushed to pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made, for until those days the sons of Israel had been burning incense to it; and it was called Nehushtan.
verses.textEn: He removed the high places, smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles. He broke into pieces the bronze snake Moses had made, for up to that time the Israelites had been burning incense to it. (It was called Nehushtan. )

verses.textZh: 他倚靠耶和华以色列的神，在他以前或以后的犹大列王中，没有像他的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他倚靠耶和华以色列的神，在他以前或以后的犹大列王中，没有像他的。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家倚靠耶和华－以色列的神，在他前后的犹大列王中没有一个及他的。
verses.textEnNiv: Hezekiah trusted in the Lord , the God of Israel. There was no one like him among all the kings of Judah, either before him or after him.
verses.textEnEsv: He trusted in the Lord , the God of Israel, so that there was none like him among all the kings of Judah after him, nor among those who were before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He trusted in the Lord God of Israel, so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah, nor who were before him.
verses.textEnNlt: Hezekiah trusted in the Lord , the God of Israel. There was no one like him among all the kings of Judah, either before or after his time.
verses.textEnNasb: He trusted in the Lord, the God of Israel; and after him there was no one like him among all the kings of Judah, nor among those who came before him.
verses.textEn: Hezekiah trusted in the Lord , the God of Israel. There was no one like him among all the kings of Judah, either before him or after him.

verses.textZh: 他忠于耶和华，没有转离不跟从他，谨守他的吩咐，就是他曾吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他忠于耶和华，没有转离不跟从他，谨守他的吩咐，就是他曾吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他专靠耶和华，总不离开，谨守耶和华所吩咐摩西的诫命。
verses.textEnNiv: He held fast to the Lord and did not stop following him; he kept the commands the Lord had given Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: For he held fast to the Lord . He did not depart from following him, but kept the commandments that the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he held fast to the Lord; he did not depart from following Him, but kept His commandments, which the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: He remained faithful to the Lord in everything, and he carefully obeyed all the commands the Lord had given Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: For he clung to the Lord; he did not desist from following Him, but kept His commandments, which the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: He held fast to the Lord and did not stop following him; he kept the commands the Lord had given Moses.

verses.textZh: 耶和华和他同在，他所有的征战都得到成功。他背叛亚述王，不再臣服他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华和他同在，他所有的征战都得到成功。他背叛亚述王，不再臣服他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华与他同在，他无论往何处去尽都亨通。他背叛、不肯事奉亚述王。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord was with him; he was successful in whatever he undertook. He rebelled against the king of Assyria and did not serve him.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord was with him; wherever he went out, he prospered. He rebelled against the king of Assyria and would not serve him.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord was with him; he prospered wherever he went. And he rebelled against the king of Assyria and did not serve him.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord was with him, and Hezekiah was successful in everything he did. He revolted against the king of Assyria and refused to pay him tribute.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord was with him; wherever he went he was successful. And he revolted against the king of Assyria and did not serve him.
verses.textEn: And the Lord was with him; he was successful in whatever he undertook. He rebelled against the king of Assyria and did not serve him.

verses.textZh: 他攻击非利士人，直到迦萨和它的四境，从哨站以至设防城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他攻击非利士人，直到迦萨和它的四境，从哨站以至设防城。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家攻击非利士人，直到迦萨，并迦萨的四境，从了望楼到坚固城。
verses.textEnNiv: From watchtower to fortified city, he defeated the Philistines, as far as Gaza and its territory.
verses.textEnEsv: He struck down the Philistines as far as Gaza and its territory, from watchtower to fortified city.
verses.textEnNkjv: He subdued the Philistines, as far as Gaza and its territory, from watchtower to fortified city.
verses.textEnNlt: He also conquered the Philistines as far distant as Gaza and its territory, from their smallest outpost to their largest walled city.
verses.textEnNasb: He defeated the Philistines as far as Gaza and its territory, from watchtower to fortified city.
verses.textEn: From watchtower to fortified city, he defeated the Philistines, as far as Gaza and its territory.

verses.textZh: 希西家王在位第四年，就是以色列王以拉的儿子何细亚在位第七年，亚述王撒缦以色上来攻击撒玛利亚，把城围困；
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家王在位第四年，就是以色列王以拉的儿子何细亚在位第七年，亚述王撒缦以色上来攻击撒玛利亚，把城围困；
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家王第四年，就是以色列王以拉的儿子何细亚第七年，亚述王撒缦以色上来围困撒马利亚；
verses.textEnNiv: In King Hezekiah’s fourth year, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Shalmaneser king of Assyria marched against Samaria and laid siege to it.
verses.textEnEsv: In the fourth year of King Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah, king of Israel, Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria and besieged it,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass in the fourth year of King Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea the son of Elah, king of Israel, that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria and besieged it.
verses.textEnNlt: During the fourth year of Hezekiah’s reign, which was the seventh year of King Hoshea’s reign in Israel, King Shalmaneser of Assyria attacked the city of Samaria and began a siege against it.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the fourth year of King Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Shalmaneser king of Assyria marched against Samaria and besieged it.
verses.textEn: In King Hezekiah’s fourth year, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Shalmaneser king of Assyria marched against Samaria and laid siege to it.

verses.textZh: 过了三年，他们就攻取了撒玛利亚。希西家在位第六年，就是以色列王何细亚在位第九年，撒玛利亚被攻取了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了三年，他们就攻取了撒玛利亚。希西家在位第六年，就是以色列王何细亚在位第九年，撒玛利亚被攻取了。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了三年就攻取了城。希西家第六年，以色列王何细亚第九年，撒马利亚被攻取了。
verses.textEnNiv: At the end of three years the Assyrians took it. So Samaria was captured in Hezekiah’s sixth year, which was the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: and at the end of three years he took it. In the sixth year of Hezekiah, which was the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.
verses.textEnNkjv: And at the end of three years they took it. In the sixth year of Hezekiah, that is, the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.
verses.textEnNlt: Three years later, during the sixth year of King Hezekiah’s reign and the ninth year of King Hoshea’s reign in Israel, Samaria fell.
verses.textEnNasb: And at the end of three years they captured it; in the sixth year of Hezekiah, which was the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was captured.
verses.textEn: At the end of three years the Assyrians took it. So Samaria was captured in Hezekiah’s sixth year, which was the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel.

verses.textZh: 亚述王把以色列人掳到亚述去，把他们安置在哈腊、哈博河和歌散河，以及玛代人的城里；
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述王把以色列人掳到亚述去，把他们安置在哈腊、哈博河和歌散河，以及玛代人的城里；
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述王将以色列人掳到亚述，把他们安置在哈腊与歌散的哈博河边，并米底亚人的城邑；
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Assyria deported Israel to Assyria and settled them in Halah, in Gozan on the Habor River and in towns of the Medes.
verses.textEnEsv: The king of Assyria carried the Israelites away to Assyria and put them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king of Assyria carried Israel away captive to Assyria, and put them in Halah and by the Habor, the River of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes,
verses.textEnNlt: At that time the king of Assyria exiled the Israelites to Assyria and placed them in colonies in Halah, along the banks of the Habor River in Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Assyria led Israel into exile to Assyria, and put them in Halah and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
verses.textEn: The king of Assyria deported Israel to Assyria and settled them in Halah, in Gozan on the Habor River and in towns of the Medes.

verses.textZh: 这是因为他们不听从耶和华他们神的话，违背他的约；耶和华的仆人摩西吩咐的一切，他们都不听从，不遵行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是因为他们不听从耶和华他们神的话，违背他的约；耶和华的仆人摩西吩咐的一切，他们都不听从，不遵行。
verses.textZhCuv: 都因他们不听从耶和华－他们神的话，违背他的约，就是耶和华仆人摩西吩咐他们所当守的。
verses.textEnNiv: This happened because they had not obeyed the Lord their God, but had violated his covenant—all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded. They neither listened to the commands nor carried them out.
verses.textEnEsv: because they did not obey the voice of the Lord their God but transgressed his covenant, even all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded. They neither listened nor obeyed.
verses.textEnNkjv: because they did not obey the voice of the Lord their God, but transgressed His covenant and all that Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded; and they would neither hear nor do them.
verses.textEnNlt: For they refused to listen to the Lord their God and obey him. Instead, they violated his covenant—all the laws that Moses the Lord ’s servant had commanded them to obey.
verses.textEnNasb: This happened because they did not obey the voice of the Lord their God, but violated His covenant, all that Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded; they would neither listen nor do it.
verses.textEn: This happened because they had not obeyed the Lord their God, but had violated his covenant—all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded. They neither listened to the commands nor carried them out.

verses.textZh: 希西家王在位第十四年，亚述王西拿基立上来攻击犹大所有的设防城，占据了它们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家王在位第十四年，亚述王西拿基立上来攻击犹大所有的设防城，占据了它们。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家王十四年，亚述王西拿基立上来攻击犹大的一切坚固城，将城攻取。
verses.textEnNiv: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah’s reign, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.
verses.textEnEsv: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and took them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and took them.
verses.textEnNlt: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah’s reign, King Sennacherib of Assyria came to attack the fortified towns of Judah and conquered them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria marched against all the fortified cities of Judah and seized them.
verses.textEn: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah’s reign, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.

verses.textZh: 犹大王希西家派人往拉吉去见亚述王说："我有罪了，请你离我回去吧，你们加于我的处分，我必承当。"于是亚述王罚了犹大王希西家九千公斤银子和九百公斤金子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王希西家派人往拉吉去见亚述王说："我有罪了，请你离我回去吧，你们加于我的处分，我必承当。"于是亚述王罚了犹大王希西家九千公斤银子和九百公斤金子。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王希西家差人往拉吉去见亚述王，说：「我有罪了，求你离开我；凡你罚我的，我必承当。」于是亚述王罚犹大王希西家银子三百他连得，金子三十他连得。
verses.textEnNiv: So Hezekiah king of Judah sent this message to the king of Assyria at Lachish: "I have done wrong. Withdraw from me, and I will pay whatever you demand of me." The king of Assyria exacted from Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria at Lachish, saying, "I have done wrong; withdraw from me. Whatever you impose on me I will bear." And the king of Assyria required of Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria at Lachish, saying, "I have done wrong; turn away from me; whatever you impose on me I will pay." And the king of Assyria assessed Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
verses.textEnNlt: King Hezekiah sent this message to the king of Assyria at Lachish: "I have done wrong. I will pay whatever tribute money you demand if you will only withdraw." The king of Assyria then demanded a settlement of more than eleven tons of silver and one ton of gold.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hezekiah king of Judah sent messengers to the king of Assyria at Lachish, saying, "I have done wrong. Withdraw from me; whatever you impose on me I will endure." So the king of Assyria imposed on Hezekiah king of Judah the payment of three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
verses.textEn: So Hezekiah king of Judah sent this message to the king of Assyria at Lachish: "I have done wrong. Withdraw from me, and I will pay whatever you demand of me." The king of Assyria exacted from Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

verses.textZh: 希西家就把耶和华殿和王宫宝库内找到的所有金子都给了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家就把耶和华殿和王宫宝库内找到的所有金子都给了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家就把耶和华殿里和王宫府库里所有的银子都给了他。
verses.textEnNiv: So Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the temple of the Lord and in the treasuries of the royal palace.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the Lord and in the treasuries of the king’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the Lord and in the treasuries of the king’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: To gather this amount, King Hezekiah used all the silver stored in the Temple of the Lord and in the palace treasury.
verses.textEnNasb: Hezekiah then gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the Lord, and in the treasuries of the king’s house.
verses.textEn: So Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the temple of the Lord and in the treasuries of the royal palace.

verses.textZh: 那时，犹大王希西家把耶和华殿门上和自己包在门柱上的金子，都刮了下来，给了亚述王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，犹大王希西家把耶和华殿门上和自己包在门柱上的金子，都刮了下来，给了亚述王。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，犹大王希西家将耶和华殿门上的金子和他自己包在柱上的金子都刮下来，给了亚述王。
verses.textEnNiv: At this time Hezekiah king of Judah stripped off the gold with which he had covered the doors and doorposts of the temple of the Lord , and gave it to the king of Assyria.
verses.textEnEsv: At that time Hezekiah stripped the gold from the doors of the temple of the Lord and from the doorposts that Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid and gave it to the king of Assyria.
