verses.textEnNkjv: At that time Hezekiah stripped thegoldfrom the doors of the temple of the Lord, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.
verses.textEnNlt: Hezekiah even stripped the gold from the doors of the Lord ’s Temple and from the doorposts he had overlaid with gold, and he gave it all to the Assyrian king.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of the Lord, and from the doorposts, which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and he gave it to the king of Assyria.
verses.textEn: At this time Hezekiah king of Judah stripped off the gold with which he had covered the doors and doorposts of the temple of the Lord , and gave it to the king of Assyria.

verses.textZh: 亚述王从拉吉派他珥探、拉伯撒利和拉伯沙基率领大军，往耶路撒冷，到希西家王那里去。他们就上来，去到耶路撒冷。他们到达以后，就站在上池的引水道旁，在漂布地的大路上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述王从拉吉派他珥探、拉伯撒利和拉伯沙基率领大军，往耶路撒冷，到希西家王那里去。他们就上来，去到耶路撒冷。他们到达以后，就站在上池的引水道旁，在漂布地的大路上。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述王从拉吉差遣他珥探、拉伯撒利，和拉伯沙基率领大军往耶路撒冷，到希西家王那里去。他们上到耶路撒冷，就站在上池的水沟旁，在漂布地的大路上。
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Assyria sent his supreme commander, his chief officer and his field commander with a large army, from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem. They came up to Jerusalem and stopped at the aqueduct of the Upper Pool, on the road to the Washerman’s Field.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Assyria sent the Tartan, the Rab-saris, and the Rabshakeh with a great army from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. When they arrived, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is on the highway to the Washer’s Field.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king of Assyria sent the Tartan, the Rabsaris, and the Rabshakeh from Lachish, with a great army against Jerusalem, to King Hezekiah. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. When they had come up, they went and stood by the aqueduct from the upper pool, which was on the highway to the Fuller’s Field.
verses.textEnNlt: Nevertheless, the king of Assyria sent his commander in chief, his field commander, and his chief of staff from Lachish with a huge army to confront King Hezekiah in Jerusalem. The Assyrians took up a position beside the aqueduct that feeds water into the upper pool, near the road leading to the field where cloth is washed.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Assyria sent Tartan, Rab-saris, and Rabshakeh from Lachish to King Hezekiah with a large army to Jerusalem. So they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they went up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is on the road of the fuller’s field.
verses.textEn: The king of Assyria sent his supreme commander, his chief officer and his field commander with a large army, from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem. They came up to Jerusalem and stopped at the aqueduct of the Upper Pool, on the road to the Washerman’s Field.

verses.textZh: 他们呼叫王；希勒家的儿子王宫总管以利亚敬、书记舍伯那和亚萨的儿子史官约亚就出来见他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们呼叫王；希勒家的儿子王宫总管以利亚敬、书记舍伯那和亚萨的儿子史官约亚就出来见他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们呼叫王的时候，就有希勒家的儿子家宰以利亚敬，并书记舍伯那和亚萨的儿子史官约亚，出来见他们。
verses.textEnNiv: They called for the king; and Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went out to them.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they called for the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebnah the secretary, and Joah the son of Asaph, the recorder.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they had called to the king, Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph, the recorder, came out to them.
verses.textEnNlt: They summoned King Hezekiah, but the king sent these officials to meet with them: Eliakim son of Hilkiah, the palace administrator; Shebna the court secretary; and Joah son of Asaph, the royal historian.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they called to the king, and Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was in charge of the household, Shebnah the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the secretary, went out to them.
verses.textEn: They called for the king; and Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went out to them.

verses.textZh: 拉伯沙基对他们说："你们要对希西家说：‘亚述大王这样说：你所倚赖的这种防御算是甚么呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉伯沙基对他们说："你们要对希西家说：‘亚述大王这样说：你所倚赖的这种防御算是甚么呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 拉伯沙基说：「你们去告诉希西家说，亚述大王如此说：『你所倚靠的有什么可仗赖的呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The field commander said to them, "Tell Hezekiah: " ‘This is what the great king, the king of Assyria, says: On what are you basing this confidence of yours?
verses.textEnEsv: And the Rabshakeh said to them, "Say to Hezekiah, ‘Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria: On what do you rest this trust of yours?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Rabshakeh said to them, "Say now to Hezekiah, ‘Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria: "What confidence is this in which you trust?
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Assyrian king’s chief of staff told them to give this message to Hezekiah: "This is what the great king of Assyria says: What are you trusting in that makes you so confident?
verses.textEnNasb: And Rabshakeh said to them, "Say now to Hezekiah, ‘This is what the great king, the king of Assyria says: "What is this confidence that you have?
verses.textEn: The field commander said to them, "Tell Hezekiah: " ‘This is what the great king, the king of Assyria, says: On what are you basing this confidence of yours?

verses.textZh: 你说有作战的智谋和能力，只是嘴上空言，现在你倚赖谁才背叛我呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你说有作战的智谋和能力，只是嘴上空言，现在你倚赖谁才背叛我呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你说有打仗的计谋和能力，我看不过是虚话。你到底倚靠谁才背叛我呢？
verses.textEnNiv: You say you have the counsel and the might for war—but you speak only empty words. On whom are you depending, that you rebel against me?
verses.textEnEsv: Do you think that mere words are strategy and power for war? In whom do you now trust, that you have rebelled against me?
verses.textEnNkjv: You speak of having plans and power for war; but theyare mere words. And in whom do you trust, that you rebel against me?
verses.textEnNlt: Do you think that mere words can substitute for military skill and strength? Who are you counting on, that you have rebelled against me?
verses.textEnNasb: You say—but they are only empty words—‘I have a plan and strength for the war.’ Now on whom have you relied, that you have revolted against me?
verses.textEn: You say you have the counsel and the might for war—but you speak only empty words. On whom are you depending, that you rebel against me?

verses.textZh: 你看，你倚赖埃及这压伤的芦苇做的手杖，人若是倚靠它，它必刺入他的手，把手刺伤，埃及王法老对所有倚赖他的人正是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你看，你倚赖埃及这压伤的芦苇做的手杖，人若是倚靠它，它必刺入他的手，把手刺伤，埃及王法老对所有倚赖他的人正是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，你所倚靠的埃及是那压伤的苇杖；人若靠这杖，就必刺透他的手。埃及王法老向一切倚靠他的人也是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: Look, I know you are depending on Egypt, that splintered reed of a staff, which pierces the hand of anyone who leans on it! Such is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who depend on him.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, you are trusting now in Egypt, that broken reed of a staff, which will pierce the hand of any man who leans on it. Such is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now look! You are trusting in the staff of this broken reed, Egypt, on which if a man leans, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.
verses.textEnNlt: On Egypt? If you lean on Egypt, it will be like a reed that splinters beneath your weight and pierces your hand. Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, is completely unreliable!
verses.textEnNasb: Now behold, you have relied on the support of this broken reed, on Egypt; on which if a man leans, it will go into his hand and pierce it. That is how Pharaoh king of Egypt is to all who rely on him.
verses.textEn: Look, I know you are depending on Egypt, that splintered reed of a staff, which pierces the hand of anyone who leans on it! Such is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who depend on him.

verses.textZh: 如果你们对我说：我们倚靠的是耶和华我们的神，希西家不是曾把他的邱坛和祭坛废去，又对犹大人和耶路撒冷人说：你们要在耶路撒冷这祭坛前敬拜吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们对我说：我们倚靠的是耶和华我们的神，希西家不是曾把他的邱坛和祭坛废去，又对犹大人和耶路撒冷人说：你们要在耶路撒冷这祭坛前敬拜吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若对我说：我们倚靠耶和华－我们的神，希西家岂不是将神的邱坛和祭坛废去，且对犹大和耶路撒冷的人说：你们当在耶路撒冷这坛前敬拜吗？
verses.textEnNiv: But if you say to me, "We are depending on the Lord our God"—isn’t he the one whose high places and altars Hezekiah removed, saying to Judah and Jerusalem, "You must worship before this altar in Jerusalem"?
verses.textEnEsv: But if you say to me, "We trust in the Lord our God," is it not he whose high places and altars Hezekiah has removed, saying to Judah and to Jerusalem, "You shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem"?
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you say to me, ‘We trust in the Lord our God,’ is it not He whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and said to Judah and Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem’?" ’
verses.textEnNlt: "But perhaps you will say to me, ‘We are trusting in the Lord our God!’ But isn’t he the one who was insulted by Hezekiah? Didn’t Hezekiah tear down his shrines and altars and make everyone in Judah and Jerusalem worship only at the altar here in Jerusalem?
verses.textEnNasb: However, if you say to me, ‘We have trusted in the Lord our God,’ is it not He whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has removed, and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem’?
verses.textEn: But if you say to me, "We are depending on the Lord our God"—isn’t he the one whose high places and altars Hezekiah removed, saying to Judah and Jerusalem, "You must worship before this altar in Jerusalem"?

verses.textZh: 现在，你可以和我主亚述王打赌，我给你二千匹战马，看你能否派出骑兵来骑牠们？
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，你可以和我主亚述王打赌，我给你二千匹战马，看你能否派出骑兵来骑牠们？
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你把当头给我主亚述王，我给你二千匹马，看你这一面骑马的人够不够。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Come now, make a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria: I will give you two thousand horses—if you can put riders on them!
verses.textEnEsv: Come now, make a wager with my master the king of Assyria: I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to set riders on them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, I urge you, give a pledge to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses—if you are able on your part to put riders on them!
verses.textEnNlt: "I’ll tell you what! Strike a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria. I will give you 2,000 horses if you can find that many men to ride on them!
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, come make a wager with my master the king of Assyria: I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to put riders on them!
verses.textEn: " ‘Come now, make a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria: I will give you two thousand horses—if you can put riders on them!

verses.textZh: 否则，你怎能使我主最小的一位臣仆转脸逃跑呢？你竟然倚赖埃及供应战车和战马吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 否则，你怎能使我主最小的一位臣仆转脸逃跑呢？你竟然倚赖埃及供应战车和战马吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 若不然，怎能打败我主臣仆中最小的军长呢？你竟倚靠埃及的战车马兵吗？
verses.textEnNiv: How can you repulse one officer of the least of my master’s officials, even though you are depending on Egypt for chariots and horsemen ?
verses.textEnEsv: How then can you repulse a single captain among the least of my master’s servants, when you trust in Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
verses.textEnNkjv: How then will you repel one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust in Egypt for chariots and horsemen?
verses.textEnNlt: With your tiny army, how can you think of challenging even the weakest contingent of my master’s troops, even with the help of Egypt’s chariots and charioteers?
verses.textEnNasb: How then can you drive back even one official of the least of my master’s servants, and rely on Egypt for chariots and horsemen?
verses.textEn: How can you repulse one officer of the least of my master’s officials, even though you are depending on Egypt for chariots and horsemen ?

verses.textZh: 现在，我上来攻击这地方，要毁灭它，不是有耶和华的意思吗？耶和华曾对我说：上去攻击那地，把它毁灭。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，我上来攻击这地方，要毁灭它，不是有耶和华的意思吗？耶和华曾对我说：上去攻击那地，把它毁灭。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我上来攻击毁灭这地，岂没有耶和华的意思吗？耶和华吩咐我说：你上去攻击毁灭这地吧！』」
verses.textEnNiv: Furthermore, have I come to attack and destroy this place without word from the Lord ? The Lord himself told me to march against this country and destroy it.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, is it without the Lord that I have come up against this place to destroy it? The Lord said to me, "Go up against this land and destroy it."’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Have I now come up without the Lord against this place to destroy it? The Lord said to me, ‘Go up against this land, and destroy it.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: What’s more, do you think we have invaded your land without the Lord ’s direction? The Lord himself told us, ‘Attack this land and destroy it!’"
verses.textEnNasb: Have I now come up without the Lord’s approval against this place to destroy it? The Lord said to me, ‘Go up against this land and destroy it.’ " ’ "
verses.textEn: Furthermore, have I come to attack and destroy this place without word from the Lord ? The Lord himself told me to march against this country and destroy it.’ "

verses.textZh: 希勒家的儿子以利亚敬、舍伯那和约亚对拉伯沙基说："请用亚兰语和你的仆人们说话，因为我们听得懂；不要用犹大语和我们说话，免得传入在城墙上的人民的耳中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 希勒家的儿子以利亚敬、舍伯那和约亚对拉伯沙基说："请用亚兰语和你的仆人们说话，因为我们听得懂；不要用犹大语和我们说话，免得传入在城墙上的人民的耳中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 希勒家的儿子以利亚敬和舍伯那，并约亚，对拉伯沙基说：「求你用亚兰言语和仆人说话，因为我们懂得；不要用犹大言语和我们说话，达到城上百姓的耳中。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah, and Shebna and Joah said to the field commander, "Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, since we understand it. Don’t speak to us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people on the wall."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, and Shebnah, and Joah, said to the Rabshakeh, "Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it. Do not speak to us in the language of Judah within the hearing of the people who are on the wall."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, Shebna, and Joah said to the Rabshakeh, "Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it; and do not speak to us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people who are on the wall."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah, Shebna, and Joah said to the Assyrian chief of staff, "Please speak to us in Aramaic, for we understand it well. Don’t speak in Hebrew, for the people on the wall will hear."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, Shebnah, and Joah, said to Rabshakeh, "Speak now to your servants in Aramaic, because we understand it; and do not speak with us in Judean so that the people who are on the wall hear you."
verses.textEn: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah, and Shebna and Joah said to the field commander, "Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, since we understand it. Don’t speak to us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people on the wall."

verses.textZh: 拉伯沙基对他们说："我主派我来，只是对你的主和你说这些话吗？不也是对坐在城墙上，和你们在一起吃自己的粪、喝自己的尿的人民说的吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉伯沙基对他们说："我主派我来，只是对你的主和你说这些话吗？不也是对坐在城墙上，和你们在一起吃自己的粪、喝自己的尿的人民说的吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 拉伯沙基说：「我主差遣我来，岂是单对你和你的主说这些话吗？不也是对这些坐在城上、要与你们一同吃自己粪、喝自己尿的人说吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: But the commander replied, "Was it only to your master and you that my master sent me to say these things, and not to the people sitting on the wall—who, like you, will have to eat their own excrement and drink their own urine?"
verses.textEnEsv: But the Rabshakeh said to them, "Has my master sent me to speak these words to your master and to you, and not to the men sitting on the wall, who are doomed with you to eat their own dung and to drink their own urine?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Rabshakeh said to them, "Has my master sent me to your master and to you to speak these words, and not to the men who sit on the wall, who will eat and drink their own waste with you?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Sennacherib’s chief of staff replied, "Do you think my master sent this message only to you and your master? He wants all the people to hear it, for when we put this city under siege, they will suffer along with you. They will be so hungry and thirsty that they will eat their own dung and drink their own urine."
verses.textEnNasb: But Rabshakeh said to them, "Has my master sent me only to your master and to you to speak these words? Has he not also sent me to the men who sit on the wall, doomed to eat their own dung and drink their own urine with you?"
verses.textEn: But the commander replied, "Was it only to your master and you that my master sent me to say these things, and not to the people sitting on the wall—who, like you, will have to eat their own excrement and drink their own urine?"

verses.textZh: 于是拉伯沙基站着，用犹大语大声喊着，说："你们要听亚述大王的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是拉伯沙基站着，用犹大语大声喊着，说："你们要听亚述大王的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是拉伯沙基站着，用犹大言语大声喊着说：「你们当听亚述大王的话！
verses.textEnNiv: Then the commander stood and called out in Hebrew, "Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria!
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Rabshakeh stood and called out in a loud voice in the language of Judah: "Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria!
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Rabshakeh stood and called out with a loud voice in Hebrew, and spoke, saying, "Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria!
verses.textEnNlt: Then the chief of staff stood and shouted in Hebrew to the people on the wall, "Listen to this message from the great king of Assyria!
verses.textEnNasb: Then Rabshakeh stood up and shouted with a loud voice in Judean, saying, "Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria!
verses.textEn: Then the commander stood and called out in Hebrew, "Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria!

verses.textZh: 王这样说：‘不要给希西家欺骗了你们，因为他不能从我的手中解救你们；
verses.textZhCnvs: 王这样说：‘不要给希西家欺骗了你们，因为他不能从我的手中解救你们；
verses.textZhCuv: 王如此说：『你们不要被希西家欺哄了；因他不能救你们脱离我的手。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you. He cannot deliver you from my hand.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the king: ‘Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to deliver you out of my hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the king: ‘Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he shall not be able to deliver you from his hand;
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the king says: Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you. He will never be able to rescue you from my power.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the king says: ‘Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to save you from my hand.
verses.textEn: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you. He cannot deliver you from my hand.

verses.textZh: 也不要让希西家欺骗你们去信赖耶和华说：耶和华一定会解救我们，这城必不会交在亚述王的手中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也不要让希西家欺骗你们去信赖耶和华说：耶和华一定会解救我们，这城必不会交在亚述王的手中。
verses.textZhCuv: 也不要听希西家使你们倚靠耶和华，说耶和华必要拯救我们，这城必不交在亚述王的手中。』
verses.textEnNiv: Do not let Hezekiah persuade you to trust in the Lord when he says, ‘The Lord will surely deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.’
verses.textEnEsv: Do not let Hezekiah make you trust in the Lord by saying, The Lord will surely deliver us, and this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.’
verses.textEnNkjv: nor let Hezekiah make you trust in the Lord, saying, "The Lord will surely deliver us; this city shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria." ’
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let him fool you into trusting in the Lord by saying, ‘The Lord will surely rescue us. This city will never fall into the hands of the Assyrian king!’
verses.textEnNasb: And do not let Hezekiah lead you to trust in the Lord by saying, "The Lord will certainly save us, and this city will not be handed over to the king of Assyria."
verses.textEn: Do not let Hezekiah persuade you to trust in the Lord when he says, ‘The Lord will surely deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.’

verses.textZh: 不要听从希西家，因为亚述王这样说：你们要与我和好，出来向我投降，各人就可以吃自己的葡萄树和无花果树的果子，喝自己水池里的水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要听从希西家，因为亚述王这样说：你们要与我和好，出来向我投降，各人就可以吃自己的葡萄树和无花果树的果子，喝自己水池里的水。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要听希西家的话！因亚述王如此说：『你们要与我和好，出来投降我，各人就可以吃自己葡萄树和无花果树的果子，喝自己井里的水。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not listen to Hezekiah. This is what the king of Assyria says: Make peace with me and come out to me. Then each of you will eat fruit from your own vine and fig tree and drink water from your own cistern,
verses.textEnEsv: Do not listen to Hezekiah, for thus says the king of Assyria: ‘Make your peace with me and come out to me. Then each one of you will eat of his own vine, and each one of his own fig tree, and each one of you will drink the water of his own cistern,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not listen to Hezekiah; for thus says the king of Assyria: ‘Make peace with me by a present and come out to me; and every one of you eat from his own vine and every one from his own fig tree, and every one of you drink the waters of his own cistern;
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t listen to Hezekiah! These are the terms the king of Assyria is offering: Make peace with me—open the gates and come out. Then each of you can continue eating from your own grapevine and fig tree and drinking from your own well.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not listen to Hezekiah, for this is what the king of Assyria says: "Make your peace with me and come out to me, and eat, each one, from his vine and each from his fig tree, and drink, each one, the waters of his own cistern,
verses.textEn: "Do not listen to Hezekiah. This is what the king of Assyria says: Make peace with me and come out to me. Then each of you will eat fruit from your own vine and fig tree and drink water from your own cistern,

verses.textZh: 直到我来带你们到一个像你们国家的地方，那地方有五谷新酒，粮食和葡萄园，橄榄树和蜂蜜，你们必可以活着，不会死亡。不要听从希西家，因为他误导你们说：耶和华必解救我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 直到我来带你们到一个像你们国家的地方，那地方有五谷新酒，粮食和葡萄园，橄榄树和蜂蜜，你们必可以活着，不会死亡。不要听从希西家，因为他误导你们说：耶和华必解救我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 等我来领你们到一个地方与你们本地一样，就是有五谷和新酒之地，有粮食和葡萄园之地，有橄榄树和蜂蜜之地，好使你们存活，不至于死。希西家劝导你们，说耶和华必拯救我们；你们不要听他的话。
verses.textEnNiv: until I come and take you to a land like your own—a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive trees and honey. Choose life and not death! "Do not listen to Hezekiah, for he is misleading you when he says, ‘The Lord will deliver us.’
verses.textEnEsv: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive trees and honey, that you may live, and not die. And do not listen to Hezekiah when he misleads you by saying, "The Lord will deliver us."
verses.textEnNkjv: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive groves and honey, that you may live and not die. But do not listen to Hezekiah, lest he persuade you, saying, "The Lord will deliver us."
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will arrange to take you to another land like this one—a land of grain and new wine, bread and vineyards, olive groves and honey. Choose life instead of death! "Don’t listen to Hezekiah when he tries to mislead you by saying, ‘The Lord will rescue us!’
verses.textEnNasb: until I come and take you to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive trees producing oil, and of honey, so that you will live and not die." But do not listen to Hezekiah, because he misleads you by saying, "The Lord will save us."
verses.textEn: until I come and take you to a land like your own—a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive trees and honey. Choose life and not death! "Do not listen to Hezekiah, for he is misleading you when he says, ‘The Lord will deliver us.’

verses.textZh: 列国的神真能解救他们的国土脱离亚述王的手吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国的神真能解救他们的国土脱离亚述王的手吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 列国的神有哪一个救他本国脱离亚述王的手呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Has the god of any nation ever delivered his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.textEnEsv: Has any of the gods of the nations ever delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.textEnNkjv: Has any of the gods of the nations at all delivered its land from the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.textEnNlt: Have the gods of any other nations ever saved their people from the king of Assyria?
verses.textEnNasb: Has any of the gods of the nations actually saved his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.textEn: Has the god of any nation ever delivered his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?

verses.textZh: 哈马和亚珥拔的神在哪里呢？西法瓦音、希拿和以瓦的神在哪里呢？他们可以解救撒玛利亚脱离我的手吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈马和亚珥拔的神在哪里呢？西法瓦音、希拿和以瓦的神在哪里呢？他们可以解救撒玛利亚脱离我的手吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 哈马、亚珥拔的神在哪里呢？西法瓦音、希拿、以瓦的神在哪里呢？他们曾救撒马利亚脱离我的手吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena and Ivvah? Have they rescued Samaria from my hand?
verses.textEnEsv: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah? Have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
verses.textEnNkjv: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim and Hena and Ivah? Indeed, have they delivered Samaria from my hand?
verses.textEnNlt: What happened to the gods of Hamath and Arpad? And what about the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah? Did any god rescue Samaria from my power?
verses.textEnNasb: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah? Have they saved Samaria from my hand?
verses.textEn: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena and Ivvah? Have they rescued Samaria from my hand?

verses.textZh: 这些国家所有的神，有哪一个曾解救他自己的国家脱离我的手呢？难道耶和华能解救耶路撒冷脱离我的手吗？’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些国家所有的神，有哪一个曾解救他自己的国家脱离我的手呢？难道耶和华能解救耶路撒冷脱离我的手吗？’"
verses.textZhCuv: 这些国的神有谁曾救自己的国脱离我的手呢？难道耶和华能救耶路撒冷脱离我的手吗？』」
verses.textEnNiv: Who of all the gods of these countries has been able to save his land from me? How then can the Lord deliver Jerusalem from my hand?"
verses.textEnEsv: Who among all the gods of the lands have delivered their lands out of my hand, that the Lord should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Who among all the gods of the lands have delivered their countries from my hand, that the Lord should deliver Jerusalem from my hand?’ "
verses.textEnNlt: What god of any nation has ever been able to save its people from my power? So what makes you think that the Lord can rescue Jerusalem from me?"
verses.textEnNasb: Who among all the gods of the lands are there who have saved their land from my hand, that the Lord would save Jerusalem from my hand?’ "
verses.textEn: Who of all the gods of these countries has been able to save his land from me? How then can the Lord deliver Jerusalem from my hand?"

verses.textZh: 众民都不出声，一句话也不回答他，因为王吩咐他们："不要回答他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众民都不出声，一句话也不回答他，因为王吩咐他们："不要回答他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓静默不言，并不回答一句，因为王曾吩咐说：「不要回答他。」
verses.textEnNiv: But the people remained silent and said nothing in reply, because the king had commanded, "Do not answer him."
verses.textEnEsv: But the people were silent and answered him not a word, for the king’s command was, "Do not answer him."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the people held their peace and answered him not a word; for the king’s commandment was, "Do not answer him."
verses.textEnNlt: But the people were silent and did not utter a word because Hezekiah had commanded them, "Do not answer him."
verses.textEnNasb: But the people were silent and did not answer him with even a word, because it was the king’s command: "Do not answer him."
verses.textEn: But the people remained silent and said nothing in reply, because the king had commanded, "Do not answer him."

verses.textZh: 当时王宫总管希勒家的儿子以利亚敬、书记舍伯那和亚萨的儿子史官约亚来到希西家那里，他们的衣服都撕裂了，他们把拉伯沙基的话都告诉了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时王宫总管希勒家的儿子以利亚敬、书记舍伯那和亚萨的儿子史官约亚来到希西家那里，他们的衣服都撕裂了，他们把拉伯沙基的话都告诉了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 当下，希勒家的儿子家宰以利亚敬和书记舍伯那，并亚萨的儿子史官约亚，都撕裂衣服，来到希西家那里，将拉伯沙基的话告诉了他。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went to Hezekiah, with their clothes torn, and told him what the field commander had said.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the secretary, and Joah the son of Asaph, the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn and told him the words of the Rabshakeh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph, the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him the words of the Rabshakeh.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah, the palace administrator; Shebna the court secretary; and Joah son of Asaph, the royal historian, went back to Hezekiah. They tore their clothes in despair, and they went in to see the king and told him what the Assyrian chief of staff had said.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was in charge of the household, and Shebna the scribe and Joah the son of Asaph, the secretary, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and they reported to him the words of Rabshakeh.
verses.textEn: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went to Hezekiah, with their clothes torn, and told him what the field commander had said.

verses.textZh: 希西家王听见了，就把自己的衣服撕裂，披上麻布，来到耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家王听见了，就把自己的衣服撕裂，披上麻布，来到耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家王听见，就撕裂衣服，披上麻布，进了耶和华的殿；
verses.textEnNiv: When King Hezekiah heard this, he tore his clothes and put on sackcloth and went into the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes and covered himself with sackcloth and went into the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, when King Hezekiah heard it, that he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: When King Hezekiah heard their report, he tore his clothes and put on burlap and went into the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Now when King Hezekiah heard the report, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and entered the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: When King Hezekiah heard this, he tore his clothes and put on sackcloth and went into the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 王又派王宫总管以利亚敬、书记舍伯那和祭司中的长老披上麻布，到亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚先知那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王又派王宫总管以利亚敬、书记舍伯那和祭司中的长老披上麻布，到亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚先知那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 使家宰以利亚敬和书记舍伯那，并祭司中的长老，都披上麻布，去见亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚，
verses.textEnNiv: He sent Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary and the leading priests, all wearing sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.
verses.textEnEsv: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the secretary, and the senior priests, covered with sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.
verses.textEnNlt: And he sent Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the court secretary, and the leading priests, all dressed in burlap, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he sent Eliakim, who was in charge of the household, with Shebna the scribe and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.
verses.textEn: He sent Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary and the leading priests, all wearing sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.

verses.textZh: 他们对他说："希西家这样说：‘今天是痛苦、责罚和侮辱的日子，好象婴儿的产期到了，却没有力量生产。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对他说："希西家这样说：‘今天是痛苦、责罚和侮辱的日子，好象婴儿的产期到了，却没有力量生产。
verses.textZhCuv: 对他说：「希西家如此说：『今日是急难、责罚、凌辱的日子，就如妇人将要生产婴孩，却没有力量生产。
verses.textEnNiv: They told him, "This is what Hezekiah says: This day is a day of distress and rebuke and disgrace, as when children come to the moment of birth and there is no strength to deliver them.
verses.textEnEsv: They said to him, "Thus says Hezekiah, This day is a day of distress, of rebuke, and of disgrace; children have come to the point of birth, and there is no strength to bring them forth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said to him, "Thus says Hezekiah: ‘This day is a day of trouble, and rebuke, and blasphemy; for the children have come to birth, but thereis no strength to bring them forth.
verses.textEnNlt: They told him, "This is what King Hezekiah says: Today is a day of trouble, insults, and disgrace. It is like when a child is ready to be born, but the mother has no strength to deliver the baby.
verses.textEnNasb: And they said to him, "This is what Hezekiah says: ‘This day is a day of distress, rebuke, and humiliation; for children have come to the point of birth, and there is no strength to deliver them.
verses.textEn: They told him, "This is what Hezekiah says: This day is a day of distress and rebuke and disgrace, as when children come to the moment of birth and there is no strength to deliver them.

verses.textZh: 或者耶和华你的神听到拉伯沙基所说的话 ，就因着耶和华你的神所听见的话责罚他。所以请为这里余剩的人献上祷告。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 或者耶和华你的神听到拉伯沙基所说的话 ，就因着耶和华你的神所听见的话责罚他。所以请为这里余剩的人献上祷告。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 或者耶和华－你的神听见拉伯沙基的一切话，就是他主人亚述王打发他来辱骂永生神的话，耶和华－你的神听见这话，就发斥责。故此，求你为余剩的民扬声祷告。』」
verses.textEnNiv: It may be that the Lord your God will hear all the words of the field commander, whom his master, the king of Assyria, has sent to ridicule the living God, and that he will rebuke him for the words the Lord your God has heard. Therefore pray for the remnant that still survives."
verses.textEnEsv: It may be that the Lord your God heard all the words of the Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to mock the living God, and will rebuke the words that the Lord your God has heard; therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left."
verses.textEnNkjv: It may be that the Lord your God will hear all the words of the Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to reproach the living God, and will rebuke the words which the Lord your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But perhaps the Lord your God has heard the Assyrian chief of staff, sent by the king to defy the living God, and will punish him for his words. Oh, pray for those of us who are left!"
verses.textEnNasb: Perhaps the Lord your God will hear all the words of Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to taunt the living God, and will avenge the words which the Lord your God has heard. Therefore, offer a prayer for the remnant that is left.’ "
verses.textEn: It may be that the Lord your God will hear all the words of the field commander, whom his master, the king of Assyria, has sent to ridicule the living God, and that he will rebuke him for the words the Lord your God has heard. Therefore pray for the remnant that still survives."

verses.textZh: 希西家王的臣仆就来到以赛亚那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家王的臣仆就来到以赛亚那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家王的臣仆就去见以赛亚。
verses.textEnNiv: When King Hezekiah’s officials came to Isaiah,
verses.textEnEsv: When the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah,
verses.textEnNkjv: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
verses.textEnNlt: After King Hezekiah’s officials delivered the king’s message to Isaiah,
verses.textEnNasb: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
verses.textEn: When King Hezekiah’s officials came to Isaiah,

verses.textZh: 以赛亚对他们说："你们要这样告诉你们的主人：‘耶和华这样说：不要因你所听见亚述王的随从亵渎我的话而惊怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以赛亚对他们说："你们要这样告诉你们的主人：‘耶和华这样说：不要因你所听见亚述王的随从亵渎我的话而惊怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 以赛亚对他们说：「要这样对你们的主人说，耶和华如此说：『你听见亚述王的仆人亵渎我的话，不要惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: Isaiah said to them, "Tell your master, ‘This is what the Lord says: Do not be afraid of what you have heard—those words with which the underlings of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
verses.textEnEsv: Isaiah said to them, "Say to your master, ‘Thus says the Lord : Do not be afraid because of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have reviled me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Isaiah said to them, "Thus you shall say to your master, ‘Thus says the Lord: "Do not be afraid of the words which you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed Me.
verses.textEnNlt: the prophet replied, "Say to your master, ‘This is what the Lord says: Do not be disturbed by this blasphemous speech against me from the Assyrian king’s messengers.
verses.textEnNasb: And Isaiah said to them, "This is what you shall say to your master: ‘The Lord says this: "Do not be fearful because of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed Me.
verses.textEn: Isaiah said to them, "Tell your master, ‘This is what the Lord says: Do not be afraid of what you have heard—those words with which the underlings of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

verses.textZh: 看哪，我要使他的心惊颤 ，他将听见消息，就退回自己的地方去；我要使他在自己的国土倒在刀下。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，我要使他的心惊颤 ，他将听见消息，就退回自己的地方去；我要使他在自己的国土倒在刀下。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必惊动 他的心，他要听见风声就归回本地。我必使他在那里倒在刀下。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Listen! When he hears a certain report, I will make him want to return to his own country, and there I will have him cut down with the sword.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I will put a spirit in him, so that he shall hear a rumor and return to his own land, and I will make him fall by the sword in his own land.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely I will send a spirit upon him, and he shall hear a rumor and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Listen! I myself will move against him, and the king will receive a message that he is needed at home. So he will return to his land, where I will have him killed with a sword.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I am going to put a spirit in him so that he will hear news and return to his own land. And I will make him fall by the sword in his own land." ’ "
verses.textEn: Listen! When he hears a certain report, I will make him want to return to his own country, and there I will have him cut down with the sword.’ "

verses.textZh: 拉伯沙基回去，发觉亚述王正在攻打立拿，因为他曾听说亚述王已拔营离开拉吉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉伯沙基回去，发觉亚述王正在攻打立拿，因为他曾听说亚述王已拔营离开拉吉。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉伯沙基回去，正遇见亚述王攻打立拿，原来他早听见亚述王拔营离开拉吉。
verses.textEnNiv: When the field commander heard that the king of Assyria had left Lachish, he withdrew and found the king fighting against Libnah.
verses.textEnEsv: The Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria fighting against Libnah, for he heard that the king had left Lachish.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Rabshakeh returned and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah, for he heard that he had departed from Lachish.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the Assyrian chief of staff left Jerusalem and went to consult the king of Assyria, who had left Lachish and was attacking Libnah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Rabshakeh returned and found the king of Assyria fighting against Libnah, for he had heard that the king had left Lachish.
verses.textEn: When the field commander heard that the king of Assyria had left Lachish, he withdrew and found the king fighting against Libnah.

verses.textZh: 亚述王听见有关古实王特哈加的消息说："看哪，他出来要和你交战。"于是亚述王再派使者去见希西家说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述王听见有关古实王特哈加的消息说："看哪，他出来要和你交战。"于是亚述王再派使者去见希西家说：
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述王听见人论古实王特哈加说：「他出来要与你争战。」于是亚述王又打发使者去见希西家，吩咐他们说：
verses.textEnNiv: Now Sennacherib received a report that Tirhakah, the king of Cush, was marching out to fight against him. So he again sent messengers to Hezekiah with this word:
verses.textEnEsv: Now the king heard concerning Tirhakah king of Cush, "Behold, he has set out to fight against you." So he sent messengers again to Hezekiah, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king heard concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, "Look, he has come out to make war with you." So he again sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Soon afterward King Sennacherib received word that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was leading an army to fight against him. Before leaving to meet the attack, he sent messengers back to Hezekiah in Jerusalem with this message:
verses.textEnNasb: When he heard them say about Tirhakah king of Cush, "Behold, he has come out to fight you," he sent messengers again to Hezekiah, saying,
verses.textEn: Now Sennacherib received a report that Tirhakah, the king of Cush, was marching out to fight against him. So he again sent messengers to Hezekiah with this word:

verses.textZh: "你们要对犹大王希西家说：‘不要让你所信靠的神欺骗你说：耶路撒冷不会交在亚述王的手中。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要对犹大王希西家说：‘不要让你所信靠的神欺骗你说：耶路撒冷不会交在亚述王的手中。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们对犹大王希西家如此说：『不要听你所倚靠的神欺哄你，说耶路撒冷必不交在亚述王的手中。
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to Hezekiah king of Judah: Do not let the god you depend on deceive you when he says, ‘Jerusalem will not be given into the hands of the king of Assyria.’
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus shall you speak to Hezekiah king of Judah: ‘Do not let your God in whom you trust deceive you by promising that Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus you shall speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying: ‘Do not let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, "Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria."
verses.textEnNlt: "This message is for King Hezekiah of Judah. Don’t let your God, in whom you trust, deceive you with promises that Jerusalem will not be captured by the king of Assyria.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what you shall say to Hezekiah king of Judah: ‘Do not let your God in whom you trust deceive you by saying, "Jerusalem will not be handed over to the king of Assyria."
verses.textEn: "Say to Hezekiah king of Judah: Do not let the god you depend on deceive you when he says, ‘Jerusalem will not be given into the hands of the king of Assyria.’

verses.textZh: 看哪，你听过亚述列王怎样对付列国，把它们完全毁灭，你会得着解救吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，你听过亚述列王怎样对付列国，把它们完全毁灭，你会得着解救吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你总听说亚述诸王向列国所行的，乃是尽行灭绝，难道你还能得救吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Surely you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the countries, destroying them completely. And will you be delivered?
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, devoting them to destruction. And shall you be delivered?
verses.textEnNkjv: Look! You have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by utterly destroying them; and shall you be delivered?
verses.textEnNlt: You know perfectly well what the kings of Assyria have done wherever they have gone. They have completely destroyed everyone who stood in their way! Why should you be any different?
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, you yourself have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the lands, destroying them completely. So will you be saved?
verses.textEn: Surely you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the countries, destroying them completely. And will you be delivered?

verses.textZh: 我祖先所消灭的民族，就是歌散人、哈兰人、利色人和在提．拉撒的伊甸人，他们的神可曾解救他们吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我祖先所消灭的民族，就是歌散人、哈兰人、利色人和在提．拉撒的伊甸人，他们的神可曾解救他们吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我列祖所毁灭的，就是歌散、哈兰、利色，和属提‧拉撒的伊甸人，这些国的神何曾拯救这些国呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Did the gods of the nations that were destroyed by my predecessors deliver them—the gods of Gozan, Harran, Rezeph and the people of Eden who were in Tel Assar?
verses.textEnEsv: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, the nations that my fathers destroyed, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the people of Eden who were in Telassar?
verses.textEnNkjv: Have the gods of the nations delivered those whom my fathers have destroyed, Gozan and Haran and Rezeph, and the people of Eden who were in Telassar?
verses.textEnNlt: Have the gods of other nations rescued them—such nations as Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the people of Eden who were in Tel-assar? My predecessors destroyed them all!
verses.textEnNasb: Did the gods of the nations which my fathers destroyed save them: Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the sons of Eden who were in Telassar?
verses.textEn: Did the gods of the nations that were destroyed by my predecessors deliver them—the gods of Gozan, Harran, Rezeph and the people of Eden who were in Tel Assar?

verses.textZh: 哈马王、亚珥拔王、西法瓦音城的王、希拿王和以瓦王在哪里呢？’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈马王、亚珥拔王、西法瓦音城的王、希拿王和以瓦王在哪里呢？’"
verses.textZhCuv: 哈马的王、亚珥拔的王、西法瓦音城的王、希拿，和以瓦的王都在哪里呢？』」
verses.textEnNiv: Where is the king of Hamath or the king of Arpad? Where are the kings of Lair, Sepharvaim, Hena and Ivvah?"
verses.textEnEsv: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, the king of the city of Sepharvaim, the king of Hena, or the king of Ivvah?’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?’ "
verses.textEnNlt: What happened to the king of Hamath and the king of Arpad? What happened to the kings of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah?"
verses.textEnNasb: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, the king of the city of Sepharvaim, and of Hena and Ivvah?’ "
verses.textEn: Where is the king of Hamath or the king of Arpad? Where are the kings of Lair, Sepharvaim, Hena and Ivvah?"

verses.textZh: 希西家从使者手中接过信件，念完了，就上耶和华的殿。希西家把信件在耶和华面前展开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家从使者手中接过信件，念完了，就上耶和华的殿。希西家把信件在耶和华面前展开。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家从使者手里接过书信来，看完了，就上耶和华的殿，将书信在耶和华面前展开。
verses.textEnNiv: Hezekiah received the letter from the messengers and read it. Then he went up to the temple of the Lord and spread it out before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it; and Hezekiah went up to the house of the Lord and spread it before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it; and Hezekiah went up to the house of the Lord, and spread it before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: After Hezekiah received the letter from the messengers and read it, he went up to the Lord ’s Temple and spread it out before the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hezekiah took the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it, and he went up to the house of the Lord and spread it out before the Lord.
verses.textEn: Hezekiah received the letter from the messengers and read it. Then he went up to the temple of the Lord and spread it out before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 希西家在耶和华面前祷告，说："耶和华以色列的神，坐在二基路伯中间的啊，只有你是地上万国的神，天地是你创造的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家在耶和华面前祷告，说："耶和华以色列的神，坐在二基路伯中间的啊，只有你是地上万国的神，天地是你创造的。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家向耶和华祷告说：「坐在二基路伯上耶和华－以色列的神啊，你是天下万国的神，你曾创造天地。
verses.textEnNiv: And Hezekiah prayed to the Lord : " Lord , the God of Israel, enthroned between the cherubim, you alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hezekiah prayed before the Lord and said: "O Lord , the God of Israel, enthroned above the cherubim, you are the God, you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; you have made the heavens and the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hezekiah prayed before the Lord, and said: "O Lord God of Israel, theOne who dwells between the cherubim, You are God, You alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.
verses.textEnNlt: And Hezekiah prayed this prayer before the Lord : "O Lord , God of Israel, you are enthroned between the mighty cherubim! You alone are God of all the kingdoms of the earth. You alone created the heavens and the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Hezekiah prayed before the Lord and said, "Lord, God of Israel, enthroned above the cherubim, You are the God, You alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.
verses.textEn: And Hezekiah prayed to the Lord : " Lord , the God of Israel, enthroned between the cherubim, you alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你侧耳聆听；耶和华啊！求你睁眼垂顾；听那派使者来侮辱永活的神的西拿基立的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你侧耳聆听；耶和华啊！求你睁眼垂顾；听那派使者来侮辱永活的神的西拿基立的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你侧耳而听！耶和华啊，求你睁眼而看！要听西拿基立打发使者来辱骂永生神的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Give ear, Lord , and hear; open your eyes, Lord , and see; listen to the words Sennacherib has sent to ridicule the living God.
verses.textEnEsv: Incline your ear, O Lord , and hear; open your eyes, O Lord , and see; and hear the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent to mock the living God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Incline Your ear, O Lord, and hear; open Your eyes, O Lord, and see; and hear the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent to reproach the living God.
verses.textEnNlt: Bend down, O Lord , and listen! Open your eyes, O Lord , and see! Listen to Sennacherib’s words of defiance against the living God.
verses.textEnNasb: Incline Your ear, Lord, and hear; open Your eyes, Lord, and see; and listen to the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent to taunt the living God.
verses.textEn: Give ear, Lord , and hear; open your eyes, Lord , and see; listen to the words Sennacherib has sent to ridicule the living God.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！亚述列王真的曾毁坏列国和它们的领土，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！亚述列王真的曾毁坏列国和它们的领土，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，亚述诸王果然使列国和列国之地变为荒凉，
verses.textEnNiv: "It is true, Lord , that the Assyrian kings have laid waste these nations and their lands.
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, O Lord , the kings of Assyria have laid waste the nations and their lands
verses.textEnNkjv: Truly, Lord, the kings of Assyria have laid waste the nations and their lands,
verses.textEnNlt: "It is true, Lord , that the kings of Assyria have destroyed all these nations.
verses.textEnNasb: It is true, Lord; the kings of Assyria have laid waste the nations and their lands,
verses.textEn: "It is true, Lord , that the Assyrian kings have laid waste these nations and their lands.

verses.textZh: 把它们的神丢进火里，但他们并不是神，不过是人手用木头、石头做成的，因此他们可以把他们除掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把它们的神丢进火里，但他们并不是神，不过是人手用木头、石头做成的，因此他们可以把他们除掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 将列国的神像都扔在火里；因为它本不是神，乃是人手所造的，是木头石头的，所以灭绝它。
verses.textEnNiv: They have thrown their gods into the fire and destroyed them, for they were not gods but only wood and stone, fashioned by human hands.
verses.textEnEsv: and have cast their gods into the fire, for they were not gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone. Therefore they were destroyed.
verses.textEnNkjv: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were not gods, but the work of men’s hands—wood and stone. Therefore they destroyed them.
verses.textEnNlt: And they have thrown the gods of these nations into the fire and burned them. But of course the Assyrians could destroy them! They were not gods at all—only idols of wood and stone shaped by human hands.
verses.textEnNasb: and have hurled their gods into the fire; for they were not gods, but only the work of human hands, wood and stone. So they have destroyed them.
verses.textEn: They have thrown their gods into the fire and destroyed them, for they were not gods but only wood and stone, fashioned by human hands.

verses.textZh: 现在，耶和华我们的神啊，求你从他的手中把我们拯救出来，地上万国就可以知道只有你耶和华才是神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，耶和华我们的神啊，求你从他的手中把我们拯救出来，地上万国就可以知道只有你耶和华才是神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我们的神啊，现在求你救我们脱离亚述王的手，使天下万国都知道惟独你－耶和华是神！」
verses.textEnNiv: Now, Lord our God, deliver us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you alone, Lord , are God."
verses.textEnEsv: So now, O Lord our God, save us, please, from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you, O Lord , are God alone."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, O Lord our God, I pray, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that You are the Lord God, You alone."
verses.textEnNlt: Now, O Lord our God, rescue us from his power; then all the kingdoms of the earth will know that you alone, O Lord , are God."
verses.textEnNasb: But now, Lord our God, please, save us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that You alone, Lord, are God."
verses.textEn: Now, Lord our God, deliver us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you alone, Lord , are God."

verses.textZh: 于是亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚派人去见希西家，说："耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘你向我祷告有关亚述王西拿基立的事，我已经听见了。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚派人去见希西家，说："耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘你向我祷告有关亚述王西拿基立的事，我已经听见了。’
verses.textZhCuv: 亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚就打发人去见希西家，说：「耶和华－以色列的神如此说：『你既然求我攻击亚述王西拿基立，我已听见了。』
verses.textEnNiv: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent a message to Hezekiah: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I have heard your prayer concerning Sennacherib king of Assyria.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, "Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: Your prayer to me about Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, "Thus says the Lord God of Israel: ‘Because you have prayed to Me against Sennacherib king of Assyria, I have heard.’
verses.textEnNlt: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent this message to Hezekiah: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I have heard your prayer about King Sennacherib of Assyria.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent word to Hezekiah, saying, "This is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: ‘Because you have prayed to Me about Sennacherib king of Assyria, I have heard you.’
verses.textEn: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent a message to Hezekiah: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I have heard your prayer concerning Sennacherib king of Assyria.

verses.textZh: 下面是耶和华所说关于他的话： ‘锡安的居民 藐视你，嗤笑你； 耶路撒冷的居民在你背后摇头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 下面是耶和华所说关于他的话： ‘锡安的居民 藐视你，嗤笑你； 耶路撒冷的居民在你背后摇头。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华论他这样说： 锡安的处女藐视你，嗤笑你； 耶路撒冷的女子向你摇头。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the word that the Lord has spoken against him: " ‘Virgin Daughter Zion despises you and mocks you. Daughter Jerusalem tosses her head as you flee.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the word that the Lord has spoken concerning him: "She despises you, she scorns you— the virgin daughter of Zion; she wags her head behind you— the daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the word which the Lord has spoken concerning him: ‘The virgin, the daughter of Zion, Has despised you, laughed you to scorn; The daughter of Jerusalem Has shaken her head behind your back!
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord has spoken this word against him: "The virgin daughter of Zion despises you and laughs at you. The daughter of Jerusalem shakes her head in derision as you flee.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the word that the Lord has spoken against him: ‘She, the virgin daughter of Zion, has shown contempt for you and mocked you; She, the daughter of Jerusalem, has shaken her head behind you!
verses.textEn: This is the word that the Lord has spoken against him: " ‘Virgin Daughter Zion despises you and mocks you. Daughter Jerusalem tosses her head as you flee.

verses.textZh: 你辱骂了谁，亵渎了谁？ 你扬声攻击谁呢？ 你高举眼目是向谁傲慢呢？ 就是攻击以色列的圣者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你辱骂了谁，亵渎了谁？ 你扬声攻击谁呢？ 你高举眼目是向谁傲慢呢？ 就是攻击以色列的圣者。
verses.textZhCuv: 你辱骂谁？亵渎谁？ 扬起声来，高举眼目攻击谁呢？ 乃是攻击以色列的圣者！
verses.textEnNiv: Who is it you have ridiculed and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes in pride? Against the Holy One of Israel!
verses.textEnEsv: "Whom have you mocked and reviled? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes to the heights? Against the Holy One of Israel!
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Whom have you reproached and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice, And lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "Whom have you been defying and ridiculing? Against whom did you raise your voice? At whom did you look with such haughty eyes? It was the Holy One of Israel!
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Whom have you taunted and blasphemed? And against whom have you raised your voice, And haughtily raised your eyes? Against the Holy One of Israel!
verses.textEn: Who is it you have ridiculed and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes in pride? Against the Holy One of Israel!

verses.textZh: 你借着你的使者侮辱了我的主， 你说—— 我要用大批的战车， 攀登众山的高峰， 到达黎巴嫩山的顶端， 砍伐高大的香柏树，佳美的松木； 我要进入极远的峰峦，最茂密的森林。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你借着你的使者侮辱了我的主， 你说—— 我要用大批的战车， 攀登众山的高峰， 到达黎巴嫩山的顶端， 砍伐高大的香柏树，佳美的松木； 我要进入极远的峰峦，最茂密的森林。
verses.textZhCuv: 你藉你的使者辱骂主， 并说：我率领许多战车上山顶， 到黎巴嫩极深之处； 我要砍伐其中高大的香柏树和佳美的松树； 我必上极高之处，进入肥田的树林。
verses.textEnNiv: By your messengers you have ridiculed the Lord. And you have said, "With my many chariots I have ascended the heights of the mountains, the utmost heights of Lebanon. I have cut down its tallest cedars, the choicest of its junipers. I have reached its remotest parts, the finest of its forests.
verses.textEnEsv: By your messengers you have mocked the Lord, and you have said, ‘With my many chariots I have gone up the heights of the mountains, to the far recesses of Lebanon; I felled its tallest cedars, its choicest cypresses; I entered its farthest lodging place, its most fruitful forest.
verses.textEnNkjv: By your messengers you have reproached the Lord, And said: "By the multitude of my chariots I have come up to the height of the mountains, To the limits of Lebanon; I will cut down its tall cedars And its choice cypress trees; I will enter the extremity of its borders, To its fruitful forest.
verses.textEnNlt: By your messengers you have defied the Lord. You have said, ‘With my many chariots I have conquered the highest mountains— yes, the remotest peaks of Lebanon. I have cut down its tallest cedars and its finest cypress trees. I have reached its farthest corners and explored its deepest forests.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Through your messengers you have taunted the Lord, And you have said, "With my many chariots I went up to the heights of the mountains, To the remotest parts of Lebanon; And I cut down its tall cedars and its choicest junipers. And I entered its farthest resting place, its thickest forest.
verses.textEn: By your messengers you have ridiculed the Lord. And you have said, "With my many chariots I have ascended the heights of the mountains, the utmost heights of Lebanon. I have cut down its tallest cedars, the choicest of its junipers. I have reached its remotest parts, the finest of its forests.

verses.textZh: 我掘井饮外地的水， 我用脚掌踏干埃及所有的河道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我掘井饮外地的水， 我用脚掌踏干埃及所有的河道。
verses.textZhCuv: 我已经在外邦挖井喝水； 我必用脚掌踏干埃及的一切河。
verses.textEnNiv: I have dug wells in foreign lands and drunk the water there. With the soles of my feet I have dried up all the streams of Egypt."
verses.textEnEsv: I dug wells and drank foreign waters, and I dried up with the sole of my foot all the streams of Egypt.’
verses.textEnNkjv: I have dug and drunk strange water, And with the soles of my feet I have dried up All the brooks of defense."
verses.textEnNlt: I have dug wells in many foreign lands and refreshed myself with their water. With the sole of my foot I stopped up all the rivers of Egypt!’
verses.textEnNasb: "I dug wells and drank foreign waters, And with the soles of my feet I dried up All the streams of Egypt."
verses.textEn: I have dug wells in foreign lands and drunk the water there. With the soles of my feet I have dried up all the streams of Egypt."

verses.textZh: 你没有听过吗？ 在远古我已决定， 在古时我已筹划， 现在我要实现， 就是你使设防城变成乱堆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你没有听过吗？ 在远古我已决定， 在古时我已筹划， 现在我要实现， 就是你使设防城变成乱堆。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说，我早先所做的， 古时所立的，就是现在藉你 使坚固城荒废，变为乱堆， 这事你岂没有听见吗？
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Have you not heard? Long ago I ordained it. In days of old I planned it; now I have brought it to pass, that you have turned fortified cities into piles of stone.
verses.textEnEsv: "Have you not heard that I determined it long ago? I planned from days of old what now I bring to pass, that you should turn fortified cities into heaps of ruins,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Did you not hear long ago How I made it, From ancient times that I formed it? Now I have brought it to pass, That you should be For crushing fortified cities into heaps of ruins.
verses.textEnNlt: "But have you not heard? I decided this long ago. Long ago I planned it, and now I am making it happen. I planned for you to crush fortified cities into heaps of rubble.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Have you not heard? Long ago I did it; From ancient times I planned it. Now I have brought it about, That you would turn fortified cities into ruined heaps.
verses.textEn: " ‘Have you not heard? Long ago I ordained it. In days of old I planned it; now I have brought it to pass, that you have turned fortified cities into piles of stone.

verses.textZh: 他们的居民没有能力， 惊惶、羞惭。 他们好象田野的嫩草， 青绿的蔬菜， 和房顶上的草， 还未长成就枯萎了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的居民没有能力， 惊惶、羞惭。 他们好象田野的嫩草， 青绿的蔬菜， 和房顶上的草， 还未长成就枯萎了。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以其中的居民力量甚小， 惊惶羞愧。 他们像野草，像青菜， 如房顶上的草， 又如未长成而枯干的禾稼。
verses.textEnNiv: Their people, drained of power, are dismayed and put to shame. They are like plants in the field, like tender green shoots, like grass sprouting on the roof, scorched before it grows up.
verses.textEnEsv: while their inhabitants, shorn of strength, are dismayed and confounded, and have become like plants of the field and like tender grass, like grass on the housetops, blighted before it is grown.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore their inhabitants had little power; They were dismayed and confounded; They were as the grass of the field And the green herb, As the grass on the housetops And grain blighted before it is grown.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why their people have so little power and are so frightened and confused. They are as weak as grass, as easily trampled as tender green shoots. They are like grass sprouting on a housetop, scorched before it can grow lush and tall.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Therefore their inhabitants were powerless, They were shattered and put to shame. They were like the vegetation of the field and the green grass, Like grass on the housetops that is scorched before it has grown.
verses.textEn: Their people, drained of power, are dismayed and put to shame. They are like plants in the field, like tender green shoots, like grass sprouting on the roof, scorched before it grows up.

verses.textZh: 你坐下，你出去，你进来， 以及你对我所发的烈怒， 我都知道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你坐下，你出去，你进来， 以及你对我所发的烈怒， 我都知道。
verses.textZhCuv: 你坐下，你出去，你进来， 你向我发烈怒，我都知道。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But I know where you are and when you come and go and how you rage against me.
verses.textEnEsv: "But I know your sitting down and your going out and coming in, and your raging against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘But I know your dwelling place, Your going out and your coming in, And your rage against Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "But I know you well— where you stay and when you come and go. I know the way you have raged against me.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘But I know your sitting down, Your going out, your coming in, And your raging against Me.
verses.textEn: " ‘But I know where you are and when you come and go and how you rage against me.

verses.textZh: 因为你向我发了烈怒， 你狂傲的话进入我的耳中， 我要把我的钩子钩在你的鼻子上， 把嚼环套在你的嘴上， 使你在你来的路上转回去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你向我发了烈怒， 你狂傲的话进入我的耳中， 我要把我的钩子钩在你的鼻子上， 把嚼环套在你的嘴上， 使你在你来的路上转回去。
verses.textZhCuv: 因你向我发烈怒， 又因你狂傲的话达到我耳中， 我就要用钩子钩上你的鼻子， 把嚼环放在你口里， 使你从你来的路转回去。
verses.textEnNiv: Because you rage against me and because your insolence has reached my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth, and I will make you return by the way you came.’
verses.textEnEsv: Because you have raged against me and your complacency has come into my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth, and I will turn you back on the way by which you came.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because your rage against Me and your tumult Have come up to My ears, Therefore I will put My hook in your nose And My bridle in your lips, And I will turn you back By the way which you came.
verses.textEnNlt: And because of your raging against me and your arrogance, which I have heard for myself, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth. I will make you return by the same road on which you came."
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Because of your raging against Me, And because your complacency has come up to My ears, I will put My hook in your nose, And My bridle in your lips, And I will turn you back by the way by which you came.
verses.textEn: Because you rage against me and because your insolence has reached my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth, and I will make you return by the way you came.’

verses.textZh: ‘这要给你作一个征兆：这一年要吃自然生长的，第二年也要吃自己长出来的，第三年要撒种、收割，栽种葡萄园，吃它们的果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘这要给你作一个征兆：这一年要吃自然生长的，第二年也要吃自己长出来的，第三年要撒种、收割，栽种葡萄园，吃它们的果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 「以色列人哪，我赐你们一个证据：你们今年要吃自生的，明年也要吃自长的；至于后年，你们要耕种收割，栽植葡萄园，吃其中的果子。
verses.textEnNiv: "This will be the sign for you, Hezekiah: "This year you will eat what grows by itself, and the second year what springs from that. But in the third year sow and reap, plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
verses.textEnEsv: "And this shall be the sign for you: this year eat what grows of itself, and in the second year what springs of the same. Then in the third year sow and reap and plant vineyards, and eat their fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘This shallbe a sign to you: You shall eat this year such as grows of itself, And in the second year what springs from the same; Also in the third year sow and reap, Plant vineyards and eat the fruit of them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Here is the proof that what I say is true: "This year you will eat only what grows up by itself, and next year you will eat what springs up from that. But in the third year you will plant crops and harvest them; you will tend vineyards and eat their fruit.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Then this shall be the sign for you: you will eat this year what grows of itself, in the second year what grows by itself, and in the third year sow, harvest, plant vineyards, and eat their fruit.
verses.textEn: "This will be the sign for you, Hezekiah: "This year you will eat what grows by itself, and the second year what springs from that. But in the third year sow and reap, plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

verses.textZh: 犹大家逃脱的余民，必再往下扎根，往上结果；
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大家逃脱的余民，必再往下扎根，往上结果；
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大家所逃脱余剩的，仍要往下扎根，向上结果。
verses.textEnNiv: Once more a remnant of the kingdom of Judah will take root below and bear fruit above.
verses.textEnEsv: And the surviving remnant of the house of Judah shall again take root downward and bear fruit upward.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the remnant who have escaped of the house of Judah Shall again take root downward, And bear fruit upward.
verses.textEnNlt: And you who are left in Judah, who have escaped the ravages of the siege, will put roots down in your own soil and will grow up and flourish.
verses.textEnNasb: The survivors that are left of the house of Judah will again take root downward and bear fruit upward.
verses.textEn: Once more a remnant of the kingdom of Judah will take root below and bear fruit above.

verses.textZh: 因为将有剩余的人从耶路撒冷出来，将有逃脱的人从锡安山而来，耶和华的热心必成全这事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为将有剩余的人从耶路撒冷出来，将有逃脱的人从锡安山而来，耶和华的热心必成全这事。
verses.textZhCuv: 必有余剩的民从耶路撒冷而出；必有逃脱的人从锡安山而来。耶和华的热心必成就这事。
verses.textEnNiv: For out of Jerusalem will come a remnant, and out of Mount Zion a band of survivors. "The zeal of the Lord Almighty will accomplish this.
verses.textEnEsv: For out of Jerusalem shall go a remnant, and out of Mount Zion a band of survivors. The zeal of the Lord will do this.
verses.textEnNkjv: For out of Jerusalem shall go a remnant, And those who escape from Mount Zion. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will do this.’
verses.textEnNlt: For a remnant of my people will spread out from Jerusalem, a group of survivors from Mount Zion. The passionate commitment of the Lord of Heaven’s Armies will make this happen!
verses.textEnNasb: For out of Jerusalem will go a remnant, and survivors out of Mount Zion. The zeal of the Lord will perform this.
verses.textEn: For out of Jerusalem will come a remnant, and out of Mount Zion a band of survivors. "The zeal of the Lord Almighty will accomplish this.

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华论到亚述王这样说：他不会来到这城，不会在那里射箭，也不会拿着盾牌向城进攻，不会筑起土堆围攻它。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华论到亚述王这样说：他不会来到这城，不会在那里射箭，也不会拿着盾牌向城进攻，不会筑起土堆围攻它。
verses.textZhCuv: 「所以，耶和华论亚述王如此说：『他必不得来到这城，也不在这里射箭，不得拿盾牌到城前，也不筑垒攻城。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore this is what the Lord says concerning the king of Assyria: " ‘He will not enter this city or shoot an arrow here. He will not come before it with shield or build a siege ramp against it.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the king of Assyria: He shall not come into this city or shoot an arrow there, or come before it with a shield or cast up a siege mound against it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the king of Assyria: ‘He shall not come into this city, Nor shoot an arrow there, Nor come before it with shield, Nor build a siege mound against it.
verses.textEnNlt: "And this is what the Lord says about the king of Assyria: "His armies will not enter Jerusalem. They will not even shoot an arrow at it. They will not march outside its gates with their shields nor build banks of earth against its walls.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Therefore this is what the Lord says about the king of Assyria: "He will not come to this city nor shoot an arrow there; and he will not come before it with a shield nor heap up an assault ramp against it.
verses.textEn: "Therefore this is what the Lord says concerning the king of Assyria: " ‘He will not enter this city or shoot an arrow here. He will not come before it with shield or build a siege ramp against it.

verses.textZh: 他必循他来的路回去，他必不能来到这城，这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必循他来的路回去，他必不能来到这城，这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 他从哪条路来，必从那条路回去，必不得来到这城。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: By the way that he came he will return; he will not enter this city, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: By the way that he came, by the same he shall return, and he shall not come into this city, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: By the way that he came, By the same shall he return; And he shall not come into this city,’ Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The king will return to his own country by the same road on which he came. He will not enter this city, says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: By the way that he came, by the same he will return, and he shall not come to this city," ’ declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: By the way that he came he will return; he will not enter this city, declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 为了我和我仆人大卫的缘故，我必保护这城，拯救这城。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了我和我仆人大卫的缘故，我必保护这城，拯救这城。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 因我为自己的缘故，又为我仆人大卫的缘故，必保护拯救这城。』」
verses.textEnNiv: I will defend this city and save it, for my sake and for the sake of David my servant.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake and for the sake of my servant David."
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘For I will defend this city, to save it For My own sake and for My servant David’s sake.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: For my own honor and for the sake of my servant David, I will defend this city and protect it."
verses.textEnNasb: ‘For I will protect this city to save it for My own sake, and for My servant David’s sake.’ "
verses.textEn: I will defend this city and save it, for my sake and for the sake of David my servant.’ "

verses.textZh: 那天晚上，耶和华的使者出去，在亚述军营杀了十八万五千人。早上，他们起来的时候，看哪，到处都是死尸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那天晚上，耶和华的使者出去，在亚述军营杀了十八万五千人。早上，他们起来的时候，看哪，到处都是死尸。
verses.textZhCuv: 当夜，耶和华的使者出去，在亚述营中杀了十八万五千人。清早有人起来，一看，都是死尸了。
verses.textEnNiv: That night the angel of the Lord went out and put to death a hundred and eighty-five thousand in the Assyrian camp. When the people got up the next morning—there were all the dead bodies!
verses.textEnEsv: And that night the angel of the Lord went out and struck down 185,000 in the camp of the Assyrians. And when people arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass on a certain night that the angel of the Lord went out, and killed in the camp of the Assyrians one hundred and eighty-five thousand; and when people arose early in the morning, there were the corpses—all dead.
verses.textEnNlt: That night the angel of the Lord went out to the Assyrian camp and killed 185,000 Assyrian soldiers. When the surviving Assyrians woke up the next morning, they found corpses everywhere.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it happened that night that the angel of the Lord went out and struck 185,000 in the camp of the Assyrians; and when the rest got up early in the morning, behold, all of the 185,000 were dead.
verses.textEn: That night the angel of the Lord went out and put to death a hundred and eighty-five thousand in the Assyrian camp. When the people got up the next morning—there were all the dead bodies!

verses.textZh: 于是亚述王西拿基立拔营离开，回去住在尼尼微。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚述王西拿基立拔营离开，回去住在尼尼微。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述王西拿基立就拔营回去，住在尼尼微。
verses.textEnNiv: So Sennacherib king of Assyria broke camp and withdrew. He returned to Nineveh and stayed there.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Sennacherib king of Assyria departed and went home and lived at Nineveh.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed and went away, returned home, and remained at Nineveh.
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Sennacherib of Assyria broke camp and returned to his own land. He went home to his capital of Nineveh and stayed there.
verses.textEnNasb: So Sennacherib the king of Assyria departed and returned home, and lived at Nineveh.
verses.textEn: So Sennacherib king of Assyria broke camp and withdrew. He returned to Nineveh and stayed there.

verses.textZh: 一日，他正在他的神亚斯洛的庙中叩拜的时候，亚得米勒和沙利色用刀刺杀了他，然后逃到亚拉腊地。他的儿子以撒哈顿接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一日，他正在他的神亚斯洛的庙中叩拜的时候，亚得米勒和沙利色用刀刺杀了他，然后逃到亚拉腊地。他的儿子以撒哈顿接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 一日在他的神尼斯洛庙里叩拜，他儿子亚得米勒和沙利色用刀杀了他，就逃到亚拉腊地。他儿子以撒哈顿接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: One day, while he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisrok, his sons Adrammelek and Sharezer killed him with the sword, and they escaped to the land of Ararat. And Esarhaddon his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And as he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer, his sons, struck him down with the sword and escaped into the land of Ararat. And Esarhaddon his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, as he was worshiping in the temple of Nisroch his god, that his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him down with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Then Esarhaddon his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: One day while he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer killed him with their swords. They then escaped to the land of Ararat, and another son, Esarhaddon, became the next king of Assyria.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it came about, as he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer killed him with the sword; and they escaped to the land of Ararat. And his son Esarhaddon became king in his place.
verses.textEn: One day, while he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisrok, his sons Adrammelek and Sharezer killed him with the sword, and they escaped to the land of Ararat. And Esarhaddon his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 在那些日子，希西家病得要死了。亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚先知来见他，对他说："耶和华这样说：‘你要留遗命给你的家人，因为你将要死，不能再活了。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那些日子，希西家病得要死了。亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚先知来见他，对他说："耶和华这样说：‘你要留遗命给你的家人，因为你将要死，不能再活了。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，希西家病得要死。亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚去见他，对他说：「耶和华如此说：『你当留遗命与你的家，因为你必死，不能活了。』」
verses.textEnNiv: In those days Hezekiah became ill and was at the point of death. The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz went to him and said, "This is what the Lord says: Put your house in order, because you are going to die; you will not recover."
verses.textEnEsv: In those days Hezekiah became sick and was at the point of death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came to him and said to him, "Thus says the Lord , ‘Set your house in order, for you shall die; you shall not recover.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: In those days Hezekiah was sick and near death. And Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, went to him and said to him, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Set your house in order, for you shall die, and not live.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: About that time Hezekiah became deathly ill, and the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz went to visit him. He gave the king this message: "This is what the Lord says: Set your affairs in order, for you are going to die. You will not recover from this illness."
verses.textEnNasb: In those days Hezekiah became mortally ill. And Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him and said to him, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Set your house in order, for you are going to die and not live.’ "
verses.textEn: In those days Hezekiah became ill and was at the point of death. The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz went to him and said, "This is what the Lord says: Put your house in order, because you are going to die; you will not recover."

verses.textZh: 他却转脸向墙，祷告耶和华说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 他却转脸向墙，祷告耶和华说：
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家就转脸朝墙，祷告耶和华说：
verses.textEnNiv: Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the Lord ,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the Lord , saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he turned his face toward the wall, and prayed to the Lord, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: When Hezekiah heard this, he turned his face to the wall and prayed to the Lord ,
verses.textEnNasb: Then he turned his face to the wall and prayed to the Lord, saying,
verses.textEn: Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the Lord ,

verses.textZh: "唉，耶和华啊！求你记念我曾怎样以真诚和完全的心在你面前行事为人，我所行的都是你看为善的事。"希西家就痛哭起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "唉，耶和华啊！求你记念我曾怎样以真诚和完全的心在你面前行事为人，我所行的都是你看为善的事。"希西家就痛哭起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华啊，求你记念我在你面前怎样存完全的心，按诚实行事，又做你眼中所看为善的。」希西家就痛哭了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Remember, Lord , how I have walked before you faithfully and with wholehearted devotion and have done what is good in your eyes." And Hezekiah wept bitterly.
verses.textEnEsv: "Now, O Lord , please remember how I have walked before you in faithfulness and with a whole heart, and have done what is good in your sight." And Hezekiah wept bitterly.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Remember now, O Lord, I pray, how I have walked before You in truth and with a loyal heart, and have done whatwas good in Your sight." And Hezekiah wept bitterly.
verses.textEnNlt: "Remember, O Lord , how I have always been faithful to you and have served you single-mindedly, always doing what pleases you." Then he broke down and wept bitterly.
verses.textEnNasb: "Please, Lord, just remember how I have walked before You wholeheartedly and in truth, and have done what is good in Your sight!" And Hezekiah wept profusely.
verses.textEn: "Remember, Lord , how I have walked before you faithfully and with wholehearted devotion and have done what is good in your eyes." And Hezekiah wept bitterly.

verses.textZh: 以赛亚还没有出到中院，耶和华的话就临到他说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 以赛亚还没有出到中院，耶和华的话就临到他说：
verses.textZhCuv: 以赛亚出来，还没有到中院 ，耶和华的话就临到他，说：
verses.textEnNiv: Before Isaiah had left the middle court, the word of the Lord came to him:
verses.textEnEsv: And before Isaiah had gone out of the middle court, the word of the Lord came to him:
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, before Isaiah had gone out into the middle court, that the word of the Lord came to him, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: But before Isaiah had left the middle courtyard, this message came to him from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: And even before Isaiah had left the middle courtyard, the word of the Lord came to him, saying,
verses.textEn: Before Isaiah had left the middle court, the word of the Lord came to him:

verses.textZh: "你回去对我子民的君主希西家说：‘你祖大卫的神耶和华这样说：我听见了你的祷告，看见了你的眼泪。看哪，我必医治你，第三日你要上耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你回去对我子民的君主希西家说：‘你祖大卫的神耶和华这样说：我听见了你的祷告，看见了你的眼泪。看哪，我必医治你，第三日你要上耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你回去告诉我民的君希西家说：耶和华－你祖大卫的神如此说：『我听见了你的祷告，看见了你的眼泪，我必医治你；到第三日，你必上到耶和华的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: "Go back and tell Hezekiah, the ruler of my people, ‘This is what the Lord , the God of your father David, says: I have heard your prayer and seen your tears; I will heal you. On the third day from now you will go up to the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Turn back, and say to Hezekiah the leader of my people, Thus says the Lord , the God of David your father: I have heard your prayer; I have seen your tears. Behold, I will heal you. On the third day you shall go up to the house of the Lord ,
