verses.textEnNkjv: "Return and tell Hezekiah the leader of My people, ‘Thus says the Lord, the God of David your father: "I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears; surely I will heal you. On the third day you shall go up to the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go back to Hezekiah, the leader of my people. Tell him, ‘This is what the Lord , the God of your ancestor David, says: I have heard your prayer and seen your tears. I will heal you, and three days from now you will get out of bed and go to the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Return and say to Hezekiah the leader of My people, ‘This is what the Lord, the God of your father David says: "I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears; behold, I am going to heal you. On the third day you shall go up to the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Go back and tell Hezekiah, the ruler of my people, ‘This is what the Lord , the God of your father David, says: I have heard your prayer and seen your tears; I will heal you. On the third day from now you will go up to the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我必把十五年的寿命增添给你。我要拯救你和这城脱离亚述王的手，又要因我自己和我仆人大卫的缘故保护这城。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把十五年的寿命增添给你。我要拯救你和这城脱离亚述王的手，又要因我自己和我仆人大卫的缘故保护这城。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必加增你十五年的寿数，并且我要救你和这城脱离亚述王的手。我为自己和我仆人大卫的缘故，必保护这城。』」
verses.textEnNiv: I will add fifteen years to your life. And I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city for my sake and for the sake of my servant David.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: and I will add fifteen years to your life. I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria, and I will defend this city for my own sake and for my servant David’s sake."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will add to your days fifteen years. I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for My own sake, and for the sake of My servant David." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I will add fifteen years to your life, and I will rescue you and this city from the king of Assyria. I will defend this city for my own honor and for the sake of my servant David.’"
verses.textEnNasb: And I will add fifteen years to your life, and I will save you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will protect this city for My own sake and for My servant David’s sake." ’ "
verses.textEn: I will add fifteen years to your life. And I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city for my sake and for the sake of my servant David.’ "

verses.textZh: 以赛亚说："取一片无花果饼来。"他们就取了来，把它贴在疮上。希西家就痊愈了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以赛亚说："取一片无花果饼来。"他们就取了来，把它贴在疮上。希西家就痊愈了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以赛亚说：「当取一块无花果饼来。」人就取了来，贴在疮上，王便痊愈了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Isaiah said, "Prepare a poultice of figs." They did so and applied it to the boil, and he recovered.
verses.textEnEsv: And Isaiah said, "Bring a cake of figs. And let them take and lay it on the boil, that he may recover."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Isaiah said, "Take a lump of figs." So they took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Isaiah said, "Make an ointment from figs." So Hezekiah’s servants spread the ointment over the boil, and Hezekiah recovered!
verses.textEnNasb: Then Isaiah said, "Take a cake of figs." And they took it and placed it on the inflamed spot, and he recovered.
verses.textEn: Then Isaiah said, "Prepare a poultice of figs." They did so and applied it to the boil, and he recovered.

verses.textZh: 希西家对以赛亚说："有甚么征兆告诉我耶和华必医治我，第三日我能上耶和华的殿呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家对以赛亚说："有甚么征兆告诉我耶和华必医治我，第三日我能上耶和华的殿呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家问以赛亚说：「耶和华必医治我，到第三日，我能上耶和华的殿，有什么兆头呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Hezekiah had asked Isaiah, "What will be the sign that the Lord will heal me and that I will go up to the temple of the Lord on the third day from now?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "What shall be the sign that the Lord will heal me, and that I shall go up to the house of the Lord on the third day?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "What is the sign that the Lord will heal me, and that I shall go up to the house of the Lord the third day?"
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Hezekiah had said to Isaiah, "What sign will the Lord give to prove that he will heal me and that I will go to the Temple of the Lord three days from now?"
verses.textEnNasb: Now Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "What will be the sign that the Lord will heal me, and that I will go up to the house of the Lord on the third day?"
verses.textEn: Hezekiah had asked Isaiah, "What will be the sign that the Lord will heal me and that I will go up to the temple of the Lord on the third day from now?"

verses.textZh: 以赛亚说："这就是耶和华给你的征兆，显明耶和华必成全他应许的这事：你要日影向前进十级或是倒退十级呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以赛亚说："这就是耶和华给你的征兆，显明耶和华必成全他应许的这事：你要日影向前进十级或是倒退十级呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 以赛亚说：「耶和华必成就他所说的。这是他给你的兆头：你要日影向前进十度呢？是要往后退十度呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Isaiah answered, "This is the Lord ’s sign to you that the Lord will do what he has promised: Shall the shadow go forward ten steps, or shall it go back ten steps?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Isaiah said, "This shall be the sign to you from the Lord , that the Lord will do the thing that he has promised: shall the shadow go forward ten steps, or go back ten steps?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Isaiah said, "This is the sign to you from the Lord, that the Lord will do the thing which He has spoken: shall the shadow go forward ten degrees or go backward ten degrees?"
verses.textEnNlt: Isaiah replied, "This is the sign from the Lord to prove that he will do as he promised. Would you like the shadow on the sundial to go forward ten steps or backward ten steps? "
verses.textEnNasb: Isaiah said, "This shall be the sign to you from the Lord, that the Lord will perform the word that He has spoken: shall the shadow go forward ten steps or go back ten steps?"
verses.textEn: Isaiah answered, "This is the Lord ’s sign to you that the Lord will do what he has promised: Shall the shadow go forward ten steps, or shall it go back ten steps?"

verses.textZh: 希西家说："日影延伸十级容易；不，我要日影倒后十级。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家说："日影延伸十级容易；不，我要日影倒后十级。"
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家回答说：「日影向前进十度容易，我要日影往后退十度。」
verses.textEnNiv: "It is a simple matter for the shadow to go forward ten steps," said Hezekiah. "Rather, have it go back ten steps."
verses.textEnEsv: And Hezekiah answered, "It is an easy thing for the shadow to lengthen ten steps. Rather let the shadow go back ten steps."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Hezekiah answered, "It is an easy thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees; no, but let the shadow go backward ten degrees."
verses.textEnNlt: "The shadow always moves forward," Hezekiah replied, "so that would be easy. Make it go ten steps backward instead."
verses.textEnNasb: So Hezekiah said, "It is easy for the shadow to decline ten steps; no, but have the shadow turn backward ten steps."
verses.textEn: "It is a simple matter for the shadow to go forward ten steps," said Hezekiah. "Rather, have it go back ten steps."

verses.textZh: 以赛亚先知呼求耶和华，他就使日晷上的日影，就是在亚哈斯的日晷上已经下移的日影倒退了十级。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以赛亚先知呼求耶和华，他就使日晷上的日影，就是在亚哈斯的日晷上已经下移的日影倒退了十级。
verses.textZhCuv: 先知以赛亚求告耶和华，耶和华就使亚哈斯的日晷向前进的日影，往后退了十度。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the prophet Isaiah called on the Lord , and the Lord made the shadow go back the ten steps it had gone down on the stairway of Ahaz.
verses.textEnEsv: And Isaiah the prophet called to the Lord , and he brought the shadow back ten steps, by which it had gone down on the steps of Ahaz.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Isaiah the prophet cried out to the Lord, and He brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down on the sundial of Ahaz.
verses.textEnNlt: So Isaiah the prophet asked the Lord to do this, and he caused the shadow to move ten steps backward on the sundial of Ahaz!
verses.textEnNasb: Then Isaiah the prophet called out to the Lord, and He brought the shadow on the stairway back ten steps by which it had gone down on the stairway of Ahaz.
verses.textEn: Then the prophet Isaiah called on the Lord , and the Lord made the shadow go back the ten steps it had gone down on the stairway of Ahaz.

verses.textZh: 那时，巴比伦王巴拉但的儿子比罗达．巴拉但送信和礼物给希西家，因为他听见希西家病了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，巴比伦王巴拉但的儿子比罗达．巴拉但送信和礼物给希西家，因为他听见希西家病了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，巴比伦王巴拉但的儿子米罗达‧巴拉但听见希西家病而痊愈，就送书信和礼物给他。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time Marduk-Baladan son of Baladan king of Babylon sent Hezekiah letters and a gift, because he had heard of Hezekiah’s illness.
verses.textEnEsv: At that time Merodach-baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent envoys with letters and a present to Hezekiah, for he heard that Hezekiah had been sick.
verses.textEnNkjv: At that time Berodach-Baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah, for he heard that Hezekiah had been sick.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon after this, Merodach-baladan son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent Hezekiah his best wishes and a gift, for he had heard that Hezekiah had been very sick.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time Berodach-baladan, a son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah, because he heard that Hezekiah had been sick.
verses.textEn: At that time Marduk-Baladan son of Baladan king of Babylon sent Hezekiah letters and a gift, because he had heard of Hezekiah’s illness.

verses.textZh: 希西家听了使者的话，随后把宝库内的一切银子、金子、香料、贵重的油和军器库，以及他宝库内一切所有的，都给他们看。无论是在他的宫中或是在全国各地的，希西家没有一样不给他们看的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家听了使者的话，随后把宝库内的一切银子、金子、香料、贵重的油和军器库，以及他宝库内一切所有的，都给他们看。无论是在他的宫中或是在全国各地的，希西家没有一样不给他们看的。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家听从使者的话，就把他宝库的金子、银子、香料、贵重的膏油，和他武库的一切军器，并他所有的财宝，都给他们看。他家中和他全国之内，希西家没有一样不给他们看的。
verses.textEnNiv: Hezekiah received the envoys and showed them all that was in his storehouses—the silver, the gold, the spices and the fine olive oil—his armory and everything found among his treasures. There was nothing in his palace or in all his kingdom that Hezekiah did not show them.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hezekiah welcomed them, and he showed them all his treasure house, the silver, the gold, the spices, the precious oil, his armory, all that was found in his storehouses. There was nothing in his house or in all his realm that Hezekiah did not show them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Hezekiah was attentive to them, and showed them all the house of his treasures—the silver and gold, the spices and precious ointment, and all his armory—all that was found among his treasures. There was nothing in his house or in all his dominion that Hezekiah did not show them.
verses.textEnNlt: Hezekiah received the Babylonian envoys and showed them everything in his treasure-houses—the silver, the gold, the spices, and the aromatic oils. He also took them to see his armory and showed them everything in his royal treasuries! There was nothing in his palace or kingdom that Hezekiah did not show them.
verses.textEnNasb: And Hezekiah listened to them, and showed them all his treasure house, the silver, the gold, the balsam oil, the scented oil, the house of his armor, and everything that was found in his treasuries. There was nothing in his house nor in all his realm that Hezekiah did not show them.
verses.textEn: Hezekiah received the envoys and showed them all that was in his storehouses—the silver, the gold, the spices and the fine olive oil—his armory and everything found among his treasures. There was nothing in his palace or in all his kingdom that Hezekiah did not show them.

verses.textZh: 后来，以赛亚先知来到希西家王那里，对他说："这些人说了些甚么？他们是从哪里来见你的呢？"希西家说："他们是从遥远的巴比伦来见我的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，以赛亚先知来到希西家王那里，对他说："这些人说了些甚么？他们是从哪里来见你的呢？"希西家说："他们是从遥远的巴比伦来见我的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是先知以赛亚来见希西家王，问他说：「这些人说什么？他们从哪里来见你？」希西家说：「他们从远方的巴比伦来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Isaiah the prophet went to King Hezekiah and asked, "What did those men say, and where did they come from?" "From a distant land," Hezekiah replied. "They came from Babylon."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and said to him, "What did these men say? And from where did they come to you?" And Hezekiah said, "They have come from a far country, from Babylon."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Isaiah the prophet went to King Hezekiah, and said to him, "What did these men say, and from where did they come to you?" So Hezekiah said, "They came from a far country, from Babylon."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Isaiah the prophet went to King Hezekiah and asked him, "What did those men want? Where were they from?" Hezekiah replied, "They came from the distant land of Babylon."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah and said to him, "What did these men say, and from where have they come to you?" And Hezekiah said, "They have come from a far country, from Babylon."
verses.textEn: Then Isaiah the prophet went to King Hezekiah and asked, "What did those men say, and where did they come from?" "From a distant land," Hezekiah replied. "They came from Babylon."

verses.textZh: 以赛亚说："他们在你宫中看到了甚么呢？"希西家说："我宫中的一切，他们都看见了。在我宝库内的，我没有一样不给他们看的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以赛亚说："他们在你宫中看到了甚么呢？"希西家说："我宫中的一切，他们都看见了。在我宝库内的，我没有一样不给他们看的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以赛亚说：「他们在你家里看见了什么？」希西家说：「凡我家中所有的，他们都看见了；我财宝中没有一样不给他们看的。」
verses.textEnNiv: The prophet asked, "What did they see in your palace?" "They saw everything in my palace," Hezekiah said. "There is nothing among my treasures that I did not show them."
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "What have they seen in your house?" And Hezekiah answered, "They have seen all that is in my house; there is nothing in my storehouses that I did not show them."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "What have they seen in your house?" So Hezekiah answered, "They have seen all that is in my house; there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them."
verses.textEnNlt: "What did they see in your palace?" Isaiah asked. "They saw everything," Hezekiah replied. "I showed them everything I own—all my royal treasuries."
verses.textEnNasb: Isaiah said, "What have they seen in your house?" So Hezekiah answered, "They have seen everything that is in my house; there is nothing among my treasuries that I have not shown them."
verses.textEn: The prophet asked, "What did they see in your palace?" "They saw everything in my palace," Hezekiah said. "There is nothing among my treasures that I did not show them."

verses.textZh: 以赛亚对希西家说："你要听耶和华的话：
verses.textZhCnvs: 以赛亚对希西家说："你要听耶和华的话：
verses.textZhCuv: 以赛亚对希西家说：「你要听耶和华的话，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Hear the word of the Lord :
verses.textEnEsv: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Hear the word of the Lord :
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Hear the word of the Lord:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Listen to this message from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Hear the word of the Lord:
verses.textEn: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Hear the word of the Lord :

verses.textZh: ‘看哪，日子快到，那时你宫中的一切和你的祖先所积存直到今日的一切，都要被掠到巴比伦去，没有一样留下。’这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘看哪，日子快到，那时你宫中的一切和你的祖先所积存直到今日的一切，都要被掠到巴比伦去，没有一样留下。’这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 日子必到，凡你家里所有的，并你列祖积蓄到如今的，都要被掳到巴比伦去，不留下一样。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: The time will surely come when everything in your palace, and all that your predecessors have stored up until this day, will be carried off to Babylon. Nothing will be left, says the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the days are coming, when all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have stored up till this day, shall be carried to Babylon. Nothing shall be left, says the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Behold, the days are coming when all that is in your house, and what your fathers have accumulated until this day, shall be carried to Babylon; nothing shall be left,’ says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The time is coming when everything in your palace—all the treasures stored up by your ancestors until now—will be carried off to Babylon. Nothing will be left, says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Behold, the days are coming when everything that is in your house, and what your fathers have stored up to this day, will be carried to Babylon; nothing will be left,’ says the Lord.
verses.textEn: The time will surely come when everything in your palace, and all that your predecessors have stored up until this day, will be carried off to Babylon. Nothing will be left, says the Lord .

verses.textZh: 并且你的众子中，就是由你所出，你所生的，有一部分要被掳去。他们要在巴比伦王的王宫中当太监。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且你的众子中，就是由你所出，你所生的，有一部分要被掳去。他们要在巴比伦王的王宫中当太监。"
verses.textZhCuv: 并且从你本身所生的众子，其中必有被掳去在巴比伦王宫里当太监的。」
verses.textEnNiv: And some of your descendants, your own flesh and blood who will be born to you, will be taken away, and they will become eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon."
verses.textEnEsv: And some of your own sons, who will come from you, whom you will father, shall be taken away, and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon."
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And they shall take away some of your sons who will descend from you, whom you will beget; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Some of your very own sons will be taken away into exile. They will become eunuchs who will serve in the palace of Babylon’s king."
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And some of your sons who will come from you, whom you will father, will be taken away; and they will become officials in the palace of the king of Babylon.’ "
verses.textEn: And some of your descendants, your own flesh and blood who will be born to you, will be taken away, and they will become eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon."

verses.textZh: 希西家对以赛亚说："你所说耶和华的话很好。"他心里说："在我的日子有和平和安全不是很好吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家对以赛亚说："你所说耶和华的话很好。"他心里说："在我的日子有和平和安全不是很好吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家对以赛亚说：「你所说耶和华的话甚好！若在我的年日中有太平和稳固的景况，岂不是好吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: "The word of the Lord you have spoken is good," Hezekiah replied. For he thought, "Will there not be peace and security in my lifetime?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "The word of the Lord that you have spoken is good." For he thought, "Why not, if there will be peace and security in my days?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "The word of the Lord which you have spoken is good!" For he said, "Will there not be peace and truth at least in my days?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "This message you have given me from the Lord is good." For the king was thinking, "At least there will be peace and security during my lifetime."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "The word of the Lord which you have spoken is good." For he thought, "Is it not good, if there will be peace and security in my days?"
verses.textEn: "The word of the Lord you have spoken is good," Hezekiah replied. For he thought, "Will there not be peace and security in my lifetime?"

verses.textZh: 希西家其余的事迹和他所有的英勇事迹，以及他做水池和引水道，把水引入城里的事，不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家其余的事迹和他所有的英勇事迹，以及他做水池和引水道，把水引入城里的事，不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家其余的事和他的勇力，他怎样挖池、挖沟、引水入城，都写在犹大列王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Hezekiah’s reign, all his achievements and how he made the pool and the tunnel by which he brought water into the city, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnEsv: The rest of the deeds of Hezekiah and all his might and how he made the pool and the conduit and brought water into the city, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah—all his might, and how he made a pool and a tunnel and brought water into the city—are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Hezekiah’s reign, including the extent of his power and how he built a pool and dug a tunnel to bring water into the city, are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah and all his might, and how he constructed the pool and the conduit and brought water into the city, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Hezekiah’s reign, all his achievements and how he made the pool and the tunnel by which he brought water into the city, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

verses.textZh: 希西家和他的祖先一同长眠，他的儿子玛拿西就接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希西家和他的祖先一同长眠，他的儿子玛拿西就接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 希西家与他列祖同睡。他儿子玛拿西接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Hezekiah rested with his ancestors. And Manasseh his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and Manasseh his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Hezekiah rested with his fathers. Then Manasseh his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: Hezekiah died, and his son Manasseh became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: So Hezekiah lay down with his fathers, and his son Manasseh became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Hezekiah rested with his ancestors. And Manasseh his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 玛拿西登基的时候是十二岁；他在耶路撒冷作王五十五年，他的母亲名叫协西巴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西登基的时候是十二岁；他在耶路撒冷作王五十五年，他的母亲名叫协西巴。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西登基的时候年十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王五十五年。他母亲名叫协西巴。
verses.textEnNiv: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-five years. His mother’s name was Hephzibah.
verses.textEnEsv: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hephzibah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hephzibah.
verses.textEnNlt: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-five years. His mother was Hephzibah.
verses.textEnNasb: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned for fifty-five years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Hephzibah.
verses.textEn: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-five years. His mother’s name was Hephzibah.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，好象耶和华在以色列人面前赶走的民族所行的可憎恶的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，好象耶和华在以色列人面前赶走的民族所行的可憎恶的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法耶和华在以色列人面前赶出的外邦人所行可憎的事。
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , following the detestable practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , according to the despicable practices of the nations whom the Lord drove out before the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, according to the abominations of the nations whom the Lord had cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: He did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight, following the detestable practices of the pagan nations that the Lord had driven from the land ahead of the Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord, in accordance with the abominations of the nations whom the Lord dispossessed before the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , following the detestable practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 他重新建造邱坛，就是他父亲希西家所拆毁的；又为巴力建立祭坛，做亚舍拉，好象以色列王亚哈所做的，并且敬拜事奉天上的万象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他重新建造邱坛，就是他父亲希西家所拆毁的；又为巴力建立祭坛，做亚舍拉，好象以色列王亚哈所做的，并且敬拜事奉天上的万象。
verses.textZhCuv: 重新建筑他父希西家所毁坏的邱坛，又为巴力筑坛，做亚舍拉像，效法以色列王亚哈所行的，且敬拜事奉天上的万象；
verses.textEnNiv: He rebuilt the high places his father Hezekiah had destroyed; he also erected altars to Baal and made an Asherah pole, as Ahab king of Israel had done. He bowed down to all the starry hosts and worshiped them.
verses.textEnEsv: For he rebuilt the high places that Hezekiah his father had destroyed, and he erected altars for Baal and made an Asherah, as Ahab king of Israel had done, and worshiped all the host of heaven and served them.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he rebuilt the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; he raised up altars for Baal, and made a wooden image, as Ahab king of Israel had done; and he worshiped all the host of heaven and served them.
verses.textEnNlt: He rebuilt the pagan shrines his father, Hezekiah, had destroyed. He constructed altars for Baal and set up an Asherah pole, just as King Ahab of Israel had done. He also bowed before all the powers of the heavens and worshiped them.
verses.textEnNasb: For he rebuilt the high places which his father Hezekiah had destroyed; and he erected altars for Baal and made an Asherah, just as Ahab king of Israel had done, and he worshiped all the heavenly lights and served them.
verses.textEn: He rebuilt the high places his father Hezekiah had destroyed; he also erected altars to Baal and made an Asherah pole, as Ahab king of Israel had done. He bowed down to all the starry hosts and worshiped them.

verses.textZh: 他又在耶和华的殿内建造祭坛，耶和华曾指着这殿说："我要立我的名在耶路撒冷。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又在耶和华的殿内建造祭坛，耶和华曾指着这殿说："我要立我的名在耶路撒冷。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶和华殿宇中筑坛。耶和华曾指着这殿说：「我必立我的名在耶路撒冷。」
verses.textEnNiv: He built altars in the temple of the Lord , of which the Lord had said, "In Jerusalem I will put my Name."
verses.textEnEsv: And he built altars in the house of the Lord , of which the Lord had said, "In Jerusalem will I put my name."
verses.textEnNkjv: He also built altars in the house of the Lord, of which the Lord had said, "In Jerusalem I will put My name."
verses.textEnNlt: He built pagan altars in the Temple of the Lord , the place where the Lord had said, "My name will remain in Jerusalem forever."
verses.textEnNasb: And he built altars in the house of the Lord, of which the Lord had said, "In Jerusalem I will put My name."
verses.textEn: He built altars in the temple of the Lord , of which the Lord had said, "In Jerusalem I will put my Name."

verses.textZh: 他又在耶和华殿的两院中为天上的万象建造祭坛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又在耶和华殿的两院中为天上的万象建造祭坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在耶和华殿的两院中为天上的万象筑坛，
verses.textEnNiv: In the two courts of the temple of the Lord , he built altars to all the starry hosts.
verses.textEnEsv: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: He built these altars for all the powers of the heavens in both courtyards of the Lord ’s Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: He built altars for all the heavenly lights in the two courtyards of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: In the two courts of the temple of the Lord , he built altars to all the starry hosts.

verses.textZh: 他又把他的儿子用火烧为祭 ，并且算命、观兆，交鬼和行巫术；多行耶和华看为恶的事，惹他发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又把他的儿子用火烧为祭 ，并且算命、观兆，交鬼和行巫术；多行耶和华看为恶的事，惹他发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 并使他的儿子经火，又观兆，用法术，立交鬼的和行巫术的，多行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，惹动他的怒气；
verses.textEnNiv: He sacrificed his own son in the fire, practiced divination, sought omens, and consulted mediums and spiritists. He did much evil in the eyes of the Lord , arousing his anger.
verses.textEnEsv: And he burned his son as an offering and used fortune-telling and omens and dealt with mediums and with necromancers. He did much evil in the sight of the Lord , provoking him to anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also he made his son pass through the fire, practiced soothsaying, used witchcraft, and consulted spiritists and mediums. He did much evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke Him to anger.
verses.textEnNlt: Manasseh also sacrificed his own son in the fire. He practiced sorcery and divination, and he consulted with mediums and psychics. He did much that was evil in the Lord ’s sight, arousing his anger.
verses.textEnNasb: And he made his son pass through the fire, interpreted signs, practiced divination, and used mediums and spiritists. He did great evil in the sight of the Lord, provoking Him to anger.
verses.textEn: He sacrificed his own son in the fire, practiced divination, sought omens, and consulted mediums and spiritists. He did much evil in the eyes of the Lord , arousing his anger.

verses.textZh: 他又把自己所做的亚舍拉雕像安放在圣殿中，耶和华曾对大卫和他的儿子所罗门论到这殿说："我要在这殿和我从以色列众支派中拣选的耶路撒冷，立我的名，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又把自己所做的亚舍拉雕像安放在圣殿中，耶和华曾对大卫和他的儿子所罗门论到这殿说："我要在这殿和我从以色列众支派中拣选的耶路撒冷，立我的名，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 又在殿内立雕刻的亚舍拉像。耶和华曾对大卫和他儿子所罗门说：「我在以色列众支派中所选择的耶路撒冷和这殿，必立我的名，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: He took the carved Asherah pole he had made and put it in the temple, of which the Lord had said to David and to his son Solomon, "In this temple and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my Name forever.
verses.textEnEsv: And the carved image of Asherah that he had made he set in the house of which the Lord said to David and to Solomon his son, "In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: He even set a carved image of Asherah that he had made, in the house of which the Lord had said to David and to Solomon his son, "In this house and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put My name forever;
verses.textEnNlt: Manasseh even made a carved image of Asherah and set it up in the Temple, the very place where the Lord had told David and his son Solomon: "My name will be honored forever in this Temple and in Jerusalem—the city I have chosen from among all the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he put the carved image of Asherah that he had made in the house of which the Lord had said to David and to his son Solomon, "In this house and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen from all the tribes of Israel, I will put My name forever.
verses.textEn: He took the carved Asherah pole he had made and put it in the temple, of which the Lord had said to David and to his son Solomon, "In this temple and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my Name forever.

verses.textZh: 只要以色列人谨守遵行我吩咐他们的一切，就是我的仆人摩西吩咐他们的一切律法，我必不会再使他们的脚离开我赐给他们祖先的土地，流离飘荡。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只要以色列人谨守遵行我吩咐他们的一切，就是我的仆人摩西吩咐他们的一切律法，我必不会再使他们的脚离开我赐给他们祖先的土地，流离飘荡。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人若谨守遵行我一切所吩咐他们的和我仆人摩西所吩咐他们的一切律法，我就不再使他们挪移离开我所赐给他们列祖之地。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will not again make the feet of the Israelites wander from the land I gave their ancestors, if only they will be careful to do everything I commanded them and will keep the whole Law that my servant Moses gave them."
verses.textEnEsv: And I will not cause the feet of Israel to wander anymore out of the land that I gave to their fathers, if only they will be careful to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the Law that my servant Moses commanded them."
verses.textEnNkjv: and I will not make the feet of Israel wander anymore from the land which I gave their fathers—only if they are careful to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that My servant Moses commanded them."
verses.textEnNlt: If the Israelites will be careful to obey my commands—all the laws my servant Moses gave them—I will not send them into exile from this land that I gave their ancestors."
verses.textEnNasb: And I will not make the feet of Israel wander anymore from the land which I gave their fathers, if only they will take care to act in accordance with everything that I have commanded them, and with all the Law that My servant Moses commanded them."
verses.textEn: I will not again make the feet of the Israelites wander from the land I gave their ancestors, if only they will be careful to do everything I commanded them and will keep the whole Law that my servant Moses gave them."

verses.textZh: 但是他们没有听从。玛拿西引诱他们去作坏事，比耶和华从以色列人面前消灭的外族人更厉害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是他们没有听从。玛拿西引诱他们去作坏事，比耶和华从以色列人面前消灭的外族人更厉害。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却不听从。玛拿西引诱他们行恶，比耶和华在以色列人面前所灭的列国更甚。
verses.textEnNiv: But the people did not listen. Manasseh led them astray, so that they did more evil than the nations the Lord had destroyed before the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: But they did not listen, and Manasseh led them astray to do more evil than the nations had done whom the Lord destroyed before the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they paid no attention, and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than the nations whom the Lord had destroyed before the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: But the people refused to listen, and Manasseh led them to do even more evil than the pagan nations that the Lord had destroyed when the people of Israel entered the land.
verses.textEnNasb: But they did not listen, and Manasseh encouraged them to do evil, more than the nations whom the Lord eliminated from the presence of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: But the people did not listen. Manasseh led them astray, so that they did more evil than the nations the Lord had destroyed before the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华借着他的仆人众先知说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华借着他的仆人众先知说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华藉他仆人众先知说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said through his servants the prophets:
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said by his servants the prophets,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke by His servants the prophets, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said through his servants the prophets:
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord spoke through His servants the prophets, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said through his servants the prophets:

verses.textZh: "因为犹大王玛拿西所作这些可憎恶的事，比在他以前的亚摩利人所行的恶更坏，并且以他的偶像使犹大人犯罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因为犹大王玛拿西所作这些可憎恶的事，比在他以前的亚摩利人所行的恶更坏，并且以他的偶像使犹大人犯罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 「因犹大王玛拿西行这些可憎的恶事比先前亚摩利人所行的更甚，使犹大人拜他的偶像，陷在罪里；
verses.textEnNiv: "Manasseh king of Judah has committed these detestable sins. He has done more evil than the Amorites who preceded him and has led Judah into sin with his idols.
verses.textEnEsv: "Because Manasseh king of Judah has committed these abominations and has done things more evil than all that the Amorites did, who were before him, and has made Judah also to sin with his idols,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Because Manasseh king of Judah has done these abominations ( he has acted more wickedly than all the Amorites who were before him, and has also made Judah sin with his idols),
verses.textEnNlt: "King Manasseh of Judah has done many detestable things. He is even more wicked than the Amorites, who lived in this land before Israel. He has caused the people of Judah to sin with his idols.
verses.textEnNasb: "Since Manasseh king of Judah has committed these abominations, having done more evil than all that the Amorites did who were before him, and has also misled Judah into sin with his idols,
verses.textEn: "Manasseh king of Judah has committed these detestable sins. He has done more evil than the Amorites who preceded him and has led Judah into sin with his idols.

verses.textZh: 所以，耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘看哪，我要把灾祸降在耶路撒冷和犹大，使听见的人，双耳都要刺痛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘看哪，我要把灾祸降在耶路撒冷和犹大，使听见的人，双耳都要刺痛。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华－以色列的神如此说：我必降祸与耶路撒冷和犹大，叫一切听见的人无不耳鸣。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I am going to bring such disaster on Jerusalem and Judah that the ears of everyone who hears of it will tingle.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: Behold, I am bringing upon Jerusalem and Judah such disaster that the ears of everyone who hears of it will tingle.
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore thus says the Lord God of Israel: ‘Behold, I am bringing such calamity upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whoever hears of it, both his ears will tingle.
verses.textEnNlt: So this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I will bring such disaster on Jerusalem and Judah that the ears of those who hear about it will tingle with horror.
verses.textEnNasb: therefore this is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: ‘Behold, I am bringing such a disaster on Jerusalem and Judah that whoever hears about it, both of his ears will ring.
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I am going to bring such disaster on Jerusalem and Judah that the ears of everyone who hears of it will tingle.

verses.textZh: 我要用量度撒玛利亚的准绳和测试亚哈家的铅锤，测量耶路撒冷；我要抹净耶路撒冷，像人抹净盘子一样。抹完了，就把盘子翻转过来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要用量度撒玛利亚的准绳和测试亚哈家的铅锤，测量耶路撒冷；我要抹净耶路撒冷，像人抹净盘子一样。抹完了，就把盘子翻转过来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必用量撒马利亚的准绳和亚哈家的线铊拉在耶路撒冷上，必擦净耶路撒冷，如人擦盘，将盘倒扣。
verses.textEnNiv: I will stretch out over Jerusalem the measuring line used against Samaria and the plumb line used against the house of Ahab. I will wipe out Jerusalem as one wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the measuring line of Samaria, and the plumb line of the house of Ahab, and I will wipe Jerusalem as one wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the measuring line of Samaria and the plummet of the house of Ahab; I will wipe Jerusalem as one wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.
verses.textEnNlt: I will judge Jerusalem by the same standard I used for Samaria and the same measure I used for the family of Ahab. I will wipe away the people of Jerusalem as one wipes a dish and turns it upside down.
verses.textEnNasb: I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria and the plummet of the house of Ahab, and I will wipe Jerusalem clean just as one wipes a bowl, wiping it and turning it upside down.
verses.textEn: I will stretch out over Jerusalem the measuring line used against Samaria and the plumb line used against the house of Ahab. I will wipe out Jerusalem as one wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.

verses.textZh: 我要舍弃我的产业的余民，把他们交在他们的仇敌手上；他们要成为他们的仇敌的掠物和战利品。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要舍弃我的产业的余民，把他们交在他们的仇敌手上；他们要成为他们的仇敌的掠物和战利品。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必弃掉所余剩的子民 ，把他们交在仇敌手中，使他们成为一切仇敌掳掠之物；
verses.textEnNiv: I will forsake the remnant of my inheritance and give them into the hands of enemies. They will be looted and plundered by all their enemies;
verses.textEnEsv: And I will forsake the remnant of my heritage and give them into the hand of their enemies, and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies,
verses.textEnNkjv: So I will forsake the remnant of My inheritance and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become victims of plunder to all their enemies,
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will reject even the remnant of my own people who are left, and I will hand them over as plunder for their enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will abandon the remnant of My inheritance and hand them over to their enemies, and they will become as plunder and spoils to all their enemies,
verses.textEn: I will forsake the remnant of my inheritance and give them into the hands of enemies. They will be looted and plundered by all their enemies;

verses.textZh: 因为自从他们的祖先从埃及出来的那天，直到今日，他们一直行我看为恶的事，惹我发怒。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为自从他们的祖先从埃及出来的那天，直到今日，他们一直行我看为恶的事，惹我发怒。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 是因他们自从列祖出埃及直到如今，常行我眼中看为恶的事，惹动我的怒气。」
verses.textEnNiv: they have done evil in my eyes and have aroused my anger from the day their ancestors came out of Egypt until this day."
verses.textEnEsv: because they have done what is evil in my sight and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came out of Egypt, even to this day."
verses.textEnNkjv: because they have done evil in My sight, and have provoked Me to anger since the day their fathers came out of Egypt, even to this day.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: For they have done great evil in my sight and have angered me ever since their ancestors came out of Egypt."
verses.textEnNasb: because they have done evil in My sight, and have been provoking Me to anger since the day their fathers came from Egypt, even to this day.’ "
verses.textEn: they have done evil in my eyes and have aroused my anger from the day their ancestors came out of Egypt until this day."

verses.textZh: 此外，玛拿西又流了许多无辜人的血，耶路撒冷，从这边直到那边，都满了血。这还是在他使犹大人犯罪，去行耶和华看为恶的事那罪之外。
verses.textZhCnvs: 此外，玛拿西又流了许多无辜人的血，耶路撒冷，从这边直到那边，都满了血。这还是在他使犹大人犯罪，去行耶和华看为恶的事那罪之外。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，使犹大人陷在罪里，又流许多无辜人的血，充满了耶路撒冷，从这边直到那边。
verses.textEnNiv: Moreover, Manasseh also shed so much innocent blood that he filled Jerusalem from end to end—besides the sin that he had caused Judah to commit, so that they did evil in the eyes of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, Manasseh shed very much innocent blood, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another, besides the sin that he made Judah to sin so that they did what was evil in the sight of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover Manasseh shed very much innocent blood, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another, besides his sin by which he made Judah sin, in doing evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Manasseh also murdered many innocent people until Jerusalem was filled from one end to the other with innocent blood. This was in addition to the sin that he caused the people of Judah to commit, leading them to do evil in the Lord ’s sight.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, Manasseh shed very much innocent blood until he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another, besides his sin into which he misled Judah, in doing evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Moreover, Manasseh also shed so much innocent blood that he filled Jerusalem from end to end—besides the sin that he had caused Judah to commit, so that they did evil in the eyes of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 玛拿西其余的事迹和他所行的一切，以及他所犯的众罪，不是都记录在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西其余的事迹和他所行的一切，以及他所犯的众罪，不是都记录在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西其余的事，凡他所行的和他所犯的罪都写在犹大列王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Manasseh’s reign, and all he did, including the sin he committed, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh and all that he did, and the sin that he committed, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh—all that he did, and the sin that he committed—are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Manasseh’s reign and everything he did, including the sins he committed, are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh and all that he did, and his sin which he committed, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Manasseh’s reign, and all he did, including the sin he committed, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

verses.textZh: 玛拿西和他的祖先一同长眠，葬在他宫中的花园、乌撒的花园里；他的儿子亚们接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西和他的祖先一同长眠，葬在他宫中的花园、乌撒的花园里；他的儿子亚们接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西与他列祖同睡，葬在自己宫院乌撒的园内；他儿子亚们接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Manasseh rested with his ancestors and was buried in his palace garden, the garden of Uzza. And Amon his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Manasseh slept with his fathers and was buried in the garden of his house, in the garden of Uzza, and Amon his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Manasseh rested with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza. Then his son Amon reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Manasseh died, he was buried in the palace garden, the garden of Uzza. Then his son Amon became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: And Manasseh lay down with his fathers and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza, and his son Amon became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Manasseh rested with his ancestors and was buried in his palace garden, the garden of Uzza. And Amon his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 亚们登基时是二十二岁；他在耶路撒冷作王二年。他母亲名叫米舒利密，来自约提巴，是哈鲁斯的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚们登基时是二十二岁；他在耶路撒冷作王二年。他母亲名叫米舒利密，来自约提巴，是哈鲁斯的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚们登基的时候年二十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王二年。他母亲名叫米舒利密，是约提巴人哈鲁斯的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem two years. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth daughter of Haruz; she was from Jotbah.
verses.textEnEsv: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
verses.textEnNlt: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem two years. His mother was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz from Jotbah.
verses.textEnNasb: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned for two years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
verses.textEn: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem two years. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth daughter of Haruz; she was from Jotbah.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，好象他父亲玛拿西所行的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，好象他父亲玛拿西所行的。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚们行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，与他父亲玛拿西所行的一样；
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , as his father Manasseh had done.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , as Manasseh his father had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, as his father Manasseh had done.
verses.textEnNlt: He did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight, just as his father, Manasseh, had done.
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord, just as his father Manasseh had done.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , as his father Manasseh had done.

verses.textZh: 他跟随他父亲所行的一切道路，服事他父亲所服事的偶像，敬拜它们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他跟随他父亲所行的一切道路，服事他父亲所服事的偶像，敬拜它们。
verses.textZhCuv: 行他父亲一切所行的，敬奉他父亲所敬奉的偶像，
verses.textEnNiv: He followed completely the ways of his father, worshiping the idols his father had worshiped, and bowing down to them.
verses.textEnEsv: He walked in all the way in which his father walked and served the idols that his father served and worshiped them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he walked in all the ways that his father had walked; and he served the idols that his father had served, and worshiped them.
verses.textEnNlt: He followed the example of his father, worshiping the same idols his father had worshiped.
verses.textEnNasb: For he walked entirely in the way that his father had walked, and served the idols that his father had served, and worshiped them.
verses.textEn: He followed completely the ways of his father, worshiping the idols his father had worshiped, and bowing down to them.

verses.textZh: 他离弃耶和华他祖先的神，不跟随耶和华的道路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他离弃耶和华他祖先的神，不跟随耶和华的道路。
verses.textZhCuv: 离弃耶和华－他列祖的神，不遵行耶和华的道。
verses.textEnNiv: He forsook the Lord , the God of his ancestors, and did not walk in obedience to him.
verses.textEnEsv: He abandoned the Lord , the God of his fathers, and did not walk in the way of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: He forsook the Lord God of his fathers, and did not walk in the way of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: He abandoned the Lord , the God of his ancestors, and he refused to follow the Lord ’s ways.
verses.textEnNasb: So he abandoned the Lord, the God of his fathers, and did not walk in the way of the Lord.
verses.textEn: He forsook the Lord , the God of his ancestors, and did not walk in obedience to him.

verses.textZh: 亚们的臣仆阴谋背叛他，在王宫中把他杀死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚们的臣仆阴谋背叛他，在王宫中把他杀死。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚们王的臣仆背叛他，在宫里杀了他。
verses.textEnNiv: Amon’s officials conspired against him and assassinated the king in his palace.
verses.textEnEsv: And the servants of Amon conspired against him and put the king to death in his house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the servants of Amon conspired against him, and killed the king in his own house.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Amon’s own officials conspired against him and assassinated him in his palace.
verses.textEnNasb: And the servants of Amon conspired against him and killed the king in his own house.
verses.textEn: Amon’s officials conspired against him and assassinated the king in his palace.

verses.textZh: 可是国民却击杀了所有阴谋背叛亚们王的人。国民立了他的儿子约西亚接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是国民却击杀了所有阴谋背叛亚们王的人。国民立了他的儿子约西亚接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 但国民杀了那些背叛亚们王的人，立他儿子约西亚接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the people of the land killed all who had plotted against King Amon, and they made Josiah his son king in his place.
verses.textEnEsv: But the people of the land struck down all those who had conspired against King Amon, and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the people of the land executed all those who had conspired against King Amon. Then the people of the land made his son Josiah king in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon, and they made his son Josiah the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon, and the people of the land made his son Josiah king in his place.
verses.textEn: Then the people of the land killed all who had plotted against King Amon, and they made Josiah his son king in his place.

verses.textZh: 亚们其余的事迹，就是他所行的一切，不是都记在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚们其余的事迹，就是他所行的一切，不是都记在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 亚们其余所行的事都写在犹大列王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Amon’s reign, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Amon that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Amon’s reign and what he did are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Amon’s reign, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

verses.textZh: 他葬在乌撒园里他自己的坟墓中；他的儿子约西亚接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他葬在乌撒园里他自己的坟墓中；他的儿子约西亚接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚们葬在乌撒的园内自己的坟墓里。他儿子约西亚接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza. And Josiah his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And he was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza, and Josiah his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza. Then Josiah his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza. Then his son Josiah became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: He was buried in his grave in the garden of Uzza, and his son Josiah became king in his place.
verses.textEn: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza. And Josiah his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 约西亚登基的时候只有八岁。他在耶路撒冷作王共三十一年。他母亲名叫耶底大，是亚大雅的女儿，来自波斯加。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约西亚登基的时候只有八岁。他在耶路撒冷作王共三十一年。他母亲名叫耶底大，是亚大雅的女儿，来自波斯加。
verses.textZhCuv: 约西亚登基的时候年八岁，在耶路撒冷作王三十一年。他母亲名叫耶底大，是波斯加人亚大雅的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years. His mother’s name was Jedidah daughter of Adaiah; she was from Bozkath.
verses.textEnEsv: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jedidah the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.
verses.textEnNkjv: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jedidah the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.
verses.textEnNlt: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years. His mother was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah from Bozkath.
verses.textEnNasb: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned for thirty-one years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Jedidah the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.
verses.textEn: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years. His mother’s name was Jedidah daughter of Adaiah; she was from Bozkath.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为正的事，跟随他祖宗大卫所行的一切道路，不偏左右。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为正的事，跟随他祖宗大卫所行的一切道路，不偏左右。
verses.textZhCuv: 约西亚行耶和华眼中看为正的事，行他祖大卫一切所行的，不偏左右。
verses.textEnNiv: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord and followed completely the ways of his father David, not turning aside to the right or to the left.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord and walked in all the way of David his father, and he did not turn aside to the right or to the left.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did whatwas right in the sight of the Lord, and walked in all the ways of his father David; he did not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.textEnNlt: He did what was pleasing in the Lord ’s sight and followed the example of his ancestor David. He did not turn away from doing what was right.
verses.textEnNasb: He did what was right in the sight of the Lord and walked entirely in the way of his father David, and did not turn aside to the right or to the left.
verses.textEn: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord and followed completely the ways of his father David, not turning aside to the right or to the left.

verses.textZh: 约西亚在位第十八年，王差派米书兰的孙子、亚萨利的儿子、书记沙番到耶和华的殿，吩咐他说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 约西亚在位第十八年，王差派米书兰的孙子、亚萨利的儿子、书记沙番到耶和华的殿，吩咐他说：
verses.textZhCuv: 约西亚王十八年，王差遣米书兰的孙子、亚萨利的儿子－书记沙番上耶和华殿去，吩咐他说：
verses.textEnNiv: In the eighteenth year of his reign, King Josiah sent the secretary, Shaphan son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, to the temple of the Lord . He said:
verses.textEnEsv: In the eighteenth year of King Josiah, the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, son of Meshullam, the secretary, to the house of the Lord , saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, that the king sent Shaphan the scribe, the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, to the house of the Lord, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: In the eighteenth year of his reign, King Josiah sent Shaphan son of Azaliah and grandson of Meshullam, the court secretary, to the Temple of the Lord . He told him,
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, the king sent Shaphan, the son of Azaliah the son of Meshullam the scribe, to the house of the Lord, saying,
verses.textEn: In the eighteenth year of his reign, King Josiah sent the secretary, Shaphan son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, to the temple of the Lord . He said:

verses.textZh: "你上去到希勒家大祭司那里，叫他把献给耶和华殿的银子，就是守门的从人民所收集的，结算一下。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你上去到希勒家大祭司那里，叫他把献给耶和华殿的银子，就是守门的从人民所收集的，结算一下。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你去见大祭司希勒家，使他将奉到耶和华殿的银子，就是守门的从民中收聚的银子，数算数算，
verses.textEnNiv: "Go up to Hilkiah the high priest and have him get ready the money that has been brought into the temple of the Lord , which the doorkeepers have collected from the people.
verses.textEnEsv: "Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may count the money that has been brought into the house of the Lord , which the keepers of the threshold have collected from the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may count the money which has been brought into the house of the Lord, which the doorkeepers have gathered from the people.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go to Hilkiah the high priest and have him count the money the gatekeepers have collected from the people at the Lord ’s Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: "Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, and have him count all the money brought into the house of the Lord, which the doorkeepers have collected from the people.
verses.textEn: "Go up to Hilkiah the high priest and have him get ready the money that has been brought into the temple of the Lord , which the doorkeepers have collected from the people.

verses.textZh: 然后要他们把银子交到在耶和华殿管理工匠的人手中，他们可以把银子交付在耶和华殿修补破坏的地方的工匠，
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后要他们把银子交到在耶和华殿管理工匠的人手中，他们可以把银子交付在耶和华殿修补破坏的地方的工匠，
verses.textZhCuv: 交给耶和华殿里办事的人，使他们转交耶和华殿里做工的人，好修理殿的破坏之处，
verses.textEnNiv: Have them entrust it to the men appointed to supervise the work on the temple. And have these men pay the workers who repair the temple of the Lord —
verses.textEnEsv: And let it be given into the hand of the workmen who have the oversight of the house of the Lord , and let them give it to the workmen who are at the house of the Lord , repairing the house
verses.textEnNkjv: And let them deliver it into the hand of those doing the work, who are the overseers in the house of the Lord; let them give it to those who are in the house of the Lord doing the work, to repair the damages of the house—
verses.textEnNlt: Entrust this money to the men assigned to supervise the restoration of the Lord ’s Temple. Then they can use it to pay workers to repair the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: And have them hand it over to the workmen who have the oversight of the house of the Lord, and have them give it to the workmen who are in the house of the Lord to repair the damage to the house:
verses.textEn: Have them entrust it to the men appointed to supervise the work on the temple. And have these men pay the workers who repair the temple of the Lord —

verses.textZh: 就是交给木匠、建筑工人、石匠，又购买木材和凿好的石头，用来修理圣殿破坏的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是交给木匠、建筑工人、石匠，又购买木材和凿好的石头，用来修理圣殿破坏的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是转交木匠和工人，并瓦匠，又买木料和凿成的石头修理殿宇，
verses.textEnNiv: the carpenters, the builders and the masons. Also have them purchase timber and dressed stone to repair the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: (that is, to the carpenters, and to the builders, and to the masons), and let them use it for buying timber and quarried stone to repair the house.
verses.textEnNkjv: to carpenters and builders and masons—and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.
verses.textEnNlt: They will need to hire carpenters, builders, and masons. Also have them buy the timber and the finished stone needed to repair the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: to the carpenters, the builders, the masons, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the house.
verses.textEn: the carpenters, the builders and the masons. Also have them purchase timber and dressed stone to repair the temple.

verses.textZh: 银子交在他们手中，不用和他们算帐，因为他们办事诚实。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 银子交在他们手中，不用和他们算帐，因为他们办事诚实。"
verses.textZhCuv: 将银子交在办事的人手里，不与他们算帐，因为他们办事诚实。」
verses.textEnNiv: But they need not account for the money entrusted to them, because they are honest in their dealings."
verses.textEnEsv: But no accounting shall be asked from them for the money that is delivered into their hand, for they deal honestly."
verses.textEnNkjv: However there need be no accounting made with them of the money delivered into their hand, because they deal faithfully."
verses.textEnNlt: But don’t require the construction supervisors to keep account of the money they receive, for they are honest and trustworthy men."
verses.textEnNasb: However, no accounting shall be made with them for the money handed over to them, because they deal honestly."
verses.textEn: But they need not account for the money entrusted to them, because they are honest in their dealings."

verses.textZh: 希勒家大祭司对书记沙番说："我在耶和华的殿里找到了一卷律法书。"他把书卷交给沙番；沙番就阅读那书卷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希勒家大祭司对书记沙番说："我在耶和华的殿里找到了一卷律法书。"他把书卷交给沙番；沙番就阅读那书卷。
verses.textZhCuv: 大祭司希勒家对书记沙番说：「我在耶和华殿里得了律法书。」希勒家将书递给沙番，沙番就看了。
verses.textEnNiv: Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the secretary, "I have found the Book of the Law in the temple of the Lord ." He gave it to Shaphan, who read it.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the secretary, "I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the Lord ." And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, "I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the Lord." And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
verses.textEnNlt: Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the court secretary, "I have found the Book of the Law in the Lord ’s Temple!" Then Hilkiah gave the scroll to Shaphan, and he read it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, "I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the Lord." And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, who read it.
verses.textEn: Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the secretary, "I have found the Book of the Law in the temple of the Lord ." He gave it to Shaphan, who read it.

verses.textZh: 书记沙番来见王，向王回报说："你的臣仆已经把殿里的银子清点，交在耶和华殿里管理工匠的人手中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 书记沙番来见王，向王回报说："你的臣仆已经把殿里的银子清点，交在耶和华殿里管理工匠的人手中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 书记沙番到王那里，回复王说：「你的仆人已将殿里的银子倒出数算，交给耶和华殿里办事的人了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Shaphan the secretary went to the king and reported to him: "Your officials have paid out the money that was in the temple of the Lord and have entrusted it to the workers and supervisors at the temple."
verses.textEnEsv: And Shaphan the secretary came to the king, and reported to the king, "Your servants have emptied out the money that was found in the house and have delivered it into the hand of the workmen who have the oversight of the house of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Shaphan the scribe went to the king, bringing the king word, saying, "Your servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of those who do the work, who oversee the house of the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Shaphan went to the king and reported, "Your officials have turned over the money collected at the Temple of the Lord to the workers and supervisors at the Temple."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Shaphan the scribe came to the king and brought back word to the king and said, "Your servants have emptied out the money that was found in the house, and have handed it over to the workmen who have the oversight of the house of the Lord."
verses.textEn: Then Shaphan the secretary went to the king and reported to him: "Your officials have paid out the money that was in the temple of the Lord and have entrusted it to the workers and supervisors at the temple."

verses.textZh: 书记沙番又告诉王说："希勒家大祭司交给我一卷书卷。"书记沙番就在王面前诵读那书卷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 书记沙番又告诉王说："希勒家大祭司交给我一卷书卷。"书记沙番就在王面前诵读那书卷。
verses.textZhCuv: 书记沙番又对王说：「祭司希勒家递给我一卷书。」沙番就在王面前读那书。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Shaphan the secretary informed the king, "Hilkiah the priest has given me a book." And Shaphan read from it in the presence of the king.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Shaphan the secretary told the king, "Hilkiah the priest has given me a book." And Shaphan read it before the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Shaphan the scribe showed the king, saying, "Hilkiah the priest has given me a book." And Shaphan read it before the king.
verses.textEnNlt: Shaphan also told the king, "Hilkiah the priest has given me a scroll." So Shaphan read it to the king.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, Shaphan the scribe informed the king, saying, "Hilkiah the priest has given me a book." And Shaphan read it in the presence of the king.
verses.textEn: Then Shaphan the secretary informed the king, "Hilkiah the priest has given me a book." And Shaphan read from it in the presence of the king.

verses.textZh: 王听见律法书上的话的时候，就撕裂自己的衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王听见律法书上的话的时候，就撕裂自己的衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 王听见律法书上的话，便撕裂衣服，
verses.textEnNiv: When the king heard the words of the Book of the Law, he tore his robes.
verses.textEnEsv: When the king heard the words of the Book of the Law, he tore his clothes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, when the king heard the words of the Book of the Law, that he tore his clothes.
verses.textEnNlt: When the king heard what was written in the Book of the Law, he tore his clothes in despair.
verses.textEnNasb: When the king heard the words of the Book of the Law, he tore his clothes.
verses.textEn: When the king heard the words of the Book of the Law, he tore his robes.

verses.textZh: 王又吩咐希勒家祭司、沙番的儿子亚希甘、米该亚的儿子亚革博、书记沙番和王的臣仆及亚撒雅说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 王又吩咐希勒家祭司、沙番的儿子亚希甘、米该亚的儿子亚革博、书记沙番和王的臣仆及亚撒雅说：
verses.textZhCuv: 吩咐祭司希勒家与沙番的儿子亚希甘、米该亚的儿子亚革波、书记沙番和王的臣仆亚撒雅，说：
verses.textEnNiv: He gave these orders to Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Akbor son of Micaiah, Shaphan the secretary and Asaiah the king’s attendant:
verses.textEnEsv: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Micaiah, and Shaphan the secretary, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Achbor the son of Michaiah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then he gave these orders to Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Acbor son of Micaiah, Shaphan the court secretary, and Asaiah the king’s personal adviser:
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Achbor the son of Micaiah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying,
verses.textEn: He gave these orders to Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Akbor son of Micaiah, Shaphan the secretary and Asaiah the king’s attendant:

verses.textZh: "你们去，为了我、为了人民、为了犹大全国，因着所发现的这书卷上的话求问耶和华，因为耶和华向我们所发的怒气极大；这是因着我们的祖先没有听从这律法书上的话，没有照着所有写给我们的去行。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们去，为了我、为了人民、为了犹大全国，因着所发现的这书卷上的话求问耶和华，因为耶和华向我们所发的怒气极大；这是因着我们的祖先没有听从这律法书上的话，没有照着所有写给我们的去行。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们去为我、为民、为犹大众人，以这书上的话求问耶和华；因为我们列祖没有听从这书上的言语，没有遵着书上所吩咐我们的去行，耶和华就向我们大发烈怒。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Go and inquire of the Lord for me and for the people and for all Judah about what is written in this book that has been found. Great is the Lord ’s anger that burns against us because those who have gone before us have not obeyed the words of this book; they have not acted in accordance with all that is written there concerning us."
verses.textEnEsv: "Go, inquire of the Lord for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that has been found. For great is the wrath of the Lord that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not obeyed the words of this book, to do according to all that is written concerning us."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go, inquire of the Lord for me, for the people and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that has been found; for great is the wrath of the Lord that is aroused against us, because our fathers have not obeyed the words of this book, to do according to all that is written concerning us."
verses.textEnNlt: "Go to the Temple and speak to the Lord for me and for the people and for all Judah. Inquire about the words written in this scroll that has been found. For the Lord ’s great anger is burning against us because our ancestors have not obeyed the words in this scroll. We have not been doing everything it says we must do."
verses.textEnNasb: "Go, inquire of the Lord for me and for the people and all Judah concerning the words of this book that has been found, for the wrath of the Lord that burns against us is great, because our fathers did not listen to the words of this book, to act in accordance with everything that is written regarding us."
verses.textEn: "Go and inquire of the Lord for me and for the people and for all Judah about what is written in this book that has been found. Great is the Lord ’s anger that burns against us because those who have gone before us have not obeyed the words of this book; they have not acted in accordance with all that is written there concerning us."

verses.textZh: 于是希勒家祭司、亚希甘、亚革博、沙番、亚撒雅去见女先知户勒大。她就是掌管礼服的沙龙的妻子，沙龙是哈珥哈斯的孙子、特瓦的儿子。她住在耶路撒冷第二区；他们就把事情都告诉了她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是希勒家祭司、亚希甘、亚革博、沙番、亚撒雅去见女先知户勒大。她就是掌管礼服的沙龙的妻子，沙龙是哈珥哈斯的孙子、特瓦的儿子。她住在耶路撒冷第二区；他们就把事情都告诉了她。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，祭司希勒家和亚希甘、亚革波、沙番、亚撒雅都去见女先知户勒大。户勒大是掌管礼服沙龙的妻；沙龙是哈珥哈斯的孙子、特瓦的儿子。户勒大住在耶路撒冷第二区。他们请问于她。
verses.textEnNiv: Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Akbor, Shaphan and Asaiah went to speak to the prophet Huldah, who was the wife of Shallum son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe. She lived in Jerusalem, in the New Quarter.
verses.textEnEsv: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asaiah went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe (now she lived in Jerusalem in the Second Quarter), and they talked with her.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe. (She dwelt in Jerusalem in the Second Quarter.) And they spoke with her.
verses.textEnNlt: So Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Acbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah went to the New Quarter of Jerusalem to consult with the prophet Huldah. She was the wife of Shallum son of Tikvah, son of Harhas, the keeper of the Temple wardrobe.
verses.textEnNasb: So Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe (and she lived in Jerusalem in the Second Quarter); and they spoke to her.
verses.textEn: Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Akbor, Shaphan and Asaiah went to speak to the prophet Huldah, who was the wife of Shallum son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe. She lived in Jerusalem, in the New Quarter.

verses.textZh: 她对他们说："耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘告诉那差你们到我这里来的人说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 她对他们说："耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘告诉那差你们到我这里来的人说：
verses.textZhCuv: 她对他们说：「耶和华－以色列的神如此说：『你们可以回复那差遣你们来见我的人说，
verses.textEnNiv: She said to them, "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Tell the man who sent you to me,
verses.textEnEsv: And she said to them, "Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she said to them, "Thus says the Lord God of Israel, ‘Tell the man who sent you to Me,
verses.textEnNlt: She said to them, "The Lord , the God of Israel, has spoken! Go back and tell the man who sent you,
verses.textEnNasb: Then she said to them, "This is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: ‘Tell the man who sent you to Me,
verses.textEn: She said to them, "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Tell the man who sent you to me,

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说：看哪，我要照着犹大王所念那书卷上所有的话，使灾祸降临在这地方和它的居民身上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说：看哪，我要照着犹大王所念那书卷上所有的话，使灾祸降临在这地方和它的居民身上，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：我必照着犹大王所读那书上的一切话，降祸与这地和其上的居民。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘This is what the Lord says: I am going to bring disaster on this place and its people, according to everything written in the book the king of Judah has read.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord , Behold, I will bring disaster upon this place and upon its inhabitants, all the words of the book that the king of Judah has read.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord: ‘Behold, I will bring calamity on this place and on its inhabitants—all the words of the book which the king of Judah has read—
verses.textEnNlt: ‘This is what the Lord says: I am going to bring disaster on this city and its people. All the words written in the scroll that the king of Judah has read will come true.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord says: ‘Behold, I am going to bring disaster on this place and on its inhabitants, all the words of the book which the king of Judah has read.
verses.textEn: ‘This is what the Lord says: I am going to bring disaster on this place and its people, according to everything written in the book the king of Judah has read.

verses.textZh: 因为他们背弃了我，向别的神焚香。他们所行的一切都使我发怒，因此我的怒火要在这地方燃点，不会熄灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们背弃了我，向别的神焚香。他们所行的一切都使我发怒，因此我的怒火要在这地方燃点，不会熄灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们离弃我，向别神烧香，用他们手所做的惹我发怒，所以我的忿怒必向这地发作，总不止息。』
verses.textEnNiv: Because they have forsaken me and burned incense to other gods and aroused my anger by all the idols their hands have made, my anger will burn against this place and will not be quenched.’
verses.textEnEsv: Because they have forsaken me and have made offerings to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the work of their hands, therefore my wrath will be kindled against this place, and it will not be quenched.
verses.textEnNkjv: because they have forsaken Me and burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke Me to anger with all the works of their hands. Therefore My wrath shall be aroused against this place and shall not be quenched.’ " ’
verses.textEnNlt: For my people have abandoned me and offered sacrifices to pagan gods, and I am very angry with them for everything they have done. My anger will burn against this place, and it will not be quenched.’
verses.textEnNasb: Since they have abandoned Me and have burned incense to other gods so that they may provoke Me to anger with all the work of their hands, My wrath burns against this place, and it shall not be quenched.’ "
verses.textEn: Because they have forsaken me and burned incense to other gods and aroused my anger by all the idols their hands have made, my anger will burn against this place and will not be quenched.’

verses.textZh: 至于那差你们来求问耶和华的犹大王，你们要这样对他说：耶和华以色列的神这样说：有关你所听见的话，
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于那差你们来求问耶和华的犹大王，你们要这样对他说：耶和华以色列的神这样说：有关你所听见的话，
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，差遣你们来求问耶和华的犹大王，你们要这样回复他说：『耶和华－以色列的神如此说：至于你所听见的话，
verses.textEnNiv: Tell the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the Lord , ‘This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says concerning the words you heard:
verses.textEnEsv: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the Lord , thus shall you say to him, Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: Regarding the words that you have heard,
verses.textEnNkjv: But as for the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the Lord, in this manner you shall speak to him, ‘Thus says the Lord God of Israel: "Concerning the words which you have heard—
verses.textEnNlt: "But go to the king of Judah who sent you to seek the Lord and tell him: ‘This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says concerning the message you have just heard:
verses.textEnNasb: But to the king of Judah who sent you to inquire of the Lord, this is what you shall say to him: "This is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: ‘Regarding the words which you have heard,
verses.textEn: Tell the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the Lord , ‘This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says concerning the words you heard:

verses.textZh: 你听见我攻击这地方和它的居民的话，就是他们要成为荒凉，受咒诅，你的心就顺服，在我面前谦卑，又撕裂自己的衣服，在我面前哀哭，我已经听到了。这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你听见我攻击这地方和它的居民的话，就是他们要成为荒凉，受咒诅，你的心就顺服，在我面前谦卑，又撕裂自己的衣服，在我面前哀哭，我已经听到了。这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是听见我指着这地和其上的居民所说、要使这地变为荒场、民受咒诅的话，你便心里敬服，在我面前自卑，撕裂衣服，向我哭泣，因此我应允了你。这是我－耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Because your heart was responsive and you humbled yourself before the Lord when you heard what I have spoken against this place and its people—that they would become a curse and be laid waste—and because you tore your robes and wept in my presence, I also have heard you, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: because your heart was penitent, and you humbled yourself before the Lord , when you heard how I spoke against this place and against its inhabitants, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and you have torn your clothes and wept before me, I also have heard you, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before the Lord when you heard what I spoke against this place and against its inhabitants, that they would become a desolation and a curse, and you tore your clothes and wept before Me, I also have heard you," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: You were sorry and humbled yourself before the Lord when you heard what I said against this city and its people—that this land would be cursed and become desolate. You tore your clothing in despair and wept before me in repentance. And I have indeed heard you, says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: since your heart was tender and you humbled yourself before the Lord when you heard what I spoke against this place and against its inhabitants, that they would become an object of horror and a curse, and you have torn your clothes and wept before Me, I have indeed heard you,’ declares the Lord."
verses.textEn: Because your heart was responsive and you humbled yourself before the Lord when you heard what I have spoken against this place and its people—that they would become a curse and be laid waste—and because you tore your robes and wept in my presence, I also have heard you, declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 因此，看哪，我要使你归到你的祖先那里，你必平平安安地葬在你的坟墓里；你不会看见我要降在这地的一切灾祸。’"他们就把这话向王回报。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，看哪，我要使你归到你的祖先那里，你必平平安安地葬在你的坟墓里；你不会看见我要降在这地的一切灾祸。’"他们就把这话向王回报。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使你平平安安地归到坟墓到你列祖那里；我要降与这地的一切灾祸，你也不至亲眼看见。』」他们就回复王去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I will gather you to your ancestors, and you will be buried in peace. Your eyes will not see all the disaster I am going to bring on this place.’ " So they took her answer back to the king.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace, and your eyes shall not see all the disaster that I will bring upon this place.’" And they brought back word to the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Surely, therefore, I will gather you to your fathers, and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace; and your eyes shall not see all the calamity which I will bring on this place." ’ " So they brought back word to the king.
verses.textEnNlt: So I will not send the promised disaster until after you have died and been buried in peace. You will not see the disaster I am going to bring on this city.’" So they took her message back to the king.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, behold, I am going to gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace, and your eyes will not look at all the devastation that I am going to bring on this place.’ " So they brought back word to the king.
verses.textEn: Therefore I will gather you to your ancestors, and you will be buried in peace. Your eyes will not see all the disaster I am going to bring on this place.’ " So they took her answer back to the king.

verses.textZh: 于是王派人召集犹大和耶路撒冷所有的长老到他那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是王派人召集犹大和耶路撒冷所有的长老到他那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 王差遣人招聚犹大和耶路撒冷的众长老来。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king called together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king sent, and all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem were gathered to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the king sent them to gather all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem to him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king summoned all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king sent messengers, and they gathered to him all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Then the king called together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 王登上耶和华的殿，犹大众人、耶路撒冷所有的居民，还有祭司、先知和众民，不论大小，都一同前往。王就把在耶和华殿发现的约书所记的一切话都念给他们听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王登上耶和华的殿，犹大众人、耶路撒冷所有的居民，还有祭司、先知和众民，不论大小，都一同前往。王就把在耶和华殿发现的约书所记的一切话都念给他们听。
verses.textZhCuv: 王和犹大众人与耶路撒冷的居民，并祭司、先知，和所有的百姓，无论大小，都一同上到耶和华的殿；王就把耶和华殿里所得的约书念给他们听。
verses.textEnNiv: He went up to the temple of the Lord with the people of Judah, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the priests and the prophets—all the people from the least to the greatest. He read in their hearing all the words of the Book of the Covenant, which had been found in the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And the king went up to the house of the Lord , and with him all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem and the priests and the prophets, all the people, both small and great. And he read in their hearing all the words of the Book of the Covenant that had been found in the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The king went up to the house of the Lord with all the men of Judah, and with him all the inhabitants of Jerusalem—the priests and the prophets and all the people, both small and great. And he read in their hearing all the words of the Book of the Covenant which had been found in the house of the Lord.
