verses.textEnNlt: And the king went up to the Temple of the Lord with all the people of Judah and Jerusalem, along with the priests and the prophets—all the people from the least to the greatest. There the king read to them the entire Book of the Covenant that had been found in the Lord ’s Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king went up to the house of the Lord and every man of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, the prophets, and all the people, from the small to the great; and he read in their presence all the words of the Book of the Covenant which was found in the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: He went up to the temple of the Lord with the people of Judah, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the priests and the prophets—all the people from the least to the greatest. He read in their hearing all the words of the Book of the Covenant, which had been found in the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 王站在柱旁，在耶和华面前立约，要一心一意跟从耶和华，谨守他的诫命、典章和律例，实行这书上所写有关这约的话。众民都一同立约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王站在柱旁，在耶和华面前立约，要一心一意跟从耶和华，谨守他的诫命、典章和律例，实行这书上所写有关这约的话。众民都一同立约。
verses.textZhCuv: 王站在柱旁，在耶和华面前立约，要尽心尽性地顺从耶和华，遵守他的诫命、法度、律例，成就这书上所记的约言。众民都服从这约。
verses.textEnNiv: The king stood by the pillar and renewed the covenant in the presence of the Lord —to follow the Lord and keep his commands, statutes and decrees with all his heart and all his soul, thus confirming the words of the covenant written in this book. Then all the people pledged themselves to the covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the Lord , to walk after the Lord and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all his heart and all his soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people joined in the covenant.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king stood by a pillar and made a covenant before the Lord, to follow the Lord and to keep His commandments and His testimonies and His statutes, with all his heart and all his soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people took a stand for the covenant.
verses.textEnNlt: The king took his place of authority beside the pillar and renewed the covenant in the Lord ’s presence. He pledged to obey the Lord by keeping all his commands, laws, and decrees with all his heart and soul. In this way, he confirmed all the terms of the covenant that were written in the scroll, and all the people pledged themselves to the covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the Lord, to walk after the Lord, and to keep His commandments, His provisions, and His statutes with all his heart and all his soul, to carry out the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people entered into the covenant.
verses.textEn: The king stood by the pillar and renewed the covenant in the presence of the Lord —to follow the Lord and keep his commands, statutes and decrees with all his heart and all his soul, thus confirming the words of the covenant written in this book. Then all the people pledged themselves to the covenant.

verses.textZh: 王吩咐希勒家大祭司、副祭司和守殿门的，把所有为巴力、亚舍拉和天上的万象所制造的器皿，从耶和华殿里搬出去，在耶路撒冷城外汲沦谷的田野，把它们烧了。然后把它们的灰烬带到伯特利去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王吩咐希勒家大祭司、副祭司和守殿门的，把所有为巴力、亚舍拉和天上的万象所制造的器皿，从耶和华殿里搬出去，在耶路撒冷城外汲沦谷的田野，把它们烧了。然后把它们的灰烬带到伯特利去。
verses.textZhCuv: 王吩咐大祭司希勒家和副祭司，并把门的，将那为巴力和亚舍拉，并天上万象所造的器皿，都从耶和华殿里搬出来，在耶路撒冷外汲沦溪旁的田间烧了，把灰拿到伯特利去。
verses.textEnNiv: The king ordered Hilkiah the high priest, the priests next in rank and the doorkeepers to remove from the temple of the Lord all the articles made for Baal and Asherah and all the starry hosts. He burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron Valley and took the ashes to Bethel.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest and the priests of the second order and the keepers of the threshold to bring out of the temple of the Lord all the vessels made for Baal, for Asherah, and for all the host of heaven. He burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron and carried their ashes to Bethel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, the priests of the second order, and the doorkeepers, to bring out of the temple of the Lord all the articles that were made for Baal, for Asherah, and for all the host of heaven; and he burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried their ashes to Bethel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king instructed Hilkiah the high priest and the priests of the second rank and the Temple gatekeepers to remove from the Lord ’s Temple all the articles that were used to worship Baal, Asherah, and all the powers of the heavens. The king had all these things burned outside Jerusalem on the terraces of the Kidron Valley, and he carried the ashes away to Bethel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, the priests of the second order, and the doorkeepers to bring out of the temple of the Lord all the utensils that had been made for Baal, for Asherah, and for all the heavenly lights; and he burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron Valley, and carried their ashes to Bethel.
verses.textEn: The king ordered Hilkiah the high priest, the priests next in rank and the doorkeepers to remove from the temple of the Lord all the articles made for Baal and Asherah and all the starry hosts. He burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron Valley and took the ashes to Bethel.

verses.textZh: 他废除了从前犹大列王所立、在犹大各城的邱坛，和耶路撒冷的周围焚香拜偶像的祭司。又废除向巴力、日、月、星辰和天上万象焚香的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他废除了从前犹大列王所立、在犹大各城的邱坛，和耶路撒冷的周围焚香拜偶像的祭司。又废除向巴力、日、月、星辰和天上万象焚香的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前犹大列王所立拜偶像的祭司，在犹大城邑的邱坛和耶路撒冷的周围烧香，现在王都废去，又废去向巴力和日、月、行星 ，并天上万象烧香的人；
verses.textEnNiv: He did away with the idolatrous priests appointed by the kings of Judah to burn incense on the high places of the towns of Judah and on those around Jerusalem—those who burned incense to Baal, to the sun and moon, to the constellations and to all the starry hosts.
verses.textEnEsv: And he deposed the priests whom the kings of Judah had ordained to make offerings in the high places at the cities of Judah and around Jerusalem; those also who burned incense to Baal, to the sun and the moon and the constellations and all the host of the heavens.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he removed the idolatrous priests whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense on the high places in the cities of Judah and in the places all around Jerusalem, and those who burned incense to Baal, to the sun, to the moon, to the constellations, and to all the host of heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: He did away with the idolatrous priests, who had been appointed by the previous kings of Judah, for they had offered sacrifices at the pagan shrines throughout Judah and even in the vicinity of Jerusalem. They had also offered sacrifices to Baal, and to the sun, the moon, the constellations, and to all the powers of the heavens.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he did away with the idolatrous priests whom the kings of Judah had appointed to burn incense on the high places in the cities of Judah and in the surrounding area of Jerusalem, as well as those who burned incense to Baal, to the sun, to the moon, to the constellations, and to all the remaining heavenly lights.
verses.textEn: He did away with the idolatrous priests appointed by the kings of Judah to burn incense on the high places of the towns of Judah and on those around Jerusalem—those who burned incense to Baal, to the sun and moon, to the constellations and to all the starry hosts.

verses.textZh: 他把亚舍拉像从耶和华殿里搬走，拿到耶路撒冷外的汲沦溪去，在汲沦溪把它烧毁，磨碎成灰，把灰撒在平民的坟墓上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把亚舍拉像从耶和华殿里搬走，拿到耶路撒冷外的汲沦溪去，在汲沦溪把它烧毁，磨碎成灰，把灰撒在平民的坟墓上。
verses.textZhCuv: 又从耶和华殿里将亚舍拉搬到耶路撒冷外汲沦溪边焚烧，打碎成灰，将灰撒在平民的坟上；
verses.textEnNiv: He took the Asherah pole from the temple of the Lord to the Kidron Valley outside Jerusalem and burned it there. He ground it to powder and scattered the dust over the graves of the common people.
verses.textEnEsv: And he brought out the Asherah from the house of the Lord , outside Jerusalem, to the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron and beat it to dust and cast the dust of it upon the graves of the common people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he brought out the wooden image from the house of the Lord, to the Brook Kidron outside Jerusalem, burned it at the Brook Kidron and ground it to ashes, and threw its ashes on the graves of the common people.
verses.textEnNlt: The king removed the Asherah pole from the Lord ’s Temple and took it outside Jerusalem to the Kidron Valley, where he burned it. Then he ground the ashes of the pole to dust and threw the dust over the graves of the people.
verses.textEnNasb: He also brought out the Asherah from the house of the Lord outside Jerusalem to the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and ground it to dust, and threw its dust on the graves of the common people.
verses.textEn: He took the Asherah pole from the temple of the Lord to the Kidron Valley outside Jerusalem and burned it there. He ground it to powder and scattered the dust over the graves of the common people.

verses.textZh: 他拆毁在耶和华殿内男性庙妓的房屋，就是妇女为亚舍拉编织袍子的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他拆毁在耶和华殿内男性庙妓的房屋，就是妇女为亚舍拉编织袍子的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 又拆毁耶和华殿里娈童的屋子，就是妇女为亚舍拉织帐子的屋子，
verses.textEnNiv: He also tore down the quarters of the male shrine prostitutes that were in the temple of the Lord , the quarters where women did weaving for Asherah.
verses.textEnEsv: And he broke down the houses of the male cult prostitutes who were in the house of the Lord , where the women wove hangings for the Asherah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he tore down the ritual booths of the perverted persons that were in the house of the Lord, where the women wove hangings for the wooden image.
verses.textEnNlt: He also tore down the living quarters of the male and female shrine prostitutes that were inside the Temple of the Lord , where the women wove coverings for the Asherah pole.
verses.textEnNasb: And he tore down the cubicles of the male cult prostitutes which were in the house of the Lord, where the women were weaving hangings for the Asherah.
verses.textEn: He also tore down the quarters of the male shrine prostitutes that were in the temple of the Lord , the quarters where women did weaving for Asherah.

verses.textZh: 他又从犹大各城把祭司们召来，污秽祭司们焚香的邱坛，从迦巴直到别是巴。他又拆毁设在城门的邱坛，就是在市长约书亚门的出入处，在城门的左边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又从犹大各城把祭司们召来，污秽祭司们焚香的邱坛，从迦巴直到别是巴。他又拆毁设在城门的邱坛，就是在市长约书亚门的出入处，在城门的左边。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且从犹大的城邑带众祭司来，污秽祭司烧香的邱坛，从迦巴直到别是巴，又拆毁城门旁的邱坛，这邱坛在邑宰约书亚门前，进城门的左边。
verses.textEnNiv: Josiah brought all the priests from the towns of Judah and desecrated the high places, from Geba to Beersheba, where the priests had burned incense. He broke down the gateway at the entrance of the Gate of Joshua, the city governor, which was on the left of the city gate.
verses.textEnEsv: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had made offerings, from Geba to Beersheba. And he broke down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on one’s left at the gate of the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he brought all the priests from the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba; also he broke down the high places at the gates which were at the entrance of the Gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were to the left of the city gate.
verses.textEnNlt: Josiah brought to Jerusalem all the priests who were living in other towns of Judah. He also defiled the pagan shrines, where they had offered sacrifices—all the way from Geba to Beersheba. He destroyed the shrines at the entrance to the gate of Joshua, the governor of Jerusalem. This gate was located to the left of the city gate as one enters the city.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he brought all the priests from the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba; and he tore down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on one’s left at the city gate.
verses.textEn: Josiah brought all the priests from the towns of Judah and desecrated the high places, from Geba to Beersheba, where the priests had burned incense. He broke down the gateway at the entrance of the Gate of Joshua, the city governor, which was on the left of the city gate.

verses.textZh: 但是邱坛的祭司不会登上在耶路撒冷耶和华的祭坛，他们只是在他们的兄弟中间吃无酵饼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是邱坛的祭司不会登上在耶路撒冷耶和华的祭坛，他们只是在他们的兄弟中间吃无酵饼。
verses.textZhCuv: 但是邱坛的祭司不登耶路撒冷耶和华的坛，只在他们弟兄中间吃无酵饼。
verses.textEnNiv: Although the priests of the high places did not serve at the altar of the Lord in Jerusalem, they ate unleavened bread with their fellow priests.
verses.textEnEsv: However, the priests of the high places did not come up to the altar of the Lord in Jerusalem, but they ate unleavened bread among their brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless the priests of the high places did not come up to the altar of the Lord in Jerusalem, but they ate unleavened bread among their brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: The priests who had served at the pagan shrines were not allowed to serve at the Lord ’s altar in Jerusalem, but they were allowed to eat unleavened bread with the other priests.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless the priests of the high places did not go up to the altar of the Lord in Jerusalem, but they ate unleavened bread among their brothers.
verses.textEn: Although the priests of the high places did not serve at the altar of the Lord in Jerusalem, they ate unleavened bread with their fellow priests.

verses.textZh: 他又污秽在欣嫩子谷的陀斐特，不许人在那里将儿女焚烧献给摩洛 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又污秽在欣嫩子谷的陀斐特，不许人在那里将儿女焚烧献给摩洛 。
verses.textZhCuv: 又污秽欣嫩子谷的陀斐特，不许人在那里使儿女经火献给摩洛；
verses.textEnNiv: He desecrated Topheth, which was in the Valley of Ben Hinnom, so no one could use it to sacrifice their son or daughter in the fire to Molek.
verses.textEnEsv: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, that no one might burn his son or his daughter as an offering to Molech.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter pass through the fire to Molech.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king defiled the altar of Topheth in the valley of Ben-Hinnom, so no one could ever again use it to sacrifice a son or daughter in the fire as an offering to Molech.
verses.textEnNasb: He also defiled Topheth, which is in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, so that no one would make his son or his daughter pass through the fire for Molech.
verses.textEn: He desecrated Topheth, which was in the Valley of Ben Hinnom, so no one could use it to sacrifice their son or daughter in the fire to Molek.

verses.textZh: 他又除去犹大列王献给日头的马匹；这些马匹是在耶和华殿的入口处，靠近太监拿单．米勒在院子里的住宅。他又把献给日头的战车用火烧掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又除去犹大列王献给日头的马匹；这些马匹是在耶和华殿的入口处，靠近太监拿单．米勒在院子里的住宅。他又把献给日头的战车用火烧掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 又将犹大列王在耶和华殿门旁、太监拿单‧米勒靠近游廊的屋子、向日头所献的马废去，且用火焚烧日车。
verses.textEnNiv: He removed from the entrance to the temple of the Lord the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun. They were in the court near the room of an official named Nathan-Melek. Josiah then burned the chariots dedicated to the sun.
verses.textEnEsv: And he removed the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun, at the entrance to the house of the Lord , by the chamber of Nathan-melech the chamberlain, which was in the precincts. And he burned the chariots of the sun with fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he removed the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun, at the entrance to the house of the Lord, by the chamber of Nathan-Melech, the officer who was in the court; and he burned the chariots of the sun with fire.
verses.textEnNlt: He removed from the entrance of the Lord ’s Temple the horse statues that the former kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun. They were near the quarters of Nathan-melech the eunuch, an officer of the court. The king also burned the chariots dedicated to the sun.
verses.textEnNasb: And he did away with the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entrance of the house of the Lord, by the chamber of Nathan-melech the official, which was at the covered courtyard; and he burned the chariots of the sun with fire.
verses.textEn: He removed from the entrance to the temple of the Lord the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun. They were in the court near the room of an official named Nathan-Melek. Josiah then burned the chariots dedicated to the sun.

verses.textZh: 他又把亚哈斯的楼房顶上，犹大列王所做的祭坛，和玛拿西在耶和华殿的两院中所做的祭坛拆毁，就地打碎，把它们的灰尘倒进汲沦溪去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又把亚哈斯的楼房顶上，犹大列王所做的祭坛，和玛拿西在耶和华殿的两院中所做的祭坛拆毁，就地打碎，把它们的灰尘倒进汲沦溪去。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大列王在亚哈斯楼顶上所筑的坛和玛拿西在耶和华殿两院中所筑的坛，王都拆毁打碎了，就把灰倒在汲沦溪中。
verses.textEnNiv: He pulled down the altars the kings of Judah had erected on the roof near the upper room of Ahaz, and the altars Manasseh had built in the two courts of the temple of the Lord . He removed them from there, smashed them to pieces and threw the rubble into the Kidron Valley.
verses.textEnEsv: And the altars on the roof of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars that Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the Lord , he pulled down and broke in pieces and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.
verses.textEnNkjv: The altars that were on the roof, the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the Lord, the king broke down and pulverized there, and threw their dust into the Brook Kidron.
verses.textEnNlt: Josiah tore down the altars that the kings of Judah had built on the palace roof above the upper room of Ahaz. The king destroyed the altars that Manasseh had built in the two courtyards of the Lord ’s Temple. He smashed them to bits and scattered the pieces in the Kidron Valley.
verses.textEnNasb: The king also tore down the altars that were on the roof, the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courtyards of the house of the Lord; and he smashed them there and threw their dust into the brook Kidron.
verses.textEn: He pulled down the altars the kings of Judah had erected on the roof near the upper room of Ahaz, and the altars Manasseh had built in the two courts of the temple of the Lord . He removed them from there, smashed them to pieces and threw the rubble into the Kidron Valley.

verses.textZh: 在耶路撒冷东面、橄榄山南面的邱坛，就是以色列王所罗门为西顿人可憎的神亚斯他录、摩押人可憎的神基抹，和亚扪人可憎的神米勒公所筑的邱坛，王都污秽了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶路撒冷东面、橄榄山南面的邱坛，就是以色列王所罗门为西顿人可憎的神亚斯他录、摩押人可憎的神基抹，和亚扪人可憎的神米勒公所筑的邱坛，王都污秽了。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前以色列王所罗门在耶路撒冷前、邪僻山右边为西顿人可憎的神亚斯她录、摩押人可憎的神基抹、亚扪人可憎的神米勒公所筑的邱坛，王都污秽了，
verses.textEnNiv: The king also desecrated the high places that were east of Jerusalem on the south of the Hill of Corruption—the ones Solomon king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the vile goddess of the Sidonians, for Chemosh the vile god of Moab, and for Molek the detestable god of the people of Ammon.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king defiled the high places that were east of Jerusalem, to the south of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king defiled the high places that were east of Jerusalem, which were on the south of the Mount of Corruption, which Solomon king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the people of Ammon.
verses.textEnNlt: The king also desecrated the pagan shrines east of Jerusalem, to the south of the Mount of Corruption, where King Solomon of Israel had built shrines for Ashtoreth, the detestable goddess of the Sidonians; and for Chemosh, the detestable god of the Moabites; and for Molech, the vile god of the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king defiled the high places that were opposite Jerusalem, which were on the right of the mount of destruction which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the sons of Ammon.
verses.textEn: The king also desecrated the high places that were east of Jerusalem on the south of the Hill of Corruption—the ones Solomon king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the vile goddess of the Sidonians, for Chemosh the vile god of Moab, and for Molek the detestable god of the people of Ammon.

verses.textZh: 他又打碎神柱，砍下亚舍拉，把死人的骨头布满那个地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又打碎神柱，砍下亚舍拉，把死人的骨头布满那个地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 又打碎柱像，砍下木偶，将人的骨头充满了那地方。
verses.textEnNiv: Josiah smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles and covered the sites with human bones.
verses.textEnEsv: And he broke in pieces the pillars and cut down the Asherim and filled their places with the bones of men.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he broke in pieces the sacred pillars and cut down the wooden images, and filled their places with the bones of men.
verses.textEnNlt: He smashed the sacred pillars and cut down the Asherah poles. Then he desecrated these places by scattering human bones over them.
verses.textEnNasb: He also smashed to pieces the memorial stones and cut down the Asherim, and filled their places with human bones.
verses.textEn: Josiah smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles and covered the sites with human bones.

verses.textZh: 此外，甚至在伯特利的祭坛和那使以色列人陷于罪中的尼八的儿子耶罗波安所做的邱坛，他都拆毁焚烧，压碎成灰，又把亚舍拉烧了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 此外，甚至在伯特利的祭坛和那使以色列人陷于罪中的尼八的儿子耶罗波安所做的邱坛，他都拆毁焚烧，压碎成灰，又把亚舍拉烧了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他将伯特利的坛，就是叫以色列人陷在罪里、尼八的儿子耶罗波安所筑的那坛，都拆毁焚烧，打碎成灰，并焚烧了亚舍拉。
verses.textEnNiv: Even the altar at Bethel, the high place made by Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused Israel to sin—even that altar and high place he demolished. He burned the high place and ground it to powder, and burned the Asherah pole also.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, the altar at Bethel, the high place erected by Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, that altar with the high place he pulled down and burned, reducing it to dust. He also burned the Asherah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the altar that was at Bethel, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he broke down; and he burned the high place and crushed it to powder, and burned the wooden image.
verses.textEnNlt: The king also tore down the altar at Bethel—the pagan shrine that Jeroboam son of Nebat had made when he caused Israel to sin. He burned down the shrine and ground it to dust, and he burned the Asherah pole.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, the altar that was at Bethel and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who misled Israel into sin, had made, even that altar and the high place he tore down. Then he burned the high place, ground the remains to dust, and burned the Asherah.
verses.textEn: Even the altar at Bethel, the high place made by Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused Israel to sin—even that altar and high place he demolished. He burned the high place and ground it to powder, and burned the Asherah pole also.

verses.textZh: 约西亚转过身来，看见在山上的坟墓，于是派人把骨头从坟墓中取出来，烧在祭坛上，污秽它，就像神人从前所宣告的耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约西亚转过身来，看见在山上的坟墓，于是派人把骨头从坟墓中取出来，烧在祭坛上，污秽它，就像神人从前所宣告的耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 约西亚回头，看见山上的坟墓，就打发人将坟墓里的骸骨取出来，烧在坛上，污秽了坛，正如从前神人宣传耶和华的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Josiah looked around, and when he saw the tombs that were there on the hillside, he had the bones removed from them and burned on the altar to defile it, in accordance with the word of the Lord proclaimed by the man of God who foretold these things.
verses.textEnEsv: And as Josiah turned, he saw the tombs there on the mount. And he sent and took the bones out of the tombs and burned them on the altar and defiled it, according to the word of the Lord that the man of God proclaimed, who had predicted these things.
verses.textEnNkjv: As Josiah turned, he saw the tombs that were there on the mountain. And he sent and took the bones out of the tombs and burned them on the altar, and defiled it according to the word of the Lord which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Josiah turned around and noticed several tombs in the side of the hill. He ordered that the bones be brought out, and he burned them on the altar at Bethel to desecrate it. (This happened just as the Lord had promised through the man of God when Jeroboam stood beside the altar at the festival.) Then Josiah turned and looked up at the tomb of the man of God who had predicted these things.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Josiah turned, he saw the graves that were there on the mountain, and he sent men and took the bones from the graves, and burned them on the altar and defiled it in accordance with the word of the Lord which the man of God proclaimed, the one who proclaimed these things.
verses.textEn: Then Josiah looked around, and when he saw the tombs that were there on the hillside, he had the bones removed from them and burned on the altar to defile it, in accordance with the word of the Lord proclaimed by the man of God who foretold these things.

verses.textZh: 约西亚说："我看见的这墓碑是谁的呢？"那城的人对他说："这是以前从犹大来预告你在伯特利祭坛上所作的事的神人的坟墓。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约西亚说："我看见的这墓碑是谁的呢？"那城的人对他说："这是以前从犹大来预告你在伯特利祭坛上所作的事的神人的坟墓。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约西亚问说：「我所看见的是什么碑？」那城里的人回答说：「先前有神人从犹大来，预先说王现在向伯特利坛所行的事，这就是他的墓碑。」
verses.textEnNiv: The king asked, "What is that tombstone I see?" The people of the city said, "It marks the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and pronounced against the altar of Bethel the very things you have done to it."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said, "What is that monument that I see?" And the men of the city told him, "It is the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and predicted these things that you have done against the altar at Bethel."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "What gravestone is this that I see?" So the men of the city told him, "Itis the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and proclaimed these things which you have done against the altar of Bethel."
verses.textEnNlt: "What is that monument over there?" Josiah asked. And the people of the town told him, "It is the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and predicted the very things that you have just done to the altar at Bethel!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "What is this gravestone there that I see?" And the men of the city told him, "It is the grave of the man of God who came from Judah and proclaimed these things which you have done against the altar of Bethel."
verses.textEn: The king asked, "What is that tombstone I see?" The people of the city said, "It marks the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and pronounced against the altar of Bethel the very things you have done to it."

verses.textZh: 所以王说："由他吧！不要让人动他的骨头。"于是他们没有碰他的骨头和那从撒玛利亚来的先知的骨头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以王说："由他吧！不要让人动他的骨头。"于是他们没有碰他的骨头和那从撒玛利亚来的先知的骨头。
verses.textZhCuv: 约西亚说：「由他吧！不要挪移他的骸骨。」他们就不动他的骸骨，也不动从撒马利亚来那先知的骸骨。
verses.textEnNiv: "Leave it alone," he said. "Don’t let anyone disturb his bones." So they spared his bones and those of the prophet who had come from Samaria.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Let him be; let no man move his bones." So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet who came out of Samaria.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "Let him alone; let no one move his bones." So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet who came from Samaria.
verses.textEnNlt: Josiah replied, "Leave it alone. Don’t disturb his bones." So they did not burn his bones or those of the old prophet from Samaria.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "Leave him alone; no one is to disturb his bones." So they left his bones undisturbed with the bones of the prophet who came from Samaria.
verses.textEn: "Leave it alone," he said. "Don’t let anyone disturb his bones." So they spared his bones and those of the prophet who had come from Samaria.

verses.textZh: 以色列诸王在撒玛利亚各城市建造，以致激怒耶和华的一切邱坛上的庙堂，约西亚都除去；他照着在伯特利所行的一切对付它们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列诸王在撒玛利亚各城市建造，以致激怒耶和华的一切邱坛上的庙堂，约西亚都除去；他照着在伯特利所行的一切对付它们。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前以色列诸王在撒马利亚的城邑建筑邱坛的殿，惹动耶和华的怒气，现在约西亚都废去了，就如他在伯特利所行的一般；
verses.textEnNiv: Just as he had done at Bethel, Josiah removed all the shrines at the high places that the kings of Israel had built in the towns of Samaria and that had aroused the Lord ’s anger.
verses.textEnEsv: And Josiah removed all the shrines also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which kings of Israel had made, provoking the Lord to anger. He did to them according to all that he had done at Bethel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Josiah also took away all the shrines of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the Lord to anger; and he did to them according to all the deeds he had done in Bethel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Josiah demolished all the buildings at the pagan shrines in the towns of Samaria, just as he had done at Bethel. They had been built by the various kings of Israel and had made the Lord very angry.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Josiah also removed all the houses of the high places which were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had constructed, provoking the Lord to anger; and he did to them just as he had done in Bethel.
verses.textEn: Just as he had done at Bethel, Josiah removed all the shrines at the high places that the kings of Israel had built in the towns of Samaria and that had aroused the Lord ’s anger.

verses.textZh: 他又把所有邱坛的祭司都在祭坛上宰了。他把人的骨头烧在它们上面，然后回到耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又把所有邱坛的祭司都在祭坛上宰了。他把人的骨头烧在它们上面，然后回到耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 又将邱坛的祭司都杀在坛上，并在坛上烧人的骨头，就回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Josiah slaughtered all the priests of those high places on the altars and burned human bones on them. Then he went back to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And he sacrificed all the priests of the high places who were there, on the altars, and burned human bones on them. Then he returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: He executed all the priests of the high places who were there, on the altars, and burned men’s bones on them; and he returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: He executed the priests of the pagan shrines on their own altars, and he burned human bones on the altars to desecrate them. Finally, he returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: And he slaughtered all the priests of the high places who were there on the altars, and burned human bones on them; then he returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Josiah slaughtered all the priests of those high places on the altars and burned human bones on them. Then he went back to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 王又命令众民说："照着这约书上所写的，守逾越节，记念耶和华你们的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王又命令众民说："照着这约书上所写的，守逾越节，记念耶和华你们的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王吩咐众民说：「你们当照这约书上所写的，向耶和华－你们的神守逾越节。」
verses.textEnNiv: The king gave this order to all the people: "Celebrate the Passover to the Lord your God, as it is written in this Book of the Covenant."
verses.textEnEsv: And the king commanded all the people, "Keep the Passover to the Lord your God, as it is written in this Book of the Covenant."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king commanded all the people, saying, "Keep the Passover to the Lord your God, as itis written in this Book of the Covenant."
verses.textEnNlt: King Josiah then issued this order to all the people: "You must celebrate the Passover to the Lord your God, as required in this Book of the Covenant."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king commanded all the people, saying, "Celebrate the Passover to the Lord your God as it is written in this Book of the Covenant."
verses.textEn: The king gave this order to all the people: "Celebrate the Passover to the Lord your God, as it is written in this Book of the Covenant."

verses.textZh: 真的自从士师治理以色列的日子以来，以及以色列诸王和犹大列王所有的日子以来，没有守过像这次的逾越节的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 真的自从士师治理以色列的日子以来，以及以色列诸王和犹大列王所有的日子以来，没有守过像这次的逾越节的。
verses.textZhCuv: 自从士师治理以色列人和以色列王、犹大王的时候，直到如今，实在没有守过这样的逾越节；
verses.textEnNiv: Neither in the days of the judges who led Israel nor in the days of the kings of Israel and the kings of Judah had any such Passover been observed.
verses.textEnEsv: For no such Passover had been kept since the days of the judges who judged Israel, or during all the days of the kings of Israel or of the kings of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Such a Passover surely had never been held since the days of the judges who judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel and the kings of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: There had not been a Passover celebration like that since the time when the judges ruled in Israel, nor throughout all the years of the kings of Israel and Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Truly such a Passover had not been celebrated since the days of the judges who judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel and the kings of Judah.
verses.textEn: Neither in the days of the judges who led Israel nor in the days of the kings of Israel and the kings of Judah had any such Passover been observed.

verses.textZh: 只有在约西亚王第十八年，在耶路撒冷守了这逾越节，记念耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有在约西亚王第十八年，在耶路撒冷守了这逾越节，记念耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 只有约西亚王十八年在耶路撒冷向耶和华守这逾越节。
verses.textEnNiv: But in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, this Passover was celebrated to the Lord in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: But in the eighteenth year of King Josiah this Passover was kept to the Lord in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: But in the eighteenth year of King Josiah this Passover was held before the Lord in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: But in the eighteenth year of King Josiah’s reign, this Passover was celebrated to the Lord in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: But in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, this Passover was celebrated to the Lord in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: But in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, this Passover was celebrated to the Lord in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 约西亚也除去在犹大地和耶路撒冷所有招魂的、行巫术的、家神、偶像和一切可憎之物，为要实践希勒家祭司在耶和华殿里所寻得的书上所写律法的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约西亚也除去在犹大地和耶路撒冷所有招魂的、行巫术的、家神、偶像和一切可憎之物，为要实践希勒家祭司在耶和华殿里所寻得的书上所写律法的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡犹大国和耶路撒冷所有交鬼的、行巫术的，与家中的神像和偶像，并一切可憎之物，约西亚尽都除掉，成就了祭司希勒家在耶和华殿里所得律法书上所写的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Furthermore, Josiah got rid of the mediums and spiritists, the household gods, the idols and all the other detestable things seen in Judah and Jerusalem. This he did to fulfill the requirements of the law written in the book that Hilkiah the priest had discovered in the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, Josiah put away the mediums and the necromancers and the household gods and the idols and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, that he might establish the words of the law that were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover Josiah put away those who consulted mediums and spiritists, the household gods and idols, all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Josiah also got rid of the mediums and psychics, the household gods, the idols, and every other kind of detestable practice, both in Jerusalem and throughout the land of Judah. He did this in obedience to the laws written in the scroll that Hilkiah the priest had found in the Lord ’s Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, Josiah removed the mediums, the spiritists, the household idols, the idols, and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, so that he might fulfill the words of the Law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Furthermore, Josiah got rid of the mediums and spiritists, the household gods, the idols and all the other detestable things seen in Judah and Jerusalem. This he did to fulfill the requirements of the law written in the book that Hilkiah the priest had discovered in the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 在他以前没有王好象他按着摩西一切律法，全心、全性、全力归向耶和华；在他以后也没有兴起一个王好象他的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他以前没有王好象他按着摩西一切律法，全心、全性、全力归向耶和华；在他以后也没有兴起一个王好象他的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在约西亚以前没有王像他尽心、尽性、尽力地归向耶和华，遵行摩西的一切律法；在他以后也没有兴起一个王像他。
verses.textEnNiv: Neither before nor after Josiah was there a king like him who turned to the Lord as he did—with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his strength, in accordance with all the Law of Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: Before him there was no king like him, who turned to the Lord with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his might, according to all the Law of Moses, nor did any like him arise after him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now before him there was no king like him, who turned to the Lord with all his heart, with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the Law of Moses; nor after him did any arise like him.
verses.textEnNlt: Never before had there been a king like Josiah, who turned to the Lord with all his heart and soul and strength, obeying all the laws of Moses. And there has never been a king like him since.
verses.textEnNasb: Before him there was no king like him who turned to the Lord with all his heart, all his soul, and all his might, in conformity to all the Law of Moses; nor did any like him arise after him.
verses.textEn: Neither before nor after Josiah was there a king like him who turned to the Lord as he did—with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his strength, in accordance with all the Law of Moses.

verses.textZh: 但耶和华并没有把他向犹大所发的烈怒消除，因玛拿西种种的恶行激怒了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶和华并没有把他向犹大所发的烈怒消除，因玛拿西种种的恶行激怒了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，耶和华向犹大所发猛烈的怒气仍不止息，是因玛拿西诸事惹动他。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, the Lord did not turn away from the heat of his fierce anger, which burned against Judah because of all that Manasseh had done to arouse his anger.
verses.textEnEsv: Still the Lord did not turn from the burning of his great wrath, by which his anger was kindled against Judah, because of all the provocations with which Manasseh had provoked him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless the Lord did not turn from the fierceness of His great wrath, with which His anger was aroused against Judah, because of all the provocations with which Manasseh had provoked Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Even so, the Lord was very angry with Judah because of all the wicked things Manasseh had done to provoke him.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless, the Lord did not turn from the fierceness of His great wrath with which His anger burned against Judah, because of all the provocations with which Manasseh had provoked Him.
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, the Lord did not turn away from the heat of his fierce anger, which burned against Judah because of all that Manasseh had done to arouse his anger.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："我也要把犹大从我面前赶走，好象我把以色列除去一样。我要丢弃我所拣选的城市耶路撒冷，以及圣殿，我曾说：‘我的名必立在那里。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："我也要把犹大从我面前赶走，好象我把以色列除去一样。我要丢弃我所拣选的城市耶路撒冷，以及圣殿，我曾说：‘我的名必立在那里。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「我必将犹大人从我面前赶出，如同赶出以色列人一般；我必弃掉我从前所选择的这城－耶路撒冷和我所说立我名的殿。」
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord said, "I will remove Judah also from my presence as I removed Israel, and I will reject Jerusalem, the city I chose, and this temple, about which I said, ‘My Name shall be there.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said, "I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, and I will cast off this city that I have chosen, Jerusalem, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said, "I will also remove Judah from My sight, as I have removed Israel, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, ‘My name shall be there.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord said, "I will also banish Judah from my presence just as I have banished Israel. And I will reject my chosen city of Jerusalem and the Temple where my name was to be honored."
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said, "I will also remove Judah from My sight, just as I have removed Israel. And I will reject this city which I have chosen, Jerusalem, and the temple of which I said, ‘My name shall be there!’ "
verses.textEn: So the Lord said, "I will remove Judah also from my presence as I removed Israel, and I will reject Jerusalem, the city I chose, and this temple, about which I said, ‘My Name shall be there.’ "

verses.textZh: 约西亚其余的事迹和他所行的一切，不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 约西亚其余的事迹和他所行的一切，不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 约西亚其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Josiah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Josiah’s reign and all his deeds are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Josiah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

verses.textZh: 在约西亚的日子，埃及王法老尼哥上来幼发拉底河帮助 亚述王，约西亚王竟去迎战他，法老看见他的时候，就把他杀死在米吉多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在约西亚的日子，埃及王法老尼哥上来幼发拉底河帮助 亚述王，约西亚王竟去迎战他，法老看见他的时候，就把他杀死在米吉多。
verses.textZhCuv: 约西亚年间，埃及王法老尼哥上到幼发拉底河攻击亚述王；约西亚王去抵挡他。埃及王遇见约西亚在米吉多，就杀了他。
verses.textEnNiv: While Josiah was king, Pharaoh Necho king of Egypt went up to the Euphrates River to help the king of Assyria. King Josiah marched out to meet him in battle, but Necho faced him and killed him at Megiddo.
verses.textEnEsv: In his days Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt went up to the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates. King Josiah went to meet him, and Pharaoh Neco killed him at Megiddo, as soon as he saw him.
verses.textEnNkjv: In his days Pharaoh Necho king of Egypt went to the aid of the king of Assyria, to the River Euphrates; and King Josiah went against him. And PharaohNecho killed him at Megiddo when he confronted him.
verses.textEnNlt: While Josiah was king, Pharaoh Neco, king of Egypt, went to the Euphrates River to help the king of Assyria. King Josiah and his army marched out to fight him, but King Neco killed him when they met at Megiddo.
verses.textEnNasb: In his days Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt went up to the king of Assyria at the river Euphrates. And King Josiah went to meet him, and when Pharaoh Neco saw him he killed him at Megiddo.
verses.textEn: While Josiah was king, Pharaoh Necho king of Egypt went up to the Euphrates River to help the king of Assyria. King Josiah marched out to meet him in battle, but Necho faced him and killed him at Megiddo.

verses.textZh: 他的臣仆把他的尸体从米吉多用马车运载，送到耶路撒冷，把他埋葬在他自己的坟墓里。国民选举约西亚的儿子约哈斯，膏了他，立他接续他父亲作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的臣仆把他的尸体从米吉多用马车运载，送到耶路撒冷，把他埋葬在他自己的坟墓里。国民选举约西亚的儿子约哈斯，膏了他，立他接续他父亲作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的臣仆用车将他的尸首从米吉多送到耶路撒冷，葬在他自己的坟墓里。国民膏约西亚的儿子约哈斯接续他父亲作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Josiah’s servants brought his body in a chariot from Megiddo to Jerusalem and buried him in his own tomb. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz son of Josiah and anointed him and made him king in place of his father.
verses.textEnEsv: And his servants carried him dead in a chariot from Megiddo and brought him to Jerusalem and buried him in his own tomb. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then his servants moved his body in a chariot from Megiddo, brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own tomb. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, anointed him, and made him king in his father’s place.
verses.textEnNlt: Josiah’s officers took his body back in a chariot from Megiddo to Jerusalem and buried him in his own tomb. Then the people of the land anointed Josiah’s son Jehoahaz and made him the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: His servants carried his body in a chariot from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem and buried him in his own tomb. Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah and anointed him and made him king in place of his father.
verses.textEn: Josiah’s servants brought his body in a chariot from Megiddo to Jerusalem and buried him in his own tomb. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz son of Josiah and anointed him and made him king in place of his father.

verses.textZh: 约哈斯登基时是二十三岁，他在耶路撒冷作王三个月。他母亲名叫哈慕他，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约哈斯登基时是二十三岁，他在耶路撒冷作王三个月。他母亲名叫哈慕他，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 约哈斯登基的时候年二十三岁，在耶路撒冷作王三个月。他母亲名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.
verses.textEnEsv: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.
verses.textEnNasb: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned for three months in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.textEn: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，好象他的祖先所行的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，好象他的祖先所行的。
verses.textZhCuv: 约哈斯行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他列祖一切所行的。
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , just as his predecessors had done.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , according to all that his fathers had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his fathers had done.
verses.textEnNlt: He did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight, just as his ancestors had done.
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord, in accordance with all that his forefathers had done.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , just as his predecessors had done.

verses.textZh: 法老尼哥把他囚禁在哈马地的利比拉，使他不能在耶路撒冷作王；又罚了犹大国三千公斤银子和三十公斤金子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老尼哥把他囚禁在哈马地的利比拉，使他不能在耶路撒冷作王；又罚了犹大国三千公斤银子和三十公斤金子。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老尼哥将约哈斯锁禁在哈马地的利比拉，不许他在耶路撒冷作王，又罚犹大国银子一百他连得，金子一他连得。
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh Necho put him in chains at Riblah in the land of Hamath so that he might not reign in Jerusalem, and he imposed on Judah a levy of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
verses.textEnEsv: And Pharaoh Neco put him in bonds at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem, and laid on the land a tribute of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Pharaoh Necho put him in prison at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and he imposed on the land a tribute of one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh Neco put Jehoahaz in prison at Riblah in the land of Hamath to prevent him from ruling in Jerusalem. He also demanded that Judah pay 7,500 pounds of silver and 75 pounds of gold as tribute.
verses.textEnNasb: And Pharaoh Neco imprisoned him at Riblah in the land of Hamath, so that he would not reign in Jerusalem; and he imposed on the land a fine of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
verses.textEn: Pharaoh Necho put him in chains at Riblah in the land of Hamath so that he might not reign in Jerusalem, and he imposed on Judah a levy of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

verses.textZh: 法老尼哥另立约西亚的儿子以利雅敬接续他的父亲约西亚作王，改了他的名字作约雅敬。他俘掳了约哈斯，把他带到埃及，他就死在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老尼哥另立约西亚的儿子以利雅敬接续他的父亲约西亚作王，改了他的名字作约雅敬。他俘掳了约哈斯，把他带到埃及，他就死在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老尼哥立约西亚的儿子以利亚敬接续他父亲约西亚作王，给他改名叫约雅敬，却将约哈斯带到埃及，他就死在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh Necho made Eliakim son of Josiah king in place of his father Josiah and changed Eliakim’s name to Jehoiakim. But he took Jehoahaz and carried him off to Egypt, and there he died.
verses.textEnEsv: And Pharaoh Neco made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the place of Josiah his father, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. But he took Jehoahaz away, and he came to Egypt and died there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pharaoh Necho made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in place of his father Josiah, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. And Pharaoh took Jehoahaz and went to Egypt, and he died there.
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh Neco then installed Eliakim, another of Josiah’s sons, to reign in place of his father, and he changed Eliakim’s name to Jehoiakim. Jehoahaz was taken to Egypt as a prisoner, where he died.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pharaoh Neco made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the place of his father Josiah, and he changed his name to Jehoiakim. But he took Jehoahaz and brought him to Egypt, and he died there.
verses.textEn: Pharaoh Necho made Eliakim son of Josiah king in place of his father Josiah and changed Eliakim’s name to Jehoiakim. But he took Jehoahaz and carried him off to Egypt, and there he died.

verses.textZh: 约雅敬把银子、金子付给法老；为了应付法老的命令，他向全国征收税银，按着他的评估，向每位国民索取金银，好付给法老尼哥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约雅敬把银子、金子付给法老；为了应付法老的命令，他向全国征收税银，按着他的评估，向每位国民索取金银，好付给法老尼哥。
verses.textZhCuv: 约雅敬将金银给法老，遵着法老的命向国民征取金银，按着各人的力量派定，索要金银，好给法老尼哥。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoiakim paid Pharaoh Necho the silver and gold he demanded. In order to do so, he taxed the land and exacted the silver and gold from the people of the land according to their assessments.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh, but he taxed the land to give the money according to the command of Pharaoh. He exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, from everyone according to his assessment, to give it to Pharaoh Neco.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jehoiakim gave the silver and gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give money according to the command of Pharaoh; he exacted the silver and gold from the people of the land, from every one according to his assessment, to give it to Pharaoh Necho.
verses.textEnNlt: In order to get the silver and gold demanded as tribute by Pharaoh Neco, Jehoiakim collected a tax from the people of Judah, requiring them to pay in proportion to their wealth.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jehoiakim gave the silver and gold to Pharaoh, but he assessed the land in order to give the money at the command of Pharaoh. He collected the silver and gold from the people of the land, each according to his assessment, to give to Pharaoh Neco.
verses.textEn: Jehoiakim paid Pharaoh Necho the silver and gold he demanded. In order to do so, he taxed the land and exacted the silver and gold from the people of the land according to their assessments.

verses.textZh: 约雅敬登基的时候是二十五岁，他在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母亲名叫西布大，是鲁玛人毘大雅的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约雅敬登基的时候是二十五岁，他在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母亲名叫西布大，是鲁玛人毘大雅的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 约雅敬登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母亲名叫西布大，是鲁玛人毗大雅的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Zebidah daughter of Pedaiah; she was from Rumah.
verses.textEnEsv: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zebidah the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zebudah the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother was Zebidah, the daughter of Pedaiah from Rumah.
verses.textEnNasb: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned for eleven years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Zebidah the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
verses.textEn: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Zebidah daughter of Pedaiah; she was from Rumah.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，好象他的祖先一切所行的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，好象他的祖先一切所行的。
verses.textZhCuv: 约雅敬行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他列祖一切所行的。
verses.textEnNiv: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord , just as his predecessors had done.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , according to all that his fathers had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his fathers had done.
verses.textEnNlt: He did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight, just as his ancestors had done.
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord, in accordance with all that his forefathers had done.
verses.textEn: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord , just as his predecessors had done.

verses.textZh: 约雅敬在位的时候，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来攻打他，约雅敬就臣服他三年，后来却反悔，背叛他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约雅敬在位的时候，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来攻打他，约雅敬就臣服他三年，后来却反悔，背叛他。
verses.textZhCuv: 约雅敬年间，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒上到犹大；约雅敬服事他三年，然后背叛他。
verses.textEnNiv: During Jehoiakim’s reign, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invaded the land, and Jehoiakim became his vassal for three years. But then he turned against Nebuchadnezzar and rebelled.
verses.textEnEsv: In his days, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant for three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.
verses.textEnNkjv: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his vassal for three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.
verses.textEnNlt: During Jehoiakim’s reign, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon invaded the land of Judah. Jehoiakim surrendered and paid him tribute for three years but then rebelled.
verses.textEnNasb: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant for three years; then he turned and revolted against him.
verses.textEn: During Jehoiakim’s reign, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invaded the land, and Jehoiakim became his vassal for three years. But then he turned against Nebuchadnezzar and rebelled.

verses.textZh: 耶和华差派迦勒底的军队、亚兰的军队、摩押的军队和亚扪人的军队攻打他，他差他们攻击犹大，毁灭它，就像耶和华借着他的仆人众先知预言的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华差派迦勒底的军队、亚兰的军队、摩押的军队和亚扪人的军队攻打他，他差他们攻击犹大，毁灭它，就像耶和华借着他的仆人众先知预言的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华使迦勒底军、亚兰军、摩押军，和亚扪人的军来攻击约雅敬，毁灭犹大，正如耶和华藉他仆人众先知所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord sent Babylonian, Aramean, Moabite and Ammonite raiders against him to destroy Judah, in accordance with the word of the Lord proclaimed by his servants the prophets.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord sent against him bands of the Chaldeans and bands of the Syrians and bands of the Moabites and bands of the Ammonites, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of the Lord that he spoke by his servants the prophets.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord sent against him raiding bands of Chaldeans, bands of Syrians, bands of Moabites, and bands of the people of Ammon; He sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of the Lord which He had spoken by His servants the prophets.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord sent bands of Babylonian, Aramean, Moabite, and Ammonite raiders against Judah to destroy it, just as the Lord had promised through his prophets.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord sent against him bands of Chaldeans, bands of Arameans, bands of Moabites, and bands of Ammonites. He sent them against Judah to destroy it, in accordance with the word of the Lord which He had spoken through His servants the prophets.
verses.textEn: The Lord sent Babylonian, Aramean, Moabite and Ammonite raiders against him to destroy Judah, in accordance with the word of the Lord proclaimed by his servants the prophets.

verses.textZh: 这事临到犹大完全是出于耶和华的命令，因着玛拿西的罪，就是他所行的一切，要把他们从自己面前赶走；
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事临到犹大完全是出于耶和华的命令，因着玛拿西的罪，就是他所行的一切，要把他们从自己面前赶走；
verses.textZhCuv: 这祸临到犹大人，诚然是耶和华所命的，要将他们从自己面前赶出，是因玛拿西所犯的一切罪；
verses.textEnNiv: Surely these things happened to Judah according to the Lord ’s command, in order to remove them from his presence because of the sins of Manasseh and all he had done,
verses.textEnEsv: Surely this came upon Judah at the command of the Lord , to remove them out of his sight, for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he had done,
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely at the commandment of the Lordthis came upon Judah, to remove them from His sight because of the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he had done,
verses.textEnNlt: These disasters happened to Judah because of the Lord ’s command. He had decided to banish Judah from his presence because of the many sins of Manasseh,
verses.textEnNasb: It indeed came upon Judah at the command of the Lord, to remove them from His sight due to the sins of Manasseh, in accordance with everything that he had done,
verses.textEn: Surely these things happened to Judah according to the Lord ’s command, in order to remove them from his presence because of the sins of Manasseh and all he had done,

verses.textZh: 又因着他所流无辜人的血，他使耶路撒冷满了无辜人的血，耶和华决不赦免。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又因着他所流无辜人的血，他使耶路撒冷满了无辜人的血，耶和华决不赦免。
verses.textZhCuv: 又因他流无辜人的血，充满了耶路撒冷；耶和华决不肯赦免。
verses.textEnNiv: including the shedding of innocent blood. For he had filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the Lord was not willing to forgive.
verses.textEnEsv: and also for the innocent blood that he had shed. For he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the Lord would not pardon.
verses.textEnNkjv: and also because of the innocent blood that he had shed; for he had filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, which the Lord would not pardon.
verses.textEnNlt: who had filled Jerusalem with innocent blood. The Lord would not forgive this.
verses.textEnNasb: and also for the innocent blood which he shed, for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; and the Lord was unwilling to forgive.
verses.textEn: including the shedding of innocent blood. For he had filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the Lord was not willing to forgive.

verses.textZh: 约雅敬其余的事迹和他所行的一切，不是都记在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 约雅敬其余的事迹和他所行的一切，不是都记在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 约雅敬其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Jehoiakim’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the deeds of Jehoiakim and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Jehoiakim’s reign and all his deeds are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Jehoiakim’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

verses.textZh: 约雅敬和他的祖先一同长眠，他的儿子约雅斤接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约雅敬和他的祖先一同长眠，他的儿子约雅斤接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 约雅敬与他列祖同睡。他儿子约雅斤接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoiakim rested with his ancestors. And Jehoiachin his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers, and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jehoiakim rested with his fathers. Then Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jehoiakim died, his son Jehoiachin became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jehoiakim lay down with his fathers, and his son Jehoiachin became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Jehoiakim rested with his ancestors. And Jehoiachin his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 埃及王不再从本国出征，因为巴比伦王占据了所有从前属于埃及王的领土，从埃及小河直到幼发拉底河。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及王不再从本国出征，因为巴比伦王占据了所有从前属于埃及王的领土，从埃及小河直到幼发拉底河。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及王不再从他国中出来；因为巴比伦王将埃及王所管之地，从埃及小河直到幼发拉底河都夺去了。
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Egypt did not march out from his own country again, because the king of Babylon had taken all his territory, from the Wadi of Egypt to the Euphrates River.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Egypt did not come again out of his land, for the king of Babylon had taken all that belonged to the king of Egypt from the Brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king of Egypt did not come out of his land anymore, for the king of Babylon had taken all that belonged to the king of Egypt from the Brook of Egypt to the River Euphrates.
verses.textEnNlt: The king of Egypt did not venture out of his country after that, for the king of Babylon captured the entire area formerly claimed by Egypt—from the Brook of Egypt to the Euphrates River.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the king of Egypt did not come out of his land again, because the king of Babylon had taken everything that belonged to the king of Egypt from the brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates.
verses.textEn: The king of Egypt did not march out from his own country again, because the king of Babylon had taken all his territory, from the Wadi of Egypt to the Euphrates River.

verses.textZh: 约雅斤登基的时候是十八岁，他在耶路撒冷作王三个月；他母亲名叫尼护施他，是耶路撒冷人以利拿单的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约雅斤登基的时候是十八岁，他在耶路撒冷作王三个月；他母亲名叫尼护施他，是耶路撒冷人以利拿单的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 约雅斤登基的时候年十八岁，在耶路撒冷作王三个月。他母亲名叫尼护施她，是耶路撒冷人以利拿单的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta daughter of Elnathan; she was from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned for three months in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta daughter of Elnathan; she was from Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，好象他的祖先一切所行的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，好象他的祖先一切所行的。
verses.textZhCuv: 约雅斤行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他父亲一切所行的。
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father had done.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , according to all that his father had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father had done.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoiachin did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight, just as his father had done.
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord, in accordance with all that his father had done.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father had done.

verses.textZh: 那时，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的臣仆来到耶路撒冷，城就被围困。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的臣仆来到耶路撒冷，城就被围困。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的军兵上到耶路撒冷，围困城。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time the officers of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon advanced on Jerusalem and laid siege to it,
verses.textEnEsv: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up to Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.
verses.textEnNkjv: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.
verses.textEnNlt: During Jehoiachin’s reign, the officers of King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon came up against Jerusalem and besieged it.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon went up to Jerusalem, and the city came under siege.
verses.textEn: At that time the officers of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon advanced on Jerusalem and laid siege to it,

verses.textZh: 尼布甲尼撒的臣仆正在围城的时候，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒亲自来到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼布甲尼撒的臣仆正在围城的时候，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒亲自来到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 当他军兵围困城的时候，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒就亲自来了。
verses.textEnNiv: and Nebuchadnezzar himself came up to the city while his officers were besieging it.
verses.textEnEsv: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, as his servants were besieging it.
verses.textEnNlt: Nebuchadnezzar himself arrived at the city during the siege.
verses.textEnNasb: And Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon came to the city, while his servants were besieging it.
verses.textEn: and Nebuchadnezzar himself came up to the city while his officers were besieging it.

verses.textZh: 犹大王约雅斤和他的母亲、众臣仆、众领袖，以及众太监，出城投降巴比伦王。巴比伦王于是捉住他。那时，是巴比伦王在位第八年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王约雅斤和他的母亲、众臣仆、众领袖，以及众太监，出城投降巴比伦王。巴比伦王于是捉住他。那时，是巴比伦王在位第八年。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王约雅斤和他母亲、臣仆、首领、太监一同出城，投降巴比伦王；巴比伦王便拿住他。那时是巴比伦王第八年。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoiachin king of Judah, his mother, his attendants, his nobles and his officials all surrendered to him. In the eighth year of the reign of the king of Babylon, he took Jehoiachin prisoner.
verses.textEnEsv: and Jehoiachin the king of Judah gave himself up to the king of Babylon, himself and his mother and his servants and his officials and his palace officials. The king of Babylon took him prisoner in the eighth year of his reign
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jehoiachin king of Judah, his mother, his servants, his princes, and his officers went out to the king of Babylon; and the king of Babylon, in the eighth year of his reign, took him prisoner.
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Jehoiachin, along with the queen mother, his advisers, his commanders, and his officials, surrendered to the Babylonians. In the eighth year of Nebuchadnezzar’s reign, he took Jehoiachin prisoner.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, his mother, his servants, his commanders, and his officials. And the king of Babylon took him prisoner in the eighth year of his reign.
verses.textEn: Jehoiachin king of Judah, his mother, his attendants, his nobles and his officials all surrendered to him. In the eighth year of the reign of the king of Babylon, he took Jehoiachin prisoner.

verses.textZh: 他又从耶路撒冷把耶和华殿一切宝物和王宫的宝物取去，并且把以色列王所罗门在耶和华殿所做的一切金器都捣毁，就像耶和华所说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又从耶路撒冷把耶和华殿一切宝物和王宫的宝物取去，并且把以色列王所罗门在耶和华殿所做的一切金器都捣毁，就像耶和华所说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦王将耶和华殿和王宫里的宝物都拿去了，将以色列王所罗门所造耶和华殿里的金器都毁坏了，正如耶和华所说的；
verses.textEnNiv: As the Lord had declared, Nebuchadnezzar removed the treasures from the temple of the Lord and from the royal palace, and cut up the gold articles that Solomon king of Israel had made for the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: and carried off all the treasures of the house of the Lord and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold in the temple of the Lord , which Solomon king of Israel had made, as the Lord had foretold.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he carried out from there all the treasures of the house of the Lord and the treasures of the king’s house, and he cut in pieces all the articles of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the Lord, as the Lord had said.
verses.textEnNlt: As the Lord had said beforehand, Nebuchadnezzar carried away all the treasures from the Lord ’s Temple and the royal palace. He stripped away all the gold objects that King Solomon of Israel had placed in the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: He also brought out from there all the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king’s house, and he smashed all the articles of gold that Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the Lord, just as the Lord had said.
verses.textEn: As the Lord had declared, Nebuchadnezzar removed the treasures from the temple of the Lord and from the royal palace, and cut up the gold articles that Solomon king of Israel had made for the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他又掳去耶路撒冷的众民、众领袖，以及英勇的战士共一万人，还有工匠、铁匠；除了国民中最贫穷的以外，没有剩下的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又掳去耶路撒冷的众民、众领袖，以及英勇的战士共一万人，还有工匠、铁匠；除了国民中最贫穷的以外，没有剩下的。
verses.textZhCuv: 又将耶路撒冷的众民和众首领，并所有大能的勇士，共一万人，连一切木匠、铁匠都掳了去；除了国中极贫穷的人以外，没有剩下的；
verses.textEnNiv: He carried all Jerusalem into exile: all the officers and fighting men, and all the skilled workers and artisans—a total of ten thousand. Only the poorest people of the land were left.
verses.textEnEsv: He carried away all Jerusalem and all the officials and all the mighty men of valor, 10,000 captives, and all the craftsmen and the smiths. None remained, except the poorest people of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also he carried into captivity all Jerusalem: all the captains and all the mighty men of valor, ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths. None remained except the poorest people of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: King Nebuchadnezzar took all of Jerusalem captive, including all the commanders and the best of the soldiers, craftsmen, and artisans—10,000 in all. Only the poorest people were left in the land.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he led into exile all the people of Jerusalem and all the commanders and all the valiant warriors, ten thousand exiles, and all the craftsmen and the smiths. None were left except the poorest people of the land.
verses.textEn: He carried all Jerusalem into exile: all the officers and fighting men, and all the skilled workers and artisans—a total of ten thousand. Only the poorest people of the land were left.

verses.textZh: 他把约雅斤掳到巴比伦去，又把太后、后妃、太监和国中的要员都从耶路撒冷掳到巴比伦；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把约雅斤掳到巴比伦去，又把太后、后妃、太监和国中的要员都从耶路撒冷掳到巴比伦；
verses.textZhCuv: 并将约雅斤和王母、后妃、太监，与国中的大官，都从耶路撒冷掳到巴比伦去了；
verses.textEnNiv: Nebuchadnezzar took Jehoiachin captive to Babylon. He also took from Jerusalem to Babylon the king’s mother, his wives, his officials and the prominent people of the land.
verses.textEnEsv: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon. The king’s mother, the king’s wives, his officials, and the chief men of the land he took into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he carried Jehoiachin captive to Babylon. The king’s mother, the king’s wives, his officers, and the mighty of the land he carried into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: Nebuchadnezzar led King Jehoiachin away as a captive to Babylon, along with the queen mother, his wives and officials, and all Jerusalem’s elite.
verses.textEnNasb: So he led Jehoiachin into exile to Babylon; also the king’s mother, the king’s wives, and his officials and the leading men of the land, he led into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon.
verses.textEn: Nebuchadnezzar took Jehoiachin captive to Babylon. He also took from Jerusalem to Babylon the king’s mother, his wives, his officials and the prominent people of the land.

verses.textZh: 还有七千位战士，一千位工匠和铁匠，全都是能作战的勇士，巴比伦王把他们都掳到巴比伦去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有七千位战士，一千位工匠和铁匠，全都是能作战的勇士，巴比伦王把他们都掳到巴比伦去。
verses.textZhCuv: 又将一切勇士七千人和木匠、铁匠一千人，都是能上阵的勇士，全掳到巴比伦去了。
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Babylon also deported to Babylon the entire force of seven thousand fighting men, strong and fit for war, and a thousand skilled workers and artisans.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon all the men of valor, 7,000, and the craftsmen and the metal workers, 1,000, all of them strong and fit for war.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the valiant men, seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths, one thousand, all whowere strong and fit for war, these the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: He also exiled 7,000 of the best troops and 1,000 craftsmen and artisans, all of whom were strong and fit for war.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the valiant men, seven thousand, and the craftsmen and the smiths, a thousand, all strong and fit for war, these too the king of Babylon brought into exile to Babylon.
verses.textEn: The king of Babylon also deported to Babylon the entire force of seven thousand fighting men, strong and fit for war, and a thousand skilled workers and artisans.

verses.textZh: 巴比伦王立约雅斤的叔叔玛探雅接续他作王，并且把玛探雅的名字改为西底家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴比伦王立约雅斤的叔叔玛探雅接续他作王，并且把玛探雅的名字改为西底家。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦王立约雅斤的叔叔玛探雅代替他作王，给玛探雅改名叫西底家。
verses.textEnNiv: He made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s uncle, king in his place and changed his name to Zedekiah.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s uncle, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s uncle, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king of Babylon installed Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s uncle, as the next king, and he changed Mattaniah’s name to Zedekiah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Babylon made his uncle Mattaniah king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.
verses.textEn: He made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s uncle, king in his place and changed his name to Zedekiah.

verses.textZh: 西底家登基的时候是二十一岁，他在耶路撒冷作王十一年；他母亲名叫哈慕他，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西底家登基的时候是二十一岁，他在耶路撒冷作王十一年；他母亲名叫哈慕他，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 西底家登基的时候年二十一岁，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母亲名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.
verses.textEnEsv: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.textEnNlt: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.
verses.textEnNasb: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned for eleven years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.textEn: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，像约雅敬一切所行的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，像约雅敬一切所行的。
verses.textZhCuv: 西底家行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，是照约雅敬一切所行的。
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , just as Jehoiakim had done.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also did evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
verses.textEnNlt: But Zedekiah did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight, just as Jehoiakim had done.
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord, in accordance with everything that Jehoiakim had done.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , just as Jehoiakim had done.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华的怒气向耶路撒冷和犹大发作，直到他把他们从自己的面前赶走。后来，西底家背叛了巴比伦王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华的怒气向耶路撒冷和犹大发作，直到他把他们从自己的面前赶走。后来，西底家背叛了巴比伦王。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此耶和华的怒气在耶路撒冷和犹大发作，以致将人民从自己面前赶出。
verses.textEnNiv: It was because of the Lord ’s anger that all this happened to Jerusalem and Judah, and in the end he thrust them from his presence. Now Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: For because of the anger of the Lord it came to the point in Jerusalem and Judah that he cast them out from his presence. And Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: For because of the anger of the Lordthis happened in Jerusalem and Judah, that He finally cast them out from His presence. Then Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: These things happened because of the Lord ’s anger against the people of Jerusalem and Judah, until he finally banished them from his presence and sent them into exile. Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: For it was due to the anger of the Lordthat this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until He cast them out of His presence. And Zedekiah revolted against the king of Babylon.
verses.textEn: It was because of the Lord ’s anger that all this happened to Jerusalem and Judah, and in the end he thrust them from his presence. Now Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

verses.textZh: 西底家作王第九年十月十日，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领他的全军来攻打耶路撒冷；他们在城外安营，又在四围筑垒攻城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西底家作王第九年十月十日，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领他的全军来攻打耶路撒冷；他们在城外安营，又在四围筑垒攻城。
verses.textZhCuv: 西底家背叛巴比伦王。他作王第九年十月初十日，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领全军来攻击耶路撒冷，对城安营，四围筑垒攻城。
verses.textEnNiv: So in the ninth year of Zedekiah’s reign, on the tenth day of the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his whole army. He encamped outside the city and built siege works all around it.
verses.textEnEsv: And in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came with all his army against Jerusalem and laid siege to it. And they built siegeworks all around it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army came against Jerusalem and encamped against it; and they built a siege wall against it all around.
verses.textEnNlt: So on January 15, during the ninth year of Zedekiah’s reign, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon led his entire army against Jerusalem. They surrounded the city and built siege ramps against its walls.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the ninth year of his reign, on the tenth day of the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, camped against it, and built a siege wall all around it.
verses.textEn: So in the ninth year of Zedekiah’s reign, on the tenth day of the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his whole army. He encamped outside the city and built siege works all around it.

verses.textZh: 于是，城被围困，直到西底家王第十一年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，城被围困，直到西底家王第十一年。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是城被围困，直到西底家王十一年。
verses.textEnNiv: The city was kept under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
verses.textEnEsv: So the city was besieged till the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
verses.textEnNlt: Jerusalem was kept under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah’s reign.
verses.textEnNasb: So the city was under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
verses.textEn: The city was kept under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

verses.textZh: 四月九日，城里饥荒非常严重，甚至那地的人民都断了粮食。
verses.textZhCnvs: 四月九日，城里饥荒非常严重，甚至那地的人民都断了粮食。
verses.textZhCuv: 四月初九日，城里有大饥荒，甚至百姓都没有粮食。
verses.textEnNiv: By the ninth day of the fourth month the famine in the city had become so severe that there was no food for the people to eat.
verses.textEnEsv: On the ninth day of the fourth month the famine was so severe in the city that there was no food for the people of the land.
