verses.textEnNkjv: By the ninth day of the fourth month the famine had become so severe in the city that there was no food for the people of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: By July 18 in the eleventh year of Zedekiah’s reign, the famine in the city had become very severe, and the last of the food was entirely gone.
verses.textEnNasb: On the ninth day of the fourth month the famine was so severe in the city that there was no food for the people of the land.
verses.textEn: By the ninth day of the fourth month the famine in the city had become so severe that there was no food for the people to eat.

verses.textZh: 城终于被攻破了，所有的战士就在夜间从靠近王的花园的两墙中间的那门，逃跑出城。那时迦勒底人在四围攻城；他们就往亚拉巴的方向逃走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城终于被攻破了，所有的战士就在夜间从靠近王的花园的两墙中间的那门，逃跑出城。那时迦勒底人在四围攻城；他们就往亚拉巴的方向逃走。
verses.textZhCuv: 城被攻破，一切兵丁就在夜间从靠近王园两城中间的门逃跑。迦勒底人正在四围攻城，王就向亚拉巴逃走。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the city wall was broken through, and the whole army fled at night through the gate between the two walls near the king’s garden, though the Babylonians were surrounding the city. They fled toward the Arabah,
verses.textEnEsv: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, by the king’s garden, and the Chaldeans were around the city. And they went in the direction of the Arabah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the city wall was broken through, and all the men of war fled at night by way of the gate between two walls, which was by the king’s garden, even though the Chaldeans were still encamped all around against the city. And theking went by way of the plain.
verses.textEnNlt: Then a section of the city wall was broken down. Since the city was surrounded by the Babylonians, the soldiers waited for nightfall and escaped through the gate between the two walls behind the king’s garden. Then they headed toward the Jordan Valley.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the city was broken into, and all the men of war fled by night by way of the gate between the two walls that were beside the king’s garden, though the Chaldeans were all around the city. And they went by way of the Arabah.
verses.textEn: Then the city wall was broken through, and the whole army fled at night through the gate between the two walls near the king’s garden, though the Babylonians were surrounding the city. They fled toward the Arabah,

verses.textZh: 迦勒底人的军队追赶王，在耶利哥的原野上把他追上了；他的全军都离开他四散了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦勒底人的军队追赶王，在耶利哥的原野上把他追上了；他的全军都离开他四散了。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒底的军队追赶王，在耶利哥的平原追上他；他的全军都离开他四散了。
verses.textEnNiv: but the Babylonian army pursued the king and overtook him in the plains of Jericho. All his soldiers were separated from him and scattered,
verses.textEnEsv: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king and overtook him in the plains of Jericho, and all his army was scattered from him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king, and they overtook him in the plains of Jericho. All his army was scattered from him.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Babylonian troops chased the king and overtook him on the plains of Jericho, for his men had all deserted him and scattered.
verses.textEnNasb: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king and overtook him in the plains of Jericho, and all his army was scattered from him.
verses.textEn: but the Babylonian army pursued the king and overtook him in the plains of Jericho. All his soldiers were separated from him and scattered,

verses.textZh: 他们把王擒住，把他解到利比拉巴比伦王那里；他们就宣判他的罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把王擒住，把他解到利比拉巴比伦王那里；他们就宣判他的罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒底人就拿住王，带他到在利比拉的巴比伦王那里审判他。
verses.textEnNiv: and he was captured. He was taken to the king of Babylon at Riblah, where sentence was pronounced on him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they captured the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah, and they passed sentence on him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they took the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah, and they pronounced judgment on him.
verses.textEnNlt: They captured the king and took him to the king of Babylon at Riblah, where they pronounced judgment upon Zedekiah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they captured the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah, and he passed sentence on him.
verses.textEn: and he was captured. He was taken to the king of Babylon at Riblah, where sentence was pronounced on him.

verses.textZh: 他们又在西底家眼前杀了他的众子，并且把西底家的眼睛弄瞎，然后用铜炼锁住他，把他带到巴比伦去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又在西底家眼前杀了他的众子，并且把西底家的眼睛弄瞎，然后用铜炼锁住他，把他带到巴比伦去。
verses.textZhCuv: 在西底家眼前杀了他的众子，并且剜了西底家的眼睛，用铜链锁着他，带到巴比伦去。
verses.textEnNiv: They killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. Then they put out his eyes, bound him with bronze shackles and took him to Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: They slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah and bound him in chains and took him to Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, put out the eyes of Zedekiah, bound him with bronze fetters, and took him to Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: They made Zedekiah watch as they slaughtered his sons. Then they gouged out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him in bronze chains, and led him away to Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: And they slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, then put out Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him with bronze shackles, and brought him to Babylon.
verses.textEn: They killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. Then they put out his eyes, bound him with bronze shackles and took him to Babylon.

verses.textZh: 五月七日，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒第十九年，巴比伦王的大臣，护卫长尼布撒拉旦来到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 五月七日，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒第十九年，巴比伦王的大臣，护卫长尼布撒拉旦来到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒十九年五月初七日，巴比伦王的臣仆、护卫长尼布撒拉旦来到耶路撒冷，
verses.textEnNiv: On the seventh day of the fifth month, in the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard, an official of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: In the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month—that was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon—Nebuzaradan, the captain of the bodyguard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month (which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon), Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: On August 14 of that year, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar’s reign, Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard and an official of the Babylonian king, arrived in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Now on the seventh day of the fifth month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguards, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: On the seventh day of the fifth month, in the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard, an official of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 他放火焚烧耶和华的殿和王宫，以及耶路撒冷一切房屋；一切高大的房屋，他都放火烧了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他放火焚烧耶和华的殿和王宫，以及耶路撒冷一切房屋；一切高大的房屋，他都放火烧了。
verses.textZhCuv: 用火焚烧耶和华的殿和王宫，又焚烧耶路撒冷的房屋，就是各大户家的房屋。
verses.textEnNiv: He set fire to the temple of the Lord , the royal palace and all the houses of Jerusalem. Every important building he burned down.
verses.textEnEsv: And he burned the house of the Lord and the king’s house and all the houses of Jerusalem; every great house he burned down.
verses.textEnNkjv: He burned the house of the Lord and the king’s house; all the houses of Jerusalem, that is, all the houses of the great, he burned with fire.
verses.textEnNlt: He burned down the Temple of the Lord , the royal palace, and all the houses of Jerusalem. He destroyed all the important buildings in the city.
verses.textEnNasb: And he burned the house of the Lord, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem; even every great house he burned with fire.
verses.textEn: He set fire to the temple of the Lord , the royal palace and all the houses of Jerusalem. Every important building he burned down.

verses.textZh: 跟随护卫长的迦勒底人全军拆毁了耶路撒冷周围的城墙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 跟随护卫长的迦勒底人全军拆毁了耶路撒冷周围的城墙。
verses.textZhCuv: 跟从护卫长迦勒底的全军就拆毁耶路撒冷四围的城墙。
verses.textEnNiv: The whole Babylonian army under the commander of the imperial guard broke down the walls around Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down the walls around Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the army of the Chaldeans who werewith the captain of the guard broke down the walls of Jerusalem all around.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he supervised the entire Babylonian army as they tore down the walls of Jerusalem on every side.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the army of the Chaldeans who were with the captain of the bodyguards tore down the walls around Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: The whole Babylonian army under the commander of the imperial guard broke down the walls around Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 至于城中剩下的人民，和已经向巴比伦王投降的人，以及剩下的民众，护卫长尼布撒拉旦都掳了去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于城中剩下的人民，和已经向巴比伦王投降的人，以及剩下的民众，护卫长尼布撒拉旦都掳了去。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时护卫长尼布撒拉旦将城里所剩下的百姓，并已经投降巴比伦王的人，以及大众所剩下的人，都掳去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard carried into exile the people who remained in the city, along with the rest of the populace and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: And the rest of the people who were left in the city and the deserters who had deserted to the king of Babylon, together with the rest of the multitude, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried into exile.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive the rest of the people who remained in the city and the defectors who had deserted to the king of Babylon, with the rest of the multitude.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, took as exiles the rest of the people who remained in the city, the defectors who had declared their allegiance to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the population.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Nebuzaradan, the captain of the bodyguards, led into exile the rest of the people who were left in the city and the deserters who had deserted to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the people.
verses.textEn: Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard carried into exile the people who remained in the city, along with the rest of the populace and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon.

verses.textZh: 至于那地最贫穷的人，护卫长把他们留下，去修理葡萄园和耕种田地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于那地最贫穷的人，护卫长把他们留下，去修理葡萄园和耕种田地。
verses.textZhCuv: 但护卫长留下些民中最穷的，使他们修理葡萄园，耕种田地。
verses.textEnNiv: But the commander left behind some of the poorest people of the land to work the vineyards and fields.
verses.textEnEsv: But the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to be vinedressers and plowmen.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the captain of the guard left some of the poor of the land as vinedressers and farmers.
verses.textEnNlt: But the captain of the guard allowed some of the poorest people to stay behind to care for the vineyards and fields.
verses.textEnNasb: But the captain of the bodyguards left some of the poorest of the land to be vinedressers and farmers.
verses.textEn: But the commander left behind some of the poorest people of the land to work the vineyards and fields.

verses.textZh: 耶和华殿的铜柱，以及耶和华殿的铜座和铜海，迦勒底人都打碎了，把铜运到巴比伦去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华殿的铜柱，以及耶和华殿的铜座和铜海，迦勒底人都打碎了，把铜运到巴比伦去。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华殿的铜柱，并耶和华殿的盆座和铜海，迦勒底人都打碎了，将那铜运到巴比伦去了，
verses.textEnNiv: The Babylonians broke up the bronze pillars, the movable stands and the bronze Sea that were at the temple of the Lord and they carried the bronze to Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: And the pillars of bronze that were in the house of the Lord , and the stands and the bronze sea that were in the house of the Lord , the Chaldeans broke in pieces and carried the bronze to Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: The bronze pillars that were in the house of the Lord, and the carts and the bronze Sea that were in the house of the Lord, the Chaldeans broke in pieces, and carried their bronze to Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: The Babylonians broke up the bronze pillars in front of the Lord ’s Temple, the bronze water carts, and the great bronze basin called the Sea, and they carried all the bronze away to Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Chaldeans smashed to pieces the bronze pillars which were in the house of the Lord, and the stands and the bronze Sea which were in the house of the Lord, and carried the bronze to Babylon.
verses.textEn: The Babylonians broke up the bronze pillars, the movable stands and the bronze Sea that were at the temple of the Lord and they carried the bronze to Babylon.

verses.textZh: 他们又把锅、铲子、烛剪、碟子和敬拜用的一切铜器都拿去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又把锅、铲子、烛剪、碟子和敬拜用的一切铜器都拿去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 又带去锅、铲子、蜡剪、调羹，并所用的一切铜器，
verses.textEnNiv: They also took away the pots, shovels, wick trimmers, dishes and all the bronze articles used in the temple service.
verses.textEnEsv: And they took away the pots and the shovels and the snuffers and the dishes for incense and all the vessels of bronze used in the temple service,
verses.textEnNkjv: They also took away the pots, the shovels, the trimmers, the spoons, and all the bronze utensils with which the priests ministered.
verses.textEnNlt: They also took all the ash buckets, shovels, lamp snuffers, ladles, and all the other bronze articles used for making sacrifices at the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: And they took away the pots, the shovels, the shears, the spoons, and all the bronze utensils which were used in temple service.
verses.textEn: They also took away the pots, shovels, wick trimmers, dishes and all the bronze articles used in the temple service.

verses.textZh: 此外，火鼎和碗，无论是金的或是银的，护卫长都拿去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 此外，火鼎和碗，无论是金的或是银的，护卫长都拿去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 火鼎、碗，无论金的银的，护卫长也都带去了。
verses.textEnNiv: The commander of the imperial guard took away the censers and sprinkling bowls—all that were made of pure gold or silver.
verses.textEnEsv: the fire pans also and the bowls. What was of gold the captain of the guard took away as gold, and what was of silver, as silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: The firepans and the basins, the things of solid gold and solid silver, the captain of the guard took away.
verses.textEnNlt: The captain of the guard also took the incense burners and basins, and all the other articles made of pure gold or silver.
verses.textEnNasb: The captain of the bodyguards also took away the firepans and the basins, what was fine gold and what was fine silver.
verses.textEn: The commander of the imperial guard took away the censers and sprinkling bowls—all that were made of pure gold or silver.

verses.textZh: 所罗门为耶和华殿所做的两根铜柱、一个铜海和十个铜座，这一切器皿的铜，重得无法可称。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门为耶和华殿所做的两根铜柱、一个铜海和十个铜座，这一切器皿的铜，重得无法可称。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门为耶和华殿所造的两根铜柱、一个铜海，和几个盆座，这一切的铜，多得无法可称。
verses.textEnNiv: The bronze from the two pillars, the Sea and the movable stands, which Solomon had made for the temple of the Lord , was more than could be weighed.
verses.textEnEsv: As for the two pillars, the one sea, and the stands that Solomon had made for the house of the Lord , the bronze of all these vessels was beyond weight.
verses.textEnNkjv: The two pillars, one Sea, and the carts, which Solomon had made for the house of the Lord, the bronze of all these articles was beyond measure.
verses.textEnNlt: The weight of the bronze from the two pillars, the Sea, and the water carts was too great to be measured. These things had been made for the Lord ’s Temple in the days of Solomon.
verses.textEnNasb: The two pillars, the one Sea, and the stands which Solomon had made for the house of the Lord— the bronze of all these articles was too heavy to weigh.
verses.textEn: The bronze from the two pillars, the Sea and the movable stands, which Solomon had made for the temple of the Lord , was more than could be weighed.

verses.textZh: 铜柱每根高八公尺，柱上有铜柱头；柱头高一公尺三公寸，柱头四周有网子和石榴都是铜的；另一根柱子同样也有网子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 铜柱每根高八公尺，柱上有铜柱头；柱头高一公尺三公寸，柱头四周有网子和石榴都是铜的；另一根柱子同样也有网子。
verses.textZhCuv: 这一根柱子高十八肘，柱上有铜顶，高三肘；铜顶的周围有网子和石榴，都是铜的。那一根柱子，照此一样，也有网子。
verses.textEnNiv: Each pillar was eighteen cubits high. The bronze capital on top of one pillar was three cubits high and was decorated with a network and pomegranates of bronze all around. The other pillar, with its network, was similar.
verses.textEnEsv: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and on it was a capital of bronze. The height of the capital was three cubits. A latticework and pomegranates, all of bronze, were all around the capital. And the second pillar had the same, with the latticework.
verses.textEnNkjv: The height of one pillar was eighteen cubits, and the capital on it was of bronze. The height of the capital was three cubits, and the network and pomegranates all around the capital were all of bronze. The second pillar was the same, with a network.
verses.textEnNlt: Each of the pillars was 27 feet tall. The bronze capital on top of each pillar was 7-1/2 feet high and was decorated with a network of bronze pomegranates all the way around.
verses.textEnNasb: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and a bronze capital was on it; the height of the capital was three cubits, with latticework and pomegranates on the capital all around, all of bronze. And the second pillar was like these, same features with latticework.
verses.textEn: Each pillar was eighteen cubits high. The bronze capital on top of one pillar was three cubits high and was decorated with a network and pomegranates of bronze all around. The other pillar, with its network, was similar.

verses.textZh: 护卫长拿住祭司长西莱雅、副祭司长西番亚和三个守门的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 护卫长拿住祭司长西莱雅、副祭司长西番亚和三个守门的；
verses.textZhCuv: 护卫长拿住大祭司西莱雅、副祭司西番亚，和三个把门的，
verses.textEnNiv: The commander of the guard took as prisoners Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the priest next in rank and the three doorkeepers.
verses.textEnEsv: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest and Zephaniah the second priest and the three keepers of the threshold;
verses.textEnNkjv: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three doorkeepers.
verses.textEnNlt: Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, took with him as prisoners Seraiah the high priest, Zephaniah the priest of the second rank, and the three chief gatekeepers.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the captain of the bodyguards took Seraiah the chief priest and Zephaniah the second priest, with the three doorkeepers.
verses.textEn: The commander of the guard took as prisoners Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the priest next in rank and the three doorkeepers.

verses.textZh: 又从城里拿住一个管理军兵的官长，并且在城里搜获常见王面的五个人，和一个负责召募当地人民的军长书记，又在城中搜获六十个当地的人民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从城里拿住一个管理军兵的官长，并且在城里搜获常见王面的五个人，和一个负责召募当地人民的军长书记，又在城中搜获六十个当地的人民。
verses.textZhCuv: 又从城中拿住一个管理兵丁的官 ，并在城里所遇常见王面的五个人和检点国民军长的书记，以及城里遇见的国民六十个人。
verses.textEnNiv: Of those still in the city, he took the officer in charge of the fighting men, and five royal advisers. He also took the secretary who was chief officer in charge of conscripting the people of the land and sixty of the conscripts who were found in the city.
verses.textEnEsv: and from the city he took an officer who had been in command of the men of war, and five men of the king’s council who were found in the city; and the secretary of the commander of the army, who mustered the people of the land; and sixty men of the people of the land, who were found in the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also took out of the city an officer who had charge of the men of war, five men of the king’s close associates who were found in the city, the chief recruiting officer of the army, who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land whowere found in the city.
verses.textEnNlt: And from among the people still hiding in the city, he took an officer who had been in charge of the Judean army; five of the king’s personal advisers; the army commander’s chief secretary, who was in charge of recruitment; and sixty other citizens.
verses.textEnNasb: And from the city he took one official who was overseer of the men of war, and five of the king’s advisers who were found in the city; and the scribe of the captain of the army who mustered the people of the land; and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city.
verses.textEn: Of those still in the city, he took the officer in charge of the fighting men, and five royal advisers. He also took the secretary who was chief officer in charge of conscripting the people of the land and sixty of the conscripts who were found in the city.

verses.textZh: 护卫长尼布撒拉旦把他们拿住，带到利比拉巴比伦王那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 护卫长尼布撒拉旦把他们拿住，带到利比拉巴比伦王那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 护卫长尼布撒拉旦将这些人带到在利比拉的巴比伦王那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Nebuzaradan the commander took them all and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
verses.textEnEsv: And Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard, took these and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
verses.textEnNlt: Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, took them all to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
verses.textEnNasb: Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguards took them and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
verses.textEn: Nebuzaradan the commander took them all and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.

verses.textZh: 巴比伦王击杀他们，在哈马地的利比拉把他们处死。这样，犹大人被掳，离开了他们的国土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴比伦王击杀他们，在哈马地的利比拉把他们处死。这样，犹大人被掳，离开了他们的国土。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦王就把他们击杀在哈马地的利比拉。这样，犹大人被掳去离开本地。
verses.textEnNiv: There at Riblah, in the land of Hamath, the king had them executed. So Judah went into captivity, away from her land.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Babylon struck them down and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was taken into exile out of its land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king of Babylon struck them and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Judah was carried away captive from its own land.
verses.textEnNlt: And there at Riblah, in the land of Hamath, the king of Babylon had them all put to death. So the people of Judah were sent into exile from their land.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Babylon struck them down and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah went into exile from its land.
verses.textEn: There at Riblah, in the land of Hamath, the king had them executed. So Judah went into captivity, away from her land.

verses.textZh: 至于在犹大地剩下来的人民，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒留下来的，巴比伦王委派沙番的孙子、亚希甘的儿子基大利管理他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于在犹大地剩下来的人民，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒留下来的，巴比伦王委派沙番的孙子、亚希甘的儿子基大利管理他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于犹大国剩下的民，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒所剩下的，巴比伦王立了沙番的孙子、亚希甘的儿子基大利作他们的省长。
verses.textEnNiv: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, to be over the people he had left behind in Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: And over the people who remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, he appointed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, son of Shaphan, governor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor over the people who remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left.
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Nebuchadnezzar appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam and grandson of Shaphan as governor over the people he had left in Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the people who were left in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, he appointed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan over them.
verses.textEn: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, to be over the people he had left behind in Judah.

verses.textZh: 众将领和他们的士兵，听见巴比伦王委派了基大利，他们就来到米斯巴去见基大利；其中有尼探雅的儿子以实玛利、加利亚的儿子约哈难、尼陀法人单户篾的儿子西莱雅、玛迦人的儿子雅撒尼亚，以及他们的士兵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众将领和他们的士兵，听见巴比伦王委派了基大利，他们就来到米斯巴去见基大利；其中有尼探雅的儿子以实玛利、加利亚的儿子约哈难、尼陀法人单户篾的儿子西莱雅、玛迦人的儿子雅撒尼亚，以及他们的士兵。
verses.textZhCuv: 众军长和属他们的人听见巴比伦王立了基大利作省长，于是军长尼探雅的儿子以实玛利、加利亚的儿子约哈难、尼陀法人单户篾的儿子西莱雅、玛迦人的儿子雅撒尼亚，和属他们的人都到米斯巴见基大利。
verses.textEnNiv: When all the army officers and their men heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah as governor, they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah—Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, Jaazaniah the son of the Maakathite, and their men.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when all the captains and their men heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah governor, they came with their men to Gedaliah at Mizpah, namely, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah—Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, Johanan the son of Careah, Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.
verses.textEnNlt: When all the army commanders and their men learned that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah as governor, they went to see him at Mizpah. These included Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, Jezaniah son of the Maacathite, and all their men.
verses.textEnNasb: When all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah, namely, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, Johanan the son of Kareah, Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.
verses.textEn: When all the army officers and their men heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah as governor, they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah—Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, Jaazaniah the son of the Maakathite, and their men.

verses.textZh: 基大利向他们和他们的士兵起誓，又对他们说："你们不必惧怕迦勒底的官员，只管住在这地，服事巴比伦王，就可以平安无事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 基大利向他们和他们的士兵起誓，又对他们说："你们不必惧怕迦勒底的官员，只管住在这地，服事巴比伦王，就可以平安无事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 基大利向他们和属他们的人起誓说：「你们不必惧怕迦勒底臣仆，只管住在这地服事巴比伦王，就可以得福。」
verses.textEnNiv: Gedaliah took an oath to reassure them and their men. "Do not be afraid of the Babylonian officials," he said. "Settle down in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well with you."
verses.textEnEsv: And Gedaliah swore to them and their men, saying, "Do not be afraid because of the Chaldean officials. Live in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Gedaliah took an oath before them and their men, and said to them, "Do not be afraid of the servants of the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you."
verses.textEnNlt: Gedaliah vowed to them that the Babylonian officials meant them no harm. "Don’t be afraid of them. Live in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and all will go well for you," he promised.
verses.textEnNasb: And Gedaliah swore to them and their men and said to them, "Do not be afraid of the servants of the Chaldeans; live in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well for you."
verses.textEn: Gedaliah took an oath to reassure them and their men. "Do not be afraid of the Babylonian officials," he said. "Settle down in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well with you."

verses.textZh: 但在七月的时候，王裔以利沙玛的孙子、尼探雅的儿子以实玛利，带了十个人和他一起，他们袭击基大利，把他杀死，和他一起在米斯巴的犹大人和迦勒底人，也被杀死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但在七月的时候，王裔以利沙玛的孙子、尼探雅的儿子以实玛利，带了十个人和他一起，他们袭击基大利，把他杀死，和他一起在米斯巴的犹大人和迦勒底人，也被杀死。
verses.textZhCuv: 七月间，宗室以利沙玛的孙子、尼探雅的儿子以实玛利带着十个人来，杀了基大利和同他在米斯巴的犹大人与迦勒底人。
verses.textEnNiv: In the seventh month, however, Ishmael son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, who was of royal blood, came with ten men and assassinated Gedaliah and also the men of Judah and the Babylonians who were with him at Mizpah.
verses.textEnEsv: But in the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, son of Elishama, of the royal family, came with ten men and struck down Gedaliah and put him to death along with the Jews and the Chaldeans who were with him at Mizpah.
verses.textEnNkjv: But it happened in the seventh month that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal family, came with ten men and struck and killed Gedaliah, the Jews, as well as the Chaldeans who were with him at Mizpah.
verses.textEnNlt: But in midautumn of that year, Ishmael son of Nethaniah and grandson of Elishama, who was a member of the royal family, went to Mizpah with ten men and killed Gedaliah. He also killed all the Judeans and Babylonians who were with him at Mizpah.
verses.textEnNasb: But it happened in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal family, came with ten men and struck Gedaliah down so that he died along with the Jews and the Chaldeans who were with him at Mizpah.
verses.textEn: In the seventh month, however, Ishmael son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, who was of royal blood, came with ten men and assassinated Gedaliah and also the men of Judah and the Babylonians who were with him at Mizpah.

verses.textZh: 因此，众民无论大小，以及众将领都起来逃往埃及去，因为他们惧怕迦勒底人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，众民无论大小，以及众将领都起来逃往埃及去，因为他们惧怕迦勒底人。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是众民，无论大小，连众军长；因为惧怕迦勒底人，都起身往埃及去了。
verses.textEnNiv: At this, all the people from the least to the greatest, together with the army officers, fled to Egypt for fear of the Babylonians.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the forces arose and went to Egypt, for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the people, small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose and went to Egypt; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.
verses.textEnNlt: Then all the people of Judah, from the least to the greatest, as well as the army commanders, fled in panic to Egypt, for they were afraid of what the Babylonians would do to them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the people, from the small to the great, and the captains of the forces set out and came to Egypt; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.
verses.textEn: At this, all the people from the least to the greatest, together with the army officers, fled to Egypt for fear of the Babylonians.

verses.textZh: 犹大王约雅斤被掳后第三十七年，就是巴比伦王以未．米罗达登基的那一年，十二月二十七日，他恩待 犹大王约雅斤，把他从狱中领出来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王约雅斤被掳后第三十七年，就是巴比伦王以未．米罗达登基的那一年，十二月二十七日，他恩待 犹大王约雅斤，把他从狱中领出来，
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王约雅斤被掳后三十七年，巴比伦王以未‧米罗达元年十二月二十七日，使犹大王约雅斤抬头，提他出监；
verses.textEnNiv: In the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the year Awel-Marduk became king of Babylon, he released Jehoiachin king of Judah from prison. He did this on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month.
verses.textEnEsv: And in the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, Evil-merodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, graciously freed Jehoiachin king of Judah from prison.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass in the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, that Evil-Merodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, released Jehoiachin king of Judah from prison.
verses.textEnNlt: In the thirty-seventh year of the exile of King Jehoiachin of Judah, Evil-merodach ascended to the Babylonian throne. He was kind to Jehoiachin and released him from prison on April 2 of that year.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about in the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon, in the year that he became king, released Jehoiachin king of Judah from prison;
verses.textEn: In the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the year Awel-Marduk became king of Babylon, he released Jehoiachin king of Judah from prison. He did this on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month.

verses.textZh: 并且安慰他，使他的地位高过和他一起在巴比伦的众王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且安慰他，使他的地位高过和他一起在巴比伦的众王。
verses.textZhCuv: 又对他说恩言，使他的位高过与他一同在巴比伦众王的位，
verses.textEnNiv: He spoke kindly to him and gave him a seat of honor higher than those of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: And he spoke kindly to him and gave him a seat above the seats of the kings who were with him in Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: He spoke kindly to him, and gave him a more prominent seat than those of the kings who were with him in Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: He spoke kindly to Jehoiachin and gave him a higher place than all the other exiled kings in Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: and he spoke kindly to him and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon.
verses.textEn: He spoke kindly to him and gave him a seat of honor higher than those of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.

verses.textZh: 又换下他的囚衣，赐他终生常在王面前吃饭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又换下他的囚衣，赐他终生常在王面前吃饭。
verses.textZhCuv: 给他脱了囚服。他终身常在巴比伦王面前吃饭。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jehoiachin put aside his prison clothes and for the rest of his life ate regularly at the king’s table.
verses.textEnEsv: So Jehoiachin put off his prison garments. And every day of his life he dined regularly at the king’s table,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jehoiachin changed from his prison garments, and he ate bread regularly before the king all the days of his life.
verses.textEnNlt: He supplied Jehoiachin with new clothes to replace his prison garb and allowed him to dine in the king’s presence for the rest of his life.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jehoiachin changed his prison clothes, and had his meals in the king’s presence regularly all the days of his life;
verses.textEn: So Jehoiachin put aside his prison clothes and for the rest of his life ate regularly at the king’s table.

verses.textZh: 他的生活费用，在他一生的年日中，每日不断由王供应。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的生活费用，在他一生的年日中，每日不断由王供应。
verses.textZhCuv: 王赐他所需用的食物，日日赐他一分，终身都是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: Day by day the king gave Jehoiachin a regular allowance as long as he lived.
verses.textEnEsv: and for his allowance, a regular allowance was given him by the king, according to his daily needs, as long as he lived.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as for his provisions, therewas a regular ration given him by the king, a portion for each day, all the days of his life.
verses.textEnNlt: So the king gave him a regular food allowance as long as he lived.
verses.textEnNasb: and as his allowance, a regular allowance was given to him by the king, a portion for each day, all the days of his life.
verses.textEn: Day by day the king gave Jehoiachin a regular allowance as long as he lived.
